name: Seasonal Youth Apprenticeship
org: 1001 Colors (Cincinnati public art and youth workforce development)
what_you_do: You work on a team led by Teaching Artists. The team makes public art such as murals. You get career development training. Work may also include design, photography, film, screen printing and writing.
deadline_text: The 2026 Application and Interview Weekend has passed. The page says 2027 details will be posted by late 2026.

name: ACCEL Middle College (East Side Union / Evergreen Valley College)
org: East Side Union High School District
what_you_do: Sophomores and juniors attend college classes in the morning. The college is Evergreen Valley College. High school classes are in the afternoon.
deadline_text: Recruitment meetings are held in the evening; dates not posted on the program page.

name: Youth Innovation Program (WIOA In-School Youth)
what_you_do: You get help getting into college and jobs. You also get help with work-based learning, such as internships and apprenticeships. You get mentoring and support services.
grades: Currently in high school or college
deadline_text: The page does not state an application window or ongoing intake.

name: After School Matters (paid apprenticeships and assistantships)
what_you_do: Chicago high schoolers join hands-on programs. Areas include arts, communications and leadership, sports, STEM and skilled trades. You earn a stipend. Most programs need an interview, in person or virtual.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications opened Aug 26. Fall programs started Sept 28, 2026, and the fall interviews (Sept 21 to 23) have passed, so the fall round is over. Spring 2027 applications open in January, and summer 2027 applications open in April (per the session timeline on the apply page).

name: Discovery Station volunteer, Udvar-Hazy Center
org: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum
what_you_do: Run hands-on Discovery Station tables about space, astronomy and aeronautics and answer visitors' questions at the Udvar-Hazy Center.
deadline_text: No application window or recruiting dates are stated on the page.

name: California Girls State (American Legion Auxiliary)
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of California
city: California (session location not stated on the site)
what_you_do: You spend a week at a summer camp for 11th graders from across the state. You learn how city, county and state government work. You learn how elections run, and you write a bill.
grades: 11th grade (the site says each delegate is an 11th grade student during the 2026-27 school year)
deadline_text: 2027 (84th) session: dates and location not posted yet. The online form for Unit-selected 2027 delegates and alternates opens February 2027. The form for Department (statewide) alternate applicants opens April 2027. Last session: June 22 to 27, 2026.

name: Aquatic Internship Program
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks, Aquatics
what_you_do: You help pool staff and learn how to keep swimmers safe. You get safety and rescue training and a mentor from the aquatics team.
deadline_text: The 2026 program page said applications close May 8, or sooner if the program fills. Interviews began the week of May 15. The next year is not posted.

name: City of Alameda Summer Internship
what_you_do: You work a summer internship with the City of Alameda. The program page does not list the tasks.
deadline_text: The program page says details are usually posted in March and applications are due in mid-May. It gives no year.

name: Alameda County Community Food Bank: Volunteer
what_you_do: Sign up for volunteer shifts at the food bank warehouse in Oakland. Tasks and times are listed on the volunteer calendar.
deadline_text: No deadline. Pick a shift on the volunteer calendar.

name: District 1 Internship and Volunteer Program
org: Alameda County Board of Supervisors, District 1
city: Pleasanton, CA (serves Dublin, Fremont, Livermore, Pleasanton and Sunol)
what_you_do: You help with a project for the community. You also help the office with office work and research. You go to community events for the office.
deadline_text: The application is open for School Year 26-27. The program page lists no deadline.

name: Alameda County Fair Seasonal Jobs
what_you_do: You work at the county fair. Jobs include tickets at the gate, exhibits, the animal barns, parking, the tram and event work.
deadline_text: The program page says 2027 information is coming soon. Hiring dates and the fair dates are not posted yet.

name: Student Intern Program
what_you_do: You join a county tech team for the summer. You help build apps and tools for the County. You may work on apps, websites, tech help, networks, security or servers.
grades: High school, college or STEM trade school students
deadline_text: Applications for Cohort 2026 are closed. The program page says it will post more information in February or March 2027.

name: Alameda County Library Teen Volunteers (Fremont, Newark, Union City)
city: Fremont, Newark and Union City, CA
what_you_do: The library's Volunteer with the Library page links to volunteer opportunities on its Better Impact portal. The page does not say which roles take teens.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page.

name: Alameda Free Library Teen Advisory Group (TAG)
what_you_do: You suggest ideas for library events and projects. You earn 1 service hour per meeting.
deadline_text: The page states no deadline or intake dates.

name: Alameda Free Library Teen Volunteers (Book Reviewers and Coding with LEGO)
what_you_do: You can write teen book reviews. Each review is 1 service hour, one a month. Or you can help younger kids with LEGO coding activities.
deadline_text: The page states no deadline or intake dates.

name: HEAL Program High School Internships (HealthPATH, Highland Hospital)
city: Oakland, CA (Wilma Chan Highland Hospital Campus)
what_you_do: You rotate through hospital units like the ER, the ICU and Labor and Delivery. You shadow doctors and nurses. You also learn skills like CPR and how to take vital signs in a practice lab.
grades: Fall and spring: 10th to 12th grade (one fall cohort is 12th grade only). Summer: 11th grade only.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 cohorts: application opens Oct 26, 2026 and closes Nov 17, 2026; interviews week of Nov 30; decisions Dec 15, 2026. Summer 2027: opens Jan 5, 2027, closes Jan 27, 2027. Fall 2026 cohorts closed Aug 27, 2026.

name: Alameda High School Career Technical Education (CTE) Pathways
org: Alameda High School, Alameda Unified School District
what_you_do: You take career classes at Alameda High. There are five paths to pick from. They are digital filmmaking, multimedia, computer science, sports medicine and biotech.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadlines. Ask your counselor when you pick classes.

name: Teen Haunted House Volunteers
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks
city: Alameda, CA (Veterans Building and South Shore Mall)
what_you_do: You design and build haunted rooms, props and special effects for the Teen Haunted House. You also act as a scare actor on haunted house nights.
deadline_text: Registration for the 21st annual haunted house closed September 20, 2026. Dates for next year are not posted on the program page.

name: Alameda Youth Career and Job Fair
org: City of Alameda and Alameda Unified School District
what_you_do: This is a free fair. You meet employers, schools, nonprofits and trade groups. You can explore careers, part-time jobs, internships and training.
deadline_text: The 10th annual fair was Wednesday, April 1, 2026, 1 to 5 pm. No 2027 date is posted.

name: Alameda Youth Committee (AYC)
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks, Underground Teen Center
what_you_do: You work with other teens to create programs and events. You build skills in teamwork, communication and civic engagement.
deadline_text: The program page says the committee runs in Fall 2026 and links to online registration. It gives no open or close dates.

name: Balloon Fiesta Navigator Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteers called Navigators help. They work before the event. They work during it. They work after it.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. Page says check back after the 2026 event for 2027 information.

name: Conservation Camp Counselors at the ABQ BioPark
what_you_do: Teens help a Camp BioPark teacher with hands-on activities, games and art projects. They set up, clean up and keep the space safe at the Zoo, Aquarium or Botanic Garden.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 20. The 2026 program ran June 1 to July 25.

name: ABQ BioPark High School Internship
what_you_do: A part-time paid internship on an animal care team or a plant team. You help feed animals, make toys for them and talk to guests about your area.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Mar 1 to Mar 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect March.

name: Nature Guides (teen volunteers)
what_you_do: In summer, volunteers move between the Zoo, Aquarium and Botanic Garden. They run hands-on learning areas and teach guests about animals and plants.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was May 20 (virtual open house May 16). 2027 dates not posted.

name: BioPark Education Student Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens help with classes, make teaching props and set up workshops. They also help at the zoo, aquarium or botanic garden for a semester.
deadline_text: Applications taken all year. Placements usually made at the start of each semester.

name: Aquatics Aide and Lifeguard (City pools)
what_you_do: Seasonal jobs at City swimming pools: aquatics aide or lifeguard. Lifeguards must pass a City water test first.
deadline_text: The page lists no dates or deadlines.

name: Career Pathways Internship at X Studio
org: Explora Science Center and Children's Museum
what_you_do: A paid internship that lasts 2 years, for rising juniors and seniors who like STEAM jobs. You work 10 to 20 hours a week.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran July 20 to Aug 26, 2026, interviews Aug 31 to Sept 5, onboarding Sept 19. 2027 dates not posted; expect summer.

name: Explora Volunteers
org: Explora Science Center and Children's Museum
what_you_do: Volunteers help teachers run programs and talk with guests about the exhibits. They join outreach around New Mexico and help keep the museum clean.
deadline_text: No deadline. Fill out the interest form any time.

name: Job Mentor Program Summer Internship
org: Youth and Family Services, City of Albuquerque
what_you_do: Seven-week paid summer internship with a City department, government agency or nonprofit. You work up to 25 hours a week.
deadline_text: The page gives no spring dates or year for applications. Apply during the spring window on the City's Jobs and Internships page.

name: Mayor's Creative Youth Corps
what_you_do: A paid summer mentorship in arts-based leadership. Youth are placed with community partners and mentors. More than 80 local youth took part over the last two summers.
deadline_text: No application dates posted on the page.

name: Mayor's Youth Advisory Council (MYAC)
what_you_do: Up to 21 high school students advise the Mayor's office on city issues from the youth point of view.
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the page.

name: Junior Docents at the NM Museum of Natural History and Science
org: New Mexico Museum of Natural History and Science
what_you_do: Teens work in the museum's exhibit halls. They talk with visitors about science, help at events and can pick a special project.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 15, 2026. The program page says to check back in January 2027 for the 2027 program.

name: Volunteer Internships at the National Museum of Nuclear Science and History
org: National Museum of Nuclear Science and History
what_you_do: Interns pick a project that fits academic goals and museum goals. They also help with education programs and special events. A general track rotates you through the museum.
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the program page.

name: Warehouse Volunteers at Roadrunner Food Bank of New Mexico
org: Roadrunner Food Bank of New Mexico
what_you_do: Volunteers prep food for distribution in the warehouse. The food leaves the docks for hundreds of locations across the state. Shifts are at the Albuquerque warehouse.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for open dates and times.

name: Sandia National Laboratories High School Internships
what_you_do: High school students work on real tech or business projects. Mentors help them. Sandia has posted Technical High School internships (summer and year round) in areas like mechanical design.
deadline_text: Jobs are posted one by one on Sandia's careers site. Each has its own dates.

name: Engineering and Computing Summer Academy (UNM)
org: University of New Mexico Engineering Student Success Center
what_you_do: Do hands-on work in engineering and computer science. Meet UNM students and STEM faculty. Meet people who work in the field.
grades: Incoming grades 8 to 12 (depends on the option)
deadline_text: The 2026 priority deadline was March 15, 2026. The page lists no 2027 dates.

name: Youth Volunteer at UNM Health (Guest Services)
what_you_do: Volunteers help at Guest Services. The place is UNM Sandoval Regional Medical Center. The page lists a youth form for teens.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Call the volunteer office to learn more.

name: PATH Emerging Scholars Program (UNM Health Sciences)
org: University of New Mexico Health Sciences, Office for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
what_you_do: A one-week program on health careers. Students see clinical or research work, study health equity and do community projects.
grades: High school juniors and seniors (the page also lists rising sophomores)
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was December 31, 2025 and the 2026 program ran June 15 to 24. The page lists no 2027 dates.

name: Youth Arts Leadership (YAL)
what_you_do: Young artists get paid work in the arts. They also grow personal and work skills and learn to organize their culture, through art projects, community work, service learning and goal setting.
deadline_text: Page says more information about the 2027 program is coming soon. Email programs@workingclassroom.org to get on the notification list.

name: Petroglyph National Monument Beautification
what_you_do: Paid summer youth jobs and job skills training. You help care for and clean up Petroglyph National Monument in west Albuquerque. The National Park Service pays for it.
deadline_text: Page says recruitment begins in April each year.

name: YouthBuild Albuquerque
what_you_do: Young people learn building and safety trades. They also earn a high school equivalency (GED or HiSET) and NCCER Core Construction and OSHA 10 papers. Help with rides and child care is offered.
deadline_text: Page says a final YouthBuild cohort is coming soon. No dates posted.

name: One Albuquerque Youth Job & Volunteer Fair
what_you_do: A fair each year where youth meet City teams and local employers. You learn how to apply and sign up for seasonal jobs, internships and volunteer roles.
deadline_text: 2026 fair was Saturday Feb 7, 2026, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Berna Facio Professional Development Center. 2027 date not posted.

name: Alexandria Library Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Group
what_you_do: Help at library branches. You set up for programs, help with computers and clean up. The Teen Advisory Group meets to plan teen library events. It counts toward service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline listed.

name: Alexandria Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: City of Alexandria Workforce Development Center
what_you_do: Six weeks of paid work with a local employer. You also get an orientation, workshops and a closing ceremony.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Dec 15 and closed Feb 14, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

grades: High school teens for the Teen Advisory Board
name: Teen Volunteers, Internships and Teen Advisory Board
org: Alive Center (Naperville, Aurora and Hanover Park)
city: Naperville, Aurora and Hanover Park, IL
what_you_do: Mentor and tutor younger teens after school. Help with events or join the Teen Advisory Board. Unpaid internships are offered. Fields include marketing, graphic design and fundraising. Others are mentoring, IT and social media.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board: new high school members are picked each April. Volunteering and internships have no deadline stated on the page.

name: Palefsky Collision Project (Alliance Theatre)
what_you_do: For three weeks in summer, you work with professional artists. You use a source text. You write and do theater exercises. Then you rehearse and perform an original piece at the Alliance.
deadline_text: The interview and application window runs from January to mid-April each year; the Summer 2026 window is closed. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Altru Health System Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in the health system and see health jobs up close. You get an orientation and on-the-job experience.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Iowa 4-H Youth Conference
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Spend three days on the Iowa State campus. You go to workshops, tours and evening events, build leadership skills and explore careers. You stay in a residence hall.
deadline_text: The 2026 conference was June 23 to 25. Registration ran from April 1 to June 1, 2026. Dates for 2027 are not posted. Expect a spring sign up again.

name: Iowa State RISE with WiSE Summer Experience
org: Program for Women in Science and Engineering, Iowa State University
what_you_do: A one week stay on the Iowa State campus. Pick one of two hands-on STEM tracks, Engineering or Life Sciences, taught by faculty, staff and students. You also get a taste of college life.
deadline_text: Applications open in January, per the page. The page gives no year and no closing date. It does not say if the $450 price applies to 2027.

name: Anaheim Fire and Rescue Explorer Program
what_you_do: Learn basic fire and life-saving skills with Anaheim firefighters. Meetings mix fitness, class time and skills practice. After six months you can ride along on fire engines and ambulances.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Join the interest list to hear when spots open.

name: Anaheim Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at an Anaheim library branch. Some branches ask for 2 hours a week. You can also work online on a teen blog, a teen podcast or book catalog translation.
deadline_text: Dates depend on the branch. East Anaheim, Haskett, Heritage Center, Ponderosa and Sunkist take applications year-round. Central Library takes them at the start of summer, fall and spring. Canyon Hills takes them in September, January and May, for summer work. Euclid takes them during the spring semester, for summer work.

name: Anaheim Summer VolunTEEN Program
org: City of Anaheim Community Services Department
what_you_do: Volunteer at summer programs in Anaheim. You can help at day camps, nature camps, libraries and a gym. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: The 2026 applications are closed. Last cycle, applications opened Feb 2, 2026 and closed Apr 10, 2026 at 5 p.m. No late applications were accepted.

name: Volunteer and School Service Hours (ages 16 and up, plus at-home projects)
city: South Elgin, Bloomingdale, Geneva, Algonquin, IL
what_you_do: Walk and socialize shelter dogs, care for cats, help at adoption events, or help wildlife. Teens can earn school service hours. Younger teens and anyone who cannot come in can do at-home projects.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sign-ups are open for Dog Care, Cat Care, Shelter Support, Social Media and School Service Hours. Only Wildlife (no applications now) and Clinic Support (full) cannot be joined. We keep this as rolling because the other roles still take sign-ups.

name: Young Artist Competition (Ann Arbor Symphony Orchestra)
what_you_do: Send in a video of a solo with orchestra. The winner plays with the full professional orchestra at the Link Up youth concert and gets a cash prize.
deadline_text: 2026 application closed Sept 25, 2026 at 10 AM. Final round is Nov 7, 2026. Next year dates are not posted.

name: Youth Council
what_you_do: Help give out more than $100,000 a year in grants to local youth projects, take part in service projects, and go to a statewide summer grantmaking conference.
deadline_text: The page says the new member application is closed until 2027. No dates posted yet.

name: Ann Arbor District Library Volunteer Program (teens and adults)
what_you_do: Prepare materials for library programs, give occasional program support and do shelf reading. Shelving books is done by paid staff.
deadline_text: The page lists no open or close dates. Fill out the online form, then attend a volunteer orientation.

name: BioMed Focus (Michigan Medicine summer research)
what_you_do: Work full time in a Michigan Medicine lab. You do your own research project with a mentor. You also take a science writing class and a college prep class. At the end you write a paper and give a talk.
deadline_text: The BioMed Focus 2027 interest form closes January 8, 2027 at 11:59 pm, per the program About page. That page does not give an opening date. The card earlier said the form opens Monday, Oct 12, 2026; the About page does not confirm that.

name: Teen Service Group (library volunteers)
what_you_do: Help the youth and teen librarians plan and run programs, sign kids up for the Reading Program, and do other tasks all year.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The group runs year-round.

name: Food Gatherers Volunteer Shifts (warehouse and Community Kitchen)
what_you_do: You sort and repackage donated food in the warehouse. Or you prepare and serve meals at the Community Kitchen. You also clean up there. The kitchen is in downtown Ann Arbor.
deadline_text: Shifts open for sign-up 3 months ahead and fill quickly.

name: Teen Leadership Program (Growing Hope urban farm)
what_you_do: Work on an urban farm. Learn farming, cooking, food justice and how to organize your community. You lead garden and cooking workshops. Summer is 8 weeks. The after-school program runs September to May.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open March 1, 2027. A closing date is not posted.

name: Volunteer at Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum and Leslie Science & Nature Center
org: Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum and Leslie Science & Nature Center (Discover Science and Nature)
what_you_do: Help at the science museum and nature center. The page lists staffing the preschool areas, preparing distance learning kits for school groups, and cleaning indoor and outdoor sites. Leslie also has wildlife volunteering.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are posted.

name: Junior Volunteer Program at Humane Society of Huron Valley
what_you_do: After 6 training sessions, you can volunteer on your own. Jobs include cat comforting, dog visiting and shelter cleaning. Others are cat feeding, making enrichment toys and camp counseling. There are also events.
deadline_text: Registration for the November sessions (Nov 2 to 19) opens Mon Oct 19 at 8am; for the December sessions (Nov 30 to Dec 17) it opens Mon Nov 16 at 8am. Sessions are offered monthly and fill quickly.

name: Young Filmmakers Camp (Michigan Theater and State Theatre)
org: Marquee Arts (Michigan Theater and State Theatre)
what_you_do: Learn to make films from working pros. Three weeks cover planning, filming and editing. The camp ends with a red carpet show of your films.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed Friday, June 19, 2026 at 5 PM. 2027 dates and prices are not posted.

name: #MI-Internship Prep (4-week free course)
what_you_do: Take a free 4 week course. Explore careers, build job skills, and make a portfolio with a resume and cover letter. Each week you meet a top employer.
deadline_text: Cohorts run throughout the year. No dates are posted on the page.

name: Neutral Zone free teen programs and youth-led projects
what_you_do: Drop in after school or join weekly programs. Some are music production, running a concert venue, game design, and first job and college planning. Teens can also start their own project.
deadline_text: School year 2026-27 programs run weekdays. Drop-in is Monday to Friday, 2 to 6 PM. No deadline is posted.

name: Leadership Institute (Ozone House)
what_you_do: One week of workshops. Topics are public speaking, money and credit, art, teamwork, and help in your community. Youth help plan and run it.
deadline_text: Dates are not posted. The page says it is offered twice a year.

name: Ann Arbor lifeguard certification course and pool jobs
org: City of Ann Arbor Parks and Recreation (Mack Indoor Pool)
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard course (lifeguarding, first aid, CPR and AED). If you are hired at one of the city's pools, the $200 course fee is refunded. The city also hires seasonal staff at pools, golf courses and canoe liveries.
deadline_text: Registration for the course opens Jan 21, 2027. Session 1 starts Friday, April 16, 2027 (Friday 5 to 10 p.m., then Saturday and Sunday 11 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.). Registration closes 7 days before the course starts. Seasonal job postings for 2027 are not up yet.

name: Volunteer in the Parks (City of Ann Arbor)
org: City of Ann Arbor Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Sign up for park projects such as the Huron River cleanup, Trash Trailblazers, Breeding Bird Survey, Adopt-a-Park and playground maintenance. Groups of 5 to 30 can request a project.
deadline_text: No deadline. Event dates are on the online volunteer calendar.

name: Summer Day Camp counselors and Counselors in Training (Peace Neighborhood Center)
what_you_do: High school students work with Peace staff and interns as counselors at Summer Day Camp. Rising 9th graders can join as Counselors in Training.
deadline_text: Dates and application steps are not posted on the page.

name: Ann Arbor Summer Festival volunteer (Top of the Park)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the summer festival's Top of the Park site. Teen roles include the Welcome Team and Zero Waste Champions. Others are Donation Ambassadors and Merch Mavens. Each shift you finish earns perks. One perk is access to special hospitality areas.
deadline_text: The page says sign-up opens April 1 (for the 2026 season). Festival dates are not on this page. 2027 sign-up is not posted yet.

name: SummerWorks (Washtenaw County Summer Youth Employment Program)
org: SummerWorks: Michigan Works! Southeast, Washtenaw County OCED, University of Michigan Poverty Solutions and partners
what_you_do: You get weekly professional development. You get an adult mentor. If you are selected, you get a paid 10 week summer internship with a local employer.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 15 and were due Mar 22, 2026; internship period June 15 to Aug 21, 2026. The site says 2027 applications open in mid-January and are usually open late January to late March. 2027 closing date is not posted.

name: Trinity Health Ann Arbor Teen Volunteer Program
org: Trinity Health Michigan, Ann Arbor and Livingston
what_you_do: High school students volunteer in the hospital. They help improve the patient experience. They get a first look at working in health care.
deadline_text: No application dates posted. The newest date on the page is old: a summer teen orientation on June 24, 2026. No later orientation is listed. Ask the volunteer office about the next one.

name: Future Ready Scholars at the University of Michigan
org: Michigan Engineering Zone, University of Michigan College of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on the U-M Ann Arbor campus solving real problems with the engineering design process. You also build math, reading, writing and study skills. Monthly Saturday sessions follow.
deadline_text: 2026 camp: July 5 to 17, 2026. The application was due April 5, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: MPulse Summer Performing Arts Institutes
org: University of Michigan School of Music, Theatre and Dance
what_you_do: Live on campus for 1 to 4 weeks and study music, theatre or dance with U-M faculty. There are 16 institutes, from jazz and strings to musical theatre, dance and theatre design. Each ends with a performance.
deadline_text: MPulse 2027 applications are open now. The priority deadline is February 1, 2027. After that, institutes take applications until they are full.

name: Stamps BioDesign Studio
org: University of Michigan Stamps School of Art and Design
what_you_do: Work with a U-M engineering research group on medical implant surfaces. Make 2D and 3D patterns, take electron microscope images, then turn them into art.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The early action deadline was February 1, 2026 and the final deadline was March 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Stamps Pre-College Portfolio Prep
org: University of Michigan Stamps School of Art and Design
what_you_do: Build an art and design portfolio for college in a 2 week studio program with Stamps faculty. Learn about art school admission from the Stamps admission team.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The early action deadline was February 1, 2026 and the final deadline was March 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: WISE GISE summer STEM day camp
org: University of Michigan Women in Science and Engineering (WISE)
what_you_do: Spend a week in U-M labs. Pick a morning major (2026 choices were Outer Space, Game Design and Biodiversity) and try other subjects in the afternoon with U-M student leaders.
deadline_text: Applications open February 15 and close May 15. Spots go as applications come in, so apply early. 2027 camp dates are not posted.

name: Washtenaw County Youth Commission
org: Washtenaw County Youth Commission (run through the Neutral Zone)
what_you_do: Talk about problems that affect teens. Learn about your community. Suggest changes and new programs to the county leaders.
deadline_text: Application timeline not posted. The page says to contact Britt Baron at britt@neutral-zone.org.

name: Career Technical Education high school programs (Washtenaw ISD)
org: Washtenaw Intermediate School District with local school districts
what_you_do: Take career classes while in high school. Your school may offer health science, car repair, cooking, computer safety, hair and skin care, welding, drones and more.
deadline_text: Not posted. The 2026-27 program list is on the page.

name: Dual Enrollment at Washtenaw Community College
what_you_do: Take real college classes at WCC while you are still in high school or homeschooled. Classes can count toward the Michigan Transfer Agreement or a WCC certificate.
deadline_text: No single deadline posted. Check the academic dates link on the page.

grades: Currently in 8th grade (9th grade program) or 9th or 10th grade (Middle College)
name: Washtenaw Technical Middle College (WTMC)
what_you_do: Take high school and college classes at the same time at Washtenaw Community College. You finish with a diploma. You also get a two year degree or a job certificate.
deadline_text: Admissions for fall 2027 begins Dec 1, 2026. Online application closes Feb 26, 2027. Letters go out Mar 19, 2027. Lottery Mar 26, 2027 if needed. Confirm by Apr 9, 2027.

name: Youth Volunteer Corps and youth volunteer roles at the Ann Arbor YMCA
what_you_do: Join service-learning projects with the Youth Volunteer Corps. Or volunteer as a youth helper. You can help in swim lessons, day camps or the Y on the Fly sports program.
deadline_text: No application window or deadline is stated. The page has a Begin your application button.

name: Summer Youth Volunteer Corps (Ypsilanti District Library)
what_you_do: Help with kids STEAM programs, the garden, and games like Pokemon cards and chess. You attend a one-hour training first.
deadline_text: The page says the application for 2027 summer volunteers opens in late April.

name: Teen Advisory Group and teen volunteer roles (Ypsilanti District Library)
what_you_do: Teen Advisory Group members plan teen events. They lead them, write grants and talk to youth groups. Other roles are event helper and teen librarian aide (waitlist). Grades 10 to 12 can start their own project.
deadline_text: No application window is listed for the Teen Advisory Group. All Teen Librarian Assistant spots were filled, so the form puts you on a waitlist.

name: VolunTEENS at the Aquarium of the Pacific
what_you_do: Talk with aquarium guests about ocean life and conservation at touch pools and education carts. You get trained, then work one set day a week.
deadline_text: 2026 windows: Summer applications Mar 1 to Apr 15; Fall applications Jun 20 to Aug 5. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Future U Youth and Young Adult Program
what_you_do: Get help with school, job training, and finding work. You can get on-the-job training, apprenticeships, GED prep, and career exploration.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed on the program page.

name: Teen Volunteer (Arapahoe Libraries)
what_you_do: Teens help with shelving, displays, book picks and events. Join a team for a semester or the summer, or join a monthly Teen Advisory Board.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted on the page.

name: NextGen Youth Workforce Program (WorkSource Atlanta Regional)
org: Atlanta Regional Commission, Atlanta Regional Workforce Development Board
city: Cherokee, Clayton, Douglas, Fayette, Gwinnett, Henry and Rockdale counties, GA
what_you_do: This is year-round workforce training and education for youth. It serves seven metro Atlanta counties. A contracted provider runs it in each county.
deadline_text: Year-round. No application dates are posted.

name: TRIO Upward Bound and Upward Bound Math and Science (American River College)
what_you_do: You get free tutoring and academic advising. You get help with college applications and financial aid. You go on campus visits. You do career exploration. The program has monthly Saturday Academies. It also has a required summer part.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page.

name: Arizona 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Do hands-on projects in science, agriculture, health and civic engagement with adult mentors. Teens can apply for state teen leader groups, camps and shooting sports.
deadline_text: Join through your local Cooperative Extension office.

name: Arlington Employment Center Teen Job Seekers and Teen Job Board
what_you_do: Free help finding a first job. You get a resume template and a 1-on-1 resume review. You also get interview practice videos and a mock interview. A Teen Job Board lists local openings.
deadline_text: No deadline. Use any time.

grades: Summer Squad: entering grades 7 to 12. Middle School Panel: grades 7 to 8.
name: Summer Volunteer Squad and Middle School Volunteer Panel
what_you_do: Summer Volunteer Squad: teens help at the library over the summer. The Middle School Volunteer Panel meets once a month in the school year. It does service projects and plans programs.
deadline_text: Summer volunteer applications closed on April 30, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Arlingteens Leaders Summer Internship
what_you_do: Spend two weeks with Parks and Recreation staff. You try jobs like park ranger, nature guide, event planner, carpenter and preschool teacher.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened early March and closed May 10, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Arlington Summer Camp Volunteers
what_you_do: Help camp staff run activities at county camps: field trips, arts and crafts, sports, special events and games.
deadline_text: 2026: registration opened Feb 18 and closed when full. New volunteer interview was April 22 and training June 3, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Arlington Teen Network Board (TNB)
what_you_do: A teen group named by the County Board and School Board. Members talk about youth issues and make advice for leaders. They work in one of four teams: drug and alcohol prevention, healthy relationships, peer to peer, or volunteering and internships.
deadline_text: No application dates posted.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
org: Arrowhead Regional Medical Center (San Bernardino County)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the county hospital on one weekly shift. You give at least 100 hours of service.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the page.

name: Armory Center for the Arts Studio Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help the teaching artists in the Armory's kids' Studio classes. You help with set up and clean up, and you help during class each session.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline listed.

name: Teen Academy (summer art classes)
what_you_do: Take one-week studio classes in drawing, painting, filmmaking, photography, fashion design, creative writing and more, and build a portfolio.
deadline_text: The page shows the 2026 course schedule. 2027 dates and registration are not posted.

name: Volunteer at Alexian Brothers Medical Center (teens 16 and up)
what_you_do: Help patients and staff in a hospital department. Students can see different parts of healthcare before picking a major or career.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline and does not say whether applications are accepted year-round. Call 847-437-5500 to ask.

name: Volunteer at Saint Alexius Medical Center (teens 16 and up)
what_you_do: Help patients and staff in a hospital department. Students can see different parts of healthcare before picking a major or career.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline and does not say whether applications are accepted year-round. Call 847-755-8708 to ask.

name: Assisteens Auxiliary (Assistance League of Newport-Mesa)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a thrift shop. Help give school clothes to low-income families. Do service projects with your grade. You can also be a leader.
deadline_text: No sign-up dates are posted on the program page. Call for details.

name: INSPIRE Summer Program (Access ASU)
what_you_do: Stay in an ASU residence hall for a week. Do hands-on projects, cultural activities, and college prep. Meet ASU students, staff, and faculty.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 ran June 21 to 25 and applications are closed. Next dates are not stated on the program page.

name: RISE Summer Leadership Institute
what_you_do: Live on the ASU campus for a few days. Work on leadership, starting a business, and community projects. Talk with working professionals.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 ran June 14 to 17 and applications are closed. Next dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Joaquin Bustoz Math-Science Honors Program (JBMSHP)
what_you_do: Take a 3-credit college math class over the summer. You can pick College Algebra, Pre-Calculus, or Calculus for Engineers I.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 open in early December. Student application is due Feb 16, 2027. Recommender letter is due Feb 18, 2027.

name: Fleischer Scholars Program
org: Arizona State University, W. P. Carey School of Business
what_you_do: Join online sessions with mentors and staff. Earn one elective ASU college credit. Visit the Tempe campus. Learn to think strategically.
deadline_text: The program page lists Feb 15 for priority, March 15 for late, and May 6 as the final deadline for the summer 2027 group. It does not write the year for these dates.

name: Summer Youth Leadership Institute at Goizueta (SYLI)
org: 21st Century Leaders with Emory Goizueta Business School
what_you_do: Spend a week living on the Emory campus. You work on business and startup challenges. You meet leaders from companies such as Coca-Cola and Cox Enterprises.
deadline_text: The 2026 application window was Jan 5 to Mar 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: ATL Workforce Summer Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Work a paid six-week summer job at Atlanta's airport. You learn workplace skills, get a mentor, and see careers in aviation.
deadline_text: The page says applications open the first week of February through mid-March each year. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: ATL Workforce Youth Apprenticeship Program
what_you_do: Work a paid, part-time trade job at Atlanta's airport while you earn school credit. Placements match the trades your school district offers.
deadline_text: Rolling. The page says applications are accepted based on the airport's needs and may vary each year.

name: SPEAK Student Volunteers (Atlanta Botanical Garden)
what_you_do: Students Promoting Environmental Awareness and Knowledge: staff carts around the Garden and talk with visitors about plants and sustainability for short conversations.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: info sessions Jan 13 and Feb 10, application and recommendation due March 1, 2026, group interviews March 21 or 28. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Summer High School Internship (Atlanta Botanical Garden)
what_you_do: Work outdoors and in labs and greenhouses at the Garden, such as plant conservation research, rare plant care or keeping the Edible Garden and Storza Woods. Build college and career skills.
deadline_text: The Garden says to check back in December 2026 for Summer 2027 details.

name: Student Business Shadow Project (SBSP)
what_you_do: Spend part of a summer working next to business owners and their teams. Classes cover money, customer care, how to start a firm, speaking and resumes.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline are posted on the page.

name: CHRIS 180 youth drop-in center and Summit Trail Apartments
what_you_do: For young people with no stable home. A daytime drop-in center gives basic needs and case managers who link youth to housing, school, jobs and behavioral health care. Summit Trail Apartments give supportive housing.
deadline_text: No deadline. Drop-in hours were not listed.

name: Atlanta College and Career Academy (ACCA)
what_you_do: Stay at your home school and spend part of each day at ACCA. You study a career path such as HVAC, culinary arts, dental science, patient care, graphic design or cybersecurity. Some paths earn college credit.
grades: 10 to 12 for the dual enrollment pathways. The page gives no grade range for the career pathways.
deadline_text: The FAQ says students can apply online from November to March. Exact dates and year not posted on the page.

name: Volunteering at the Atlanta Community Food Bank (ages 8 and up with an adult)
what_you_do: Volunteers help at ongoing food bank projects. Youth under 18 come with an adult chaperone who stays the whole shift.
deadline_text: Sign up for a shift on the volunteer calendar. Dates not on the calendar are full or not offered.

name: Teen Experience and Leadership Program (TELP)
what_you_do: Spend 7 summer weeks at Grady hospital. You rotate through clinical and non-clinical areas, shadow health workers, do labs and workshops, and get a mentor. You can also join a research project and present it.
deadline_text: The 2026 application was open Jan 16 to Feb 20, 2026, with the YouScience assessment Feb 23 to Mar 8 and interviews Mar 9 to 27. 2027 dates are not posted; expect a similar January opening.

name: Institute on Neuroscience (ION) Summer Research Program
org: Georgia State University, Center for Behavioral Neuroscience
what_you_do: Do paid summer research in a Georgia State neuroscience lab with a faculty mentor. You start with a fruit fly lab course, go to weekly workshops, then present your results at a symposium.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed June 14, 2026, a late, short cycle because funding was delayed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: The Neuroscience School: Short Courses for High School Students
org: Georgia State University, Center for Behavioral Neuroscience
what_you_do: Take a one-week summer neuroscience course taught by Georgia State professors. Choices include a Boot Camp, fruit fly lab courses on Alzheimer's or stress, and advanced topics. Some run in person, some online.
deadline_text: In 2026, registration stayed open until classes were full, and classes without enough sign-ups by June 1 were canceled. The 2026 schedule was posted in December 2025. 2027 courses are not posted.

name: Atlanta Teen Leader Program and Parks and Recreation Teen Summer Employment
org: City of Atlanta, Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Join free teen activities at city recreation centers, such as sneaker and fashion design, music, cooking, sports training, content creating and graphic design. Registered teens can be considered for Parks and Recreation summer jobs.
deadline_text: The catalog says teens must be registered prior to December 31, 2026 to be considered for the Parks and Recreation summer employment program, and that registration is ongoing. That date is a registration cutoff, not a job application. The catalog also says summer 2026 employment registration is closed.

name: Mentorship and Internship Program (APS Gifted and Talented)
org: Atlanta Public Schools, Gifted and Talented Programs
what_you_do: Take a fall mentorship class, then spend a 60-hour, one-on-one spring internship with a professional in a field you like. You finish with a capstone project.
deadline_text: No application deadline listed. Mentor meetings usually start in November. Capstone Celebration in April.

name: Work-Based Learning (CTAE), Atlanta Public Schools
org: Atlanta Public Schools, Career, Technical and Agricultural Education (CTAE)
what_you_do: Learn job skills in the community while you earn high school credit. Work-based learning connects your class work to real work experience.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: City of Atlanta, Department of Labor and Employment Services
what_you_do: Get matched with a summer job, internship or skills-trade program at an Atlanta employer. Spots are competitive. The city does not promise you one.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran in June and July. Registration was listed as a waiting list. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: YMB Fuel youth business accelerator
city: Atlanta, GA (some parts may be online)
what_you_do: If you already run a small business, join a one-week summer camp with coaching, mentors and a Pitch Day for cash grants. It is free. The company does not take any share of your business.
deadline_text: No deadline or cohort dates are posted on the page.

name: Better Employment Outcomes (BEO) Initiative
org: City of Aurora Youth Activities and Services
what_you_do: Get matched with summer internships and research chances. The team also helps with networking and career ideas. It helps you write a resume and a cover letter.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates are posted. After you send the interest form, the team says it will reach out as soon as possible.

name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: Speak up for teens at the library. Work with the teen librarians to improve the library and plan programs for local teens.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Meets the 1st Monday of each month at 6 p.m.

name: Youth Climate Action Fund microgrants
what_you_do: Young residents design a climate project and apply for a $1,000 to $5,000 microgrant to carry it out. City staff help with ideas before you apply.
deadline_text: Applications ran Aug 24 to Oct 16, 2026 (the FAQ says Oct 5). A second round may come if projects finish on time. No date is posted.

name: Youth Court (peer jurors)
org: City of Aurora Youth Activities and Services
what_you_do: Serve as a peer juror in Youth Court. It hears cases of teens charged with a first minor offense. The teens get a chance to avoid a record.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sessions are the third Tuesday of each month at the Aurora Police Department, 1200 Indian Trail Road.

name: Austin Animal Services Volunteer Program (teens)
what_you_do: Help dogs and cats find homes. You greet visitors, walk and play with dogs, and help cats and kittens get used to people. You also help at outreach events.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply any time.

name: City of Austin High School Summer Internship Programs
org: City of Austin, Austin Economic Development (Youth Initiatives)
what_you_do: Six-week paid summer internships in City departments and partner sites. One application covers five tracks: Emerging Leaders, Get Ready (STEAM), Automotive/Entrepreneurial, Aviation Department, and the Austin Convention Center (on hold).
grades: Rising sophomore, junior or senior, or current senior
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Jan 28 to Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Works In Progress (WIP) Paid Arts Internship
org: Dougherty Arts Center, City of Austin Arts, Culture, Music and Entertainment Department
what_you_do: Paid 8 week arts internship in person at the Dougherty Arts Center and the Zilker Hillside Theater. The page calls it a program for high school students.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates are not posted. Join the Dougherty Arts Center mailing list for updates.

name: Austin Habitat for Humanity Youth Volunteering
what_you_do: Teens help build homes and help the families who will live in them. Ages 16 and 17 can do new home building. Younger teens do jobs like painting flower boxes, building tables or tutoring the kids of these families.
deadline_text: No deadline. Check the volunteer calendar for dates.

name: Austin Humane Society Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Help care for animals, mostly by getting cats and dogs used to people. You also help with outreach projects that work to end pet homelessness in Central Texas.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register any time.

name: Austin ISD Summer Internship Program
org: Austin ISD with Austin Ed Fund and the Austin Chamber of Commerce
what_you_do: Work at a business or community partner for 6 weeks, about 20 hours a week. Students are placed by their interests and what is open.
deadline_text: The 2026 interest form closed Feb 6, 2026. A banner on the page says 2027 details are coming and the student form opens in December (year not stated, so confirm).

name: Teen Library Fellowship
org: Austin Public Library with the Austin Library Foundation
what_you_do: Paid fellows meet each month. They plan community action projects. Projects include a teen magazine, workshops, open mics and a podcast. Fellows also help host library programs for teens.
deadline_text: Foundation page: the next cohort application opens in May 2027. The 2026-27 application ran May 1-31, 2026.

name: Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help library staff with checkout and programs. You help set up and take down programs. You re-shelve books and run teen clubs. You do light clean-up. You usually work with the youth librarians.
deadline_text: Windows each year: fall Jul 1-31, spring Dec 1-31, summer Mar 1-31. The fall window has closed; the next one is spring, Dec 1-31 (the page gives these windows without a year).

name: Caminos Teen Leadership Program
org: Emma S. Barrientos Mexican American Cultural Center (City of Austin)
what_you_do: This is a paid creative arts internship. Teens make murals, publications, films and events with local artists. Teens also plan programs for other teens. You learn about Latin American and Indigenous cultures.
deadline_text: Applications for the Class of 2027 are closed. The next round (Class of 2028) is due in Spring 2027, announced on Instagram @atxcaminos.

name: Lifeguard training and hiring
org: Austin Parks and Recreation Department, Aquatic Division
what_you_do: You train as a certified lifeguard. You work at City of Austin pools and aquatic facilities. New and returning guards fill out an application. They also do hiring paperwork before they sign up for training.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 hiring open hours were Mar 31, Apr 16 and Apr 28 (4 to 8 p.m.) at 2818 San Gabriel St. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Teen Summer Volunteer Program, St. David's Medical Center
org: St. David's HealthCare, St. David's Medical Center
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors find their way. You also help with wheelchair rides at discharge, restock nurses' stations and keep patients company. Top needs include the gift shop, discharge lounge and info desks.
deadline_text: The page says applications open March 15 and close April 15 at 11:59 pm, once a year. The year is not stated.

name: Teen Summer Volunteer Program, St. David's North Austin Medical Center
org: St. David's HealthCare, North Austin Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital for the summer. After you apply, you send more paperwork. If you are picked, you interview, finish screenings and go to orientation.
deadline_text: The page says applications run March 1 to March 31 and late materials are not accepted. The year is not stated.

name: VolunTeen Program
what_you_do: Teens do 60 hours of training, then give 40 hours of service at the museum. Thinkery says 208 VolunTeens served 8,880 hours in its last reported year.
deadline_text: Dates and application window are not stated on the program page.

name: Urban Roots High School Leadership Programs
what_you_do: The page describes paid youth internships for teens. It does not say what the work involves. Free elementary day camps and a free middle school Food Lab are also listed, but those are not for high schoolers.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says to watch for future opportunities. No dates are posted.

name: Youth Career Services
what_you_do: Work readiness and life skills training, personal guidance, work experience and help earning a credential for low income youth. In school students are served through Climb the Ladder CTX.
deadline_text: No deadline listed on the Youth Services page, and it does not say when you can start.

name: Austin Youth Council
org: City of Austin Economic Development (Youth Initiatives)
what_you_do: Meet monthly, hear from City staff, plan actions on community issues and talk with City Council members. Members learn Robert's Rules of Order. They also go to monthly service events.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says 2027 to 2028 applications are expected to open in Spring 2027.

name: Austin Youth Development (AYD)
org: Austin Public Health, City of Austin
what_you_do: A City of Austin youth program for ages 17 to 22. The page says it offers paid work with the City, mentoring and career planning. The goal is to help youth earn a livable wage.
deadline_text: No application dates are listed.

name: Youth Forest Council
org: City of Austin, Austin Climate Action and Resilience (Urban Forest Program)
what_you_do: This is a yearlong paid internship. It is with the City's Urban Forest Program. You help plan community events. You design education materials about trees. You represent the program in your neighborhood.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 cohort were due March 15, 2026. The page says applications open again in January 2027.

name: Teen Volunteers (Volunteens)
what_you_do: Help at a local library branch. Some branches recruit teen Volunteens each spring to help with the Summer @ Your Library program.
deadline_text: Varies by branch. The page says Teen Volunteens are recruited in the spring and gives no application dates.

name: Baltimore City Youth Commission
what_you_do: Young people advise the Mayor, City Council and city agencies on policies and services that affect kids, youth and families. Seats are listed by council district.
deadline_text: No application window is posted. Two district seats (2 and 6) were shown as vacant in the member list.

name: Baltimore Conservation Leadership Corps (BCLC)
what_you_do: Five-week summer crew that improves city parks, community gardens, urban farms and vacant lots. Once a week the whole group meets for a class on topics from stream ecology to money skills.
deadline_text: The page still says enrollment for 2025 opens in April. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: Teen Service Learning (Be Involved, Teen Advisory Boards, Buddies)
what_you_do: Earn service-learning hours with drop-in community projects, by joining a Teen Advisory Board, or by helping younger kids read and do STEM projects as a Buddy.
deadline_text: Be Involved is drop-in with no application. Teen Advisory Board and Buddies dates are not posted on this page.

name: Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the science center and help visitors. The page does not list the exact jobs.
deadline_text: No deadline or rolling-application language is stated on the page. Applicants should be prepared for a placement interview.

name: Pre-College Summer Intensive
what_you_do: Take art and design studio classes with MICA faculty, plus workshops and artist talks. Earn college credit. Choose a 2-week or 4-week option, living on campus or commuting.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are coming soon. Tuition is due only after acceptance.

name: Summer Academy of Actuarial and Mathematical Sciences (SAAMS)
org: Morgan State University, School of Computer, Mathematical and Natural Sciences
what_you_do: Four weeks of college-level math and intro actuarial science classes, plus field trips, professional development sessions and career exploration.
deadline_text: Application dates are not posted. Students hear a final decision by late May.

name: Youth Exhibit Guide Program
what_you_do: Spend a summer as a volunteer guide in the Aquarium galleries after a week of training. Talk with guests and learn about marine science careers.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 open in December 2026 (exact day not posted). 2026 interviews were held in late February and early March.

name: Branches Paid Internship
what_you_do: This is a paid after-school internship. You do outdoor work to protect nature. You also join weekly sessions on college, jobs, money and teamwork. The focus is green jobs.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the Branches Fall 2026 session are open now. No closing date is shown. The session dates on the FAQ are from 2025.

name: Teen Library Board
what_you_do: Plan and run a library program for teens, meet library leaders, explore careers and give feedback on teen services.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications closed. Members are told by October 16, 2026. The page says to check back in the spring for 2027-28 applications.

name: Enoch Pratt Youth Collective (EPYC)
what_you_do: Join a short themed series at a Pratt library branch to earn service learning hours and build skills. Fall 2026 theme is sewing.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications have closed. Groups meet Oct 1 to Nov 24, 2026. The next themes and dates are not posted.

name: TU Teacher Scholars Summer Institute
what_you_do: Four days on campus learning what teaching is like, with professor-led activities, a visit to the child care center, the planetarium and library. Earn one college credit.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened in February 2026 and the session ran July 13 to 16. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Research and Mentoring Program (RAMP)
org: University of Maryland School of Medicine (UMB)
what_you_do: Two-year program. Year one is five summer weeks learning lab and clinical skills plus school-year research rotations. Year two is a second summer of applied research.
deadline_text: Applications closed for 2026-2027. The next window is not posted.

name: Summer Enrichment Academy (SEA)
what_you_do: One-week hands-on summer workshops on the UMBC campus in science, technology, arts and leadership, led by experts and mentors.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 is over. The page says to check back soon for Summer 2027 registration. In 2026 the one-week sessions ran June 22 to July 31.

name: High School Media Classes (Video, Photo, Animation, Illustration)
what_you_do: Take media classes in video, photo, animation or illustration.
deadline_text: The fall 2026 high school session ran Sep 28 to Dec 11. No next session dates are posted. Registration is required, and if a class is full you can sign up for the waitlist.

name: MediaWorks Summer Intensive
what_you_do: A paid summer program that mixes media arts training with college and career development.
deadline_text: No 2027 dates posted on the program pages.

name: YouthWorks Summer Jobs
org: Baltimore Mayor's Office of Employment Development
what_you_do: Work a summer job at a city, nonprofit or private worksite, with training on money skills and career exploration.
deadline_text: 2027 youth application: January 4 to February 27, 2027. Program runs June 29 to July 30, 2027.

name: Bard on the Beach Volunteer Program
org: Bard on the Beach Shakespeare Festival
what_you_do: Work at the front of the theater as a greeter, ticket taker or usher. You can also help in the shop or snack bar, or at events at the Vanier Park festival.
deadline_text: Applications are closed until early 2027.

name: BART Summer Internship (high school)
what_you_do: You get a paid summer internship at BART, 10 to 20 hours a week, in person.
deadline_text: 2026 program ran June 22 to July 31, 2026. Direct applications are not accepted. 2027 not posted.

name: Green Teen Community Gardening
org: Cornell Cooperative Extension of Dutchess County
what_you_do: Teens grow food in two Beacon gardens and run a free farm stand. They also take workshops such as CPR, first aid, money skills and resume writing.
deadline_text: Applications are released on the Green Teen Facebook page in February, May and September.

name: Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help plan, promote and help out with teen and children's library programs. Help judge writing contests. Help with community outreach projects.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: RISE Youth Leadership Program
org: Tualatin Hills Park and Recreation District (THPRD)
what_you_do: Volunteer with park district programs and events. Give at least 80 hours of service within a year.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Online trainings are held monthly, with more before summer.

name: Berkeley High CTE Pathways
what_you_do: You can follow career pathways at Berkeley High. There are six areas. They are health, public service, arts and media, IT, engineering and building trades. You can earn credit for an internship or work-based learning.
deadline_text: Choose pathway classes during course selection.

name: Berkeley Humane Volunteer (teens 12 and up)
what_you_do: After a volunteer orientation, you can help in the thrift shop. You can help at adoption events or in the vet clinic. You can help with foster care or office work.
deadline_text: No volunteer application deadline is posted, and the page does not say whether orientation sign-ups are ongoing. Internships are 18+ only and are available year-round.

name: Berkeley Pre-College Scholars (Summer Sessions)
what_you_do: Take UC Berkeley summer classes for college credit in a 6 or 8 week session.
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 2 to Mar 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Berkeley Public Library Teen Volunteer and Youth Worker
what_you_do: You can volunteer at a Berkeley library. Use the Teen Volunteer Application. Or work as a paid Youth Worker, up to 15 hours a week. Berkeley YouthWorks hires Youth Workers.
deadline_text: Berkeley YouthWorks Winter 2027 interest form is due October 30, 2026. Positions generally run January to March 2027. Filling out the form does not guarantee placement.

name: Teen Council
org: Berkeley Repertory Theatre, School of Theatre
what_you_do: 10 to 15 Bay Area high schoolers are in this council. They plan Teen Night programs. They host original works showcases. They organize advocacy events. They interview artists.
deadline_text: A new group is chosen at the start of each school year. No 2026 to 2027 dates are posted; join the mailing list for news.

name: Berkeley YouthWorks
what_you_do: You can get a paid, part-time, temporary internship through the City of Berkeley. The Ready to Work workshop series pays a stipend.
deadline_text: Interest form for Winter 2027 is due October 30, 2026. Summer 2027 information is expected February 2027. Fall 2026 is full through November 2026.

name: Junior Volunteer Program (Suburban Hospital)
what_you_do: Help at a hospital in Bethesda for 4 hours a week. Teen helpers often push the Art Cart and Comfort Cart or work at the front desk. You meet patients, families and staff.
deadline_text: All fall 2026 junior spots are full. The page says to check back beginning in February 2027 for spring and summer openings.

name: Iacocca Global Entrepreneurship Intensive (IGEI)
what_you_do: A three-week program where you live on campus. Teens from around the world learn to build a business idea and pitch it.
deadline_text: Page says IGEI 2027 applications open in October 2026. 2026 priority deadline was Feb 15, with rolling admission after. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Beyond Emancipation (B:E) employment coaching for foster youth
what_you_do: If you are a current or former foster youth in Alameda County, you can get coaching. The coaching covers career interests. It also covers resumes and budgeting. You can get help with job connections. You can get help with training or apprenticeships.
deadline_text: No application window or intake deadline is stated on the program pages. Call or email to ask how to start.

name: Industry Clubs (Boys & Girls Clubs of North Central Illinois)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of North Central Illinois
city: Elgin / South Elgin area and other Fox Valley clubs, IL
what_you_do: 8 to 10 week hands-on career programs with expert instructors in fields like healthcare, manufacturing, IT, cybersecurity, culinary arts, photography and interior design. Teens get paid, meet local employers and build job skills.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Fill out the interest form to hear about the next session.

name: Keystone Club and Youth of the Year
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of North Central Illinois
city: Elgin, South Elgin, Aurora, Streamwood, Hanover Park and Schaumburg, IL
what_you_do: Keystone Club builds leadership through school help, career prep and community service. Youth of the Year trains teens in public speaking, resume writing and social justice. Then it holds a contest. Winners can get Club scholarships.
deadline_text: No application window or deadline is posted on the page. Call (847) 608-5017 or email membership@bgcncil.org for current dates.

name: Junior Staff (Boys & Girls Clubs of Oakland)
what_you_do: Club teens who meet the requirements take paid work positions at the Club. The page says these give real work experience and professional development.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page.

name: Teen Volunteering and Summer Teen Internship (Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula
city: Menlo Park, CA (Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula, 401 Pierce Rd., serving San Mateo County)
what_you_do: You help younger kids with homework once a week during the school year. In summer, teen interns help with classes and fun learning time at the club's summer program.
grades: Summer Teen Internship: rising 9th to 12th grade
deadline_text: Program Support: rolling applications during the school year (September to May). Summer Teen Internship: application opens March 2027 (exact day not posted).

name: Camp Mendocino Leaders-in-Training (LIT) and Careers-in-Training (CIT)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (Camp Mendocino)
city: San Francisco, CA (overnight camp at Camp Mendocino; buses leave from San Francisco)
what_you_do: LITs help younger campers, take job skills classes and shadow staff at an overnight camp. CITs pick a track: youth work, upkeep or the kitchen. They learn job skills and earn a certificate.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 15, with rolling deadlines Feb 16, March 16, April 13 and a final deadline of May 4, 2026. The camp says 'See you in 2027,' but 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Leaders-In-Training (LIT) Program (Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco
what_you_do: You take 10 hours of work training, then work about 7 hours a week for 10 weeks at a Clubhouse. You get coaching, explore careers, and build a professional portfolio.
deadline_text: Past cohorts began with a required training in January 2025 (Jan 11 to 18) and September 2025 (Sept 13 to 20). The 2026-27 training dates are not posted.

name: Teen Summer Program
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Leandro
city: San Leandro, CA (Teen Clubhouse, 2200 San Leandro Blvd)
what_you_do: You pick hands-on classes such as digital media, cooking, sports, art, tech, wellness and college readiness. You make your own summer schedule at the teen clubhouse.
deadline_text: The program page is for summer 2027 and says details are coming this spring. No dates are posted.

name: STEM Drone Summer Camp
what_you_do: Build a drone that works. Learn to solder. Learn the FAA safety rules. Fly drones with an adult watching. Then study the data from the air with GIS tools.
deadline_text: The page lists dates but no year and no deadline. Spots are limited.

name: WIOA Youth Program (Billings area)
org: District VII HRDC with the Montana Department of Labor and Industry
what_you_do: Get help to finish school and get ready for work. You can get tutoring. You can get paid or unpaid work. You can get job training, a mentor and help with college.
deadline_text: No application dates stated on the state program page.

name: LINKS (Leadership Institute for Nature, Kids and Stewardship)
what_you_do: Be a trained mentor for 3rd to 6th graders in an after-school program. You canoe, build forts, play games and explore the outdoors with them.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 applications were due March 26, 2026. The page says there are fall and spring sessions. Next dates are not posted.

name: Movin' On
org: Montana Center on Inclusive Education, MSU Billings
what_you_do: Visit MSU Billings, City College and Rocky Mountain College. Get a mentor who is a college student with a disability. There is also a four day summer camp in the dorms.
deadline_text: The page says Summer Camp 2027 information is coming soon. No dates or deadline are posted.

name: TRIO Upward Bound
what_you_do: Meet with an advisor during the school year and spend six summer weeks living on campus. You take enrichment classes and go on field trips. It prepares you for college.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Summer jobs at Oasis WaterPark
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at a water park: lifeguard, swim instructor, concessions, or guest services. Most jobs start at age 15.
deadline_text: The program page says Oasis is no longer taking applications for Summer 2026. Next summer's dates are not posted.

name: Youth Volunteer Corps
what_you_do: Sign up for team service projects posted online and log your volunteer hours. The city says the projects teach life and work skills.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. The page calls the program new and gives no dates.

name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: Teens meet twice a month to brainstorm ideas, plan programs and help improve the library for teens.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due September 1, 2026. Next year's date is not posted yet.

name: Wonder Guides
what_you_do: Wonder Guides help visitors and staff at a children's museum. You learn how the museum runs. Other volunteer jobs are play help and special events.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Museum Teen Council
what_you_do: Make art, talk about art, and learn from people who work in the art world. Council members also take part in volunteer chances and community events.
deadline_text: The Fall 2026 group started October 7, 2026 (applications were due September 16). Spring 2027 applications open December 1 and are due January 20.

name: Yellowstone County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and do projects in things like animals, shooting sports and other skills. Clubs are run by adult leaders.
deadline_text: The 4-H year starts October 1. Clubs may take new members until December 1 or until they are full. The page does not state the year; the club list is labeled 26-27.

name: Yellowstone County Summer Jobs Program
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job with a local employer. You also do a paid work skills training before summer and get an adult mentor.
deadline_text: No current dates on the program page. The article is from August 2024.

name: Bismarck Parks and Recreation District Part-Time Jobs for Ages 14 and 15+
what_you_do: Part-time jobs. Open to 14 year olds. Youth basketball official, ice arena attendant, open gym supervisor and youth tennis instructor. Open to 15 year olds. Lifeguard, swim lesson instructor, after-school BLAST leader and youth basketball coach.
deadline_text: No application deadline is listed for part-time or seasonal jobs.

name: Black Girls Code Workshops
what_you_do: You can join workshops in robotics, art and AI for girls ages 7 to 18. Free Code Along videos on YouTube and mentoring chances are also available.
deadline_text: See the events page for current workshops.

name: Camp Carilion
what_you_do: Four-day camp with hands-on practice of life-saving skills, CPR training, nursing skills, operating room instruments and many health careers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due Apr 3, 2026. Camp ran June 16 to 19, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Student Volunteers (Historic Smithfield)
what_you_do: Help at an old house museum next to Virginia Tech. You could be a tour guide, store cashier or gardener. You could also decorate for the holidays or help at the July camp.
deadline_text: No deadline. Open season April to December.

name: Junior Volunteer Program (LewisGale Hospital Montgomery)
what_you_do: Help patients and staff. You work the info desk and deliver flowers and mail. You run errands to the lab and imaging. You also help with patient admitting and discharge and move patients in wheelchairs.
deadline_text: No application deadline is stated. Applicants are contacted for interviews as the need arises.

name: Montgomery County 4-H clubs (including Teens for a Better Tomorrow)
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club to build leadership, citizenship and life skills. Teens can join the Teens for a Better Tomorrow club. It focuses on leadership, career readiness and community service. Many members serve as camp counselors-in-training.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Clubs fill first come, first served.

name: New River Valley Governor's School for the Arts and Humanities
org: Radford University, New River Community College and regional school divisions
what_you_do: Take arts and humanities classes at Radford University for three hours each weekday morning, earn up to 30 college credits, and do internships and mentorships with regional arts groups.
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the program page. Ask your school counselor.

name: Summer Bridge: Women in STEM (Radford University)
org: Radford University, Artis College of Science and Technology
what_you_do: Spend a week on campus to try STEM. You can try space, chemistry, biology, computers, rocks, math, robots and drones.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline are shown on the page. It links to a 2026 application.

name: SAME Virginia Tech STEM Camp
org: Society of American Military Engineers (SAME), Central Virginia Post
what_you_do: Day camp with engineering design challenges, drone and robotics activities, construction projects, and tours of STEM labs, construction sites and the Virginia Tech campus.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp was postponed to Summer 2027. The 2026 July 1 application deadline has passed. 2027 dates and application are not posted yet.

name: Summer Enrichment Experience (SEE Camp)
org: Edward Via College of Osteopathic Medicine (VCOM), Virginia campus
what_you_do: Spend a week at a medical school. A surgeon teaches you stitches and knots. You run health care practice drills and use microscopes. You finish with a small group research project.
deadline_text: 2026 registration ran Feb 6 to Mar 6, with acceptances Mar 15 and week commitment due Apr 1. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Virginia 4-H State Congress
what_you_do: Spend four days at Virginia Tech with other 4-H teens in competitive and non-competitive events that build life skills and leadership. Teens stay in dorms. This is the state's main yearly 4-H event for teens.
deadline_text: 2026 Congress was June 16 to 19, 2026. The page gives two different 2026 registration windows: March 6 to May 10, 2026, and March 13 to May 15, 2026 on 4-H Online. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Volunteer Montgomery (volunteers under 18)
what_you_do: Join the county volunteer program. The page does not list specific projects for minors.
deadline_text: No deadline.

name: BLAST: Building Leaders for Advancing Science and Technology (Virginia Tech session)
org: Virginia Space Grant Consortium with Virginia Tech and partner universities
what_you_do: Stay three days in college dorms. Try hands-on STEM activities led by university faculty, with demos and tours. No STEM experience is needed. You can pick one of five campuses, including Virginia Tech in Blacksburg.
deadline_text: Applications open December 1, 2026 and close February 1, 2027 (page: 'Applications: Open December 1 - February 1 2027'). 2027 sessions: William & Mary June 20 to 23, UVA June 27 to 30, Radford July 18 to 21, Virginia Tech July 21 to 24, Old Dominion July 25 to 28. Acceptance notices go out at the end of April.

name: CyberSpark cybersecurity camp (Virginia Tech)
org: Virginia Tech College of Engineering, DoD Senior Military College Cyber Institute
what_you_do: Do hands-on cybersecurity activities. Virginia Tech staff and faculty lead them. You also learn about careers in the field. No experience is needed.
deadline_text: 2026 camps: July 6 to 10 in Blacksburg and July 27 to 31 in Arlington, VA. Applications closed March 24, 2026 and decisions were emailed April 17, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Explore Architecture (formerly Inside Design)
what_you_do: A week of hands-on design work. You build models, draw plans, scan and print in 3D, and hear talks. It ends with a show of your work. Choose day, overnight in the dorms, or online.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 registration closed May 15, 2026 or when full. The page says registration will open December 1st (no year given) and close May 15th or when full. No 2027 dates or prices are posted.

name: Geosciences High School Summer Camp
org: Virginia Tech Department of Geosciences with the Fralin Life Sciences Institute
what_you_do: A full week of solving real earth science problems. Study soil, water, earthquakes and volcanoes. Tour labs and design an exhibit for the Museum of Geosciences.
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran June 1 to 5. No registration deadline and no 2027 dates posted.

name: Imagination (Virginia Tech engineering camp)
org: Virginia Tech Center for Engineering Excellence and Discovery (CEED)
what_you_do: Build real devices like a drone, a video game console or a digital camera. Learn the engineering design process and how to solder.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran June 14 to July 3, 2026. 2027 dates and application deadline not posted.

name: Pamplin's Inspiring Possibilities (PIP) Academy
org: Virginia Tech Pamplin College of Business
what_you_do: Spend ten days on campus. Learn about business majors like money, sales, hotels and real estate. Work on a team project. Meet teachers, graduates and company partners.
deadline_text: Application deadline not shown on the page. The page shows the 2026 session; the next one for seniors in 2027-28 is not posted.

name: Pathways for Future Engineers (Virginia Tech)
what_you_do: A Virginia Tech College of Engineering program for first generation college students. It offers summer engineering programs. The page does not say how long they are or how they run.
