name: Teen Ambassadors
what_you_do: Teens learn the history of their own neighborhood. They practice public speaking and interviews and visit old buildings. Then they work as guides at the Open House Chicago festival in October.
deadline_text: 2026 round: priority deadline August 21, notices August 25, confirm by August 31. The page says it is sold out.

name: Teen Fellows
what_you_do: A 15 month program about architecture and design. Fellows do a six week summer session, take fall and spring terms, and finish with a paid second-summer internship.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 round is closed. The page says applications for Summer 2027 to Summer 2028 open in November. Last deadline was March 31.

name: Art Institute of Chicago Teen Council
what_you_do: A group of 15 teens works with museum staff. They plan programs and tools that make the museum more welcoming and useful for Chicago-area youth. Members meet at the museum and go behind the scenes.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 Teen Council application was open through June 30, 2026. 2027-28 dates not posted.

name: Art Institute of Chicago Teen Summer Internship
org: Art Institute of Chicago with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help with festivals, gallery tours and workshops. They meet museum workers and local artists. They also plan and host creative events for visitors.
deadline_text: Applications open in the spring through After School Matters. Exact 2027 dates not posted.

name: College First (grades 11 and 12)
org: Chicago Botanic Garden, Science Career Continuum
what_you_do: Rising CPS juniors and seniors take a college-level environmental science class and get a mentor. They do a summer research project. Through the school year they get help with college applications. The job is paid, with school-year stipends.
deadline_text: Page says the application deadline is Tuesday, April 15 (no year shown).

name: Science First (grades 9 and 10)
org: Chicago Botanic Garden, Science Career Continuum
what_you_do: Rising CPS freshmen and sophomores spend four weeks at the Garden. They learn about nature, biology, ecology and environmental justice. They do group projects and show them to family and friends. Students are paid.
deadline_text: Page says the application deadline is Tuesday, April 15 (no year shown).

name: Summer at Columbia
what_you_do: A four-week program for high school students. You take a freshman-level college class in the arts, media or communications. Your teachers work in those fields. Credits can count if you enroll at Columbia later.
deadline_text: 2026 registration has closed. 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Sophomores, juniors and seniors in fall 2027
name: Driehaus Summer Business Institute
org: DePaul University, Driehaus College of Business
what_you_do: Take a one-week class with team projects in money, sales, business and accounting. You pitch a new idea for a business. You earn a business certificate.
deadline_text: 2027 dates and sign-up are not posted yet. The page says to check back later. Late sign-ups go on a waitlist.

name: Invest for Kids Summer Investment Challenge
org: DePaul University, Driehaus College of Business
city: DePaul Lincoln Park and Loop campuses, Chicago, IL
what_you_do: Live on campus for five days and four nights in a team sponsored by a company. Learn markets and valuation, use Excel and Bloomberg tools, then pitch a stock idea to professionals.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline are posted on the page.

name: On the Money Paid Internship
org: Economic Awareness Council (with DePaul University Writing Center)
what_you_do: Research and write an article for On the Money Magazine. Teens write it, and it is about money and starting a business. You also build resume, speaking, writing and interview skills.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 interviews were tentatively in September. No closing date is stated. A spring internship is announced but its dates are not posted.

name: High School Science and Digital Learning Internship
what_you_do: Each summer, 15 Chicago-area high school students pick a Field Museum scientist or expert. They do a 5-week research project. They also learn digital media, tech and career skills.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. The page says to check back in early 2027 for next summer.

name: Chicago Green Ambassadors Summer Program
org: The Field Museum, Keller Science Action Center (Roots and Routes Initiative and Youth Conservation Action)
what_you_do: Paid summer interns link their neighborhoods with the Burnham Wildlife Corridor. It is a nature area on the south lakefront. Interns work on real problems in the environment and in the community.
deadline_text: Dates and application not posted on the program page.

name: Field Museum Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens greet visitors and share science stories. They help young kids in the Crown Family PlayLab and show real specimens at interpretive carts in Stanley Field Hall.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Jan 2026 to Feb 28, 2026. Interviews late March or early April; final notice by May 8. The page says check back in early 2027.

name: Free Spirit Media Teen Programs
what_you_do: Teens learn screenwriting, editing, camera work, audio and acting. Programs run after school, in school and in summer. Teens also get job skills training.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 programs: Sept 21 to Nov 20, 2026. Registration deadline not stated.

name: Building Leaders teen program
what_you_do: A free after-school program for teens. It has homework help, science and art projects, college visits, financial aid workshops and service hours. Gads Hill says teens can also find job chances through After School Matters and One Summer Chicago.
deadline_text: Enrolling now per the site. No deadline stated.

name: Genesys Works Chicago paid year-long internship
what_you_do: Juniors get 8 weeks of training in business and tech skills. In senior year they work a paid internship at a partner company for about 20 hours a week. The internship lasts a year. They also get college and career coaching.
deadline_text: No 2026-27 application dates are posted on the program pages.

name: Goodman Musical Theater Intensive
what_you_do: A free summer program. Teens train in acting, singing and dancing with professional musical theater artists. They perform in a show at the Goodman.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed; callbacks were Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Goodman PlayBuild Youth Intensive
what_you_do: A free summer theater program. Teens learn acting, creative writing, improv and physical theater from pros. They create an original show about civic issues.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed; callbacks were Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Goodman Youth Arts Council (GYAC)
what_you_do: CPS students use theater to talk about issues that young people face. They plan and run events by teens for teens. They learn from Goodman artists and staff, and they act as ambassadors for the theater.
deadline_text: Applications for 2025/26 are closed. 2026/27 dates not posted on the program page.

name: RISE Teen Program
org: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry (MSI Chicago)
what_you_do: A free program where teens explore careers in science, tech, engineering, arts and math. You do hands-on projects, LEGO engineering challenges and panels with pros and mentors. You can join a 12-week session or drop in.
deadline_text: Registration for the Fall 2026 session has closed. Next session dates not posted.

name: Chicago Metro History Day
what_you_do: Students pick a topic that fits the yearly theme and research it like a historian. Then they make a website, show, film, paper or exhibit. Volunteers judge the projects at yearly contests in the Chicago area.
deadline_text: 2027 theme: Innovation in History. Teacher intent form due Dec 1, 2026. Student project registration due Feb 10, 2027; upload due Feb 17, 2027. Regional contest Feb 27, 2027 (grades 9-12). Junior Division (grades 6-8) Mar 6, 2027. National contest June 13-17, 2027.

name: Broadway Youth Center (drop-in, health and housing connections)
what_you_do: A drop-in center for young people. It offers medical care, social help and mental health care. It also links you to housing and other help.
deadline_text: No deadline. Drop-in hours are Mon 9 to 3, Tue 10 to 3, Wed 1 to 5, Thu 9 to 3, Fri 9 to 3.

name: Bronzeville Youth Shelter (emergency shelter for ages 14 to 17)
what_you_do: A safe, temporary place to stay for teens with nowhere to go. Ignite also runs a drop-in resource center.
deadline_text: No deadline. A 24/7 help line is listed.

name: Ignite employment and education program (paid internships)
what_you_do: Youth make a plan with a case manager for school, GED, college or certificates. Then they do four weeks of job workshops, then an eight week paid internship with a local employer.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Camp Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help counselors run Conservation Camp for young kids. They set up activities, join in and help make camp fun. They earn service hours and an EcoLeader certificate.
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Conservation Ambassadors Board
org: Lincoln Park Zoo with After School Matters
what_you_do: Each semester, teens study one conservation topic in depth. Then they plan and carry out a project and share it with peers and the public. They build skills in leadership, research, speaking, event planning, promotion and money.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 application opened Jan 20 and was due Feb 1. A fall term also runs. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Nature Buds Internship
org: Lincoln Park Zoo with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help run nature play for the zoo's youngest visitors. There is music, art, story time and sensory bins. Interns also help kids and the adults with them find their way around the zoo.
deadline_text: The summer 2026 application was to open the week of April 27 on the After School Matters site. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Malott Family Research Apprenticeship Program
what_you_do: Apprentices work with zoo researchers on a real science question. They learn research methods in the field and on computers. At the end of summer they show their results at a poster session.
grades: Entering grades 11 to 12, or freshman year of college
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Malott Family Zoo Intern Program
what_you_do: Interns teach zoo guests about animals and conservation. They learn how to share conservation messages. They meet zoo researchers and animal care staff. They finish with a project they present.
grades: Entering grades 10 to 12, or freshman year of college
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Zoo Teens events
what_you_do: Free events just for teens, led by zoo experts. You can make conservation art, learn to live next to city wildlife like bats and birds, and play a role-playing game.
deadline_text: Events: Saturday Oct 31 (Roll for Wildlife, Prism Games, Logan Square) and Saturday Nov 7 (Plants and Prints, Lincoln Park Zoo). The page has no year, but both weekdays match 2026. Register on the page.

name: Marwen Art@Work summer internship
what_you_do: Nearly 20 young people are hired for paid 5-week internships. The jobs are at arts groups and creative businesses. Interns also go to Marwen workshops. Topics are resumes, interviews, public speaking and money.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 open in spring 2027. For 2026 they were due April 11, 2026.

name: Teen Creative Agency (TCA)
what_you_do: Chicago teens meet each week with two lead artists. They spend time in the galleries and at other culture sites. They make art projects and public events, including the yearly teen show called 21Minus.
deadline_text: Applications open in the spring, per the page. Exact dates not posted.

name: CPS Student Advisory Council (Mikva Challenge)
what_you_do: Students from 20+ Chicago schools meet with CPS leaders. They gather ideas from peers and do research. Then they write advice on school issues. Past groups spoke to the CPS Board.
grades: Citywide Youth Councils are for current 9th to 11th graders
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Safety and Justice Council (Mikva Challenge)
what_you_do: Youth who live in Chicago or Cook County give advice to the Cook County Board President. They talk about youth justice, safety in the community and holding police responsible. They write advice each year.
grades: Citywide Youth Councils are for current 9th to 11th graders
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Mikva Student Election Judge Program
org: Mikva Challenge Illinois with Chicago election officials
what_you_do: High school juniors and seniors work at polling places on Election Day. They do the same jobs as adult judges. They help voters, run the machines and close the polls.
deadline_text: Each election cycle. No dates posted on the page.

name: Mikva Summer Fellows
org: Mikva Challenge Illinois with the Illinois Department of Human Services Youth Investment Program
what_you_do: Fellows work for six weeks in the offices of city, county, state and federal leaders. They also go to weekly workshops on leadership, setting goals and job skills.
grades: Placed after senior year of high school
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Teen Health Council (Mikva Challenge)
what_you_do: Teens study the physical, mental and sexual health of Chicago youth. They make action plans. They share ideas with the Chicago Department of Public Health and CPS. They also learn about public health careers.
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.

name: Recreation Leader in Training (RIT), ages 13 to 15
what_you_do: This is a mentoring and job-readiness program for 13 to 15 year olds. Teens help with park programs. Programs include sports, games, nature and arts and crafts. You build leadership, communication and customer service skills.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions: Winter Jan 12 to Mar 14 (programs viewable online Dec 1, 2025), Spring Apr 6 to Jun 6, Summer Jun 22 to Jul 31, Fall Oct 5 to Dec 11 (viewable online July 27). 2027 dates not posted.

name: Chicago Park District summer jobs (lifeguard, recreation leader, junior laborer)
what_you_do: Teens 16 and up can work in the parks. Jobs include lifeguard and day camp recreation leader. You can also be a special recreation leader. Those camps serve kids and adults with intellectual disabilities. Junior laborers do landscape work.
deadline_text: All four 2026 summer positions are marked closed. 2027 dates not posted. The Park District holds free Teen Opportunity Fairs in Feb and March (Feb 21 to Mar 14 in 2026) where teens can apply.

name: Rush University Medical Center volunteer program
what_you_do: Volunteers greet visitors and walk them to where they need to go. They push wheelchairs, deliver flowers and mail, visit with patients and help with events. After six months you can apply for a role in one department.
deadline_text: New volunteers are always welcome, per the page. No deadline is stated.

name: SAIC Early College Program (ECP) courses
org: School of the Art Institute of Chicago
what_you_do: High school students take art and design classes in fall, spring or summer. Examples are figure drawing, animation, fashion and comics. You build work for your portfolio for art school.
grades: High school; college credit only for those who finished sophomore year
deadline_text: Register online for each term. No fixed deadline stated on the program pages.

name: SAIC Early College Program Summer Institute (ECPSI)
org: School of the Art Institute of Chicago
what_you_do: Intensive 1, 2 or 4-week summer art and design courses at SAIC. Students earn one college credit for each week attended.
deadline_text: Page says registration opens November 1 (year not stated; (year inferred from the next cycle)). The 2026 sessions ran June 15 to July 31. A priority deadline is mentioned but not dated on the program page.

name: Steppenwolf Young Adult Council
what_you_do: 30 high school students meet every Wednesday to learn how a big theater works. They see plays, join workshops with theater artists, and plan teen nights with the ensemble.
deadline_text: Page says applications are closed. Next dates not posted.

name: Chicago Summer Business Institute (CSBI) Summer Internship
what_you_do: Six-week summer internship. Interns must commit to the daily requirements, but the pages do not describe them or list the job sites. A former intern's profile mentions tasks such as filing and spreadsheet work. Contact the office for placement details.
deadline_text: The portal is open Feb 1 to Mar 31 (the page gives no year but names the 2027 summer program, so expect Feb 1 to Mar 31, 2027).

name: CPS-UChicago Program
org: University of Chicago with Chicago Public Schools
what_you_do: Advanced CPS juniors and seniors take one college class each quarter at the University of Chicago. They sit in class with UChicago students. The classes go on the CPS transcript.
deadline_text: For 2026-27 the application opened June 8, 2026 and closed July 15, 2026. 2027-28 dates not posted.

name: Chicago EYES on Cancer
org: University of Chicago Medicine Comprehensive Cancer Center
what_you_do: Students work full time in a University of Chicago cancer research lab for two summers. They also get monthly career workshops, talks and mentors. They present at a research event.
grades: High school sophomore, junior or senior (or college freshman or sophomore)
deadline_text: Application and two recommendations due Nov 30, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. CT. In-person interviews Jan 4, 2027.

name: Healthcare Experience and Research in Oncology (HERO)
org: University of Chicago Medicine Comprehensive Cancer Center
what_you_do: A two-week online program where high school students work on a cancer genetics project and a patient case study, hear daily faculty talks and build skills. Students get a home lab kit.
deadline_text: Application and two recommendations due Mar 1, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. CT. Interviews in April 2027.

name: UChicago Medicine student volunteer program
what_you_do: Student volunteers help patients, families and visitors in the hospital. They welcome people and visit with patients. They help families find their way. Roles include Child Life and patient comfort teams.
grades: High school, college and graduate students
deadline_text: Fall window ran Aug 25 to Oct 1, 2026 (may close early). Next cycle starts Jan 10, 2027; closing date not posted.

name: researcHStart
org: University of Chicago Medicine Comprehensive Cancer Center with UIC, UIUC, Northwestern and Rush
what_you_do: High school students spend 8 weeks in a cancer research lab. They work 35 to 40 hours a week. The lab is at one of five Illinois universities. Students also get career workshops and mentors.
grades: High school junior or senior at time of application
deadline_text: Application and two recommendations due Jan 11, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. CT. On-campus interviews in February 2027; acceptance notices March 1, 2027.

name: University of Chicago Summer Session pre-college programs
what_you_do: High school students take college-level courses in person (live on campus or commute) or online. Choices run from short programs to research courses. Examples are lab biology or fieldwork with Field Museum fossil experts.
grades: High school (programs open depend on your current grade)
deadline_text: 2026 deadlines: priority Feb 11, regular Mar 12 (Practicum priority only). 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Entering grades 10, 11 or 12 (from the Tech and AI day page)
name: UIC Business high school summer days (Accounting, Finance, Tech and AI, Marketing)
org: University of Illinois Chicago, College of Business Administration
city: UIC, 601 S. Morgan St., Chicago, IL
what_you_do: Spend a day on campus in a business area. The Finance Day had a trading game, a student panel and a stock pitch contest. Other days cover accounting, tech and AI, and marketing.
deadline_text: The 2026 programs ran June 23 to 26, 2026 and registration was full and closed. The page does not say if they will run again.

name: Windy City Harvest Youth Farm
org: Chicago Botanic Garden, Windy City Harvest, with After School Matters
what_you_do: Teens grow food on urban farms, tend beehives, cook with what they grow, and sell it at farm stands and markets. They build leadership and job skills and explore careers in food and farming.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

name: Chicago Youth Works (formerly One Summer Chicago): summer jobs
org: City of Chicago Dept. of Family and Support Services
what_you_do: The City runs a summer youth jobs program. It places young people in paid jobs. Partners include the Park District, CPS and City Colleges. Others are the Chicago Housing Authority, the Forest Preserves and Lincoln Park Zoo.
deadline_text: 2026 application ran March 10 to May 29, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect late winter or spring.

name: Chicagobility (paid summer career exploration for ages 14 and 15)
org: City of Chicago Dept. of Family and Support Services
what_you_do: This is a six-week summer program. It has workforce training, financial literacy training and career exploration. It has 120 hours of activities. You make a resume. You sign up for direct deposit.
deadline_text: The 2026 Chicago Youth Works application (which covers 14 to 24 year olds) ran March 10 to May 29, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: VolunTEEN Program (Children's Healthcare of Atlanta)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a children's hospital over the summer, at least one 3-hour shift a week for eight weeks. Placements are at Arthur M. Blank, Hughes Spalding or Scottish Rite hospitals.
deadline_text: The page says the next chance to apply is February 2027; exact open and close dates are not posted yet.

name: CHP Explorer Post (East Sacramento)
what_you_do: You can join an Explorer post for teens who want a law enforcement career. You get training and mentoring from CHP officers.
deadline_text: Rolling.

name: Junior Ambassador Program (high school volunteers)
what_you_do: You serve patients and visitors. You support hospital staff. You explore health care careers. You work one 4 hour shift each week.
deadline_text: Three cycles a year: summer apply by April 30, fall by August 30, spring by December 30. The page lists month and day only, no year.

name: Living Coast Discovery Center Volunteer (ages 16 to 17)
what_you_do: Help at a nature center and wildlife rescue by supporting events, working on the grounds and in the office, and later in animal care. Orientations are held on weekends.
deadline_text: Accepted on a rolling basis. Orientations are on alternating Saturdays and Sundays at 10 a.m. each month.

name: 10x10 Teen Volunteer Team (Cincinnati Art Museum)
what_you_do: Help plan the 10x10 Teen Art Expo, a week long exhibition of more than 100 teen artists from the greater Cincinnati region. The team picks the theme that artists use for their 10 by 10 inch pieces and meets monthly.
deadline_text: Volunteer applications for the 2026 to 27 team were due Friday September 4, 2026, with replies by September 11. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: Teen Workforce Development (Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Cincinnati)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Cincinnati
what_you_do: Join the Clubs' teen Workforce Development programming. You explore careers with local businesses. You also explore careers with universities, trades and the military. You learn about money. You get ready for jobs. Driver's education is part of it too.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Enroll through the Club member portal.

name: C-YA Teen Council
what_you_do: You join monthly workshops with local artists, tour the museum behind the scenes, and plan a CAC-sponsored teen event. You also post on the teen Instagram account.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 enrollment deadline was July 11. The next deadline is not posted.

name: CCM Prep Ballet Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: A one week summer ballet program. You work on ballet skills, pointe and modern dance. You also take classes on avoiding injury, healthy eating and pilates.
deadline_text: Registration opens in January 2027. A closing date is not stated on the page.

name: CCM Prep Musical Theatre Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: You train in singing, dance and acting. Teachers from the conservatory and local pros lead you. Pick a 1 week or 2 week summer session.
deadline_text: Auditions opened Oct 1, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 15, 2027. Final deadline March 1, 2027.

name: CCM Prep Strings Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: A one week summer program for high school string players. You play in small groups and a string orchestra. You learn from pros in master classes. It ends with a concert.
deadline_text: Auditions opened Oct 1, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 15, 2027. Final deadline March 15, 2027.

name: High School Summer Immersion Program
what_you_do: A one month summer program. You learn by doing and grow work skills with experts across the hospital. It replaces the earlier paid summer internship.
deadline_text: Online application opens Nov 1 and closes Feb 1, for summer 2027.

name: High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You complete tasks under hospital staff supervision. This is in the pediatric setting. You work a 2 to 3 hour shift each week. You build teamwork and leadership skills.
deadline_text: The deadline for the Summer 2026 session has passed. The page says the summer application is usually posted in January, with about two months to finish the packet.

name: CPS EDGE Internship
what_you_do: You work on a district team that matches your career goals for 6 to 8 weeks, for example facilities or communications. You shadow staff, do real tasks and tour school sites.
deadline_text: No application dates are given on the program page.

name: Aquatics Jobs: Lifeguard and Pool Staff
what_you_do: You can work part-time or seasonal jobs at Cincinnati public pools. Lifeguards keep pool users safe. Gate and pool monitors handle customer service. They also watch behavior around the pool.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page. A 2026 lifeguard screening registration form is linked.

name: Youth to Work (Y2WK) Summer Jobs
what_you_do: You work a summer job with City departments or nonprofit partners. Examples include recreation centers, pools, parks, fire and police cadets. There are workshops on workplace etiquette and basic work skills.
deadline_text: The program page says the application is usually available February to March. In 2026 the deadline passed in March (WVXU reported about two weeks left on March 10, 2026). 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Teen Volunteers (Great Parks of Hamilton County)
what_you_do: Volunteer long term in parks. Jobs include habitat restoration, education programs and special events. You can work on golf course upkeep. You can grow native plants or garden. You can also care for animals. Role training and uniforms are provided.
deadline_text: Long term volunteer information sessions have ended for 2026. Great Parks says it will host them again in March 2027.

name: Hamilton County Youth Employment Program
org: Hamilton County Job and Family Services
what_you_do: You get a paid job and job training all year. Training covers resumes, interviews, work habits, customer service and solving problems.
deadline_text: The county page has a Youth Apply Here link and no closing date. Summer slots can fill early, so apply in winter.

name: Library Volunteer Opportunities (ages 12+)
what_you_do: You can volunteer at the Main Library or a branch. You can help with kids and teen events. You can also help with holds, clerical work, technology help and tutoring.
deadline_text: The library volunteer system says it is accepting new volunteer applications. No deadline is posted.

name: Youth Programs Volunteers
what_you_do: Greet visitors, help guests find their way and cover the museums' gallery spaces, working with museum teams. Teens set their own shifts and can stay until they graduate.
deadline_text: Youth volunteers are recruited each year from January through March. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Youth Volunteer Opportunities (Cincinnati Nature Center)
what_you_do: Help collect data on the maple trees in the sugarbush during maple season. Help tidy the grounds in early spring. Teens ages 14 to 17 can also be Leaders in Training. They help camp counselors, including on nature hikes.
deadline_text: The volunteer page says recruiting and onboarding is closed for the 2026 season and to check back in the new year for 2027 dates.

name: Green Team Youth Summer Jobs
org: Groundwork Ohio River Valley with Cincinnati Parks
what_you_do: You improve and maintain trails, parks and community spaces. You remove invasive plants. You learn job readiness and natural resource skills. These skills help in the green industry.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the program pages. The City post is undated.

grades: Showcases: entering grades 6 to 12. Academies: entering grades 1 to 6 or 6 to 12
name: Performance Academies and Showcases (Cincinnati Playhouse summer theatre camp)
what_you_do: Two week academies put on a whole play or musical. One week showcases build stage skills, with a focus on acting and telling stories.
deadline_text: The program page listed 2026 camps with an early bird discount through Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Cincinnati Police Summer Cadet Program
what_you_do: You work part time over the summer for the Cincinnati Police Department and learn about police work. The page says it gives help to people who may choose police work as a career.
deadline_text: No current dates are posted on the police page. A January 2024 city news item said the 2024 police cadet application had its own deadline, so check in winter.

name: Job Shadowing (TriHealth)
what_you_do: Follow a TriHealth staff member for a short look at the job. It is usually about 8 to 16 hours. Shadowing is observation only. You cannot talk with patients in a hands-on way or see their medical records.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are posted. Check with the program.

name: UC Summer Engineering Camps (Young and Rising Engineers)
org: University of Cincinnati College of Engineering and Applied Science
what_you_do: Day camps on the Clifton campus from 9 am to 4 pm. Camps are organized by age and interest level.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed and late applications were not accepted. Sign up for the interest list to hear about 2027 camps.

name: Early IT Summer Camp (University of Cincinnati)
org: University of Cincinnati School of Information Technology
what_you_do: Attend a free day camp. Learn cybersecurity, software development, game development and data and cloud technologies. Hear from IT leaders. Build a team project with a college student mentor.
deadline_text: The camp page has a Registration is Now Open notice for June 1 to 18, Monday to Friday. Spots are first come, first served. The page shows no year and no closing date, so a teen cannot tell which summer it means. The registration notice may be from a past year: the same page still links an Early IT Summer Camp 2023 Application. Email ucearlyit@ucmail.uc.edu to confirm the year before applying.

name: Career Journeys Program (UC Medical Center)
what_you_do: You learn what hospital jobs are like, both with patients and behind the scenes. You hear from staff, go on tours and join online sessions.
deadline_text: The page links an online application and gives no deadline.

name: UC Health Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors, work in waiting rooms and clinics, and do other tasks such as the gift shop. At least 4 hours a week.
deadline_text: UC Medical Center summer applications run April 1 to 30. West Chester summer applications run April 1 to 30; fall applications start in August and spring applications start in December.

name: Medical Sciences Summer Institute (University of Cincinnati)
org: University of Cincinnati College of Medicine
what_you_do: Take a week long, full day workshop at the UC College of Medicine. It is for rising high school juniors and seniors. They should be interested in medicine or health care. Tracks are Cellular or Molecular, plus one Medical Informatics session.
grades: Rising high school juniors and seniors
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was March 25, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program (Urban Champions)
org: Urban League of Greater Southwestern Ohio
what_you_do: You work a summer job that teaches responsibility and career readiness. The league also runs a yearly youth summit led by teens.

name: Youth Volunteer (Clark Planetarium)

deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

deadline_text: No dates posted. Schools sign up as groups.

deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

deadline_text: 2026-27 class: orientation Aug 17, 2026, retreat Sept 12-13, evenings Oct 14, Oct 26, Nov 16, Dec 7, Jan 25, Feb 22, Mar 22, graduation Apr 19, 2027. Next application dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Help at one of 15 Cobb libraries. Roles listed include book finder (shelver), classroom helper and community garden helper. You can also be a greeter or watch the video games.
deadline_text: The page does not list an application deadline.

deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page. Ask your school's coordinator for the application window.

org: CobbWorks (Cobb County workforce board, WorkSource Cobb)

deadline_text: No application dates are posted, and the page does not say whether applications are accepted year-round. Call 770-528-4300 or email bossinfo@cobbworks.org to ask about timing.

name: College of Alameda Concurrent Enrollment for High School Students
what_you_do: You take real college classes while you are still in high school.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadlines or term dates.

what_you_do: Take free college classes at College of San Mateo while in high school. Dual enrollment is through partner high schools. It includes free books and materials. Concurrent enrollment is free for up to 11 units a semester.
deadline_text: No application deadline stated on the program pages.

name: College Park Composite Squadron, Civil Air Patrol cadets
org: Civil Air Patrol, Maryland Wing (College Park Composite Squadron, MD-011)
what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. This squadron meets on Wednesday evenings at the College Park Airport.
deadline_text: No application deadline is stated on the squadron page. Email the commander to ask how to start.

name: Greenbelt Youth Advisory Committee
what_you_do: Advise the City Council on issues that affect kids, teens and families. Meets monthly at places around the city.
deadline_text: No application dates posted.

org: Luminis Health Doctors Community Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital you are placed in for a full semester. You work at least 3 hours a week.
deadline_text: The Lanham campus was accepting student applications when read. Deadlines are listed only for the Annapolis campus (Summer May 1, Fall Aug 1, Spring Dec 1).

name: NASA Goddard Space Club Scholars Program
org: National Space Club and Foundation with NASA Goddard Space Flight Center
what_you_do: Six weeks on site at NASA Goddard working with a scientist or engineer on a real project such as robotics, mission software or satellite data analysis.
deadline_text: The application period has closed. The page does not give 2026 or 2027 dates.

name: ARTrepreneur
org: Prince George's County Department of Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)
what_you_do: Learn branding, marketing and business basics for young artists. It ends with a pitch contest.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the teen programs page.

name: Shakespeare in the Parks Apprenticeship Program
org: Prince George's County Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)
what_you_do: Join a summer ensemble. It tours Shakespeare plays for families. It plays in parks across Prince George's and Montgomery counties. Professional theater artists mentor you.
deadline_text: The county page lists a March 1, 2027 deadline but does not say whether applications are open, and it has no application link. Email to ask before you plan around it.

name: Teen Arts Council (Prince George's County Parks and Recreation)
org: Prince George's County Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)
what_you_do: Serve on the council for an eight month term. You help curate art projects and presentations. You attend council meetings every two weeks. You also do community service and join an annual art field trip.

name: Young Stars
org: Prince George's County Department of Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)

deadline_text: No dates posted on the teen programs page.

what_you_do: Take college classes at PGCC while still in high school and earn college credit.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 application deadline Dec 18, 2026. Summer 2027 deadline Apr 16, 2027. Fall 2027 deadline Jul 16, 2027.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital in 4-hour shifts, working toward 100 hours within 12 months.
deadline_text: The page does not say whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis or have a deadline. The process usually takes about one month.

name: Brin Maryland Mathematics Camp
org: University of Maryland, Department of Mathematics
what_you_do: A two-week summer day camp in advanced math. It is for high school students who are strongly driven.
deadline_text: 2027 dates and deadline not posted.

deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Friday May 8, 2026, with notices by May 22 and rolling spots after that. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: UMD Volcano Camp for Prince George's County students

what_you_do: One week of learning why volcanoes erupt and which ones are the most dangerous. You do hands-on volcano research.

what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club and pick projects like livestock, science, food or sewing. You learn to lead, build hobbies and serve your community.

deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Friday, June 12, 2026 at 5 PM. The city says it holds a formal recruitment in odd-numbered years, or when a seat opens. The next dates are not posted.

name: Congressional App Challenge
what_you_do: Build an app in any language and submit it to your House district. Winners are shown at the US Capitol.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline for registering and submitting is October 26, 2026.

name: Contra Costa 4-H Youth Development Program
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects to work on during the year. Most meetings and activities are from August through May.
deadline_text: Youth enrollment opened Aug 3, 2026 for the 2026-2027 program year. The page gives no closing date.

name: Contra Costa College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: You can take free college classes. There is no cost for tuition, books or enrollment fees. You must attend West Contra Costa USD, Leadership Public Schools, Griffin Technology Academies or Middle College High School. Classes are on campus.
deadline_text: Rolling by term.

name: Contra Costa County Library Teen Volunteers
city: Contra Costa County, CA (Richmond, Concord, Pleasant Hill and other branches)
what_you_do: Teen roles include Summer Read volunteer, Computer Docent and Homework Help.
grades: Entering 8th grade or above (Summer Read); age 16+ for other roles
deadline_text: Summer Read recruiting starts in April. Some libraries take volunteers on a limited basis.

name: Youth Services, Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County
org: Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County
what_you_do: Get help to finish school, find a job or start a career. Help can include a case manager, job training, work, a mentor and help with school.
deadline_text: The board offers services all year. No deadline is stated.

name: Conservation Corps summer youth program
org: Forest Preserves of Cook County (listed by Cook County government)
what_you_do: A paid summer crew job outdoors. Teens get job training, do hard service work and join nature activities in the forest preserves.
deadline_text: No dates on the Cook County page. The Forest Preserves site was blocked, so check it for the deadline.

name: Opportunity Works (subsidized internships and training)
org: Cook County Office of the President and Chicago Cook Workforce Partnership
what_you_do: Young people who are not working or in school get a paid internship and training. The fields are trucking and shipping, computers, or making things.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline stated on the page.

grades: Teen Tech Tutors and Local History: grades 9 to 12. Summer volunteers: grades 7 to 12. Service crafts and T(w)een board: grades 6 to 8.
name: Teen Volunteers: Tech Tutors, Local History and Summer Volunteers
city: Libertyville and Vernon Hills, IL (Lake County)
what_you_do: Give one-on-one tech help as a Teen Tech Tutor, help with local history work like photocopying and data entry, or volunteer in the summer. Younger teens can do service craft programs or join a T(w)een Advisory Board. Volunteer work counts as service hours.
deadline_text: Local History Assistant (grades 9 to 12) takes applications with no deadline. Teen Tech Tutor closed Oct 15, 2026. Summer 2026 and Seed Library roles are closed.

name: Youth Volunteer Program (ages 13+)
what_you_do: You greet guests. You also help COSI educators as an operational volunteer. First you apply and do an interview. Then you finish three weekend training sessions.
deadline_text: 2026 window: applications Aug 1 to Aug 15, interviews Sept 15, 16 or 17, decisions Sept 30, trainings Oct 24/25, Nov 21/22 and Dec 12/13. The 2026 youth window is closed; no 2027 youth dates. Adult applications open January 2027.

name: COSMOS (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science) at UC Davis
what_you_do: You spend four weeks living on campus. It is a summer program with college-level math and science courses. You also do hands-on projects.
deadline_text: Application opens Jan 6, 2027 at 8:00 AM and closes Feb 5, 2027 (dates page says 5:00 PM). Financial aid forms postmarked by Feb 6, 2027. Decisions Mar 25, 2027.

name: Orange Coast College Dual Enrollment
org: Orange Coast College (Coast Community College District)
what_you_do: Take OCC college classes while in high school, on campus or online (concurrent), or in classes held at a partner high school (CCAP). Classes earn college units and can count toward high school credit.
deadline_text: No fixed date. Apply for the term you want. Forms take at least 7 to 10 business days to process.

name: Costa Mesa Parks and Community Services part-time jobs
what_you_do: You can work part time. You can be a Community Services Leader who runs recreation programs. You can also be a lifeguard or swim instructor. Hours vary. Leaders average 20 hours a week.
deadline_text: Jobs are posted on the city's job page. No dates are stated.

name: Teen Action Academy and Teen Leadership Committee
what_you_do: Teen Action Academy is for grades 9 to 12. It plans service projects and teen events. Teen Leadership Committee is for grades 7 to 8. It builds leadership and teamwork.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026-27 Teen Leadership Committee and Teen Action Academy is open now. The page gives no closing date.

name: Cosumnes Fire Department Explorer Program
org: Cosumnes Community Services District Fire Department
what_you_do: You get classroom and hands-on fire training. You practice leadership. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Applications for the next school year open in Spring 2027 (no exact date or closing date posted).

name: Chicago Public Library paid summer teen internships
org: Chicago Public Library with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help patrons at a library branch. They promote summer programs. They organize spaces and make book lists. Then they co-lead a library program. In 2026, interns were also trained to lead Artist's Studio in the Library with the Art Institute.
deadline_text: The 2026 posting says applications are closed. 2027 dates not posted; the Chicago Youth Works summer application ran March 10 to May 29 in 2026.

name: Chicago Public Library teen assistantships (Teen Best Reads, Teen Gamer's Guild, Teen Media Lab)
org: Chicago Public Library with After School Matters
what_you_do: These are paid teen assistantships at the library. You pick and promote the year's best teen books. Or you plan a free gaming convention. Or you make social media content in YOUmedia. Teens meet weekly or monthly and finish projects.
deadline_text: Applications open Monday Oct 19, 2026 and close Sunday Nov 8, 2026.

name: CPMC Information Desk Volunteer (Van Ness Campus, Sutter Health)
org: Sutter Health, California Pacific Medical Center (CPMC)
city: San Francisco, CA (CPMC Van Ness Campus, 1101 Van Ness Avenue)
what_you_do: Help visitors and patients who come into the main lobby at CPMC Van Ness Campus. Give directions, information and help. The listing says the desk is open 24 hours.
deadline_text: The listing shows Actively Recruiting. No application deadline is stated.

name: CPS Career and Technical Education (CTE) pathways
what_you_do: You can take career classes in 11 areas. Areas include farm science, construction and business. They also include cooking, teaching and health. Others are IT, law and safety, manufacturing, media, personal care and transportation. You get hands-on learning.
deadline_text: GoCPS high school application dates are not stated on the CTE page; check GoCPS.

name: Chicago Builds (CPS construction pre-apprenticeship)
what_you_do: This two-year training program is for CPS juniors and seniors. You rotate through carpentry, electricity, HVAC and welding. You earn OSHA 10, CPR and NCCER credentials. In senior year, you do internships. You also prepare for the pre-apprenticeship exam.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed April 17, 2026 (decisions by May 22). 2027-28 dates not posted.

name: CPS Cooperative Education (senior-year work study)
what_you_do: Seniors spend the afternoon of a school day at a paid job or internship. It lasts all year. The job matches a career path. You get a personal training plan. A co-op teacher visits the worksite.
deadline_text: Students must apply during junior year. Application dates not stated on the page.

name: CPS Early College: dual credit and dual enrollment at City Colleges of Chicago
org: Chicago Public Schools and City Colleges of Chicago
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take college courses for free. Take them at their own high school (dual credit). Or take them on a City Colleges campus (dual enrollment). Career courses include aviation, construction, culinary, IT and nursing.
deadline_text: Register once per academic year. Deadlines not stated; talk to your counselor early.

name: Chicago Police and Firefighter Training Academy (CPFTA)
org: Chicago Public Schools with Chicago Police, Fire and City Colleges
what_you_do: This two-year after-school program is for juniors and seniors. You apply as a sophomore. Classes meet twice a week at the Police or Fire Academy. Qualified students can earn OSHA, CPR and EMT-B certifications. It leads to a path into City Colleges.
grades: Apply in 10th grade; program runs 11th and 12th grade
deadline_text: The application for the class of 2028 is closed. Sophomores apply online each year beginning in February; recruitment events run in February and March. 2027 dates not posted.

name: California State Summer School for the Arts (CSSSA)
org: California State Summer School for the Arts (state program)
city: California (the 2027 campus is not named yet)
what_you_do: This is a month long, pre-professional summer arts program. Students train in one department. Choices are animation, dance, film and music. Others are theater, visual art, writing, or architecture and environment.
deadline_text: 2027 application opens in November (timeline lists Nov 1, 2026). Application and scholarship priority deadline is Feb 28, 2027, 6 pm, with no extensions. Session: registration July 3, classes July 5, graduation July 31, 2027.

name: STEM Research Experience (CU Boulder Science Discovery)
org: University of Colorado Boulder, Science Discovery
what_you_do: Spend about seven weeks in a real CU Boulder or CU Anschutz research group with a mentor. Weekly research seminar, then a poster talk at the end. You earn a micro-credential.
deadline_text: Application opens mid-December 2026. Deadline March 16, 2027 at 11:59 PM MT. Notified by March 23, 2027.

name: Science Discovery Summer Classes for High School (CU Boulder)
org: University of Colorado Boulder, Science Discovery
what_you_do: Take a 1 week STEM class that gives no college credit. Sample classes cover space flight, robots, the brain, crime science and computers.
deadline_text: The page refers to high school classes for summer 2026. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: Pre-Collegiate Development Program (CU Denver)
what_you_do: A school year and summer program for teens who would be the first in their family to go to college. It has monthly Saturday classes. It also has a 2 week summer program after 10th grade and a 5 week program after 11th grade.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Contact the program manager before completing any forms.

name: College Now
what_you_do: Take free college courses and college and career awareness classes from a CUNY campus while in high school. You can take them at your school, on a campus, online, or on Saturdays. Earn up to 15 college credits.
deadline_text: Each campus sets its own deadline. CUNY says spring applications are typically available October to early February, summer March to June, and fall late March to mid-September.

name: Cupertino Teen Commission
what_you_do: Teen commissioners advise the Cupertino City Council on issues that affect local youth. They attend monthly meetings from September to May.
deadline_text: The city page says recruitment is currently closed. No reopening date is stated.

name: Zoo Crew Teen Volunteers at Dakota Zoo
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo. Roles are Camp Mentor, Conservation Educator and Junior Zookeeper Mentor. Off-season they help with Ed-Venture Camps. They also help with Saturdays with Santa, Winter Zookeeper Camp and the Easter Egg Hunt.
deadline_text: No start date or application deadline is listed on the program page.

name: Town of Danville Volunteer Program
org: Town of Danville Recreation, Arts and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at town events and long projects, such as art gallery helper or theatre usher. You can do one event or stay longer.
deadline_text: New chances are posted through the year. Each posting shows its own dates.

name: Danville Youth Council (DYC)
org: Town of Danville Recreation, Arts and Community Services
what_you_do: Join a teen group in Danville. You help create programs and special events for youth and teens. You also volunteer and donate time and resources to people in need.
deadline_text: The page does not give application dates for 2026-27. It lists the 2025-26 meetings: second Monday of the month, September to May, 4:30 to 5:30 PM.

name: Lifeguard Training, Junior Lifeguarding and Junior Swim Instructor
what_you_do: You can take Red Cross lifeguard training. You can also take a junior lifeguard class. Or try Junior Swim Instructor, where you shadow instructors. This can lead to volunteer chances and city aquatics jobs.
deadline_text: Courses are offered throughout the year. Check WebTrac for sessions.

name: Davis Junior Basketball Coach, Official and Score Keeper
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You referee or keep score at youth basketball games on Saturdays, or coach a team of 3rd to 6th graders. Hours are 5 to 10 a week for officials and 3 to 8 for coaches.
deadline_text: The posting is open continuously. Mandatory training is the week of January 4, 2027 and a coaching clinic on January 9, 2027.

name: Rec Leader in Training (RLIT) and Outdoor Education Camp Volunteers
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You spend two weeks learning to lead camp games, crafts, bike safety and first aid. Then you interview and help at a city day camp for a week. Teens 14 to 16 can help at Camp Putah and other outdoor camps instead.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle: summer 2026 registration for camps and programs other than Camp Putah, Trekkers and Horse Camps opened Wednesday, March 11, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. for Davis residents. Outdoor Education Volunteer applications were due Friday, March 27, 2026 by 4:00 p.m.

name: City of Davis Seasonal Lifeguard and Swim Instructor Jobs
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services (Aquatics)
what_you_do: As a lifeguard, you watch swimmers at city pools and help in emergencies. As a swim teacher, you teach kids in groups or one on one. You also enforce pool rules and help keep the pool clean and safe.
deadline_text: No aquatics job is posted as of Oct 16, 2026, and 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle: the Lifeguard (2026) and Swim Instructor (2026) postings both opened Jan 28, 2026. Lifeguard closed Apr 12, 2026 and Swim Instructor closed Apr 21, 2026. Expect new postings around late January 2027. A separate Off-Season Lifeguard posting ran Dec 3, 2024 to Jan 31, 2025.

name: Davis Senior High CTE Pathways
what_you_do: You can take school classes in career pathways. The pathways are in seven industry sectors. Courses come in a sequence. The district also offers student internships through its career program.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Enroll through your counselor during normal course selection.

name: City of Davis Summer Camp Recreation Leader Jobs
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You lead games, crafts and sports for kids ages 6 to 12 at city day camps. You help watch campers and teen helpers. You give simple first aid and keep camp safe.
deadline_text: No camp job is posted as of Oct 16, 2026, and 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle: Summer Playgrounds Recreation Leader (2026) opened Feb 16, 2026; the posting listed a final filing date of Friday, Feb 27 or until filled, and a closing date of Mar 3, 2026. Recreation Leader, Outdoor Education (2026) opened Feb 19, 2026 with an application deadline of Mar 16, 2026 or until filled. In 2025 these jobs opened Feb 4 and Jan 22. Expect new postings around late January to February 2027.

name: Teen Leadership Council
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You plan events and service projects. You learn leadership skills. You speak up on issues that matter to Davis teens.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application period was extended to Oct 2, 2026 and is now closed. The next call is not posted.

grades: Current high school student returning in the fall (not a rising 9th grader, not a senior)
name: Summer High School Volunteer Program
city: Washington, DC (main hospital, Michigan Avenue NW)
what_you_do: Six-week summer volunteer session at the hospital. Greet patients and visitors, help with wayfinding, round with the hospitality cart, and finish a group project.
deadline_text: The application is closed. The page says to check back in February 2027. 2027 session dates are to be determined.

name: De Anza College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take De Anza College classes, online or on campus, while in high school. Many courses count toward CSU or UC credit.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Apply for admission before the quarter you want; see the De Anza academic calendar.

name: DECA (high school division)
what_you_do: You can join a school club that prepares you for marketing, finance, hospitality and management careers. It has competitions and conferences.
deadline_text: Join anytime through your advisor.

grades: High school (grade levels not stated on the page)
name: DECA high school chapters and competitions
what_you_do: Join a business club at your school. Members practice role-plays and take tests in sales, money, hotels and management. Then they compete at district, state and international events.
deadline_text: Join through your school chapter any time. 2026-27 national events: Ultimate DECA Power Trip Nov 20 to 22, 2026 (Louisville KY); Sports and Entertainment Marketing Conference Jan 27 to 31, 2027 (Orlando FL); International Career Development Conference Apr 17 to 20, 2027 (Anaheim CA).

name: DeKalb County Fire Rescue Explorer Post 901
what_you_do: Train like a firefighter: hose lines, ladders, breathing gear and tools, plus CPR and first aid, fitness and teamwork. After cadet training you may ride along on fire trucks.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Meeting times are not listed.

name: Teen Advisory Board (DeKalb County Public Library)
what_you_do: You plan and run a teen library project or program. You share ideas at monthly meetings. You help promote reading and library services.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 school year are closed. The page does not say when the next application opens.

name: DeKalb Parks Youth Sports Support Volunteer
org: DeKalb County Recreation, Parks and Cultural Affairs
what_you_do: Help at recreation centers and sports fields with set-up, check-in, equipment and keeping kids engaged. Shifts are weekday afternoons and Saturdays.
deadline_text: No deadline. Volunteer any time.

name: DeKalb County School District Work-Based Learning
org: DeKalb County School District, Career, Technical and Agricultural Education
what_you_do: Take a school class that places you in a paid or unpaid job or internship related to your career goal while you finish high school. Juniors and seniors start this work experience.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Ask your school's Work-Based Learning coordinator.

name: DeKalb Summer Youth Employment Program (DSYEP)
org: DeKalb County Government and WorkSource DeKalb
what_you_do: These are paid summer internships with county partners. Fields include healthcare, education, technology, retail and government. In 2025, 350 interns worked Monday to Thursday. They worked up to 24 hours a week.
deadline_text: In 2025 registration ran Apr 10 to Apr 20 (11:59 p.m.). No 2026 or 2027 cycle was found on the county site.

name: Junior volunteer program at Del Sol Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital in one of several positions. The program page does not list the tasks.
deadline_text: Junior volunteer applications are accepted from March 15 through May 1 each year. Expect it to reopen around March 15, 2027.

name: Delaware Valley Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus and train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Trades include carpentry, electrical, culinary arts and facilities maintenance. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Teen Studio at the Denver Art Museum
what_you_do: Spend one week in a five-day museum studio workshop, 9:30 am to 3:30 pm. Teens make their own art. Workshops are for ages 12 to 14 or ages 15 to 17.
deadline_text: The 2026 workshops ran July 13 to 31. Next dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Summer Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Pick the plant track or the guest track. The plant track covers gardening and nature science, with garden care, farm share help and pest control. The guest track is about helping guests and sharing science, like Science Chats.
deadline_text: The page says summer 2026 applications are closed. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: Job Shadowing Program
what_you_do: Follow a health care worker at Denver Health to see a normal workday. You learn the skills and school needed for that job.
deadline_text: The application was closed after July 31, 2026. The page says it is expected to reopen in early November 2026 for winter break shadowing.

name: Medical Career Collaborative (MC2) High School Internship
org: Denver Health with Children's Hospital Colorado
city: Denver metro and Colorado Springs, CO
what_you_do: A health careers program for juniors and seniors. You do a paid internship of 100 to 120 hours at Denver Health or Children's Colorado. You also join weekly classes and earn small health certificates.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 application is closed. The 2027 to 2028 application opens in mid January 2027.

name: Mayor's YouthWorks Initiative
org: City and County of Denver, Economic Development and Opportunity
what_you_do: Get a job on your own, work at least 100 hours over the summer, and the city pays you a $250 bonus in the fall. The city also runs job fairs and gives job help.
deadline_text: The 2026 cycle closed: apply by Monday, July 6, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted. Check the city page in spring 2027.

name: Teen Science Scholars
org: Denver Museum of Nature and Science
what_you_do: Spend three weeks in a summer internship with museum scientists on a research track. Some tracks include outdoor fieldwork. Lunch vouchers and materials are covered.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed and the page gives no 2027 dates. For 2026, interviews were expected in late March and early April, with offers in mid April.

name: Denver Parks and Recreation Lifeguard Training and Hiring
what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at a Denver pool. If you are not certified, the city trains you for free first. You may also teach swim lessons or help at the front desk.
deadline_text: Hiring year-round. The page gives no deadline.

name: Denver Parks and Recreation Volunteers: Free Youth Meals and Recreation
what_you_do: Help recreation center staff serve free meals to kids and teens. Meals can be breakfast, lunch, snacks or supper. You can also help with games and other activities.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.

name: ArtLab Paid Arts Internship
what_you_do: Join art and community projects at ArtLab. Interns get an hourly stipend. They also get help such as therapy, tutoring, and groceries.
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application is closed. The next application window is January to March 2027.

name: Teen Advisory Boards (TAB)
what_you_do: Meet with other teens and library staff. Work on library projects with community partners. Help spread the word about library programs. Advise librarians.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline.

name: Teen Volunteering at Denver Public Library
what_you_do: Teens 14 and up can apply to volunteer at the library.
deadline_text: The page says all current teen volunteer positions are filled. No reopening date is posted.

name: Western National Roundup (4-H and FFA contests)
what_you_do: Compete in contests like livestock judging, horse judging, meat judging, quiz bowl and public speaking. You meet 4-H and FFA teens from across the country.
deadline_text: Registration opened Oct 5, 2026. Early bird ends Nov 16. Late registration ends Dec 1, 2026. Payments due Dec 30. Last day to book the listed hotels: Dec 14, 2026.

name: YMCA of Metro Denver Summer Jobs for Teens
what_you_do: Work at a Y in summer. Jobs are lifeguard, swim instructor, or part-time camp counselor. Lifeguards need lifeguard certification and CPR.
deadline_text: The program page gives no dates. It says the Y recruits every spring.

name: Teen Volunteers at the Animal Rescue League
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Animal Rescue League of Iowa shelter. The program page does not list the exact jobs.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Fill out the volunteer application.

name: Des Moines Art Center Teen Arts Academy and Teen Clay Academy
what_you_do: A nine month art program for high school students. Students meet once a week and build a portfolio. You can apply for the Arts Academy, the Clay Academy, or both.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 to 2027 closed Oct 15, 2026. It starts each fall. 2027 to 2028 dates are not posted.

name: Volunteers (Greater Des Moines Botanical Garden)
what_you_do: Volunteer in education, guest services, plant care (horticulture) or office help. There is a short form for event volunteers. Events include the Spring Garden Festival and Trick or Trees.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Fill out the volunteer application any time.

name: Summer Concurrent Enrollment (DMACC Career Advantage)
what_you_do: Take a real college class in the summer. Earn college credit while you are still in high school. Summer 2026 classes included anatomy and physiology, statistics, programming, medical terms and accounting.
grades: Current juniors and younger (rising seniors and below)
deadline_text: The 2026 pre-registration form is closed. The program page lists no deadline for future summers.

name: BullD.O.G.S. in Healthcare Summer Camp (Drake University)
org: Drake University College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences
what_you_do: Spend a weekend on the Drake campus and try out health jobs. Join sessions on nursing, occupational therapy and pharmacy. Do hands-on labs. Visit a local health group.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 9 to 11, 2026. Registration closed June 1, 2026 at noon. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.

name: Youth and Young Adult Services (IowaWORKS, WIOA Youth)
what_you_do: Get free help from a career planner. Services can include summer and year-round jobs, internships, job shadowing, tutoring, job training and a mentor. You must qualify first.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Services are offered all year through local IowaWORKS offices.

name: Day Camp Junior Counselor
what_you_do: Help staff counselors run summer day camp on a 500 acre living history farm. You lead games and songs, help with crafts, set up and clean up, and are a role model for campers.
deadline_text: The program page still shows 2026 dates: group interviews on March 26, April 7 and April 11, and training on April 18. The volunteer page says applications will reopen in early 2027. Exact dates are not posted yet.

name: Des Moines Parks and Recreation Lifeguard Class and Seasonal Jobs
org: City of Des Moines Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard class. Then apply for lifeguard jobs at city pools. One is the Prairie Meadows Pool at Reichardt Community Recreation Center.
deadline_text: Lifeguard job applications are open now with no closing date posted. The next lifeguard class on the page is Dec 4 to 6, with limited spots.

name: Volunteer Pre-Intern Program (Des Moines Playhouse)
what_you_do: Help teach theatre classes as a student assistant, or work backstage on shows. Backstage jobs include light or sound board, spotlight, assistant stage manager and work crew. Training is provided.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page. Fall, Winter and Spring 2026-27 opportunities are listed on the page.

name: Summer Camp Sidekick Volunteer (Polk County Conservation)
what_you_do: Help naturalists run nature camps for kids ages 6 to 11 at Jester Park. You help with games, crafts and outdoor activities. Training is provided and no experience is needed.
deadline_text: For 2026 the application deadline was May 1. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.

name: Youth Corps Crew Member (Polk County Conservation)
what_you_do: Work on a crew of teens in county parks. You remove invasive plants, maintain trails, and plant seedlings. You also learn about the environment and try outdoor recreation. The program includes at least one overnight camping trip.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for Fall 2026. The program page said 2026 summer sessions ran June 8 to 26 and July 13 to 31. 2027 dates: not stated on the program page.

name: Des Moines Public Library VolunTeens
what_you_do: Help the Youth Services Librarians at your local branch. Teens help at kids' events and sign kids and teens up for Summer Reading. They also prepare crafts for storytimes and make displays.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Y-ExCL Summer Program (Evelyn K. Davis Center)
org: Lutheran Services in Iowa, Evelyn K. Davis Center for Working Families
what_you_do: Train for 2 weeks on work skills, then work 8 weeks at a job placement. You work Monday through Thursday.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 are closed. The program page says to check back in Spring 2027. The schedule on the page: training June 2 to 13, then job placement June 16 to August 7 (the page does not give the year).

name: Concurrent Enrollment for High School Students at Diablo Valley College
what_you_do: Take DVC classes on your own while you are still in high school. You earn college credit. The page has a list of high school friendly classes.
deadline_text: You submit the form every term. This page does not list dates.

name: Dual Enrollment (CCAP) at Diablo Valley College
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (also the San Ramon campus)
what_you_do: Take real college classes for free while you are still in high school. Some classes are at DVC campuses, and some are online. You earn college credit.
deadline_text: Each program sets its own dates. For CollegeConnect, the page says current 10th graders are encouraged to apply in February. Ask your counselor about the other programs.

name: DVC Summer Career Academies
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (some at the San Ramon campus)
what_you_do: Try a career field in a short college class made for high school students. You learn by doing and go on field trips. You earn college credit.
deadline_text: The Health and Public Safety academies ran in July 2026. Dates for 2027 are not posted. The page lists these steps: apply to DVC, send the Special Admissions form starting in March, and sign up in the student portal starting in May.

name: Discovery Cube Los Angeles Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Teen volunteers run hands-on science exhibits, help at birthday parties and support special events at the science center. Most shifts are on weekends, school holidays and in summer.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply online any time.

name: Discovery Cube Orange County Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: You engage guests at exhibits. You lead hands-on activities. You answer visitor questions. You help at events like Bubblefest. You also help with admin tasks and special projects.
deadline_text: Teen application is closed right now. The page says to check back on December 1, 2026 for winter/spring 2027 details.

name: Internship and Career Development Course

name: Douglas County Young Adult Employment Program (DCYEP)
