deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Virtual information sessions are held three times a month. October 2026 sessions are Oct 1, Oct 23 and Oct 28.

name: Lyman Woods Volunteers (camp and program helpers, ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Help the camp counselor and campers with games, crafts and hikes at Lyman Woods. You can also help at after-school and special programs. Other roles are restoration and garden work. There is also an office role at the interpretive center.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Call 630-963-9388 for Lyman Woods volunteer details.

name: Lamont Summer Academy
org: University of Denver, Lamont School of Music
what_you_do: Spend two weeks at the University of Denver music school. Play or sing in lessons, ensembles, and classes. Singers, players, and composers can all join.
deadline_text: The program page lists three dates for the 2027 session: Dec 15 for priority decisions, Feb 15 for scholarship consideration, and Mar 15 for regular applications. The page does not write the year.

name: Dublin L.E.A.D. Summer Program
org: City of Dublin, Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Teens help City of Dublin camp staff. They help during summer camps and swim lessons. They get training in job skills. They learn to lead activities, water safety and supervising campers.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. The 2026 program ran June 8, 2026 to August 7, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Dublin Youth Advisory Committee (YAC)
org: City of Dublin, Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Dublin teens give the City input. The input is on its programs and activities for young people. The committee meets monthly. It usually meets on the second Wednesday at the Dublin Senior Center.
grades: Enrolled in middle school or high school
deadline_text: The 2026-27 seats are filled (term June 2026 to May 2027). The city page does not post a recruitment date for the 2027-28 term.

name: Duke Cell Biology Academy (CeBA)
org: Duke University Department of Cell Biology
what_you_do: This is six weeks of paid summer research in a Duke cell biology lab. You work with a graduate student or postdoc. You do your own project. There are career seminars and journal clubs.
deadline_text: The page says Summer 2026 applications are closed and Summer 2027 applications will be accepted in January 2027. 2026 deadline: the flyer says March 20, 2026 and the FAQ says March 27, 2026 at 5 pm.

name: Duke Health Youth Symposium on Healthcare Careers
org: Duke Health Volunteer Services (Duke Regional Hospital and Duke Raleigh Hospital)
what_you_do: This is a two-day hospital event for high school students. It has facility tours. It has hands-on CPR training and career activities. Students earn 14 volunteer hours and a certificate.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application opened 8 pm Friday April 10 and closed 8 pm Monday April 13, 2026; acceptance emails by May 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: MaryAnn Black Summer Internship at Duke Health
org: Duke Health and Duke Community Affairs, with Durham YouthWorks
what_you_do: A hybrid summer internship at Duke Health. In 2026 students spent three weeks touring clinical spaces, learning skills and hearing from Duke employees about their careers.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: Durham YouthWorks application opened January 23 and closed February 21, 2026; orientation in March. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Duke Pre-College Programs (High School)
org: Duke University, Office of the Provost
what_you_do: Duke runs residential summer academic programs on its campus. They are for high school students. Students must be at least 14 to attend.
deadline_text: No application deadline listed. Session dates, courses and fees for 2027 will be announced in October 2026.

name: Junior Counselor Program
what_you_do: Help adult staff run nature camp: daily camp tasks and time with young campers, and help at events if you want. Full-day or half-day shifts.
deadline_text: The page says applications opened in Spring 2026. No deadline is listed. If applications are closed, your info is kept until the next open period.

grades: Junior program: junior high students. Teen/adult program: 14 or entering high school.
name: Teen and Junior Volunteers
what_you_do: Help kids and families at the children's museum. Teen volunteers (14 and up) take flexible shifts. Junior volunteers (junior high) help one weekend day a week for three months.
deadline_text: Junior volunteers are recruited in September and January. Teen and adult openings are posted on the museum site.

name: Volunteer Programs (teen openings)
org: Forest Preserve District of DuPage County
what_you_do: Volunteer in the forest preserves. Jobs include one-time restoration workdays and special events. You can also help at nature centers, farms and historic sites. Teens 13 to 17 have a few long-term roles.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Some roles have deadlines and limited space. New volunteer orientation is held monthly at district headquarters (second Wednesday evening).

name: Durham County Library Maker + STEAM Volunteers
org: Durham County Library, Maker + STEAM Services
what_you_do: Volunteers help staff run pre-made maker programs and workshops. They run equipment trainings. They help at service desks.
deadline_text: No deadline. Capacity is limited, so you may be put on a waitlist.

name: Durham County Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens help at a library branch with shelving, pulling books, tutoring and prepping crafts. Tasks depend on the branch and the time.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Each branch decides whether it can host volunteers; availability is not guaranteed.

name: Durham Aquatic School (free lifeguard certification)
what_you_do: Free American Red Cross lifeguard training (worth $209). It covers CPR/AED and first aid. Graduates can apply for lifeguard jobs at Durham's indoor and outdoor pools.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 course: pre-course swim test Sunday, March 15, registration deadline March 15 at 10 am. New dates are posted each season.

name: Teen Volunteers (Durham Parks and Recreation)
what_you_do: Sign up for hands-on volunteer work. Choose park and trail projects, like trail help, landscaping and adopt-a-park. Or help DPR staff at special events like Earth Day and festivals.
deadline_text: No deadline. Browse and sign up for open shifts.

name: Durham Tech Apprenticeship Skills Achievement Program (ASAP)
what_you_do: Start with a pre-apprenticeship to try a field. Then move into an apprenticeship that mixes classes with on-the-job training. Apprentices earn wages that rise as their skills grow.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Career and College Promise (dual enrollment at Durham Tech)
what_you_do: Take college classes for free while in high school and earn both high school and college credit. Pick a college transfer path or a career and technical path (a certificate or diploma).
deadline_text: Spring 2027: application opened Sept 11 and closes Nov 9 (2026). Paperwork due Nov 23. Last day to register Dec 1. Spring semester starts Jan 11, 2027.

name: Durham YouthWorks
org: City of Durham, Office of Economic and Workforce Development
what_you_do: Get paid to learn job skills in the spring. Then work in summer, online or in person, with a city office, a nonprofit, or a local business.
deadline_text: The page says applications open at the start of the year. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: EBAYC Volunteers and Student Internships
what_you_do: You can volunteer at a youth group. You can also do a student internship there. The group offers life coaching, school partnerships and community organizing.
deadline_text: Not posted

name: EBMUD High School Summer Internship (HSSI)
city: Oakland, CA and EBMUD service area
what_you_do: You get a paid 6 week summer internship at the water utility. It is about 16 hours a week.
deadline_text: 2026 East Bay program: no direct applications, referrals from partner groups only. 2027 not posted.

name: Junior Lifeguard Cadets (Ages 14 to 17)
city: Hayward, CA (Don Castro Regional Recreation Area)
what_you_do: You join a two week summer lifeguard training session in Hayward at Don Castro Regional Recreation Area. Cadets 15 and older can earn Red Cross lifeguard, CPR and AED certification. Younger cadets can earn a CPR and AED card.
deadline_text: The program page said 2026 cadet applications were due May 6 and accepted cadets had to register by June 12. The next dates are not posted.

name: Leaders-in-Training (LIT) at Park'n It Day Camp
city: Alameda and Contra Costa Counties, CA (regional parks)
what_you_do: For one week you work with other teens to help lead a day camp for kids in a regional park. You learn real job skills.
deadline_text: The program page says applications open in 2027 and gives no date. Interviews are in late April. Accepted teens hear back by mid-May.

name: East Bay Regional Park District Lifeguard Jobs and Lifeguard Academy
city: Alameda and Contra Costa Counties, CA (regional parks and lakes)
what_you_do: You guard swimmers at district pools and beaches. You first take a 10 day paid Lifeguard Academy that teaches the skills.
deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates. The Lifeguard Academy begins in late April. Check the job portal for open posts.

name: East Bay Regional Park District Youth and Student Jobs
city: Oakland, CA and parks across Alameda and Contra Costa counties
what_you_do: You can get seasonal paid student jobs such as recreation leader, lifeguard, gate attendant, student laborer and interpretive student aide. The jobs include pathways from high school to college.
deadline_text: No jobs were posted on governmentjobs.com on Oct 7, 2026. Watch ebparks.org/jobs/youth and governmentjobs.com/careers/ebparks.

name: Elgin Community College Dual Credit
what_you_do: You can take college courses at Elgin Community College. You can also take them at your high school. You earn high school and college credit at the same time. Options include general education and career tech courses.
deadline_text: No deadline on the ECC page. Talk with your high school counselor about dates.

name: Educational Talent Search
what_you_do: Get help planning for college and careers. You choose classes, explore careers, set goals and prep for tests. You get help with college and aid forms. There are college tours and workshops for parents.
deadline_text: No deadline. Spots are first come, first served, so apply as early as possible.

name: Upward Bound at Elgin Community College
what_you_do: This is free college prep for high school students. It includes advising, educational workshops and tutoring. It also includes field trips and college courses. You get fee waivers for college applications and SAT/ACT.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page.

name: Youth Environmental Academy and Internships
what_you_do: You join an after-school environmental justice program for Berkeley teens and young adults (8 weeks in summer or 12 weeks in spring). Topics include zero waste, climate resilience and food systems. It is paid.
deadline_text: No dates on the Ecology Center page. Berkeley YouthWorks listed a Winter 2027 interest form due Oct 30, 2026 and said Summer 2027 information comes in Feb 2027, but that page does not mention this academy.

name: Eden Area ROP (Regional Occupational Program)
what_you_do: You take career classes during high school at the Eden Area ROP career center in Hayward or at some home high schools. Class choices include welding, auto, construction, culinary arts, dental assisting, cybersecurity, first responder and education careers.
deadline_text: Enroll through your home school counselor; the page gives no class start dates.

name: Edison Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus and train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes IT certifications (A+, AWS Cloud Practitioner) and plumbing.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: High School Scholars Program, Middlesex College
what_you_do: Take real college courses during the school day, on campus or online. You earn college credit while still in high school.
deadline_text: No deadline listed on the page.

name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB), Edison Public Library
what_you_do: Teens meet each month on the teen board. They help shape library services. They also find volunteer opportunities. The library calls TAB the starting point for teen volunteering.
deadline_text: Monthly. The listing shows the next session as Wednesday, October 14, 7:00 to 8:30 p.m., Main Library Children's Room.

name: Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Spend one 4 to 5 hour shift a week at the hospital through the summer. Juniors do things like escorting patients and delivering items. Older adult volunteers work with you and mentor you.
deadline_text: Last cycle's pattern: names taken in April, interviews in May, orientation in June, program ends end of July. 35 students took part in 2025.

name: El Camino College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes for credit while still in high school.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 (Aug 24 to Dec 12, 2026): registration is still open only for 8-week classes that start in October. The page gives no exact October date, so act soon. For the full term, Winter Session 2027 (Jan 4 to Feb 4, 2027) and Spring Semester 2027 (Feb 16 to Jun 12, 2027) registration starts in November 2026.

city: Mountain View and Los Gatos, CA

deadline_text: No application dates are stated on the program page or on the application form.

name: ASPIRE Evanston: Careers in Healthcare

name: Mayor's Summer Youth Employment Program (MSYEP)

what_you_do: Work up to nine weeks in an entry level summer job with a city department, a community group or a business. A job fair is where youth meet employers.

name: Evergreen Valley College Dual Enrollment and CCAP

deadline_text: The page does not state application deadlines or 2026-2027 term dates.

name: EXP Internship Program (paid summer internships for 11th graders)
city: Los Angeles and Long Beach area, CA

deadline_text: No application dates posted. EXP says to email internship@expfuture.org.

name: Exploring (Learning for Life career posts)

deadline_text: The program pages do not state application dates.

deadline_text: No application process or dates posted.

name: Fairfax County IT Internship for High Schoolers
org: Fairfax County Department of Information Technology
what_you_do: Summer internship with the county IT department. The county page gives no task list.
deadline_text: Recruitment generally starts in April. No 2027 dates posted.

name: Lifeguard jobs with free training

name: Fairfax County Public Library volunteering (youth 12 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Fairfax County library branch. You gain skills and experience. You can meet service requirements. Each branch has its own volunteer coordinator.

name: Educating Youth through Employment (EYE) summer program
org: Fairfax County Department of Family Services Workforce Development and Virginia Career Works Northern Region

name: ACCESS Academy AI Summer Camp

name: AI in Health Summer Camp (George Mason University)
org: George Mason University, Department of Health Administration and Policy
what_you_do: Each day has a short lesson, a hands-on activity and a team build session. The session is called the AI Maker Lab. You work on real health problems. The week ends with a showcase and a certificate of completion.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 27 to 31, 2026 and applications are closed. No 2027 dates are posted. The page offers a Future Programs Interest Form.

name: Conflict Resolution Youth Summit (CRYS)

deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: St. Jude Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Do clerical, non-clinical hospital tasks. The page gives examples for its medical units, such as answering phones and checking on patient needs, but does not list tasks for high school students. You work one 3-hour shift a week.
deadline_text: The page says high school applications may open in early 2027. Spaces are limited and applications are only taken when there are openings.

name: CONNECTED Youth Leadership Program (CYLP)
org: Fulton County Government, Community Development (with 21st Century Leaders)
what_you_do: Do a year of online and live leadership training. You explore careers, plan your education path and meet other teens and professionals. Juniors and seniors can get paid summer internships.
deadline_text: 2026-27 enrollment ran Sept 14 to 28, 2026. Next enrollment dates not posted.

name: Teen Volunteers (Fulton County Library System)
org: Fulton County Library System (Atlanta-Fulton Public Library)
what_you_do: Help library branches with 1 to 2 hour shifts. Tasks include shelving and clerical work. They also include crowd control at events and helping the Friends of the Library. Some branches have Teen Advisory Boards.
deadline_text: Applications are always accepted, but most projects are full and most locations have a waitlist.

name: Marshal's Junior Deputy Program
what_you_do: Spend one summer week learning life skills and getting a close look at law enforcement careers.
deadline_text: 2025 cycle: applications due Friday June 13, 2025 at close of business; program ran June 23 to 27, 2025. 2026 and 2027 dates not posted.

name: Work-Based Learning, Fulton County Schools
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors earn high school credit. They work under supervision at an approved job site. This can be an internship, an apprenticeship or a clinical experience. The job must match the student's career pathway.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page. Ask your school's Work-Based Learning coordinator for the application window.

name: Fulton County Youth Commission
what_you_do: Serve as a Youth Commissioner. You share what teens think with the Fulton County Board of Commissioners. You give it advice. You also join planning meetings and community service projects.
deadline_text: The page says applications are usually open in May near the end of the school year. A past call (2024-25 term) closed May 24, 2024. No 2027 dates posted.

name: Teen Volunteers at Gail Borden Public Library
what_you_do: You help with library events. You refresh library spaces. You prepare crafts for programs. Listed sessions include Cleaning the Classics, Knitting for a Cause and Crafting for the Community.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A teen volunteer orientation is listed for Sunday, Oct 18, 1:00 to 1:30 PM at the Main Library Conference Room (the page does not print the year; Oct 18 is a Sunday in 2026).

name: Montana Cybersecurity Summer Initiative (CSI) Camp
what_you_do: A day camp for Montana students. It lasts a week. You learn about cybersecurity.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was June 15 to 19. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: Camp Grove Counselor-in-Training (Garden Grove)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Help run Camp Grove, the city summer day camp for kids ages 5 to 12. You get hands-on experience and build leadership skills.
deadline_text: The 2026 application was due Monday, May 4, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Garden Grove Recreation Leader Jobs (Atlantis Play Center and Sports)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Work part time at the Atlantis Play Center or the Sports and Recreation Center. You may help run the snack bar and splash pad. You may help with events. You may also referee and keep score at youth games.
deadline_text: The page lists 2026 age cutoff dates. It gives no closing date. Use the Apply link to see which jobs are open now.

name: Garden Grove Teen Action Collaborative (GGTAC)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Join a teen leadership group. You do service projects, volunteer at city events and go to career workshops. You can also apply for scholarships.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted September 1 through November 19, 2026. Meetings are the 3rd Thursday of each month, 4:00 to 5:00 p.m.

name: Work-Based Learning (Internships), Gwinnett County Public Schools
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors work in a job linked to their career goal and earn school credit. The program also covers apprenticeships. Students must job search and interview themselves, with help from the school coordinator.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page. Forms go to your school's Work-Based Learning coordinator; ask when the next semester deadline is.

name: Genesys Works Bay Area Internship Program
what_you_do: You take eight weeks of business technology and job skills training, then work a paid, year-long internship at a partner company. You also get college and career coaching.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Applicants get an interview, then summer skills training.

name: Volunteens at Geneva Public Library
what_you_do: Volunteer for library tasks. After you register, the library emails sign-up sheets showing when help is needed and you choose time slots that fit your schedule.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 session runs Sept 14 to Dec 4, 2026. No registration deadline is listed. Dates for the next session are not posted.

name: High School Volunteers, St. David's Georgetown Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer in hospital departments for 3 to 4 hours a week during the summer program (up to 8 weeks). A few students are also accepted during the year.
deadline_text: Summer session dates and deadlines are not listed on the page checked.

grades: Ages 8 to 18 (Senior Project Achievement is grades 9 to 12)
name: Georgia 4-H
city: Georgia (county Extension offices statewide; state office in Athens, GA)
what_you_do: Join clubs, camps and projects in farming, science, civics, leadership and health. Older teens can join Project Achievement contests. They can join state conferences and leadership programs.
deadline_text: No enrollment dates listed. Ask your county Extension office.

name: Teen Volunteer Program (Georgia Aquarium)
what_you_do: Start as a Gallery Guide: talk with visitors, help at the touch pools, and in summer spend a week helping with Camp H2O. Finish with a group community project.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 session starts onboarding with information sessions in October 2026; dates not posted yet. The 2026 summer/fall cycle on the page: info sessions in July, application deadline Aug 1, interviews Aug 16, orientation Sept 12.

name: Georgia Boys State (American Legion)
what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Young men run a pretend 51st state. It has cities, counties, two parties, elections and lawmaking. You learn how Georgia government works.
deadline_text: 2027 information is listed as 'coming soon'. The 2026 session ran June 7 to 13, 2026. The 2026 memo says the Samsung scholarship application was due online by the first day of the program.

name: Georgia C.R.E.W. (Cultivating the Rising Experienced Worker) for foster youth
org: Georgia Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS)
what_you_do: Teens in Georgia foster care get career workshops, mentors and coaching. The summer program can include internships or job shadowing with partner employers. You may also get a paid reward for taking part.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer registration ran March 2 to April 17, 2026. Next dates are not posted.

grades: Not stated on the program pages
name: Georgia DECA
what_you_do: Join a school DECA chapter to prepare for college and careers. Members go to conferences, compete in DECA's competitive events and can earn a share of scholarships. The state hosts events like a Fall Rally.
deadline_text: No join deadline listed. The state calendar lists a Fall Rally on October 21, 2026 at Six Flags Over Georgia.

grades: Current sophomores and juniors (the page also says rising juniors and seniors)
name: Georgia DNR Career Academy
org: Georgia Department of Natural Resources (with Georgia 4-H)
what_you_do: Spend a week in small groups with DNR staff. Try electrofishing, planned burns, boating and gun safety, trail building and saltwater fish counts. Learn about jobs in nature care.
deadline_text: Application opens Oct 14, 2026 and closes Nov 16, 2026. Selected students interview online in early December. Camp is July 18 to 24, 2027.

name: Georgia Envirothon
org: Georgia Envirothon (Georgia Soil and Water Conservation Commission and partners)
what_you_do: Teams of 4 to 6 students learn about wildlife, forests, water life, soil and land use. They also study a current issue. Then they compete at a state contest with field tests and a talk.
deadline_text: Training day Oct 28, 2026 (Eastanollee, GA). Competition registration deadline March 20, 2027. Competition April 27, 2027 at Tugaloo State Park.

grades: Not stated on the program page
name: Georgia FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
what_you_do: Join a school business club. It has learning programs and contests. It has state projects. It offers scholarships and awards. It also has state and national conferences.
deadline_text: No join deadline listed on the page.

grades: Students enrolled in a Georgia agricultural education class (middle and high school)
name: Georgia FFA Association
org: Georgia FFA Association and Georgia Agricultural Education (Georgia Department of Education)
what_you_do: Take agriculture classes at school and join FFA: leadership contests, career development events, Supervised Agricultural Experience projects, and state and national conventions.
deadline_text: No membership deadline listed on the page. Enrollment follows your agriculture class schedule.

name: New Fresh Urban Farmers (NFUF) Paid Internship
what_you_do: Work on urban farms and school market gardens, help at food banks, learn cooking and business planning, and lead volunteers. Present a business plan at a public event.
deadline_text: The page said Accepting Applications NOW. No closing date stated.

name: Georgia Independent Living Program (GA-RYSE, Chafee services)
org: Georgia Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS)
what_you_do: Help for Georgia foster youth as they grow up. The page lists life skills classes, school money (ETV), housing help, a matched savings account, emergency help and credit report help.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

grades: Girls who have completed their junior year of high school
name: Georgia Girls State (American Legion Auxiliary)
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Georgia
what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Girls run a pretend state government. They hold elections, write bills and hear guest speakers. You learn how city, county and state government work.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: the 'I Want In' page said fee due April 20 and applications complete by May 20, 2026, while the Selection Criteria page said applications and fee due May 1, 2026. The two pages disagree, so plan for the earlier date and ask your unit. 2027 dates not posted.

grades: High school sophomores and juniors (rising juniors and seniors)
name: Georgia Governor's Honors Program (GHP)
org: Georgia Governor's Office of Education, Workforce and Strategy (GOEWS)
city: Georgia (summer residential campus; host campus not named on the program page)
what_you_do: This is a mid-summer residential program on a college campus. It is for talented sophomores and juniors. Students study an area they were nominated in. It can be a subject, an art or a career field.
deadline_text: Not open to students yet. You cannot apply directly. Local school nominations run August to early November (ask your school's GHP Coordinator now). Nominees get the online application link Nov 13, 2026, info session Dec 3, 2026, application due Jan 8, 2027, and semifinalists are told Feb 5, 2027. The page gives weekdays but no year; the years were matched by weekday. Confirm with GHP.

name: Georgia Senate Page Program
org: Georgia State Senate (Office of the Lieutenant Governor and Secretary of the Senate)
what_you_do: Serve for one legislative day at the State Capitol. Pages carry messages to senators on the Senate floor. They also watch votes and meet lawmakers.
deadline_text: No application deadline found. Pages choose a legislative day while the General Assembly is in session. The packet says the first 20 days of session fall in January and February. 2027 dates not read.

name: Dual Enrollment at Georgia State University (Atlanta Campus)
org: Georgia State University, Office of Undergraduate Admissions
what_you_do: Take college classes at Georgia State while you finish high school. The classes count for college credit and for high school.
deadline_text: Deadlines listed without a year: Spring Nov 1, Summer Apr 1, Fall May 1. Late applications are not guaranteed a decision.

name: Dual Enrollment at Georgia Tech
org: Georgia Institute of Technology, Office of Undergraduate Admission
city: Atlanta, GA (online and some on campus)
what_you_do: Take real Georgia Tech college courses while you are still in high school. Several courses are online (distance courses), and a limited number are on campus.
deadline_text: Windows listed without years: Fall apply May 15 to June 15. Spring apply Sept 25 to Oct 20. Summer (distance CS only) apply March 1 to 31.

name: STEP: Science, Technology and Engineering Program (Georgia Tech Aerospace Engineering)
org: Georgia Tech Daniel Guggenheim School of Aerospace Engineering
what_you_do: You work in a team. Your team solves an open-ended engineering challenge. The challenge is inspired by real Georgia Tech research. You work with a faculty mentor. You present results at a poster session.
deadline_text: 2027 dates not posted.

name: Summer Engineering Institute (Georgia Tech College of Engineering)
what_you_do: This is a free, overnight summer program on the Georgia Tech campus. Students do hands-on experiments and workshops. They meet professors and students. They learn about admissions and tour campus.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026 session is closed. No application deadline is shown. Next session dates are not posted.

name: Georgia Work-Based Learning (including Youth Apprenticeship)
org: Georgia Department of Education, Career, Technical and Agricultural Education
what_you_do: This is a state program with four options. Cooperative education is paid. Internship is paid or unpaid. Youth Apprenticeship is paid. Employability Skill Development is for students who already have a job. All of them link school courses to a work site.
deadline_text: Set by each school or district. No state dates are posted.

name: WorkSource Georgia Youth (WIOA)
org: Technical College System of Georgia, Office of Workforce Development (WorkSource Georgia)
what_you_do: A state youth employment program run through local WorkSource offices. Services listed include tutoring, paid and unpaid work experiences, leadership development, adult mentoring, counseling, financial literacy and GED services.
deadline_text: No application dates or ongoing-enrollment statement on the state pages (checked 2026-10-10).

name: Teen Gallery Guides @ Getty
org: J. Paul Getty Museum (Getty Center and Getty Villa)
what_you_do: You research artworks. Then you lead tours. You also lead gallery activities for school groups and visitors. This is at the Getty Center or Getty Villa. You build public speaking and teaching skills.
deadline_text: The page says the application window typically opens in early February each year. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Girls Inc. of Alameda County High School Programs
city: Oakland, CA (and Cal State East Bay, Hayward)
what_you_do: You can join free programs for high school girls. The page describes coding projects, college access and leadership programs. It says some programs offer paid summer internships at Bay Area companies.
deadline_text: Not posted. Contact Girls Inc.

name: Girls Who Code Clubs and Pathways
what_you_do: You can join a free coding club for grades 3 to 12. It meets after school or on weekends. You can also take the free, self-paced online Pathways program for high school students.
grades: Clubs: grades 3 to 12 (split 3 to 5 and 6 to 12). Pathways: high school.
deadline_text: Ongoing.

name: Glendale Community College Dual Enrollment and Jump Start
what_you_do: Take college classes while in high school. Dual Enrollment is for Glendale and Burbank school district students on an approved class list. Jump Start covers other students and other classes.
deadline_text: Registration opens Oct 19, 2026 for Winter 2027 (Jump Start only) and Nov 30, 2026 for Spring 2027 (Dual Enrollment and Jump Start).

name: Glendale Youth Alliance STEP (Student Training and Employment Program)
what_you_do: Get work training at Glendale Community College's Professional Development Center. Then do 120 hours of paid work at a worksite. The site is picked to match your skills and interests.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says to apply today through the one Apply Now form and a case worker contacts you in 3 to 5 business days. No application window is given.

name: Glendale Youth Alliance Summer Youth Employment and Youth@Work
what_you_do: Youth ages 14 to 24 get paid work experience. The Brush Clearance track is a 6 week supervised brush removal job for youth 14 to 16. Youth with basic job skills can be placed in community jobs.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines posted. Use the Apply Now form and expect a call back in 3 to 5 business days.

name: Glendale Youth Alliance TEAM (Training, Employment and Mentoring)
what_you_do: Job readiness and mentoring for low-income youth. You learn to be on time, dress right and follow through on tasks. This helps you get ready for college and work.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says to apply today through the one Apply Now form and a case worker contacts you in 3 to 5 business days. No application window is given.

name: Glenmont Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes nurse assistant. It includes culinary arts and facilities maintenance. HVAC is another. There are more.
deadline_text: The campus page gives no enrollment dates and no ongoing-application statement. Start with a MyJobCorps account on jobcorps.gov.

grades: Youth volunteers: grades 6 to 12. Innovation Center: grades 9 to 12. Teen Advisory Board: grades 7 to 11.
name: Youth Volunteers, Innovation Center Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Help with children's programs as a school year youth volunteer. Or keep the Innovation Center tidy and learn its 3D printers and laser cutters. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It plans library events.
deadline_text: School year youth volunteer applications opened August 15 and no close date is stated. Returning volunteers do not need to reapply. Teen Advisory Board applications are open November 1 to 30, and new members are told December 14 (no year printed on the page).

name: Aspiring Scientists Summer Internship Program (ASSIP)
org: George Mason University, College of Science
what_you_do: You work full time for 8 weeks. You do a one-on-one research project with a George Mason faculty mentor. It can be in person, remote or hybrid. You present at a final poster session.
deadline_text: The 2026 ASSIP Application is now closed. The page posts no date for the 2027 cycle.

name: George Mason University High School Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take lower-level college courses (100 and 200 level) at George Mason while still in high school and earn college credit. You can take up to 11 credits in one semester.
deadline_text: Application deadlines are not stated on the page. Admission is offered for one semester at a time.

name: Trail Stewardship Team
what_you_do: Work on a crew doing trail maintenance in Jefferson County parks. You use hand tools to move rocks, branches and dirt, and you hike two to six miles every day.
deadline_text: The 2026 applications are closed. The page lists 2026 interviews in April and a June 16 start. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Youth Employment Services (Y.E.S.)
city: Decatur, GA and other north Georgia career centers
what_you_do: Set career goals, take job readiness classes and get paid work experience. You earn high school credit for the job readiness classes.
deadline_text: No application dates or windows posted. Email youth@ging.org to ask about intake.

name: Grafton Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. The campus page lists training in carpentry (pre-apprentice), certified nurse assistant, clinical medical assistant and culinary arts. There are more.
deadline_text: The campus page gives no enrollment dates and no ongoing-application statement. Start with a MyJobCorps account on jobcorps.gov.

name: Grand Forks Park District Part-Time Winter Jobs (Community Center, Warming House)
what_you_do: Two part-time jobs posted now. At First Seasons Community Center you run the cash register and concessions, help customers and do light cleaning. As a warming house attendant you watch the outdoor skating rink building and enforce rink rules.
deadline_text: The employment page shows Oct 1, 2026 next to both postings. It does not say if that is a closing date.

name: Nebraska State Fair Seasonal Job: Cleaning Squad
what_you_do: Keep the fairgrounds tidy during the Nebraska State Fair. You are on your feet for hours and work on your own. This is the one 2026 fair job on the flyer open to age 16.
deadline_text: 2026 shifts were August 28 to September 7, 2026. 2027 hiring not posted yet on the program page.

name: Lifeguard training and city pool jobs
org: City of Great Falls Park and Recreation
what_you_do: Get your American Red Cross lifeguard card. Then watch swimmers and handle emergencies at city pools. The city says lifeguards also learn CPR, AED and first aid.
deadline_text: Lifeguard openings are posted online when they are available. No dates are posted.

name: Teen Art Program (TAP)
org: Paris Gibson Square Museum of Art
what_you_do: Make art with other teens in a group at the museum. Food and art supplies are provided.
deadline_text: As of an April 2, 2026 update, the program is on a temporary break until the museum finds an instructor.

name: Library volunteer program
what_you_do: Shelve and clean books. Help with youth and summer reading programs. Put craft kits together. Or help keep the building and grounds neat.
deadline_text: Not stated.

name: Great Plains Zoo Junior Zookeeper (JZK)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer all summer at the zoo. First-year jobs are helping at ZooCamp or greeting guests and running story time. Returning teens can care for farm animals and present animals.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed March 6 (returning teens) and March 27 (new teens). 2027 dates are not posted. Email Education@GPZoo.org to be told when applications open.

name: Grizzly Youth Academy (National Guard Youth ChalleNGe)
org: California National Guard / California Military Department
city: San Luis Obispo, CA (residential; serves listed central and southern counties)
what_you_do: A free, live in, structured program for teens who are behind in credits or at risk of dropping out. Cadets work on academics, leadership and life skills, and many can earn a GED.
deadline_text: No class start dates or deadlines on the program pages. Start with the online Interest Form and a required virtual orientation.

name: Groundwork Denver Green Teams
what_you_do: Join a paid crew. You work on community gardens, rain barrels and local projects for fair treatment of the earth and its people in Denver neighborhoods.
deadline_text: Openings change. The page links to a current youth jobs list, last updated 2026.

name: High School Summer Internship (Georgia Tech Research Institute)
city: Atlanta, GA; Cobb County; Warner Robins, GA (in person)
what_you_do: Five week paid, in person internship at a Georgia Tech Research Institute site. Interns work up to 24 hours a week on STEM projects with GTRI staff.
deadline_text: Pre-application launch is planned for December 11, 2026. The closing date is not listed on the page. The page says dates are approximate and final dates will be in the pre-application.

name: Empower Gwinnett Government Internship Program
what_you_do: Two Saturday workshops in May, then a four-week paid internship in a county department. The page says interns develop leadership skills through workshops and on-the-job training.
deadline_text: Last cycle (2026 page): apply Feb 9 to Mar 16, workshops May 9 and May 16, internship June 1 to June 26. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Gwinnett Youth Police Academy
what_you_do: A free one-week academy with classroom lessons and hands-on activities. Topics include CPR and AED, emergency driving, and crime scene and crash work. You also learn self defense. You see K9, aviation and SWAT demos.
deadline_text: Last cycle: application deadline May 29, 2026. The next deadline is not posted.

name: Junior District Attorney and Investigator Mentorship Program
org: Gwinnett Judicial Circuit District Attorney's Office
what_you_do: Get a hands-on look at courts, police, jails and prosecutors. You work with assistant district attorneys and investigators. You also work with office staff. You can earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Applications for the sixth group open in April 2027 and the summer experience begins in June 2027. No deadline is posted.

name: Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Council (Gwinnett County Public Library)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a library branch. Your role fits the branch, such as helping with programs or homework help. Teen Advisory Council members meet monthly. They help plan teen activities.
deadline_text: No application dates or open windows listed. Applications stay on file for six months.

name: Gwinnett County Parks Lifeguard Jobs
org: Gwinnett County Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: Work as a part-time seasonal lifeguard at county pools and water centers. First you must pass an In-Water Skills Test. You also take the American Red Cross Lifeguard Certification course.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

name: Gwinnett Parks Summer Camp Aide (volunteer)
org: Gwinnett County Parks and Recreation / Community Services
what_you_do: Volunteer as an aide at a county day camp for kids ages 5 to 13 for at least two weeks. Follow the camp supervisor's directions. No phones while volunteering.
deadline_text: 2026 form: turn in by Monday, April 20 (2026 camp weeks: June 1 to June 26 and July 6 to July 24, plus May 26-29 and July 27-31 at the Environmental and Heritage Center only; no camp June 29 to July 3). The 2027 form is not posted.

name: Gwinnett County Police Explorer Post 1808
what_you_do: Classroom and hands-on training in traffic stops, investigations, crime scene work and self defense. Compete for Gwinnett in state and national contests. Help at community events.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

name: S.M.I.L.E. Gwinnett (Summer Mentoring in Legal Education)
what_you_do: Spend Friday afternoons in summer learning about the legal system. You do debates and mock trials and watch live court cases. You tour places like the Gwinnett County Detention Center and the medical examiner's office. It ends with a graduation.
deadline_text: Applications were closed for 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Volunteer Gwinnett Internship Program
what_you_do: A volunteer internship in a Gwinnett County department. The flyer lists communications, IT, law and public safety. It also lists recreation and water resources. Health and human services are listed too. There are more.
deadline_text: The county page says volunteer internships are available year-round. No deadline is listed.

name: Habitat for Humanity East Bay / Silicon Valley: Volunteer
org: Habitat for Humanity East Bay/Silicon Valley
what_you_do: You help build or repair affordable homes on construction sites. Younger teens can help with fundraising, flyers or lunch.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No sign-up deadline stated.

name: Habitat for Humanity Greater Sacramento: Individual Volunteers (Construction and ReStore)
org: Habitat for Humanity of Greater Sacramento
what_you_do: You help build and repair homes on a job site. Or you work in the ReStore. There you organize, price and stock items. You go to a one hour orientation first. Training, tools and safety gear are provided.
deadline_text: Rolling. Sign up for shifts after orientation.

name: Hack Club
what_you_do: You can join Hack Club. It is a free teen coding community. It has school clubs and an online Slack. It has game jams, hackathons and hardware events.
deadline_text: Join anytime.

name: Hacktoberfest 2026
what_you_do: In October you can join online challenges and livestreams, or go to one of over 500 local in-person fests. This year the event focuses on open source and open-weight AI.
deadline_text: Runs through October 2026; sign in with MyMLH.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teens volunteer for seven weeks in summer, working two four-hour shifts a week. The hospital does not offer shadowing or internships to teens.
deadline_text: The page says the 2026 window is closed and to check again in February 2027 for summer 2027.

name: HandsOn Bay Area Youth Volunteering (HandsOn Tomorrow paused)
what_you_do: You can join monthly volunteer projects for younger volunteers. Find them on the HandsOn Community Calendar. Filter by age to see which are open to you.
grades: High school (for HandsOn Tomorrow and the Youth Council)
deadline_text: Monthly projects: sign up on the Community Calendar. HandsOn Tomorrow will not run in summer 2026 and no later dates are posted.

name: ZooTeen Program at Happy Hollow Park and Zoo
org: Happy Hollow Park and Zoo (City of San Jose)
what_you_do: Teens do animal meet-and-greets, help with animal care routines and work as camp helpers. Good for future zookeepers and vet techs.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round and reviewed seasonally. The page says 2026 orientations are complete and 2027 applicants will be contacted at the end of summer 2027, once that orientation schedule is set.

name: Junior Camp Counselor in Training
org: Lower Paxton Township Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Teens help senior counselors run games, crafts and activities for campers. They learn to lead and to watch kids. Each camp takes one Junior Counselor a year.
deadline_text: Send a letter of interest by March 15. Selections by April 30. These are from the 2026 camp season.

name: Harvey Mudd College Summer Session (high school students welcome)
what_you_do: Take college courses with college students, in person or online. Subjects are computer science, engineering, math and arts. There are also classes in humanities and social science.
deadline_text: For summer 2026, registration began March 2 and the application with transcript was due May 7. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Hawaii 4-H Youth Development
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa CTAHR Cooperative Extension Service
city: Oahu, Maui, Kauai and Hawaii Island
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or a special interest program. Do hands-on projects like gardening, animals, robots, public speaking or woodworking. Teens build leadership and life skills.
deadline_text: Oahu's 2026-27 4-H program year enrollment starts September 1, 2026.

name: State-Funded Paid Internships for Public High School Students
what_you_do: Students work for private companies. The jobs are in career and technical fields. In summer 2026, interns at the Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum learned to fix and restore aircraft. Interns at Aloun Farms worked in farm and office departments.
deadline_text: No application dates on the program page. The 2026 summer internships ended at the end of July. Outrigger Resorts planned interns at its Kona and Waikiki properties later in the year, with no dates given.

name: Hawaii DOE Student Summer Internships (DOE Offices and Schools)
what_you_do: Work a summer internship at a Hawaii DOE state office, a complex area office, or a school. Each internship has its own duties and hours.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications opened Mar 30, 2026 and closed Apr 10, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Kupu Aina Corps
what_you_do: Paid green jobs in nature care, farming, trail repair and green tech. You work with host groups across Hawaii and get career help and certificates.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 term are open now. Closing date not stated on the page.

name: Rep. Matsumoto High School Legislative Internship
org: Office of Hawaii State Representative Lauren Cheape Matsumoto
what_you_do: Help a state lawmaker's office during the legislative session. Some interns may continue through the end of the session after May.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Senator Schatz High School Internship Program (Hawaii)
org: Office of U.S. Senator Brian Schatz
what_you_do: Work with a U.S. Senate office from home. The internship is virtual, and the work is done outside school hours.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 application closed on Aug 19, 2026. The page says the 2027 to 2028 application will be posted in spring 2027.

name: UH Early College (College Classes at Your High School)
org: University of Hawaii System and Hawaii State Department of Education
what_you_do: Take college classes with other high school students, offered at your high school, online, or as a mix of both. A college professor or a qualified high school teacher leads the class. Classes at the 100 level and above earn high school and college credit.
deadline_text: Deadlines are set by each UH campus. Ask your counselor.

name: UH Running Start (College Classes for High School Students)
org: University of Hawaii System and Hawaii State Department of Education
what_you_do: Take a college class at a University of Hawaii campus while you are in high school. You earn high school credit and college credit.
deadline_text: Deadlines are set by each UH campus. Ask your counselor.

name: Hayward Area Historical Society Volunteers
what_you_do: You help at the history museum and old houses. You can lead tours, greet guests, help kids with crafts or work the front desk.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline.

name: H.A.R.D. Volunteer Program (Hayward Area Recreation and Park District)
org: Hayward Area Recreation and Park District (H.A.R.D.)
what_you_do: Volunteer at district events and ongoing service projects such as senior programs, nature programs, special needs programs and theatre ushering. Teens can earn community service hours and work experience.
deadline_text: Opportunities are posted throughout the year. No closing date is stated on the page.

name: Hayward Public Library Teen Volunteer Opportunities
what_you_do: Teens help the Children's Room librarians with tasks like cleaning books and craft prep, in 1-hour shifts. Teens can also attend Teen Library Council meetings.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted during the school year. No closing date is stated on the page.

name: Hayward Youth Commission
what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise three groups. Those are the Hayward City Council, the Hayward Area Recreation and Park District and the Hayward Unified School District. They advise on issues that affect young people. They also work on youth projects.
deadline_text: 2025 cycle: applications due Friday, May 9, 2025. Interviews were on Friday, May 30, 2025. No 2026 cycle was found.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Henderson library branch (Gibson, Green Valley, Paseo Verde or West Henderson). Tasks and hours are not listed on the page.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Paseo Verde Library has a 6 to 12 month wait.

name: STEAM Squad teen internship
what_you_do: Teen interns work in teams of three. They research and plan activities. They lead science, technology, engineering, art and math activities. These are for kids at participating libraries.
deadline_text: Hiring dates are not stated. Sign up for Hennepin County job notifications to be told about openings.

name: Teen volunteers
what_you_do: Help at a local Hennepin County library. Positions vary by library.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Ask your local library whether it has a teen opening.

name: VolunTeen Program
what_you_do: Teens called VolunTeens help at library branches. They follow a weekly work plan and work on their own.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page does not say if it is summer only or year-round.

name: Hidden Genius Project Immersion Program
what_you_do: You can join a free 15 month program (800+ hours) for Black male high school students. The page describes mentorship, coding and entrepreneurship training.
deadline_text: Our 2027 application is now open (apply page, checked 2026-10-10). No closing date is posted. The immersion page's last listed deadline was Feb 21, 2025.

name: Teen Leadership Council (High Museum of Art)
what_you_do: Join 15 high school students. You learn about art and how a museum works. You talk with artists and tour the collection. You help with public programs. You plan events for other teens.
deadline_text: 2026-27 cycle: applications opened Feb 1 and closed at midnight March 1 (2026); applicants were told by May 1, 2026. The page does not post the 2027-28 cycle.

name: Hiller Aviation Museum Flight Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens run hands-on STEM stations like Imagination Playground and virtual reality for visitors on alternating weekend days.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

name: Working Theory Farm Youth Positions
what_you_do: Youth employees work on a farm that grows food for community members. The page does not list the daily tasks.
deadline_text: This season's youth applications are closed. The page says to check back in late January 2027.

name: Hire LA's Youth
org: City of Los Angeles Economic and Workforce Development Department (EWDD)
what_you_do: Get a starter job with work-skills training, career coaching and money lessons. One sub-program puts high school students to work helping elementary kids in LA's BEST after-school programs.
deadline_text: The site banner says it is accepting applications but gives no dates, and its document library page still shows a 2022 summer banner. Call EWDD at 213-744-7300 to confirm the current cycle.

name: Hoag Jr. Auxiliary / Candystripers (High School Volunteer)
what_you_do: You greet visitors in the lobby. You escort people. You work in the gift store. You help in the cancer center infusion area. Duties are limited because volunteers are minors.
deadline_text: The program is full. The page says to check back January 2027 for when interest forms will be taken again.

name: Zoo Corps Teen Volunteers (Hogle Zoo)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo in summer. They share what they know about animals, nature and the earth.
deadline_text: The page says Zoo Corps applications are due April 13 with interviews April 17 and 18. It does not name the year, so this is the usual pattern.

name: Holy Cross Health volunteer program (high school students)
org: Holy Cross Health (Silver Spring and Germantown hospitals)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a Holy Cross hospital or health center in a clinical, customer service, administrative or support role. Year-round and summer-only openings are listed.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Friends of the Library of Hawaii Volunteer
org: Friends of the Library of Hawaii
what_you_do: Help sort, price and sell donated books and other items. Volunteers also help with the big book sales.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Book sales are in January and June.

name: Hawaii Foodbank Warehouse Volunteering
what_you_do: Volunteers check, sort and pack dry food, fresh produce and bread at the Honolulu warehouse. There are also monthly Saturday packings. They fill senior food boxes and Food 4 Keiki.
deadline_text: No deadline. 2026 Saturday packing dates are listed on the page. Reserve by email.

name: Hawaii Pacific Health High School Volunteer Program
org: Hawaii Pacific Health (Kapiolani, Pali Momi, Straub Benioff, Wilcox)
what_you_do: Volunteers work with patients and staff. They visit or read to patients, help at the info desk, help on patient care units or in the gift shop, or guide patients as navigators.
deadline_text: Student summer applications close in the beginning of April, and summer placement is limited. Other applications are taken as posted.

name: Hawaiian Humane Society Junior Volunteer
what_you_do: Teens ages 15 to 17 help care for shelter animals and help the community. Some roles let a junior volunteer work alone. Some roles need a teen to volunteer with an adult.
deadline_text: No deadline. Allow about 6 weeks for the application and training. Applications are kept for 6 months.

name: Teens4Animals Council
what_you_do: Council members plan and lead animal welfare events at school and in the community. They staff booths at Humane Society events. They speak up for animals. They can start an animal club at their school.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications are closed. The page does not say when the next application opens. The 2026 training was June 22 to 25, 2026.

name: HPU 600: College Classes for High School Students
what_you_do: High school students take college credit classes online. Classes are in arts and humanities, computer science, criminal justice and leadership, and math and science. Classes are taught on your own schedule, not live.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 terms: Term A Aug 31 to Oct 25, Term B Oct 26 to Dec 20, or a 16 week term Aug 31 to Dec 20. The registration deadline is not stated on the program page.

name: Kupu Community Program
what_you_do: A year long Oahu program for youth who lack support. It starts with 6 weeks of outdoor land repair. Then you work toward a high school diploma or equivalency, with job training in food and events.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round.

name: Lieutenant Governor High School Internship Program
org: Office of the Lieutenant Governor of Hawaii
what_you_do: Spend five summer weeks at the State Capitol, in person, and learn how state government works.
deadline_text: The 2026 internship ran June 15 to July 16, 2026. Its deadline was Apr 15, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: Volunteer Program (high school students can apply)
what_you_do: Volunteers talk with the public. They help with current exhibits. They help families with activities on Community Sundays. They help at HoMA Nights. They also prepare mailings for members.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings depend on what each museum department needs.

name: ʻAha ʻŌpio o OHA
what_you_do: Spend six days in Honolulu with other high school students. The program is overnight, and OHA covers airfare, lodging and meals for chosen students.
deadline_text: The next program is listed as Summer 2027, dates to be set. The online application link says coming soon. No deadline is posted.

name: Summer Fun Junior Leader (Honolulu Parks and Recreation)
org: City and County of Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Teens help staff at Honolulu's city-run Summer Fun day camps for kids at parks across Oahu.
deadline_text: 2026 kid registration was May 11 to 15. Junior Leader sign up is through each site; 2027 dates not posted.

name: Summer Swim Aide (City of Honolulu pools and ocean sites)
org: City and County of Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Lifeguards at city pools or ocean sites teach swim classes and keep swimmers safe. They also help run swim, paddle, surf and dive activities.
deadline_text: The page says applications are accepted online with no closing date listed. Current status not confirmed.

name: The Queen's Medical Center Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the hospital. Roles include gift shop help, guiding visitors, delivering gift baskets and other help for patients. There is also a High School Summer Student Program.
deadline_text: Dates not stated on the page. Call Volunteer Services (Mon to Fri, 8 am to 4 pm) for the next start.

name: UH Manoa Early College Scholars
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College
what_you_do: Take a UH Manoa college class, usually at your own high school. You earn high school credit and college credit, and you start a real college transcript.
deadline_text: Final deadlines: Spring 2027 is Nov 20, 2026. Summer 2027 and Fall 2027 are Apr 15, 2027.

name: Marine Science Investigations at the Hawaii Institute of Marine Biology
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College and Hawaii Institute of Marine Biology
what_you_do: A week of hands on sea science on Coconut Island. You do reef surveys in the water, island walking tours and lab work on sea sounds, brains and reef life.
deadline_text: 2026 application opened in March for the June 1 to 5 program. 2027 not posted. Email summer.programs@hawaii.edu to get notified.

name: Medical Diagnosis and Treatment summer program (JABSOM)
org: University of Hawaii John A. Burns School of Medicine and Outreach College
what_you_do: A week long program for students who like health careers. It has body lab demos, clinical skills labs, practice dummies and practice patient talks.
deadline_text: The page says the application opened in March 2026 for the 2026 program. 2027 information not posted. Email summer.programs@hawaii.edu to be notified.

grades: Finished grade 10 or 11 (rising juniors and seniors)
name: UH Manoa Summer Scholar Program
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College
what_you_do: High school students take UH Manoa summer classes. They learn with college students. They earn college credit.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Waikiki Aquarium High School Teen Educator Program
org: Waikiki Aquarium (University of Hawaii at Manoa)
what_you_do: Teens learn about Hawaiian sea life and practice talking with visitors about it. They build leadership and public speaking skills.
deadline_text: The page said Summer 2026 applications were open, with no closing date listed. Summer 2027 not posted yet.

name: Hawaii High School Model Youth Legislature (YMCA of Honolulu)
what_you_do: High school students practice how laws are made in a model youth legislature.
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not stated on the program page. See the state calendar link on that page.

name: Honolulu Youth Commission
org: City and County of Honolulu, Office of the Mayor
what_you_do: Commissioners speak for young people on Oahu. They advise the Mayor and the City Council. They meet at least once a month.
deadline_text: The online application portal is closed until 2027. New dates are not posted yet.

name: Honolulu Zoo Junior Leader Program
what_you_do: Teens help the Education team during Zoo Camp. They do outdoor science, guide younger campers and set a good example.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. First-time volunteers are asked to start in spring, fall or winter camp if possible.

name: HOSA Future Health Professionals
what_you_do: You can join this student group for health science students. It has skills contests, leadership events and health career exploration.
grades: Secondary and college students (exact grades not stated)
deadline_text: Join through your health science teacher.

name: Humane Society Silicon Valley Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Students under 18 can foster cats or dogs at home. They need a parent or guardian with them. They can also make no-sew fleece blankets for shelter animals. You earn service hours.
deadline_text: Rolling.

name: Bolsa Chica Conservancy Volunteer Days
what_you_do: Pull invasive plants, plant native ones and pick up trash at the Bolsa Chica wetlands. After a 3 hour training, long-term volunteers can lead wetland activities. They can also restore habitat. Some host visitors at the center.
deadline_text: No deadline. Events happen monthly.

name: Huntington Beach Public Library Teen Volunteering
what_you_do: Pick a library role. Choices include tech helper, LEGO Club assistant and seed library packer. You can also help with a chess or D&D club. You can also do general branch help like crafts, cleaning and setup.
deadline_text: Most roles take online applications with no deadline. The Teen Tech role lists applications Aug 29 to Sep 12 and interviews Sep 15 to 18, printed with no year. The page was last updated Oct 3, 2026, so that window is over for 2026 and no new Teen Tech dates are posted.

name: Huntington Beach Ocean Lifeguard I (Recurrent)
org: City of Huntington Beach Fire Department, Marine Safety Division
what_you_do: Work as a seasonal ocean lifeguard on city beaches. You do ocean rescues and give first aid. You warn people about dangers in the water. You get paid during training.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer posting opened Aug 12, 2025 and closed Apr 13, 2026. The exam was April 4, 2026. The 2027 summer dates are not posted on this page.

name: Huntington Beach Police Explorers
what_you_do: Learn about police and public safety jobs. The program builds leadership and teamwork. You also do community service.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Start with the interest form on the program page.

grades: High school (can apply the summer before 9th grade)
name: Huntington Beach Youth Collaborative
what_you_do: Sit on a city youth board of 10 to 15 students. Help run the Junior Citizens Academy and Youth in Government Day. Give ideas to city leaders. Volunteer at city events.
deadline_text: The page says applications are now available, with no end date listed.

name: Cancer Research High School Program
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah, with the American Cancer Society
what_you_do: A two week virtual program with lab lessons using a science kit sent to your home. You receive up to $500 in financial compensation.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: HCI-RISE: Remote Immersive Science Experience
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah
what_you_do: A virtual two week summer program on cancer research and health careers, with workshops, career panels and small group work. You are paid up to $400.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran February 10 to April 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: PathMaker Scholars Summer Research Program
org: Huntsman Cancer Institute, University of Utah
what_you_do: A 10 week summer research job in a University of Utah lab. You live on campus. You get weekly meetings, a research symposium and a chance to go to a national conference.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was February 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Know Your Government (KYG) Conference
org: University of Idaho Extension 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: A weekend conference in Boise. It is about how state government works. It is for 4-H youth in the Know Your Government project.
deadline_text: 2027 conference is February 13 to 15. Registration opens in December (day not stated).

name: Idaho 4-H State Teen Association Convention (STAC)
what_you_do: Spend four days on a college campus. Go to workshops, tour the campus and community, do a service project, and meet teens from across Idaho. You also explore careers and college.
grades: Youth who have completed 8th through 12th grade
deadline_text: The 2026 event was June 22 to 25, 2026. The last price window ended May 31. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Junior Zoo Crew
org: Idaho Falls Zoo at Tautphaus Park (City of Idaho Falls)
what_you_do: Join a 3-week zoo session, three days a week, from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. in the zoo's Junior Zoo Crew program.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for 2026. The page says applications open February 1st. In 2026 they closed April 18 at 4:00 p.m.

name: The Idaho Foodbank Volunteer Shifts
what_you_do: Sort donated food, repack bulk food into family size bags, label cans and build backpack food inserts. Shifts are in a warehouse.
deadline_text: No deadline. Book a shift any time.

name: Natural Resources Camp (University of Idaho Extension)
what_you_do: Spend a week at camp learning about wildlife, forestry, soils, rangeland and water. Do hands-on labs and talks with natural resource workers. Also hike, fish, shoot archery and compete in camp contests.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 15 to 20, 2026. The $310 fee was due by May 20. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Idaho Science and Aerospace Scholars (ISAS)
what_you_do: Take an online course made by NASA about space travel. It has eight units and a project. Top students may be invited to a week at the University of Idaho. There you plan a pretend mission to Mars with mentors.
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application is open. A closing date is not stated on the program page.

name: GEM High School Internship
org: Idaho State Museum (Idaho State Historical Society)
what_you_do: Teens meet with museum staff on Tuesday evenings. They sign up for at least 3 volunteer shifts during the program.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 to 2027 were due September 23 and group interviews were October 6 to 8. Dates for the next round are not posted.

name: iJAG (Iowa Jobs for America's Graduates) School Career Class
what_you_do: A class at some Iowa schools. Students do projects with employers, go to career fairs and the Career Development Conference, and get mentors and work-based learning.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Sign up through your school.

name: Illinois 4-H Creative Collective Art Ambassadors
what_you_do: A one-year statewide team for teens with strong visual or performing arts skills. Members help plan arts programs, go to trainings, and lead an art booth at the Illinois State Fair and Camp Kaleido.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

name: Illinois 4-H Food Advocacy Ambassadors
what_you_do: A statewide teen team that works on food access. Members meet with food experts, plan projects, and may speak to community groups or elected officials.
deadline_text: Application due December 31, 2026.

name: Illinois 4-H Healthy Living Ambassadors
what_you_do: A statewide teen team that plans health programs and events for youth and families. Members meet monthly online, go to a team retreat, and work at the Illinois State Fair.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

name: Illinois 4-H Influencers Team
what_you_do: A team of 7 to 10 high school students who make social media content and tell stories for 4-H. They also cover events and work the PR booth at the Illinois State Fair.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

name: Speaking for Illinois 4-H
what_you_do: A one-day, hands-on public speaking training. Teens learn to tell the 4-H story to elected officials, donors and community groups, and can speak at state events like Legislative Connection.
deadline_text: Training dates are not listed on the page. Use the register link.

name: Illinois 4-H clubs and teen leadership teams
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects. Older teens can also join state teen teams, like STEM Ambassadors, Healthy Living Ambassadors or the Youth Leadership Team.
deadline_text: No sign-up deadline is posted. Teen team applications and dates are not posted on the main teen page.

grades: High school juniors (finished at least one semester of 11th grade)
name: Illinois Boys State (American Legion)
what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Young men run a mock state government on the Eastern Illinois University campus. There are scholarship contests. You also get lifelong alumni membership.
deadline_text: The registration page says registration for the 2027 session closes at 4:00 PM on June 12, 2027, when the session starts. Ask your local Legion post about its earlier sponsor deadline.

name: Illinois Education and Training Voucher (ETV) for college and training
org: Illinois Department of Children and Family Services
what_you_do: Money for college or trade school costs that other aid does not cover, such as tuition, books, supplies, transportation and a laptop. Teens in foster care can plan for it before they graduate.
deadline_text: No deadline stated in the FAQ.

name: Illinois DCFS Employment, Job Training and Apprenticeship Incentive Program
org: Illinois Department of Children and Family Services
what_you_do: A money benefit for teens in DCFS care who have a job, are in job training or are in an approved apprenticeship. It helps youth build work skills.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Illinois DECA chapters and state conference
org: Illinois DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter to practice business skills in marketing, management, entrepreneurship, hospitality and tourism, or finance. Chapters compete at an Illinois state conference each spring.
deadline_text: The Illinois DECA conference is March 4 to 6, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency O'Hare in Rosemont, IL. No membership deadline is posted.

grades: High school (also middle level and college chapters exist)
name: Illinois FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
what_you_do: Join a business club at your school. Members build leadership and business skills, compete in events, and network at local, state and national levels.
deadline_text: 2026-27 dates: State Leadership Conference Apr 9 to 10, 2027; Summer Leadership Experience Jul 29 to 31, 2027; National Leadership Conference Jun 23 to 26, 2027 in Columbus OH. Regional dates are in the calendar PDF.

name: ALA Illini Girls State (American Legion Auxiliary)
org: American Legion Auxiliary Department of Illinois
what_you_do: A week-long citizenship and leadership program for high school girls, sponsored by an American Legion Auxiliary Unit. Delegates must attend the full session.
deadline_text: Next session is June 20 to 26, 2027. There is no fixed deadline: the FAQ says applications are accepted until the program is full, so apply early.

name: SRELO summer research at IMSA
org: Illinois Mathematics and Science Academy (IMSA), Aurora
city: Aurora, IL (open to Illinois students statewide)
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on a research project with an IMSA faculty mentor. The 2026 projects included AI and cardiology or neuroscience, molecular modeling, Chinese history and building a game in Pygame.
deadline_text: The 2026 application portal showed closed. No 2027 dates are posted. Sessions in 2026 were in June and July.

name: ISBE Student Advisory Council
what_you_do: Research education topics that affect Illinois public school students. Meet with policymakers and community partners, then present policy ideas to the State Board of Education.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed June 30, 2026 and late applications were not considered. Finalists were emailed in July for a video interview.

name: Illinois State Fair Volunteer Program
org: Illinois State Fair, Illinois Department of Agriculture
what_you_do: Volunteers work at information booths. They greet visitors at the gates and the Expo Building. They help in the fair office or go where they are needed.
deadline_text: The 2026 fair was Aug 13 to 23. The page does not post 2027 fair dates or volunteer application dates.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Illinois Wing
what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. Squadrons meet about 2.5 hours a week plus about one Saturday a month, with summer encampments and career academies.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

name: Illinois YMCA Youth and Government
city: Springfield, IL (state conference), delegations across Illinois
what_you_do: Join a delegation and take a role in a student model of Illinois state government. Roles include legislator, attorney, lobbyist or press team. You use what you learn at a state conference.
deadline_text: The scholarship portal closed October 1, 2026 (decisions come before November 1). The program page does not say if you can still register, and it posts no general registration deadline or conference dates. Ask your Delegation Advisor or the state office before you count on a spot.

name: IMSA AI Credential (online course)
what_you_do: Take a self-paced online course on how AI works, from machine learning to robotics, and on its ethics and safety. Weekly office hours with IMSA computer science faculty. You earn a certificate.
deadline_text: The September 2026 cohort runs September 28 to December 18, 2026, and has already started. The page lists registration for September 2026 only and gives no next date. Email studentenrichment@imsa.edu to ask about the next cohort.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL

name: Research Fundamentals (online)
what_you_do: Take a self-guided online course. You plan and run a science investigation and write a science paper. It is the course you must take before the summer SRELO research program.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened January 26, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL

name: RISE: Research, Inquiry Skills and Experimentation
what_you_do: Do your own science research project in a year-long, mostly asynchronous online program. You find a mentor, write a research paper, make a poster and present at spring science symposia.
deadline_text: The page says registration opened Thursday, July 30, 2026 at noon and has a Register button. It posts no closing date and does not say if new students can still join. Spots are limited. Full refund (less the $100 fee) through mid-September 2026; no refunds after September 30, 2026. Ask IMSA before you pay.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL

name: 4-H Academy @ Purdue
what_you_do: A three-day, two-night stay in a Purdue residence hall. You pick hands-on workshops such as animal health, AI, food science, leadership and plant sciences taught by Purdue faculty and experts.
deadline_text: The 2026 conference ran June 10 to 12, 2026. Registration dates are not posted on the page and 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H Day at the Statehouse
what_you_do: Students learn how state government works. They tour the Statehouse and meet state lawmakers. Some serve as student pages.
deadline_text: 2026 event was Feb 10. Registration closed Jan 19, 2026. The page does not say when the next event is.

grades: Youth who have completed grades 7 and 8
name: 4-H Round-Up at Purdue
what_you_do: A three-day stay in a Purdue residence hall for youth who just finished grades 7 and 8. Attend career classes made for Round-Up and get a taste of college life.
deadline_text: 2026 event ran June 10 to 12, 2026. Registration was open through May 22, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Teen 4-H leaders train to speak up for Indiana 4-H, act as role models for younger youth and work with adults and community partners. Training and workshops are held July 30 to August 1.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due April 15, 2026. Interviews were in the first two weeks of May and ambassadors were notified in the last week of May. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H State Fair Exhibit Hall Worker
what_you_do: Paid workers check in and display 4-H exhibits at the Indiana State Fair.
deadline_text: 2026 work dates were July 31 to Aug 25 (fair Aug 7 to 23). No application deadline was stated, and 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Indiana 4-H
