what_you_do: Teens join county clubs. Then they can join state programs such as State 4-H Ambassadors, Invention Convention, Shooting Sports Competition and 4-H Camp.
deadline_text: Join any time. State programs have their own dates.

name: Indiana DECA chapters and state conference
org: Indiana DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter at a school with business or marketing classes. Members build business skills. They compete at the Indiana state conference.
deadline_text: The Indiana DECA conference is February 26 to 28, 2027 at the Indianapolis Marriott Downtown. No membership deadline is posted.

name: Volunteer with Indiana DNR (youth volunteer agreement for under 18)
city: Indiana (state parks, nature centers and other DNR properties)
what_you_do: Help at DNR properties. Jobs include working at nature centers, fixing trails and planting native plants. You can also pull invasive plants, clean streams, check birdhouses, or share photos and art. You set up your project with a property.
deadline_text: No deadline. Schedules are flexible and set with the property.

name: WorkOne young adult (youth) services
org: Indiana Department of Workforce Development, WorkOne Career Centers
city: Statewide, with WorkOne centers in Lafayette and other Indiana cities
what_you_do: Career advising and job-readiness help for young people through WorkOne centers. Pay or work placements are not described on the page; ask the center what is offered.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Contact a WorkOne center.

name: Indiana FFA membership through your school ag class
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's agriculture class. FFA is the student group tied to agricultural education in Indiana. Local chapters run the activities.
deadline_text: Indiana FFA says affiliation declarations are due October 1, rosters November 1 and student test numbers December 1. These are chapter deadlines for the teacher.

name: Hoosier Boys State
org: American Legion, Department of Indiana (Hoosier Boys State, Inc.)
what_you_do: For one week, build a mock Indiana state government. Delegates form two made-up parties, run for office, propose laws, negotiate bills and meet real officials.
deadline_text: Registration opens January 11, 2027. The 2027 session is June 13 to 18, 2027. No registration deadline is posted.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Indiana Wing
what_you_do: Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character in a year-round cadet squadron. Cadets wear uniforms, learn drill, earn promotions and plan activities. You do not have to join the military.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

name: Work and Learn Indiana (free internship and work-based learning matching site)
org: Work and Learn Indiana, with the Indiana Commission for Higher Education
what_you_do: A free website where Indiana employers post internships and other work-based learning. Learners search by region and apply. High schools, colleges and employers can join.
deadline_text: No deadline. Postings come and go, so each one has its own date.

name: World Food Prize Youth Institute at Purdue
what_you_do: Write a research paper on a world hunger problem in one country. Then present it at Purdue to faculty, staff and industry experts. You also meet people in farming and food security.
deadline_text: Listed as Spring 2027. The page says registration dates for 2027 will be shared when available.

name: Indiana YMCA Youth and Government (INYaG)
org: Indiana YMCA Youth and Government (Alliance of Indiana YMCAs)
city: Indianapolis, IN (state conference), delegations across Indiana
what_you_do: Learn how government works by acting it out. Delegates research and debate public issues. They take mock legislative, executive and court roles. Then they serve as delegates at the state conference.
deadline_text: 2026-27 conference and registration dates are not posted on the program page (it links only a 2024-2025 calendar).

name: K-12 STEM Future Corps (INL high school internship)
what_you_do: Work six weeks at Idaho National Laboratory. Start with a week of orientation and job skills. Then rotate through facilities doing hands-on work like machining, welding, drafting and heavy equipment. End with a project and a talk.
deadline_text: Application dates are not posted. The fact sheet is dated January 2025 and says the program intends to run from mid June to early August.

name: Inova high school student volunteer sessions
city: Fairfax, Alexandria and Northern Virginia hospitals, VA
what_you_do: You volunteer one 3 to 4 hour shift a week at an Inova hospital. You can pick a spring, summer or fall session. You learn about patient care, retail and operations.
grades: High school (through the summer after graduation)
deadline_text: Spring 2027 registration opens Nov 5, 2026 at 4 p.m. and closes Nov 8, 2026 at 11:45 p.m. Inova also runs summer and fall sessions.

name: Junior Volunteers (Intermountain Health)
city: Salt Lake City and Lehi, UT
what_you_do: Teens may volunteer in a limited number of hospital roles. The page does not list the jobs.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: Iowa 4-H Agricultural Ambassadors
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens mentor younger 4-H members and join career panels and tours of farm businesses. They learn to speak up for farming. They also lead a workshop for the whole state.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed July 7. The page does not name the year of that deadline; its schedule starts August 21, 2026. The page does not say when the next application opens.

name: Iowa 4-H Career Pathways Academy
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens look at jobs in farming, teaching, business, health, science and skilled trades. They visit colleges and work sites. They shadow local workers.
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not stated on the page.

name: Iowa 4-H Reporters
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens report on county, regional and state 4-H events from June to August.
deadline_text: Members can apply in January and winners are announced in April (2026 dates not stated on the page). Events run June to August.

name: Iowa State 4-H Council
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Iowa 4-H members in grades 10 and 11 help plan the Iowa 4-H Youth Conference in Ames. They go to five weekend retreats in central Iowa. They also speak for 4-H with county councils and 4-H groups.
deadline_text: Applications open in January and winners are announced in April (2026 dates not stated on the page). No more than 60 interviews are held.

name: Iowa State Fair 4-H Volunteer, Youth Staff and Intern Jobs
org: Iowa 4-H, Iowa State University Extension and Outreach
what_you_do: Iowa only. 4-H members and alumni help run the 4-H Exhibits Building at the Iowa State Fair. They also help with speaking events and livestock and plant shows. They can work as volunteers, paid youth staff or summer interns.
deadline_text: 2026 volunteer form closed July 27. Summer 2027 intern positions open in December 2026. The page does not give 2027 fair dates.

name: Iowa 4-H
org: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Iowa 4-H
what_you_do: Iowa only. Teens join county clubs and projects. Then they can join state programs such as State 4-H Council, State 4-H Recognition Day, State Project Area Awards and Youth Conference.
deadline_text: Join through 4-H Online. The page does not give a join date. State programs have their own application dates.

name: American Legion Boys State of Iowa
city: Statewide, IA (held at Camp Dodge, Johnston)
what_you_do: Spend six days at Camp Dodge learning how government works. Delegates take part in hands-on government work and leadership events.
deadline_text: Delegate registration opens in January 2027 and closes May 1, 2027. The program runs June 20 to 25, 2027. Post reservations open in October 2026.

name: Heartland Junior Science and Humanities Symposium (Heartland-JSHS)
city: Iowa City, IA (Iowa and Nebraska students)
what_you_do: Do your own research project. Write a paper about it. If it is picked, present it to judges and compete for scholarships.
deadline_text: The paper site opens in October 2026. Papers are due January 11, 2027 (11:59 PM Central). You hear back January 25, 2027. Registration is due February 8, 2027.

name: Iowa Young Writers' Studio Summer Residential Program
org: University of Iowa, Iowa Young Writers' Studio
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on campus studying one kind of writing, such as poetry, fiction, playwriting or TV writing. You learn from students and graduates of the Iowa Writers' Workshop.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 25, 2027 and close Feb 7, 2027 (11:59 PM Central). Summer 2027 sessions are June 13 to 26 and July 11 to 24.

name: University of Iowa Secondary Student Training Program (SSTP), Summer 2027
what_you_do: Join a University of Iowa faculty member's research group. Work on a research project. If you finish, you earn 3 semester hours of college credit.
deadline_text: Opens Dec 15, 2026 at 5:00 pm CST. Closes Feb 16, 2027 at 11:59 pm CST. Session June 16 to July 23, 2027.

name: Iowa FFA
what_you_do: Iowa only. Students in farm and food classes build leadership and job skills. They do contests, work projects, conferences and the state convention.
deadline_text: The page does not state join dates. Dates for the state convention and officer selection are not on the home page.

name: Pre-Employment Transition Services (Pre-ETS)
org: Iowa Vocational Rehabilitation Services, Iowa Workforce Development
what_you_do: Students with disabilities explore careers, build work skills and try real work. You also get help planning for college or job training. You learn to speak up for yourself.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. You can start working with the program once you turn 14.

name: Iroquois Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus and train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes bricklayer, carpentry, electrical, painting and more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Irvine High School Youth Action Team (HSYAT)
what_you_do: Student reps from local high schools organize teen activities. They speak for their peers at community groups. Check the Instagram account for upcoming events.
deadline_text: The page does not list application dates.

name: Irvine Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: You help library staff with programs and crafts. You also help with the seed library and toy cleaning. You can help run the Summer Reading Program. Or join the Teen Advisory Group (TAG) for service projects. TAG also gives feedback on teen programs.
deadline_text: The undated page says: Summer Reading applications ran May 9 to May 30, school-year roles will reopen Saturday, August 1, and TAG is full with a wait list for applications after August 26. No year is shown, so confirm current openings.

name: Irvine Police Department Explorer Program
what_you_do: Train with Irvine police. Help with traffic control, community events and DUI checkpoints. After a 5-day academy, you can ride along on patrol.
deadline_text: Send in the interest card by January 1 for the winter session or by June 1 for the summer session. The page does not state the year.

name: UCI Summer Session for High School Students
what_you_do: Take one real UC Irvine college course in the summer, picked from a pre-approved list of courses numbered 1 to 99. Courses are taught at a college level.
deadline_text: Dates for Summer 2027 are not posted yet. Check the Summer Session calendar in spring.

grades: Grades K to 12 (grades 9 to 12 for most options)
name: Irvine Valley College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take regular IVC college classes while in school. You can take up to 11 units a semester, on campus or online. IVC also has high school partner classes and an Early College Pathway. It also runs an Irvine school district summer college.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Follow the steps for each term on the IVC page.

name: One Irvine Workforce Youth Service Corps Summer High School Program
what_you_do: High school students work as Community Services Leaders. You help with summer camps, art programs, events and park setup. You also get job and leadership training.
deadline_text: The page gives no closing date. It says to check back in February 2027.

name: Library Volunteer (ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteers help with tech tutoring, the Makerspace, shelf adopting and shelf reading, and special events. Staff match you to a need.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No dates.

name: JA Launchpad (Junior Achievement, Fremont)
what_you_do: You will be able to join a new career center in Fremont, coming in early 2027. It offers a money-management simulation, a student business program and career summits with company mentors.
deadline_text: The page says the center is Coming Early 2027. No opening date or sign-up is posted.

grades: Grades 9 to 12 (JA Inspire is grades 11 and 12)
name: Junior Achievement high school programs (JA Company Program, JA Job Shadow, JA Inspire)
city: Los Angeles area, Orange County and Inland Empire, CA
what_you_do: In a class or club, students learn money skills, build and run a small business with a pitch contest, or visit employers for job shadow events. JA Inspire is a career fair with mock interviews.
deadline_text: Schools request programs any time. JA Inspire 2027 is Mar 10 to 11, 2027 at JA Finance Park in Los Angeles. Registration was not open yet.

name: JC Next Summer Jobs
what_you_do: Young residents get paid summer jobs. The jobs are with city parks and play programs, local shops and city offices.
deadline_text: No 2026 deadline stated in the press release. 2027 not posted.

name: Teen Summer Docent Program
what_you_do: Teens learn STEM content, customer service and professional skills, and meet STEM role models. No specific tasks are listed on the page.
deadline_text: The page says openings will be posted there as they become available. No dates were posted as of Oct 12, 2026.

name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: Teens meet monthly at a branch. They suggest teen programs and library materials. They work on group projects. They earn volunteer credit.
deadline_text: No deadline stated, and the page does not say applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Call your branch to ask about the next intake.

name: Teen Volunteers at JMRL
what_you_do: Teen volunteers prepare program and distribution materials. They make displays and set up meeting rooms. They help with the summer reading program at a library branch.
deadline_text: The page gives a cutoff date for summer volunteer applications of 5/28/26 and does not say which branches it covers.

name: Job Corps (Brunswick and Turner centers, Georgia)
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Free career training campus. The Brunswick center page lists Building Construction Technology (pre-apprentice), Electrical (pre-apprentice), Certified Nurse Assistant and Clinical Medical Assistant, with a See More link for the full list.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start at any time. The application process usually takes about two months.

name: Job Corps: Hubert H. Humphrey Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Free live-on-campus career training. The center lists Advanced Transportation Service Worker, Building Construction Technology (pre-apprentice), Culinary Arts and Office Administration.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start the application at any time.

name: Job Corps Sacramento Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: You can get free live-in career training. Choose construction, carpentry, cement masonry or Certified Nurse Assistant. You also get help finishing high school. You can earn a high school equivalency.
deadline_text: Ongoing enrollment. No dates posted on the Sacramento page.

name: Job Corps: Gary Job Corps Center (San Marcos)
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Free live-on-campus career training. Programs listed include Advanced Cement Masonry (Pre-Apprentice), Advanced Electrical (Overhead Line Construction) and Advanced Transportation Service Worker.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start the application at any time.

name: Job Corps (Cascades, Curlew and Columbia Basin centers, Washington)
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
city: Sedro-Woolley, Curlew and Moses Lake, WA
what_you_do: Free live-on-campus career training. Centers list computer and medical assistant, carpentry, cement masonry, human services, fire management and nursing assistant training.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start the application at any time.

name: Job Service North Dakota Youth Employment and Training Program (WIOA Youth)
city: Statewide (offices in Fargo, Bismarck, Grand Forks and more), ND
what_you_do: A case manager builds a plan with you. Help can include a tutor, GED or school help, job shadowing and career exploring. You may also get a mentor and a paid short-term work experience at a public, nonprofit or private business.
deadline_text: No deadline stated in the handbook and brochure.

name: John Muir Health High School Student Volunteer Program (Walnut Creek Medical Center)
what_you_do: Help staff, patients and visitors at Walnut Creek Medical Center in a structured high school program. Students build skills in administration, patient interaction, communication, organization and leadership.
deadline_text: No application window is stated on the official page. Contact a partner high school (for example Acalanes, Campolindo, Las Lomas, Miramonte, Monte Vista, San Ramon Valley or Ygnacio Valley) to ask about the next intake.

name: Johnson County Library Teen Volunteers
city: Overland Park and Johnson County, KS
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at library branches and events. This includes summer teen volunteer jobs and teen book reviewing. You sign up for one-time, short-term or weekly spots in an online volunteer portal.
deadline_text: Sign up any time in the volunteer portal. Summer teen opportunities are posted in late April.

name: Junior Achievement of Northern California (high school programs)
what_you_do: You can join Junior Achievement programs on entrepreneurship, investing and personal finance, led by volunteers. Job shadow and Finance Park experiences are also listed, and a Silicon Valley Launchpad center is coming in early 2027.
deadline_text: No central deadline; ask JA.

name: KP LAUNCH High School Program
city: Northern California Kaiser Permanente service areas
what_you_do: You get a paid summer job. It is seven weeks and full time. The jobs are in healthcare support or admin roles. You also get weekly workshops, mentoring and networking. There is little patient contact.
grades: Current high school student (priority to juniors and seniors) or Class of 2027 graduate
deadline_text: Opens Nov 16, 2026 at 9am Pacific; closes Jan 8, 2027 at 5pm Pacific.

name: Kaiser Permanente Redwood City Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help patients, visitors and staff with friendly service at the hospital. Roles include office help, greeting and walking people where they need to go, and the front desk.
deadline_text: Closed. On 2026-10-16 the page said: not accepting applications, check back in 2027. No 2027 date is posted.

name: Kaiser Permanente San Jose Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors with friendly service at the San Jose hospital. You do not need any medical skills.
deadline_text: Closed now. On 2026-10-16 the page said the high school program is full and applications are closed, and the High School Programs listing said they are not accepting high school applicants at this time. The page says applications for minors are accepted sporadically during the year when shifts open up. No reopening date is posted.

name: Kaiser Permanente Santa Clara Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
city: Santa Clara, CA (Homestead campus, 710 Lawrence Expressway)
what_you_do: You give a warm welcome to members and guests, greet people, and walk visitors through the medical center. No medical background is needed.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. On 2026-10-16 the Santa Clara High School Programs listing showed an Apply button.

name: Kaiser Permanente South San Francisco High School Volunteer Program
city: South San Francisco, CA (1200 El Camino Real; also Daly City and San Bruno offices)
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors at the hospital or at nearby offices in Daly City and San Bruno. You work one 4 hour shift each week.
deadline_text: Not open to high school students right now. On 2026-10-16 the page said high school applications are accepted sporadically during the year based on shift availability, and that after a system upgrade it is taking a very limited number of applications, with adults 18+ applying to Hospital Services. No date is posted.

name: Kaiser Permanente Walnut Creek Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
city: Walnut Creek, CA (1425 South Main St)
what_you_do: You greet members and guests and walk visitors to where they need to go in the hospital. It is a nonclinical role, so there is no job or clinical shadowing.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. On 2026-10-16 the Walnut Creek High School Programs listing showed an Apply button, but its Status line was blank.

name: Volunteer Restoration Workdays (all ages)
org: Forest Preserve District of Kane County
what_you_do: Join a monthly restoration workday in the forest preserves. Volunteers work in natural areas. Longer roles include trail adopter and nature center host. You can also be a historic site guide or help at special events.
deadline_text: No deadline. See the monthly list of workdays on the volunteer page.

name: Kane County Workforce Development Youth Services (WIOA Youth)
city: Kane, DeKalb and Kendall Counties (Elgin area), IL
what_you_do: You can get paid work experience. You can do internships and job shadowing. Apprenticeships are also an option. You get resume and interview coaching. You can get GED prep and tutoring. You also get help with life skills, transportation and child care.
deadline_text: No dates posted. You contact a provider and they explain how to start.

name: Kansas 4-H Discovery Days
org: Kansas 4-H Youth Development, Kansas State University
what_you_do: Spend a few days on the K-State campus like a mini college experience. You pick classes, go on tours and meet teens from across Kansas. You build leadership skills.
deadline_text: 2026 event was June 3 to 5. The program page says registration is closed and does not list 2027 dates.

name: High School Summer Volunteer
what_you_do: Summer hospital volunteers welcome visitors at the front desk. They help patients and families pass the time with fun things to do in waiting rooms.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. Page says check back in spring 2027.

name: Summer Training in Academic Research (STAR 2.0)
what_you_do: 6 weeks of hands on medical research with mentors at the Children's Mercy Research Institute. You also practice science writing and speaking.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Dec 15, 2025 to Jan 9, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect a similar winter window.

name: Teen Arts Council
what_you_do: Teen leaders work with museum staff to plan and promote museum programs.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 term are closed. Interviews were in August 2026. Next application dates not posted.

name: VolunTeen Student Summer Volunteer Program
org: The University of Kansas Health System
what_you_do: Volunteer for two weeks in a hospital. You see patient care areas and behind-the-scenes jobs and meet people who work there.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was March 6, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: High school students volunteer at the museum for a session and gain skills in a history setting. Perks include store discounts.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed. Spring session dates not posted.

name: Teen Council
what_you_do: A group of students from schools across Kansas City. They shape museum events, work with other creative teens and see how a museum runs. You gain leadership skills and volunteer experience.
deadline_text: Page says applications are now open. No deadline posted.

name: ProX Summer Internship Program
org: ProX (Professional Experiences for Kansas City Youth)
what_you_do: A five-week paid summer internship with a Kansas City employer in fields like healthcare, marketing, engineering and real estate. You do workshops, then interview at a hiring fair. No experience needed.
deadline_text: Page says check back in early January 2027 for summer 2027 applications (exact date not posted). 2026 applications closed Feb 20, 2026; the hiring fair was Mar 21, 2026.

name: Teen volunteering at Kansas City Public Library
what_you_do: Teens ages 12 to 18 can volunteer at Kansas City Public Library branches. Talk to the teen volunteer lead at your branch to learn about openings.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings depend on the branch.

name: STAHR High School Scholars
what_you_do: 6 weeks on the UMKC Health Sciences Campus to explore health careers. Then you get mentors, service and help with college applications from August to April.
deadline_text: 2027 application opens Nov 15, 2026. The page prints a Feb 1, 2026 at 11:59 pm CST deadline, which appears to belong to the earlier cycle. No 2027 deadline is posted yet.

name: VolunTEEN
what_you_do: It is a teen volunteer program all year. In year 1, teens start as a Trailblazer or DigiTEEN. Then they pick a path. The paths are Junior Interpreter, Junior Counselor, EnviroTeen, Junior Caretaker and Teen Advisory Council.
deadline_text: Applications open November 2026. The page gives no close date.

name: Leaders in Training and Counselors in Training
what_you_do: Spend five nights at a Kansas 4-H camp ranch in a teen leadership program. Leaders in Training (LIT) is for younger teens. Counselors in Training (CIT) is for older teens.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran June 7 to 12, June 14 to 19, July 5 to 10 and July 12 to 17. The program page does not list 2027 dates or a deadline.

name: King County Library System Teen Advisory Boards
city: King County, WA (branches outside the city of Seattle)
what_you_do: Teen volunteers meet with a librarian. They give input on library services. They help design library programs and events.
deadline_text: No deadline. The page lists upcoming meetings (for example Maple Valley, Lake Forest Park, Newport Way and Federal Way); contact the local library to join.

name: Health Science Explorers Academy
org: University of Nebraska at Kearney Health Sciences
what_you_do: A year-long program with monthly days on the UNK campus (8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.): hands-on activities, simulations, guest speakers, field trips and health science lessons from UNK and UNMC faculty.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2027-2028 school year opens January 4, 2027. Close date not stated.

name: Keck Medicine of USC Summer Youth Volunteer Program
org: Keck Medicine of USC, Office of Volunteer Services
what_you_do: Volunteer for 8 weeks in summer. You work at Keck Hospital of USC or USC Norris Cancer Hospital.
deadline_text: The page lists the application period as Feb 1 to April 30, with recommendation letters due April 30 (year not stated). Orientation is the second week of June.

name: Kennesaw Police Public Safety Cadet Program
what_you_do: Weekly classes on police rules and methods, criminal law and the U.S. Constitution. You also do real-world training scenes. Volunteer at city events like Taste of Kennesaw. The page says cadets can earn over 100 volunteer hours in one year.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

name: Kentucky 4-H Teen Conference
org: University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension, Kentucky 4-H
what_you_do: A four-day leadership event for Kentucky 4-H teens.
deadline_text: 2026 conference was June 2 to 5. Registration closed April 15, 2026. The page does not give 2027 dates.

name: Kentucky 4-H
org: University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension, Kentucky 4-H
what_you_do: Teens join county clubs and 4-H camps. The page names Teen Conference as a teen event.
deadline_text: Enrollment opens Sept 1. The program year runs Sept 1 to Aug 31.

name: Kentucky FFA
what_you_do: Students in farm and food classes join a school chapter. They compete in career events and go to FFA camp and the state convention. They can run for chapter and state leader jobs.
deadline_text: No application date. Upcoming: State Land Judging Nov 5, 2026. The 98th State Convention has no date posted.

name: Kentucky Governor's Scholars Program (GSP)
city: Kentucky (campuses at Centre College, Morehead State University and Murray State University)
what_you_do: Spend five weeks on a college campus taking three classes plus evening and weekend activities with other top Kentucky students. There are no grades or credits. You earn a certificate.
grades: 11th grade at the time of selection (summer before senior year)
deadline_text: Single-school districts, private schools and homeschool students: Jan 15, 2027. Districts with more than one school: Jan 29, 2027. Notices go out by Apr 12, 2027.

name: Kentucky Governor's School for the Arts (GSA) 2027
org: Kentucky Center for the Performing Arts
city: Kentucky (summer program at Northern Kentucky University)
what_you_do: Spend 3 weeks in summer studying your art with other Kentucky teens. Arts are writing, dance, drama, film and photos, graphic design, band or string music, musical theatre, visual art and voice.
deadline_text: The application opened Oct 2, 2026 and is due Sunday, January 17, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET. Finalists are announced Feb 12. Final round is Mar 11 to 13, 2027. Accepted students are told Apr 9, 2027.

name: Kentucky Junior Academy of Science (KJAS)
what_you_do: Present your own science research as a talk or poster at the Kentucky Academy of Science meeting. You can also join a field project, lab tours and a STEM careers lunch.
deadline_text: The meeting is Nov 6 and 7, 2026. The registration page (year not printed on it) says the abstract deadline is October 1, late pre-registration runs Oct 2 to Oct 30, and on-site registration is Nov 6 and 7.

name: WIOA Youth Program
org: Kentucky Career Center, Department of Workforce Investment
what_you_do: Get help with school, job skills and career plans. Services can include paid or unpaid work, summer jobs, internships, job shadowing, tutoring and mentoring. Kentucky has 10 local workforce areas.
deadline_text: Programs run all year. No deadline is listed.

name: Key Club (high school service club)
what_you_do: You do service, leadership and fundraising through a student-led club at your school. If your school has no club, you can start one.
deadline_text: Join your school's club or start one. No cycle stated.

name: Keystone Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus and train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes bricklayer, carpentry, cement masonry, plumbing and more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Khan Academy college and careers courses
what_you_do: You can take free online lessons on the Khan Academy Life skills page. Topics include financial literacy, personal finance, entrepreneurship, career exploration and college admissions.
deadline_text: Always open.

name: KidsMatter Senior High Board
what_you_do: Join a student board that meets monthly during the school year. Plan and run community events, like a self-care month and a service night at a museum, and speak for teens in the community.
deadline_text: 2025-26 board: applications closed May 17, 2026. The 2026-27 call is not posted on the page yet.

name: Knox County Public Library Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at library events. Teens and adults can work at the Children's Festival of Reading. That means booths, stages, crafts, face painting and setup. They can also work at Imagination Library sign up booths and events.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted.

name: Ambassadors Program (workforce skills)
what_you_do: Build work skills at the children's museum with a group that visits each week. You practice things like tracking time, following a cleaning plan, interviews and making the site look nice.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Email the museum to ask.

name: Teen Volunteer at Knoxville Museum of Art
what_you_do: Help at Family Fun Day (art making, shows and artist demos). Or help with the museum's week long Summer Art Academy classes for kids ages 3 to 18.

name: College Now (MDUSD and Diablo Valley College)
org: Mt. Diablo Unified School District and Diablo Valley College
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (at Diablo Valley College)
what_you_do: Spend your junior and senior years on a college campus. You take three high school classes taught by Mt. Diablo teachers. You take the rest of your classes at DVC and earn high school and college credit.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due Thursday, Feb 12, 2026, with no late applications. The page says the application is held in the spring. The next dates are not posted.

name: Student Board Member, Mt. Diablo Unified School District
what_you_do: Sit with the school board as the voice of students. You go to board meetings, give input on decisions, and lead the Student Advisory Committee. You are seated with the board and can take part in discussions and cast preferential votes.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due May 29, 2026. The district picks a new Student Board Member each year. The next dates are not posted.

name: Youth Empowerment Services (YES), WIOA Youth Program
city: Concord, CA (serves Central Contra Costa County and Bay Point)
what_you_do: You get a case manager who helps you finish school, plan for college or a career, and find work. Help includes tutoring, job training, mentors, and paid and unpaid work experience.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadline is stated on the program page.

name: Youth Volunteer Sessions at MedShare
what_you_do: Sort, label and pack medical supplies in a 3-hour morning or afternoon shift. The supplies go to hospitals and clinics.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for a session before you arrive.

name: MemorialCare Long Beach Medical Center High School Volunteen Summer Program
what_you_do: Summer volunteer spots in the hospital, based on what the hospital needs. They consider your wishes but do not promise them.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full and its application closed. A waitlist was offered. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: Memphis Ambassadors Program (MAP)
org: City of Memphis Office of Youth Services
what_you_do: Join a program all year long. Ambassadors finish community service projects through the year. They build social skills, thinking skills and leadership skills.
deadline_text: No application window is posted. Call 901-636-6264 to ask.

name: Job Shadowing at Baptist Memorial Health Care
what_you_do: Watch a health care worker do their job for a short visit. Shadowing is observation only, so you do not take on work duties.
deadline_text: No fixed dates. Ask at least 6 to 8 weeks before the day you want.

name: Summer VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the children's hospital in one of four summer sessions and explore careers in medicine. Each session has eight teens.
deadline_text: The hospital's page says to check back in February for summer program updates. No dates are posted yet.

name: Summer VolunTEEN Program
city: Memphis, TN area (Methodist University, North, South, Germantown and Olive Branch hospitals)
what_you_do: Volunteer four days a week for four weeks in a hospital department. A required orientation starts the program. You write about your interest in the medical field.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was April 5 to 18, with interviews April 22 and 23 and answers by the first week of May. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: MPLOY Youth Summer Experience
org: City of Memphis Office of Youth Services
what_you_do: Work for six weeks in the summer in a soft skills training, entry-level job or internship placement with a host employer. You are paid by paper check.
deadline_text: No application window is posted on the city pages. Call 901-636-6264 to ask when it opens.

name: Teenteer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at Regional One Health for a short summer session and get volunteer experience hours. The page does not list the tasks or total hours.
grades: Entering or current high school student
deadline_text: In 2026 applications opened May 1 and closed May 18 or when full. Students were told by May 22. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Rhodes Summer Academy 2027
what_you_do: Live on campus for 2 weeks and take 1 college class for 2 credits. Choices include fiction writing, chemistry, video game design or medicine in the ancient world. Afternoons have workshops and college prep advice.
deadline_text: The program page says applications open soon. The Summer Programs page says applications open in November. No deadline is posted.

name: Stax Music Academy After-School Program and Summer Music Experience
what_you_do: After school during the school year, study instrument or voice, the music business, or songwriting. A month long summer program runs in June.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026-27 school year is open. No deadline is posted. The audition page says nothing about summer auditions.

name: Memphis Youth City Council (MYCC)
org: City of Memphis Office of Youth Services
what_you_do: The city's youth council gives high school youth a chance to take part. The city's pages do not list meeting times, projects, stipend or other rules.
deadline_text: No application window is posted. Call 901-636-6264 to ask.

name: Teen Advisory Group (TAG), Menlo Park Library
org: City of Menlo Park, Library and Community Services
what_you_do: Members help promote and improve the library's teen programs and materials. They plan events. They help with library projects. Members earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: Rolling membership. The page is accepting applications for new members and states no deadline.

name: Youth Advisory Committee (YAC), City of Menlo Park
org: City of Menlo Park, Library and Community Services Department
what_you_do: Teens advise the Parks and Recreation Commission and city staff on youth needs, activities and programs, and help plan youth services. Members serve a one-year term.
grades: Entering grades 9-12 for the upcoming academic year
deadline_text: Closed for 2026-27. The page says applications are accepted May through July for the committee year that starts in September. The next window is not announced.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Merced County Composite Squadron 147
org: Civil Air Patrol, Merced County Composite Squadron 147
what_you_do: Join the local Civil Air Patrol squadron's cadet program. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can ask to join any time.

name: College and Career Access Pathways (CCAP) at Merced College
what_you_do: You take Merced College classes offered through your high school and earn college credit. The program is aimed at students who may not already be college bound.
deadline_text: You apply for each semester you plan to attend. No dates were listed on the page.

name: K-12 Concurrent Enrollment (Merced College)
what_you_do: Take real Merced College classes while you are still in high school, tuition free (limitations may apply). Talk to your high school counselor about which courses fit your schedule.
grades: K-12 students (high school students check with a counselor)
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the page. Registration timing is on the College's When is Registration page.

name: EMPOWER Program (Merced County Office of Education)
what_you_do: This program helps young people who are out of school. It offers tutoring toward a GED or a diploma. You may get paid or unpaid work experience. You learn job skills and leadership. You get a mentor. It also helps you get into college or career training.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page; it has an online interest and application form.

name: High School Regional Occupational Program (ROP)
what_you_do: Take career classes in several industry sectors at your high school as part of the Merced County ROP. The page links to a program brochure and a Career Industry Day page.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: Volunteer at Mercy Medical Center Merced
org: Dignity Health (CommonSpirit), Mercy Medical Center Merced
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors. You might greet and guide visitors, do office tasks, help move patients, keep patients company, or work in gift shops. Duties differ by place.
deadline_text: The page does not say whether applications are open now. Ask Volunteer Services.

name: Dual Enrollment and Merced College Classes (Merced Union High School District)
org: Merced Union High School District and Merced College
what_you_do: You can earn college credit in high school in three ways. Take online CCAP classes made for high schoolers. Take Merced College classes outside the school day. Or take college courses built into select high school classes.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the district page; check with your school's Pathway Counselor.

name: SkillRISE-CH High School Internship
org: UC Merced (PACE) with Merced County Department of Public Health and Central California Alliance for Health
what_you_do: Finish a project management certificate course in spring, then work in teams on 60 hours of employer-led projects in summer.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 round closed Thursday Dec 18, 2025 at 10:59 PM. Next round dates not posted; it may reopen in the fall.

name: MercyOne Des Moines Teen Volunteers (Ages 16 to 17)
what_you_do: Volunteer at MercyOne in a role that fits your skills. The program page does not list the teen roles.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: Teen Volunteers (Meridian Library District)
what_you_do: Help the library with holds, events and the summer reading program. Teens fill out a volunteer form on the library's volunteer system.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The library lists volunteer opportunities all year on its volunteer system.

name: Aquatics Junior Lifeguard
what_you_do: Volunteer at Mesa pools in summer. You build the skills and attitude to become a lifeguard later.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page gives only the season.

name: Teen Volunteer Application at Banner Desert Medical Center
org: Banner Desert Medical Center and Banner Children's at Desert
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital area. You might work at the info desk, family lobby, gift shop, food service or nursing units.
deadline_text: Summer Student Application is accepted only January to March. No other deadline stated.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Banner Heart Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer about 4 hours a week at a heart hospital. Volunteers help in different parts of the hospital.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: East Valley Fire Cadet Program
what_you_do: Learn basic firefighting skills, CPR and first aid. Practice climbing ladders and working hose lines. Build teamwork and leadership skills.
deadline_text: Sign-up is once a year in August. The 2026-2027 sign-up is closed. The page says to check back on August 1, 2027.

name: Teen Leadership Training (TLT)
org: City of Mesa Parks, Recreation and Community Facilities
what_you_do: Be a junior staff volunteer at Mesa summer camps: help with group games, crafts and swimming trips. Builds job skills.
deadline_text: Starts when Mesa summer camp registration opens. 2027 dates not posted in the FAQ.

name: Mesa Police Cadet Post 2055
what_you_do: Go to weekly meetings with hands-on police training. Learn about traffic stops and how police investigate. Do community service.
deadline_text: The post recruits twice a year. The program page says the next recruitment window is October 2025.

name: Teen Library Volunteer
org: Montgomery-Floyd Regional Library (Blacksburg and Christiansburg branches)
what_you_do: You help with library programs. You plan youth programs. You decorate the teen area and tidy shelves. You do community service projects. Shifts are 1 to 2 hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: American Legion Auxiliary Michigan Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Michigan
what_you_do: Spend a week running a mock state government and court system with students from across Michigan. You learn how state government works. You also practice leadership.
deadline_text: The 86th session is June 13 to 19, 2027 at Michigan State University. The 2027 application is posted online. No closing date is stated on the flyer or page.

name: American Legion Michigan Boys State
city: Hillsdale, MI (2026 session at Hillsdale College); office in Lansing
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model Michigan state government. Citizens are split into two parties, hold city, county and state elections, and learn how state government works. It is for rising seniors.
deadline_text: 2026 session: June 21 to 27, 2026 at Hillsdale College; application deadline was June 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the program pages.

name: Pre-Employment Transition Services for blind and low vision students (BSBP)
org: Bureau of Services for Blind Persons, Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
what_you_do: Students who are blind or have low vision get help planning the move from high school to college or work. BSBP runs programs for students in cities around Michigan throughout the year.
deadline_text: No deadline. Check the program calendar on the page for current programs.

name: Volunteer at Cranbrook Institute of Science
what_you_do: Share science with museum guests as a Nature Zone volunteer, Gallery Guide, or special events helper. Training is provided on the job.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A volunteer open house is offered.

name: Teen Volunteer at Dearborn Public Library
what_you_do: Teens help at the Dearborn Public Library. It takes teen applications now.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The program page says the library is only taking teen volunteer applications at this time.

name: Michigan DECA chapters and state conference
org: Michigan DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter and learn business skills in marketing, management, finance, hospitality or entrepreneurship. Chapters compete at the Michigan state conference.
deadline_text: The Michigan DECA conference is March 11 to 13, 2027 at Huntington Place in Detroit. No membership deadline is posted.

name: Detroit at Work Year-Round Youth Program
what_you_do: Get free help finishing school, training for a job, and finding paid work experience, internships, job shadowing, and pre-apprenticeships, with a career coach.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Call 313-962-9675 to ask.

name: Grow Detroit's Young Talent (GDYT)
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job or internship with a Detroit employer partner.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 13 to May 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: RYSE MED (Readying Youth Scientists for Excellence in Medicine)
what_you_do: For 6 weeks, shadow health care workers, do hands-on and virtual reality practice, and give a group talk on a health topic. Then join monthly meetings from September to May.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 group are closed. Details for the 2027-28 group come 'in the new year.'

name: Department of Surgery High School Mentorship Program
what_you_do: Learn about health careers through school visits and Saturday hands-on sessions (suturing, surgery practice, tours). Some students get a paid 7-week summer internship with a one-on-one mentor.
deadline_text: 2026 internship application closed April 30, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Medical Mentors Pathway Program (M2P2)
org: Wayne State University School of Medicine, Karmanos Cancer Institute and MI-AHEC
what_you_do: Shadow doctors and other health care workers in three 2-week hospital rotations, go to weekly classes, and earn a CPR and AED certificate.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. Applicants were told by April 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Volunteer at the Michigan Science Center
what_you_do: Help at the science center with projects and guest needs. Training is given for each role, and you can learn about shows and changing exhibits.
deadline_text: The page does not state a deadline or whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Use the online volunteer application.

grades: High school sophomores, juniors and seniors
name: Beginners' Investment Camp 101
org: University of Detroit Mercy, College of Business Administration (Charlton Center)
what_you_do: Learn basic investing from industry experts. Topics include saving versus investing, stocks, bonds and careers in finance. The camp has a trip to a financial center.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp has passed. Dates for 2027 are not posted.

name: Youth Health Exploration Camp
org: University of Detroit Mercy, College of Health Professions
what_you_do: Try health care skills hands on. You learn hands-only CPR, check vital signs and use a hospital simulator. You also tour campus and meet health workers.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp is full. Dates for 2027 are not posted.

name: Biomedical Career Advancement Program (BCAP)
org: Wayne State University School of Medicine and MI-AHEC Southeast Regional Center
what_you_do: Work with research mentors in a lab for 6 weeks, build your own research project, and present it at a symposium. Fridays have lab safety, CPR, and career panels.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications ran Feb 23 to Apr 24, 2026 (5 p.m.). Program ran July 6 to Aug 14, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Summer Academy high school camps
org: Wayne State University, Anderson College of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend a week on campus on real projects in coding, design, construction and game development. Special camps cover construction management, smart agriculture and aviation careers.
deadline_text: The page says all summer 2026 sessions are complete. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Zoo Corps (teen volunteers)
what_you_do: Talk with zoo visitors about conservation, lead science activities, and join workshops, field trips and behind-the-scenes visits.
deadline_text: Page says applications are now closed. No new dates posted. Past cycle closed in late spring.

name: Michigan FFA membership through a school ag class
what_you_do: Join a Michigan FFA chapter through a school agriculture class. FFA builds leadership and career skills. These are in agriculture, food and natural resources.
deadline_text: No membership deadline is posted.

name: FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) in Michigan
what_you_do: Join a team of high school students that builds a robot with mentors from industry. The team competes at district events and the state championship.
deadline_text: No 2027 dates are posted on the FRC page. It only shows 2026 events.

name: Forgotten Harvest Volunteer
what_you_do: Pack emergency food boxes and sort fresh food at the distribution center. The food goes to people in Wayne, Oakland and Macomb counties.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Volunteers sign up online ahead of time for a shift.

name: Summer Youth Program (volunteer)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital for one 4-hour shift a week for 8 weeks in the summer. You get a certificate and a letter that confirms your hours.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. No 2027 dates posted.

name: Summer Teen Volunteering at Henry Ford Providence Novi
what_you_do: Teens give 4 hours a week at the hospital. You work the same day, time and department each week.
deadline_text: Apply from March 1 to March 15, 2027 for summer 2027.

name: Summer Teen Volunteering at Henry Ford Providence Southfield
what_you_do: Teens volunteer for one 4-hour shift a week at the hospital. The day, time and department stay the same each week.
deadline_text: Apply from March 1 to March 15, 2027 for summer 2027.

name: Summer High School Volunteering at Henry Ford West Bloomfield
what_you_do: Teens help at the hospital in a weekly 4-hour shift. You keep the same day, time and department all summer.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was March 1 to March 15, 2026, and it is closed. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted on the program page.

grades: Middle school, high school and college students
name: Michigan HOSA (Future Health Professionals)
what_you_do: Join a school chapter, compete in health skills events at one of nine regional conferences, and the top finishers go on to the state conference in April and then the international conference.
deadline_text: 2027 state conference is in April at the Grand Traverse Resort. International conference: June 22 to 25, 2027, Philadelphia. Regional dates are on the 26-27 calendar page.

name: Metroparks Volunteer Workdays
city: Southeast Michigan (parks include Hudson Mills, Dexter-Huron, Stony Creek, Willow)
what_you_do: Spend a morning on hands-on clean-ups with the park natural resources team. Most of the work is removing invasive plants and helping native species. Tools, equipment and protective gear are provided.
deadline_text: Workdays run through the year. Sign up by noon the day before each one. The workdays listed on the page were July 11, Aug 22 and Sept 26 (the page does not show the year).

name: Jump-Start Jackson
what_you_do: Get paid on-the-job training with a local employer, a mentor, and lessons on soft skills like attendance, communication and managing money.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the program page.

grades: Junior or senior in high school, or age 24 or younger
name: YouthWorks (Livingston County summer jobs)
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job at a local worksite in a field you pick, with one day a week of classroom training on workplace and career skills.
deadline_text: 2026 program ran June 15 to Aug 14, 2026. Application dates for 2027 not posted.

name: Pre-Employment Transition Services for students with disabilities (Michigan Rehabilitation Services)
org: Michigan Rehabilitation Services, Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
what_you_do: Get help with job exploration, work-based learning, planning for college or training, workplace readiness, and speaking up for yourself. Staff work with your school and IEP team.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply any time.

name: Michigan Tech Summer Youth Programs
org: Michigan Technological University, Summer Youth Programs
what_you_do: Take a week-long exploration course at Michigan Tech. Topics run from STEM and engineering to business, the arts and the humanities. You can live on campus or commute.
grades: Middle and high school (exact grades not stated)
deadline_text: 2027 registration and program dates are not posted yet on the program pages. Balances are due in full by May 1 and most scholarships are reviewed on a rolling basis.

name: Oakland NEXT paid internships and career exploration
city: Oakland County, MI (Pontiac and other service centers)
what_you_do: Explore careers, join training, and take part in paid internships with local employers. Each work experience includes learning about career paths and job skills.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the Oakland NEXT application and staff will contact you.

name: Oakland County Parks Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in the Oakland County parks. You pick the park site and the kinds of work you like when you apply.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The county takes applications only for current openings posted on Idealist.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Michigan Wing
what_you_do: Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets lead small teams and study aerospace. They sometimes fly in CAP aircraft. They go to a week-long summer encampment.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

name: WIOA Youth Program through your local Michigan Works! agency
org: Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity, delivered by local Michigan Works! agencies (Michigan Works! Southeast for Washtenaw County, Capital Area Michigan Works! for the Lansing area)
what_you_do: This is free job-readiness help for young people who face barriers. It includes tutoring and mentoring. You can get paid and unpaid work experience. That includes summer jobs. You get skills training and help planning for college or a career.
deadline_text: Operated year round by local Michigan Works! agencies. No state deadline is posted.

name: YMCA Michigan Youth in Government
what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. You take part in a student-run model government. There are fall district conferences. There is a big Lansing conference in February or April.
deadline_text: Fall district conferences run Oct 2 to Nov 9, 2026. Sign-up closes about two weeks before each one. District 6 (Detroit, Nov 9) closes Oct 26, 2026. Sign-up for the other fall districts has ended. Lansing sign-up opens Nov 10, 2026. February Lansing conference (Feb 18 to 21, 2027): regular sign-up closes Dec 27, 2026, late sign-up Dec 28 to Jan 13 with a $25 fee. April Lansing conference (Apr 22 to 25, 2027): regular sign-up closes Feb 28, 2027, late sign-up Mar 1 to 17 with a $25 fee.

name: Michigan Youth Challenge Academy (MYCA)
org: Michigan National Guard, Michigan Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
what_you_do: A free program with a 5 and a half month stay on site and 12 months of follow up. You work on your diploma, leadership, job skills, fitness, life skills and community service.
deadline_text: Two cycles a year. The January start application opens Aug 1. The July start application opens Feb 1. The application takes place over the 4 to 5 months before each cycle. No closing date is posted.

name: Opportunity Youth Program, Middlesex College
what_you_do: This program provides education and job training for out-of-school youth. It offers high school equivalency prep. It also offers paid training in in-demand jobs. You do career exploration, work readiness and work experience.
deadline_text: No dates listed.

name: Milpitas Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise the Milpitas City Council. They advise on matters that affect youth and teens. The commission meets monthly at the Milpitas Teen Center.
deadline_text: The city says commission applications are accepted year-round, and appointments are made as needed. No closing date is stated.

name: Teens at Mingei
what_you_do: Join a cohort of teens. It has 15 Wednesday evening sessions from October to May. You earn a $750 stipend for full participation.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications ran March 2 to April 1, 2026, with interviews April 20 to 24 and notices in August. Next cycle not posted; expect a similar spring window.

name: Step Up (Foundations level)
org: City of Minneapolis, Community Planning and Economic Development
what_you_do: You get a paid summer internship. Employers include parks, community groups, public agencies and nonprofits. The internship builds your first work experience. You get mentoring. You must finish a required orientation first.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was Jan 5 to Mar 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted; the city says applications open each January and offers a sign-up for 2027 updates.

name: Minnesota 4-H
org: University of Minnesota Extension, Minnesota 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club or county program. You learn by doing and grow as a young person outside of school.
grades: Kindergarten through one year past high school (grade 13)
deadline_text: No fixed deadline on the Join page. Membership lasts Oct. 1 to Sept. 30 and you re-enroll each year.

name: Minnesota American Legion Boys State
what_you_do: Spend a week at Saint John's University running a pretend government. You elect city, county and state officials. You go to classes and mock trials. You hear political speakers.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted. Each sponsor sets its own. Ask your school counselor or a local American Legion Post.

name: Minnesota DECA (high school)
org: Minnesota DECA, chartered association of DECA Inc.
what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter to learn business and marketing. You take part in DECA programs and contests, such as role plays. Minnesota DECA holds a yearly state conference.
deadline_text: Membership deadlines are set by the state advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 28 to Mar 2, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Minneapolis.

name: Minnesota FFA
what_you_do: Join an agriculture class and your school's FFA chapter. You build leadership and career skills. Members can go to leadership conferences, a winter leadership summit and the State FFA Convention.
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.

name: Minnesota House High School Page Program
org: Minnesota House of Representatives, Sergeant at Arms Office
what_you_do: Spend one week at the State Capitol. You page on the House floor, sit in a mock committee meeting, and meet legislators, judges, lobbyists and reporters.
deadline_text: Complete applications are due by end of business on Nov 10, 2026 for the 2027 session. Selected students are told by email by mid-December.

name: Minnesota State Fair Employment
what_you_do: Teens work the 12-day State Fair for fair departments or vendors. Summer jobs and fall clean-up jobs are also posted.
deadline_text: The Employment Center runs June to August for fair applicants. The page says to check back in June 2027 for registration updates.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, Minnesota Wing
city: Statewide, MN (squadrons in Duluth, St. Paul, Alexandria and more)
what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aviation, fitness and character. You wear an Air Force style uniform and earn promotions. You plan activities. You have no duty to join the military.
deadline_text: Join any time. Visit a squadron meeting first.

name: Minnesota Youth Council
what_you_do: Be one of the young people who advise the Governor and state lawmakers on issues that affect youth. You research issues, meet your legislators and hold a town hall in your district.
deadline_text: The 2026 round (for the 2026 to 2028 term) took applications from January to March 2026: Feb 28 for priority consideration, Mar 31 for all applications. No 2027 dates are posted. Seats also open when members graduate or step down.

name: Minnesota Youth Institute (MNYI)
org: University of Minnesota College of Food, Agricultural and Natural Resource Sciences
what_you_do: Students write a research paper on a global food security problem and present their ideas at a one day event on the St. Paul campus. Top presenters may go to the Global Youth Institute in Iowa.
deadline_text: 2026: register by March 27, paper due April 3, event May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: ZooTeen volunteers
what_you_do: Help run Zoo Camps: keep track of campers, help with crafts and activities, and be a role model for younger kids.
deadline_text: Applications for the Summer 2026 ZooTeen camp season are closed. The page says to check the website in 2027 for next summer.

name: Mission College High School Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: High schoolers take Mission College classes. Enrollment fees are waived and you pay only for books and materials.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed on the page. Follow the term dates.

name: Mission Hospital High School Auxiliary (Providence)
city: Mission Viejo and Laguna Beach, CA
what_you_do: Volunteer for 4 hours a week in a hospital department. You help patients, visitors and staff but do not give direct patient care. You stay in the program until you graduate.
deadline_text: Applications open September 1 and are due by the 3rd Monday of October. Applications received before or after that date are not accepted. The form is for the 2027 group.

name: Teen Art Project (TAP)
what_you_do: Work with visiting artists to make art. In the Fall 2026 project, teens help make a large textile artwork with artist Amanda Browder for four weeks. Then they work with a new artist and art style each week for four more weeks.
deadline_text: The page says applications for Summer TAP 2027 will open in spring 2027. No deadline is posted.

name: Volunteer with the Montana Natural History Center
what_you_do: Help staff naturalists with kids' games, school field trips and summer camps. Or garden at Fort Missoula. Or greet visitors at the front desk.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Lifeguard and Summer Jobs at Splash Montana and Currents
org: City of Missoula Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard course. Then work at Splash Montana or the Currents Aquatics Center. Other summer jobs there do not need you to be certified.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says summer jobs will be posted soon on the City of Missoula jobs portal.

name: Teen Library Community (TLC)
what_you_do: Help decide what the library offers to teens. Look at the books and suggest buys. Plan teen events. Volunteer at library events. You speak for teens to the Library Board.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: MOCA Teen Program (paid)

deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 21 to 26, 2026. The application closed March 31, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
