name: Job Corps in North Carolina (Schenck, Kittrell, Oconaluftee)
org: U.S. Department of Labor, Job Corps
city: Pisgah Forest, Kittrell and Cherokee, NC
what_you_do: Live on a free career training campus. You train for a trade. You also finish a high school diploma or equivalent. Schenck and Oconaluftee are Forest Service conservation centers. They have wildland firefighting and forestry training.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start at any time. The process usually takes about two months.

name: Lady Cardinal Mentorship Program
org: NC Department of Administration, Division for Women and Youth
what_you_do: Work for four weeks in a North Carolina state agency in the Raleigh area. You work next to women leaders in science, technology, engineering or math careers. You finish a group project.
grades: Grades 9 to 12 (girls; rising 9th graders cannot apply)
deadline_text: 2027 plan: applications open early Jan 2027 and close in Feb 2027 (the FAQ says the firm deadline is the end of February). Phone interviews in March, notices in April, program in July 2027.

name: Cafe Coordinators
org: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
what_you_do: Plan and host the museum's monthly Teen Science Cafes. You pick topics, work with guest scientists, run social media and help lead each cafe.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications are closed. They reopen in January 2027 and are due Monday, April 19, 2027 at 5pm. Group interviews May 4-6, 2027.

name: Climate Resilience Institute
org: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
what_you_do: One week of hands-on STEM about extreme heat, flooding and air quality. You meet people who work in climate jobs and can lead a small service project at school or in your town.
deadline_text: Applications reopen in January 2027 and are due Friday, April 9, 2027 at 5pm. Program is June 14-18, 2027.

name: Junior Curators
org: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
what_you_do: Teens support the museum's conservation work. They help with programs and events. They also do field experiences and service projects. They care for the live animal collection. The work runs September to April.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application period has closed. Applications reopen in January 2027 and are due in March 2027 for 2027-28 (exact day not posted).

name: Junior Interpreters
org: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
what_you_do: Teens work on the museum floor for 10 summer weeks. They talk with visitors. They use natural history specimens to teach. They build speaking and customer service skills.
deadline_text: Applications open mid-January 2027 and are due 5 pm Monday, March 22, 2027. Group interviews April 13-15, 2027, 3:30 to 5:00 pm; top applicants are invited.

name: Teen Science Cafes
org: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
what_you_do: Free monthly evening event where a working scientist gives a talk, you do a hands-on activity, ask questions and meet other teens who like science. Also streamed on YouTube.
deadline_text: Next cafes: Nov 6 and Dec 4, 2026, and Jan 8, 2027 (6pm to 7pm). More are held on first Fridays during the school year.

name: North Carolina Senate Page Program
what_you_do: Spend one week working in the state Senate in Raleigh. Pages work on the Senate floor and in committee meetings, deliver messages and papers, and help with office tasks.
deadline_text: The 2026 program is full. Available weeks for the 2027 session will be posted early next year. When it opens, applications are taken on a rolling basis until weeks are full.

name: SkillsUSA North Carolina
what_you_do: Join a SkillsUSA chapter in your career and technical education class. Build job skills and take on leadership roles. Compete in state and national skills contests.
deadline_text: To compete at the national level, a student must be joined in membership on the SkillsUSA national site by March 1 each year.

grades: Second or third year of high school (rising juniors and seniors)
name: Summer Ventures in Science and Mathematics
org: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM), state funded
city: Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC Charlotte and UNC Wilmington campuses, NC
what_you_do: Live on a UNC system campus for about four weeks. You do a hands-on STEM research project with faculty. You often work in a small team. Recent topics include ecology, biochemistry, DNA analysis and cybersecurity.
deadline_text: Open now on cfnc.org. Apply by Jan 5, 2027. Transcripts and teacher and counselor forms are due Feb 28, 2027. Decisions come Apr 2, 2027.

name: Kathleen Price and Joseph M. Bryan Youth Concerto Competition
what_you_do: Play a concerto for a few North Carolina Symphony musicians. There is a first round and a final round. The page lists first, second and honorable mention prizes in each group.
deadline_text: Information about the 2027 competition will be posted in Fall 2026.

name: Tar Heel Boys State
org: The American Legion, Department of North Carolina
what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend state government. Delegates run for office, pass bills, hold court sessions and learn how city, county and state government work.
deadline_text: Application opens Nov 1, 2026. No closing date is posted yet.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, North Carolina Wing
org: Civil Air Patrol, North Carolina Wing
city: Statewide, North Carolina (squadrons in many towns)
what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. Teens meet weekly with a local squadron and can go to summer encampments and other wing events.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can join any time through a local squadron.

name: North Carolina Youth Apprenticeship
city: Statewide, North Carolina (employers and community college partners)
what_you_do: Work a paid job with a mentor at an employer while taking related classes at a community college or training center. You can start as early as 16 while in high school.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Each employer or program sets its own hiring.

name: Youth Legislative Assembly
what_you_do: Take part in a mock legislative session with other high school students. You debate and vote on issues about local, state and national government.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 conference was March 13 to 15, 2026. Dates for the next conference are not posted yet.

grades: Rising 6th graders through recent high school graduates (Junior Wildlife Assistant: grades 10 and 11 when you apply)
name: North Carolina Zoo Teen Volunteer Program
org: North Carolina Zoo and Botanical Gardens
what_you_do: Volunteer at the zoo each summer. High school teens can be Junior Wildlife Assistants at the Wildlife Rehabilitation Center. Jobs are diets, cleaning, feeding and vet observation. Teens can also join Camp Crew. Middle schoolers have other roles.
deadline_text: Recruitment for this season has ended. The FAQ says summer-only applications opened April 9 in 2026, and the Junior Wildlife Assistant page listed an April 22 deadline (no year printed). Check the site again in spring 2027.

name: Teen Arts Council
what_you_do: Plan teen takeovers at the museum and advise on teen art shows. You go to artist workshops and learn about jobs in museums.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 council are closed. No date posted for 2027-28.

name: INSPIRE (STEM research for NC students)
org: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM)
what_you_do: A one-week program where you stay on campus. You are matched with a mentor for a STEM project or research. You build leadership skills. On the last day, you share your results with families.
deadline_text: 2026 portal opened Jan 6 and closed March 5, 2026. Summer 2027 applications open January 6, 2027. No 2027 close date posted yet.

grades: Current 8th graders apply; attend as rising 9th graders, then return as rising 10th graders
name: Step Up to STEM
org: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM)
what_you_do: A free week-long summer program at NCSSM-Durham. It is a hands-on STEM program that mixes subjects. There are also online workshops during the school year.
deadline_text: Summer 2027: portal opens Dec 1, 2026 and closes Feb 3, 2027. Decisions March 11, 2027. Durham sessions June 13-18 and July 18-23, 2027.

name: Summer Accelerator
org: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM)
what_you_do: Pick a STEM course taught by scientists, professors and engineers. Offered online or as sleep-away programs on the NCSSM campus in Durham or Morganton.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 details are not posted yet. The page says the application will open December 6 and stay open until all spots are filled. The page does not state the year; 2026 is inferred from the next cycle. Admissions decisions are made monthly.

name: Biomass to Brilliance: Engineering a Greener Future
org: NC State Paper Science and Engineering
what_you_do: A week-long camp. You make green energy, biofuels, bioplastics and gels from plants. You also learn how paper is recycled.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 21-26, 2026 with a March 2026 deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Catalyst: STEM program for students with disabilities
what_you_do: A free weeklong summer institute, plus Saturday sessions in the school year. You do hands-on STEM and field trips. You can also get paid STEM internships in research labs and optional certifications.
deadline_text: Required open house for the 2027-28 school year: virtual Thursday Jan 14, 2027 at 7 PM, or in person Saturday Jan 16, 2027 at 10 AM at NC State. Open house registration links will be posted on the page starting November 2026. Application dates are not posted.

name: 36 Hours to Save the World (Global Challenge Weekend)
what_you_do: Online weekend contest for teams of high school students. You research a global problem, pitch ideas, build a prototype and present to judges.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 challenge is Oct 23-25, 2026. Register by Oct 12, 2026.

name: Horticultural Science Summer Institute
what_you_do: A week on campus doing hands-on plant work. You breed vegetables, grow new shrubs from cuttings and work with cut flowers. You visit farms, greenhouses and gardens. You also learn about college choices and leadership.
deadline_text: 2026 session was July 5-10, 2026. Deadline was April 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Institute for Future Agricultural Leaders (IFAL)
org: NC Farm Bureau (with NC State and other university hosts)
what_you_do: A week-long program for students who like farm and food jobs. You visit agriculture schools and research farms. You join leadership classes and visit farm businesses. You also tour the General Assembly and live in campus dorms.
deadline_text: 2026 program was June 14-19, 2026 and the 2026 application is closed. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Livestock Science Camp
org: NC State College of Agriculture and Life Sciences, Animal Science
what_you_do: A week of hands-on work with cattle, sheep, goats, horses and pigs. You also do lab tests on food, genes and biotech, and learn about jobs with animals.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 14-19, 2026 with a March 2026 deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: NC-MSEN Pre-College Program (NC State)
org: NC State, NC Mathematics and Science Education Network
what_you_do: STEM classes for students in grades 6 to 12. There are fall and summer programs to get ready for a STEM major in college.
deadline_text: Late September for fall programs, late April or early May for summer programs (from the 2026 listing).

name: North Carolina Youth Institute
org: NC State Cooperative Extension with World Food Prize Foundation
what_you_do: Research a global issue and write a 3 to 4 page paper with a teacher or mentor. Then present at a one-day conference at NC State. Top students may represent North Carolina at the Global Youth Institute in Des Moines, Iowa.
deadline_text: 2026 conference was April 16-17, 2026 with an early March 2026 registration deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Online Research Academy
org: NC State Global Training Initiative with UNC Wilmington
what_you_do: A four-week online research program. You meet with a faculty mentor twice a week, learn how research works and do a project. You get a certificate and a letter of evaluation.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 29 to July 31, 2026. Applications opened March 1 and closed June 10, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Poultry Science Summer Immersion
org: NC State Prestage Department of Poultry Science
what_you_do: A week-long workshop where you stay overnight. You learn by doing about poultry science, animal medicine and jobs in the field. You also get info about scholarships.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 14-18, 2026. Deadline was April 3, 2026 at 5 p.m. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Resource Conservation Workshop
what_you_do: A week of field study, tours and hands-on sessions about saving natural resources. You also hear talks about college and jobs.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop was June 14-19, 2026. Applications were due in late March 2026 (deadlines vary by district). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: NC State Rising 11th-12th Grade Residential Engineering Camps
org: NC State College of Engineering, The Engineering Place
what_you_do: You live on the NC State campus in Raleigh for a week. You work in one engineering workshop. Hours are 9 am to 4 pm, Monday to Thursday. There are evening activities. A Friday showcase is for families.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: portal open January 12 to February 27, 2026; decisions March 27, 2026. The page says to watch for 2027 camp information.

name: Biome Robotics (FIRST Tech Challenge teams)
org: The Science House, NC State University
what_you_do: Join a FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team that designs, builds and programs robots. Teams meet at The Science House on Mondays and Thursdays from 6 to 9 pm, and go to scrimmages and tournaments.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Contact Kent Lupino for current team openings.

name: Red Hat Shelton Challenge
what_you_do: A six-day program where you stay on campus. It has ropes courses, service projects and group activities. They teach you about fair choices, talking with others and setting goals.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are coming soon on the program site. The page does not list a 2027 deadline. Alumni can attend a one-day re-Challenge on Saturday, Nov 21, 2026.

name: TexTEC: Exploring Textile Technology, Engineering and Chemistry
org: NC State Wilson College of Textiles
what_you_do: A two-day camp. You do hands-on projects in the textile college's labs. They cover tech, engineering and chemistry.
deadline_text: 2026 camps were June to July 2026. Deadline was early June 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Summer Textile Exploration Program (STEP)
org: NC State Wilson College of Textiles
what_you_do: Four one-week sessions where you stay on campus. You explore textiles, fashion, engineering, polymer science and marketing in college labs and studios. You also go on industry tours.
deadline_text: 2026 weeks: June 7-12, June 14-19, June 21-26, July 5-10. Application deadline was April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

grades: Rising 10th to 12th, or rising college freshman
name: VetCAMP
org: NC State Veterinary Professions Advising Center
what_you_do: A five-day camp about vet jobs. You tour the vet college and learn the basics of a small animal clinic. You work with horses, sheep and pigs. You also try stitching and dissection labs.
deadline_text: 2027 application opens Friday, Jan 29, 2027 at 9am Eastern. The page says it closes March 26, 2027 at 5pm Eastern. The page calls that day a Monday, but March 26, 2027 is a Friday, so check the closing date on the page before you apply. Decisions April 21, 2027.

name: Young and Teen Writers Workshop
what_you_do: Two-week summer workshops in the afternoon. You pick two creative writing classes: fiction, genre fiction, poetry, plays, or intro to creative writing. Your work can appear in a printed book.
deadline_text: 2026 workshops ran July 6-31, 2026. Deadline was June 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Young Nebraska Scientists: High School Researchers
what_you_do: Paid summer jobs in the labs of Nebraska scientists, such as quantum materials, nanoscience and chemistry. You learn skills like coding and share your work on a research poster at the end.
grades: 10th or 11th grade in the year you apply
deadline_text: The page says applications are taken in early spring and winners are told usually in April. Exact 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: Nevada 4-H Capital Days
org: University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada 4-H
what_you_do: Visit Nevada's capital city to learn how a bill becomes a law. Follow bills and sit in on committee hearings. Tour the Legislative Building. Meet your state lawmakers.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline posted on the page.

name: Nevada 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club and pick projects to explore. Take part in county activities, camps, workshops and the county fair.
deadline_text: Join any time, but join by your county's 4-H enrollment deadline to take part in Fair.

name: WNC Dual Credit for High School Students
what_you_do: Take a Western Nevada College class and earn college credit and high school credit at the same time. Your high school decides which WNC classes count.
deadline_text: The program page points to WNC's dates and deadlines page. No deadline is stated on it.

name: Nevada Youth Legislature
org: Research Division, Nevada Legislative Counsel Bureau
what_you_do: Serve two years as a Youth Legislator for your Senate district. You go to trainings, hold a town hall, testify, and help write a bill for the Nevada Legislature.
deadline_text: The program page does not post a current deadline. The brochure says to check the program website for deadline details.

name: Counselor-in-Training (CIT), East Brunswick Day Camp
what_you_do: Help counselors run a group of Kool Kids campers who are going into grades 1 and 2. You take mini trainings. You also write and lead at least one activity for your group.
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran June 29 to Aug 7, 2026. 2027 application dates not posted.

name: Summer Jobs at Crystal Springs Waterpark, East Brunswick
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at the Crystal Springs waterpark. You can be a lifeguard (training is given). Other jobs are lazy river attendant, guest relations, maintenance or slide tower dispatch.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 were posted with age cutoffs of May 1, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

grades: Grade 8 and up (including the summer before 8th grade)
name: Teen Volunteering (Teen Action Group)
what_you_do: Sign up for monthly library volunteer shifts. Staff post the sign-up links each month, and each shift must be logged with the hour form to count.
deadline_text: New volunteers are accepted only in June and December. Next window: December (dates within the month not stated).

name: East Brunswick Youth Council
what_you_do: Join social events, meetings and service projects with other East Brunswick high schoolers. You build leadership skills too.
deadline_text: No closing date posted. Registration is on the Volunteer Matrix site.

name: Soup Kitchen Volunteering, Elijah's Promise
what_you_do: You help prepare and serve meals. You clean and greet guests. This is at the Elijah's Promise soup kitchen. Shifts are on weekday and Saturday mornings.
deadline_text: Sign up for open shifts online; if none show, they are filled.

name: Teen Volunteering (Teen Action Group and Kindness Club)
what_you_do: Earn volunteer hours. You can make teen social media posts, decorate the Young Adult Room, make bookmarks to give away, and write letters to seniors in nursing homes and to soldiers far from home.
deadline_text: The Teen Action Group form is for the September 2026 to August 2027 school year. Kindness Club needs no application, but teens must register for each meeting. Summer 2026 Reading Buddies applications are closed.

name: Teen Volunteer at New Brunswick Free Public Library
what_you_do: Help with library events as an unpaid volunteer. The library has its own form for volunteers under 18.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time.

name: Teen Advisory Board and Teen Volunteering, Metuchen Public Library
what_you_do: Join the Teen Advisory Board to plan library events and run Homework Buddies. Or volunteer in summer to learn how the library works. Jobs include shelving, displays and book reviews.
deadline_text: The summer application goes up every year on the second Wednesday of June at 12 pm. School-year volunteer spots are limited to 5.

name: Middlesex County Magnet Schools Career and Technical Programs
org: Middlesex County Magnet Schools (East Brunswick, Perth Amboy, Piscataway, Edison and Woodbridge)
what_you_do: Take career and technical programs as a full time or shared time high school student. Majors include allied health, agriscience, and architecture and design. Others are on the career majors list.
deadline_text: No closing date is posted on the admissions page. See the page for open house dates.

name: Early Career Exploration Institute, Middlesex County Magnet Schools
city: East Brunswick, Perth Amboy and Piscataway, NJ
what_you_do: Try career and technical education in a free summer program. It has classes and hands-on projects. It ends with a gallery walk.
deadline_text: The 2026 session ran July 6 to 23, 2026 and was at capacity (waiting list only). 2027 dates not posted.

name: Teen Volunteering and Teen Advisory Board, Old Bridge Public Library
what_you_do: Pick a volunteer role. You can shelve books, tutor kids in chess or math, help patrons with tech, join Library Art Club, or plan teen events on the Teen Advisory Board. Hours earn volunteer credit.
deadline_text: Organization Club requires an orientation; the page says to check back for more orientation dates. Tech Helpers and Teen Advisory Board need an application.

name: Teen Volunteering and Teen Advisory Board, Plainsboro Public Library
what_you_do: Shelve books weekly, help at library programs, or join the Teen Advisory Board to plan programs, displays and teen-run events. The board meets every Thursday.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board membership for 2026 is open now (the board page was updated September 17, 2026); no deadline is posted. Weekly shelving registration for 2026-2027 is closed. Join the volunteer mailing list for one-time program volunteer spots.

name: Teen Volunteers, Plainsboro Township Recreation and Community Services
org: Plainsboro Township Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at big township events like Founders Day, Haunted Tonight and International Celebration. You can also run kids programs, clean trails and pack food pantry bags. Or be a Shadow Buddy for children with special needs.
deadline_text: Volunteers are used as needed. No dates are posted for applying.

grades: Entering 9th or 10th grade (apply in 8th or 9th grade)
name: Rutgers 4-H STEM Ambassadors Program
what_you_do: This is a year-round, multi-year STEM program. It includes a summer week at Rutgers-New Brunswick. You take lab tours and do research projects. You go to monthly meetings. You lead STEM activities for younger kids.
deadline_text: 2026 cohort application closed. The page says check back in early 2027 for the next cohort.

name: BOLD Summer Camp (BioCONECT Oncology Leadership Development), Rutgers Cancer Institute
org: Rutgers Cancer Institute and Rutgers School of Public Health
what_you_do: Spend a week at Rutgers Cancer Institute. You learn the biology and genes of cancer and how it is found and treated. You also learn how to lower risk and what jobs exist in the field.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed (acceptances by May 15, 2026). 2027 dates not posted. Join the mailing list at BOLD@cinj.rutgers.edu.

grades: 6 to 11 (one session per grade level, June to July)
name: TARGET Summer Engineering Program, Rutgers School of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend one week on Busch campus doing hands-on engineering workshops, labs and projects. Rutgers engineering students and faculty lead them. Lunch and two snacks are given each day.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 dates are posted (July 13 to 31, 2026). 2027 dates and the application deadline are not posted.

name: Rutgers Pre-College Summer Academies
org: Rutgers University-New Brunswick, Office of Summer and Winter Sessions
what_you_do: Live on the Rutgers campus for one week. You take workshops and talks on one topic, such as space, engineering, pre law and mock trial, physical therapy or college readiness.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 application is closed. Summer 2027 dates are not posted; the page offers an email list for updates.

name: SLAAM Engineering Summer Academy, Rutgers Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
org: Rutgers School of Engineering, Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
what_you_do: Do a research project every morning. In the afternoon, work on group design projects. Rutgers engineering faculty and grad student mentors guide you. Bring a Windows laptop.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed May 1, 2026 (6 pm Eastern). Notices went out by May 18 and payment was due June 7. 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Current high school students (graduating seniors not eligible)
name: Rutgers Summer Scholars Program
org: Rutgers University-New Brunswick Pre-College Summer Programs
what_you_do: You can take up to two approved college-level courses at Rutgers-New Brunswick. You earn college credit. You take them during the summer.
deadline_text: 2026: applications opened February 2; last day to apply May 17 (Session I) and June 28 (Session II). 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Entering 10th, 11th or 12th grade in fall 2026, with at least one high school biology course
name: Toxicology, Health and Environmental Disease (THED) High School Summer Program
org: Rutgers Environmental and Occupational Health Sciences Institute (EOHSI)
what_you_do: This is a one-week summer camp in the daytime. It is on the Rutgers Busch campus. It focuses on basic lab techniques and toxicology topics.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: enrollment opened January 5, 2026; deadline was Monday, March 2, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Rutgers Upward Bound Math-Science (RUBMS)
what_you_do: Free college prep all year. You get SAT/ACT prep, tutoring, college tours and STEM workshops. A six-week Summer Institute on campus is required. It has college-level classes.
deadline_text: The page says online applications open in mid-September and close in mid-December each year. It has a heading for the Upward Bound Math-Science 2027 Application but no direct application link.

name: Rutgers Young Scholars Program in Discrete Mathematics
what_you_do: This is a four-week residential summer program on the Busch campus. It is for math-talented high school students. You solve discrete math problems.
deadline_text: 2026: reviewed first come, first served from February 2026; completed application, including solutions to the problems, by March 31 if seeking a scholarship; financial aid applications by April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Teen / High School Volunteers, Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital
org: RWJBarnabas Health, Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital
what_you_do: You greet, direct and escort visitors. You visit patients on nursing floors. You help with patient discharges. This is at the hospital's New Brunswick or Somerset campus.
deadline_text: No application deadline or dates are listed on the page.

grades: High school students who completed a high school biology course
name: Waksman Institute Summer Experience (WISE)
org: Waksman Institute of Microbiology, Rutgers University
what_you_do: This is two weeks of lab work and bioinformatics. The work is on duckweed DNA at the Waksman Institute. Students' vetted sequences are published on GenBank with their names.
deadline_text: 2026 application opened February 2, 2026 and was first come, first served (sessions expected to fill). Application forms for the Summer 2027 WISE Programs will be posted in late January 2027.

name: Student Volunteering, Woodbridge Public Library
what_you_do: Pick a library volunteer job. You can write book reviews online for hours, or help get program materials ready at the Community Service Club. You can read with kids as a Reading Buddy, or help at the summer reading club.
deadline_text: For summer reading help, sign up in April or May. Other roles run all year.

name: Youth Recreation Advisory Board, Woodbridge Township
what_you_do: Help the township review its youth programs, suggest new ones, promote events and do service at township events. The board has one formal meeting each fall. The rest of the work is by email or phone.
deadline_text: Terms start each August. The page gives no application dates.

name: New Jersey 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club, after-school program or camp and learn by doing. Topics are science, arts, healthy living, outdoors, leadership and citizenship.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs and programs run through the year.

name: American Legion Auxiliary Jersey Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of New Jersey
city: New Jersey (2026 session at Centenary University)
what_you_do: Spend a short summer session in a mock government. You learn how city, county and state government work by holding pretend offices.
grades: Junior in high school when applying
deadline_text: 2026 sponsorships were filled and no applicants were being accepted. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: American Legion Jersey Boys State
org: American Legion Department of New Jersey
what_you_do: Spend a week in a mock state government. You hear speakers, join discussions, run for office and take part in a sports program.
grades: 11th grade (junior) with at least one semester of high school left
deadline_text: For the 2026 session (began June 21, 2026) the home page said applications were open through June 7. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Junior Volunteer Program
org: Capital Health (hospitals in Trenton and Hopewell area, NJ)
what_you_do: Help patients, families and staff in a hospital, or work in a gift shop. You see behind the scenes of health care jobs. There is no shadowing of doctors or nurses.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer program applications are closed. The page lists summer 2027 program dates as July 5 to Aug 27, 2027 but no 2027 application dates. Seasonal and year-round tracks had no open positions on Oct 10, 2026.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, New Jersey Wing
org: Civil Air Patrol, New Jersey Wing
city: New Jersey (local squadrons across the state)
what_you_do: Join a local squadron for weekly meetings. Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Wear a uniform. Move up in rank as you take on more leadership.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by visiting a squadron.

name: Governor's School of New Jersey in Engineering and Technology
org: Rutgers School of Engineering / State of New Jersey
what_you_do: This is a free, four-week residential summer program for rising seniors. You take four courses. You do a small team research and design project. You visit companies. A final research symposium ends the program.
deadline_text: 2027 application not posted on the program pages. The state page (updated 11/13/25) said 2026 applications were open; decisions are emailed in early April. Ask your school counselor about the school nomination deadline.

name: Career Prep at Mercer County Community College
what_you_do: As a senior, take free college classes at Mercer County Community College for dual credit. Choices include aviation, criminal justice, culinary arts, digital film, IT, pre-engineering and more.
deadline_text: The career prep page links to an application but does not say whether it is open and gives no dates. Ask admissions@mcts.edu for the 2027-2028 dates.

grades: Apply in 10th grade; programs run grades 11 and 12
name: Shared-Time Career Programs (grades 11 and 12)
what_you_do: In junior and senior year, spend half of each school day in a hands-on shop. Choices include carpentry, electrical, welding, HVAC, auto repair, hair and nails, cooking or game design.
deadline_text: The 2027-2028 application is open now. No closing date is posted on the page. Info sessions: Oct 29, Nov 19, Dec 9 and Dec 16, 2026 and Jan 11, 2027.

grades: Not stated on the page. See the Application and Admission FAQ.
name: Career and Technical Programs 2027-28 Application
org: Somerset County Vocational and Technical High Schools
what_you_do: Study a career and tech program in high school. Choices include carpentry, plumbing, welding, cooking, computers, biomed, money, theater or health care.
deadline_text: Applications opened Sept 8, 2026. Deadline Dec 30, 2026.

name: Watershed Academy for High School Students
what_you_do: Week long summer sessions with fieldwork, mentors from the field and a final project. 2026 topics: green architecture, water and climate, field research, and green infrastructure (with a landscape certification).
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran July 6 to 31, 2026 with full payment due March 18, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Volunteer Roles for Teens
what_you_do: Plant rain gardens, work on trails, sample stream life, care for animals or greet visitors at a nature center. Different jobs have different minimum ages.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page shows the 2026 volunteer application. Next stream cleanups: April 2027.

name: New Jersey Youth Corps
org: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
city: New Jersey (local sites across the state)
what_you_do: Work in crews of 6 to 10 on community service and conservation projects. You spend about half your time on school work. It goes toward a diploma or equivalent.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The program is described as year-round.

name: New Jersey Youth Institute (World Food Prize)
org: Rutgers School of Environmental and Biological Sciences, with the World Food Prize Foundation
what_you_do: Write a paper on a global food or hunger issue, then present your research and ideas in a short speech and small groups at Rutgers. Some students are invited to a national event in Iowa.
deadline_text: 2026: registration and paper due by February 6, 2026; the Institute was March 6, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: New Mexico 4-H
what_you_do: Pick projects like livestock, robots, cooking or public speaking. Join a club in your county with adult volunteers.
deadline_text: The 4-H year runs October 1 to September 30. Enrollment usually opens in October. Deadlines vary by county.

name: New Mexico Agricultural Education and FFA Association
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's ag program. The site lists career development events, a leadership camp and FFA Day at the Roundhouse.
deadline_text: Join through your school's ag program.

name: Forest Stewards Youth Corps (Summer)
what_you_do: Work on a crew that builds trails and fences and fixes wild places. You learn about forest care, fire and water health. You earn a paycheck.
deadline_text: The page contradicts itself. Its menu says FSYC Summer Hiring (Closed), but the text says the program is hiring now. No 2027 hiring dates are posted.

name: Conservation Crew Corpsmember (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico)
org: Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico
what_you_do: Join a paid outdoor crew. You build trails, fight invasive plants, restore land and help prevent fire danger. You work with a team in Albuquerque or Taos.
deadline_text: The 2027 Corpsmember jobs list a start date of March 18, 2027. The apply page does not give a last day to apply.

name: WIOA Youth Program, Central Region
what_you_do: Help finding a job for youth in school and out of school. You also get work experience, skills training, mentors, leadership training and follow up help.
deadline_text: No deadline. The program runs year-round.

name: WIOA Youth Program, Northern Region
city: Santa Fe and northern New Mexico
what_you_do: Free job training with a paid work placement with a local employer. You also get mentors, money skills training and 12 months of follow up help.
deadline_text: No deadline. The program runs year-round.

name: New Mexico Youth Conservation Corps (YCC)
org: New Mexico Youth Conservation Corps Commission, EMNRD
what_you_do: Get a paid job on a crew doing public conservation work that helps your community, with job training and career development. Local sponsors run the crews.
deadline_text: Set by each sponsor. The state page lists funded projects by year.

name: Dual Enrollment (New River Community College)
what_you_do: Take college courses while in high school for credit on both your high school and college transcripts. Classes are taught in partnership with local high schools.
deadline_text: The page links to a dual enrollment calendars page. No dates are listed on this page.

name: New York State 4-H
org: Cornell Cooperative Extension, New York State 4-H
city: New York State (run through county Cornell Cooperative Extension offices)
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or independent membership. Do hands-on projects. Topics are science, agriculture and arts. Others are leadership and community service.
deadline_text: No single deadline. The 4-H year runs October 1 to September 30.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, New York Wing
org: Civil Air Patrol, New York Wing
city: New York (local squadrons across the state)
what_you_do: Join a local squadron for weekly meetings. Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Wear a uniform. Move up in rank as you take on more leadership.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by visiting a squadron.

name: NYS DEC Summer Camps (Colby, DeBruce, Pack Forest, Rushford)
org: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC)
city: New York State (camps in Franklin County, the Catskills, Allegany County and the southern Adirondacks)
what_you_do: Spend a week at a DEC camp. You learn outdoor skills like backpacking, canoeing and fishing. You study habitats and ecology. Some weeks offer hunter education.
deadline_text: Registration for 2026 opened Sunday March 22, 2026 at 1 PM and weeks fill quickly (waitlist available). 2027 dates are not posted.

name: American Legion Auxiliary Empire Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of New York
city: New York State (check-in at SUNY Brockport)
what_you_do: Spend a week at a girls' government program. Workshops cover how government works, you run campaigns and write bills, and each day has a flag ceremony and the Pledge of Allegiance.
deadline_text: 2027 session: Sunday June 27 to Friday July 2, 2027 (from the site's save-the-date notice). No 2027 application deadline or registration opening is posted.

name: New York State Parks Lifeguard
org: New York State Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation (OPRHP)
city: New York State (state parks, pools and beaches; Long Island has its own process)
what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at a state park pool or beach during the summer season. You pass a qualifier and complete lifeguard training. On Long Island the training is 40 hours and paid.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted on the program page. Register for a lifeguard qualifier; the page links the qualifier dates.

name: Explorers Teen Program
what_you_do: A 3 to 4 year program for high school students near Newark. It has paid museum internships and workshops on leadership and public speaking. It also has trips to other culture sites.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. Selected applicants were told by July 20, 2026 about interviews. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Backstage Pathways
what_you_do: Teens learn stage tech: shop safety, set design, set building, lights and sound. They learn from pro teaching artists. They also join classes with the stagehand union (IATSE).
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page lists the fall and spring semester dates.

name: Newport Beach Fire Cadet Program
what_you_do: Take part in a weekly program that teaches what it takes to be a Newport Beach firefighter. You do hands-on training and can ride along on real fire and medical calls.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the program page. Email the fire department to ask for an application.

name: Newport Beach Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: You can help in the Children's Department. Tasks include the Summer Reading Program and craft materials. You can write book reviews from home. You can join the Young Adult Advisory Council.
deadline_text: No deadline. Applications are first-come, first-served and accepted as needed.

name: Newport Beach Ocean Lifeguard Trainee
org: City of Newport Beach Fire Department, Lifeguard Operations
what_you_do: Train at the Basic Lifeguard Academy. You learn rescues, CPR and emergency medical response. You also learn to spot rip currents.
deadline_text: Applications close January 20, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. The tryout is planned for Saturday, January 30, 2027, with check-in at 8:30 a.m. An info night is Wednesday, January 6, 2027, 6:00 to 7:30 p.m.

name: Newport Beach Teen Leader Program
org: City of Newport Beach Recreation and Senior Services
what_you_do: You volunteer next to city Recreation staff. Work at summer day camps, Pint-Sized Camp, the Marina Park Sailing & Boating Center and city events. You build leadership and work skills.
deadline_text: The page says 2026 applications closed Thursday, May 1, 2026 (that date is a Friday, so confirm on the page). Applications are now closed. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: Youth Career Program
org: City of Newport News, Office of Workforce Development and Economic Mobility
what_you_do: Youth learn about careers. They do hands-on summer work at job sites in the city. It is about 25 hours a week from June to August.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 enrollment is closed. Student applications reopen on February 1, 2027.

name: Oregon Coast Aquarium Youth Volunteer (Exhibit Interpreter)
what_you_do: Teens work as Exhibit Interpreters. They talk with guests about sea animals and the ocean. Summer volunteers also get trips like behind the scenes tours and career ideas.
deadline_text: The page lists school-year info sessions on Thursday October 15 at 6:00pm (virtual) and Saturday October 17, 10:30 am to 11:30 am (in person), and school-year training on November 7, 14 and 21. The page gives no year for these. Summer training is in June 2027. Email volunteer@aquarium.org to be added to the interest list.

name: World Series of Innovation (Impact League)
what_you_do: Come up with an idea that solves a real problem and enter it in a free online innovation challenge. You can enter alone or with a team. Cash prizes go to winning teams.
deadline_text: Entries are due Dec 13, 2026. The 2026-2027 challenge launched Sept 9, 2026.

name: Marine Teens Internship
org: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County (NHMLAC)
what_you_do: Build a marine science project and share it with museum visitors. You learn about museum research, collections and careers, and practice public speaking.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back in February 2027 for the application link and deadline.

name: Critical Action Lab (Natural History Museum of Utah)
what_you_do: Teens plan events for other teens about taking action in their towns. Events include a Youth Climate Summit, game nights, nature fairs and clean ups.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 to 2027 group are closed. The page says to check back later.

name: Teen Explainers (Natural History Museum of Utah)
what_you_do: Paid high school interns lead hands on activities for museum visitors. They learn how to talk with the public and go on behind the scenes tours.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 to 2027 school year group are closed. The summer group (June to August) is described on the page; the next dates are not posted.

name: NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP)
org: National Institutes of Health, Office of Intramural Training and Education
what_you_do: Work full time for a summer in an NIH research lab with a scientist mentor. You join career workshops and present your work at Summer Poster Day. Open to graduating high school seniors who meet the age rule.
deadline_text: The 2027 application is open now and closes Tuesday, January 26, 2027 at 12 pm ET. Reference letters are due Tuesday, February 2, 2027 at 12 pm ET.

name: NISRA Volunteers and Summer Camp Jobs (Elgin and 12 other member communities)
city: Elgin and 12 other member communities, northern Illinois
what_you_do: Volunteer to give one-on-one help in recreation programs for people with disabilities. Or apply for part-time jobs like program helper and summer day camp counselor. Programs meet once a week for 1 to 3 hours.
deadline_text: No deadline. NISRA says it hires summer camp staff each winter and spring. Postings are on the ADP Workforce Now site.

grades: High school juniors and seniors when you apply
name: NIST Summer High School Intern Program (SHIP), Gaithersburg
org: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
what_you_do: Spend seven summer weeks in a NIST lab on the Gaithersburg campus. You work with staff scientists and engineers on your own research project and may show it at a poster session.
deadline_text: Not open yet as of Oct 11. The page (updated Sept 14) says the 2027 job announcement is expected on USAJOBS in mid-October, with applications due at the end of January 2027. A lower line says applications generally open Nov 1, so the open date is not firm.

name: Conservation Youth Team
what_you_do: Teen volunteers work 8-hour days at the zoo. That is about 150 hours over a summer. They learn about animals and nature care. They work with guests of all ages.
deadline_text: Applications open December 1. 2026 materials were due March 16, 2026, with interviews in late March and decisions in April.

name: North Dakota 4-H Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Chosen young leaders for North Dakota 4-H. Ambassadors help plan statewide 4-H events, such as the Extension Youth Conference and retreats. They promote 4-H statewide. They also help at the State Fair and at state or county 4-H events.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications were due Oct 15, 2026. The next chance is the June election. Its May 15 deadline is from last year, since 2027 dates are not posted.

name: North Dakota Extension Youth Conference (EYC)
what_you_do: A 4 day summer conference at NDSU in Fargo. You build leadership skills and pick workshops.
deadline_text: 2026: early-bird registration ran from Thanksgiving through December, and registration closed June 1. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: North Dakota 4-H Leadership Awareness Weekend (LAW)
what_you_do: A weekend in Bismarck. Teens learn how local and state government work and how to help their towns.
deadline_text: Event Feb 14 to 15, 2027 in Bismarck. The registration deadline is not listed on the program page.

name: North Dakota Governor's School
org: NDSU Office of Teaching and Learning and University of North Dakota
city: Fargo or Grand Forks, ND (host switches between NDSU and UND)
what_you_do: A four week summer program. You live and study on the NDSU campus. Students rank their top two pathways from Engineering, Information Technology, Laboratory Science or Mathematics. The NDSU page lists dates of June 8 to July 2, 2026 for NDGS 2026.
deadline_text: The NDSU page shows the NDGS 2026 timeline with no year on the later dates: portal opened October 13, 2025 and closed February 15, 2026; acceptance emails March 12 (year not shown); accept by April 10 (year not shown). The 2026 program ran June 8 to July 2. The next session's dates are not posted on the program pages.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer with the City Library's teen program. The page does not describe the roles.
deadline_text: Registration for January 2027 opportunities opens Dec. 17 at 5 p.m., per the library's teen hub page (year inferred). Fall 2026 registration is closed.

name: Become a Lifeguard and Swim Instructor at NVRC
org: North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission
what_you_do: Take the courses in order. They are Bronze Medallion, Bronze Cross, First Aid, National Lifeguard Pool and Swim Instructor. Then apply online for pool jobs with NVRC.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Volunteer with North Vancouver Recreation and Culture (NVRC)
org: North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission
what_you_do: Help with swimming, young kids programs, fitness and special events. You can also help with general recreation.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Youth Train in Trades (North Vancouver School District)
org: North Vancouver School District 44 with BCIT, VCC and SkilledTradesBC
what_you_do: Take a trades training program while in high school. Training is at a high school, partner college or certified facility. Seats are limited.
deadline_text: Deadline is the end of February for programs the next school year. Year not stated.

name: Vancouver Coastal Health North Shore Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at Lions Gate Hospital, health clinics, care homes and community programs. You might work at the front desk, show people the way, visit with patients, help a clinic or help at events.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply online any time.

name: Civic Leadership Institute (CTD Summer Camp)
org: Northwestern University Center for Talent Development
what_you_do: Take a 3 week course on current social and political issues. You learn through service, talks with community leaders and study. You do service projects and make a plan for change.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 28 to July 17, 2026. 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet. The program has said to apply early for aid.

name: Summer Volunteer Service for Students
org: Northwestern Medicine (Delnor in Geneva, Central DuPage in Winfield, Lake Forest and other suburban hospitals)
city: Geneva, Winfield, Lake Forest and other suburbs, IL
what_you_do: Volunteer one day a week for eight weeks in a hospital in the summer.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer application period is closed. The page says to check back for the 2027 Summer Service Period in early autumn. It gives no 2027 dates on this page.

grades: Current high school juniors (rising seniors), no exceptions
name: Medill Cherubs Journalism Institute
org: Northwestern University, Medill School of Journalism
what_you_do: Spend 4 weeks on the Northwestern campus learning to report, write and produce news. Work with journalism faculty and professionals.
deadline_text: No applications before December 1, 2026. All materials are due by noon Central on March 1, 2027. Decisions by March 24, 2027.

name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Policy Debate Institute
what_you_do: Train in policy style debate in a 4 week or 6 week summer institute. The 2026 institute was fully online.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application opens this winter. Rolling admission through April or until the labs are full. 2026 dates were June 28 to July 25 (4 weeks) and June 28 to August 8 (6 weeks).

name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Film and Video Division
what_you_do: Spend 5 weeks on the Northwestern campus making films. Take courses such as acting for the screen, sound and on-set work, and finish with a festival of student films.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 9, 2026 and regular deadline March 13, 2026, with rolling late applications for some concentrations. 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.

name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Theatre Arts Division
what_you_do: Live on the Northwestern campus for 5 weeks. Take acting, voice and movement classes, work on a crew, and rehearse a full play with professional directors. Tracks: Performance, Stage Management and Design/Tech, Musical Theatre.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 2, 2026 and regular deadline February 27, 2026 (online form). 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.

name: Waterpark seasonal jobs with free training
org: NOVA Parks (Northern Virginia Regional Park Authority)
city: Northern Virginia (Fairfax, Alexandria and Arlington waterparks)
what_you_do: You can work summer jobs at a NOVA Parks waterpark. Jobs include attendant, lifeguard, water safety instructor and cook. Uniforms and training are free.
deadline_text: Page says NOVA Parks is hiring; no deadline stated.

name: NOVAworks Young Adult Services
city: Sunnyvale, CA (serves San Mateo County and northern Santa Clara County)
what_you_do: You can get free career coaching and training if you are an eligible young adult. You can also take a paid internship of about 400 hours if you are 18 or older. If you are 17, you can start with coaching and work readiness.
deadline_text: Open enrollment. No deadline posted.

name: National Park Service Youth Conservation Corps (YCC)
city: Participating national parks (see the NPS park list)
what_you_do: You can get a paid summer conservation job at a national park, working outdoors on park projects. Each park runs its own program.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 season open in late January or early February 2027. Closing dates are set by each park and are not posted.

name: ACE Mentor Program of Greater New York
org: ACE Mentor Program of Greater NY
city: Teams in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, White Plains and Riverdale (and remote)
what_you_do: Join a free after-school team of 20 to 30 students and 12 to 15 pros in architecture, engineering and construction. You learn design software and present a team project at a year-end showcase.
deadline_text: The page says most teams begin meeting late October 2026, with a few starting in January 2027. Team selection emails start in September and teams fill first come, first served. The page gives no registration close date and does not say whether registration is open now.

name: Science Research Mentoring Program (SRMP)
what_you_do: Do a real science research project with a Museum scientist for a full year. You work in a team of 2 or 3 twice a week after school, learn skills like DNA lab work or coding, and present a poster in June.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the Class of 2028 are expected to open in Winter 2027. Interviews are in April and decisions come by the end of May.

name: Arts & Entertainment Production Internship (Apollo Theater Academy)
what_you_do: A paid after-school internship at the Apollo. You see how teams build an event. Teams include fundraising, education and marketing. Others are operations, production and programming. You help shape the summer Teen Takeover event.
deadline_text: The spring 2026 application closed Friday, Mar 27, 2026. The next cycle is not posted. Check the Apollo page for the next cycle.

name: Technical Stage Production Internship (Apollo Theater Academy)
what_you_do: A paid summer internship with the Apollo production crew. You work on lighting, sound, video, building sets and stage design. You help put on the summer Apollo Teen Takeover event.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed June 26, 2026. Interviews were June 30 and July 1. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Garden Apprentice Program (GAP)
what_you_do: Grow and harvest food in the Children's Garden, learn botany, and teach garden lessons to kids ages 4 to 12. You move up through four tiers over the years.
deadline_text: The page gives no opening date for 2027 applications. It asks visitors to sign up to be notified when applications open, and it shows an Apply Now button. Submit materials before Dec 4, 2026 to be invited to an interview. No final deadline is posted. Info session Sat Oct 17, 2026, 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., RSVP required.

name: Upward Bound Math & Science
org: Bronx Community College (CUNY), Federal TRIO program
what_you_do: A free STEM college-prep program for high school students. In the school year you go to Saturday classes and tutoring on the BCC campus. There is also a six-week summer program, with a three-week stay in a college dorm.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the program pages.

name: Teen Council and Teen Summer
org: The Bronx Museum of the Arts
what_you_do: Paid youth internship at the museum. You meet and interview artists, help curate exhibitions, make a zine and make your own art with 11 other teens. There is also a four-week Teen Summer session.
deadline_text: The Fall 2026 application closed Oct 4, 2026. The spring and summer 2027 dates are not posted yet. The page says teens can apply for fall, spring and/or summer sessions each year.

name: Brooklyn Interns for Arts and Culture (BIAC)
what_you_do: A paid, year-long after-school internship for 13 students. You learn what it takes to work in arts management and get help planning life after high school.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed Friday, June 12, 2026. The next deadline is not posted.

name: Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Meet twice a month with city leaders and other teens to find problems in Brooklyn and write policy ideas to fix them. The first group ran a teen wellness summit at Borough Hall.
deadline_text: The page says applications typically open at the end of the school year. Exact dates are not posted.

name: BRIC Teen Filmmaking Bootcamp
what_you_do: Eight sessions of free filmmaking training: planning, filming in BRIC's TV studios and editing. You earn a certification that lets you borrow BRIC gear for your own projects.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 (Cycle 9) applications closed Sept 27, 2026. New cycles open through the year.

name: BRIC Teen Media and Teen Curatorial Fellowships
what_you_do: Pick one fellowship. Teen Curatorial teens plan a youth art exhibition. Teen Media teens run a youth film festival called Concrete Stories. You meet weekly in person and do the real planning.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application deadline was Sept 24, 2026 (extended). Offers were due by Sept 30, 2026. The next call is not posted.

name: Capture Your World: BRIC Teen Photography Bootcamp
what_you_do: Eight weeks of free street photography with DSLR cameras. You edit in Photoshop. You finish with a student photo show at the library.
deadline_text: Cycle 4 applications closed Sept 27, 2026. New cycles open through the year.

name: Green Team and Coastal Cleanup Volunteers
what_you_do: Help care for the park by weeding, mulching and removing leaves, or pick up trash from salt marshes and beaches and log what you find. Staff give you tools and training.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for each event. Most activities run April to October. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Summer Scholars Internship
org: Center for Brooklyn History (Brooklyn Public Library)
what_you_do: Work with archivists, historians and teachers on Brooklyn history. You do research in the Othmer Library. You see how exhibits are made. You visit museums, archives and historic sites.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 program are closed. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Groundswell Studio Programs (free after-school art and social justice)
what_you_do: Make art about social justice in a Brooklyn studio after school. Classes cover mixed media and printmaking. You also paint a community mural. Workshops are about college and jobs in the arts.
deadline_text: Last year (2025-26) open enrollment ended Nov 3, 2025, taken on a rolling basis. The 2026-27 dates were not posted on the program page.

name: Summer Leadership Institute (paid mural apprentices)
city: Brooklyn, NY (murals across New York City)
what_you_do: Join a team of 15 to 20 youth and two teaching artists. You research a community issue, design a mural, and paint it with neighbors from July to August.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the program page.

name: Health Scholars Program (Emergency Department internship)
what_you_do: Spend time as an unpaid team member in the emergency department of the busiest hospital in Brooklyn. You help patients, support staff and watch different health care jobs at work.
deadline_text: Deadline to send all materials for each block (year not printed on the page): Block 1 (Dec 11 to Mar 10) by Oct 31; Block 2 (Mar 11 to May 31) by Feb 1; Block 3 (Jun 1 to Sep 2) by Apr 30.

name: High School Volunteer Programs
what_you_do: Volunteer on hospital units or in the emergency room. You can also help in the children's hospital or with hospitality. You help patients and families. Many Brooklyn high schools work with the hospital.
deadline_text: The page does not state a deadline or whether applications are open now.

name: Science Scholars Program (summer surgery internship)
what_you_do: Four weeks in July with a surgeon as your mentor. You do a research project and watch surgery in the operating room. You use simulators and join lectures with residents.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was March 26, 2026. Interviews were the third week of April and decisions by end of April. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Museum Apprentice Program
what_you_do: Train as a museum educator. You meet artists and curators, plan lessons, help with family programs, and lead tours for summer camp groups.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 deadline has passed. The page says to come back in June 2027 to apply for the fall 2027 program.

name: Creative Practice
what_you_do: Help teaching artists run weekend art classes for students of all ages. You prepare studios and materials, learn lesson planning, and make your own art with other teens.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 deadline has passed. The page says to come back in June 2027 to apply for the fall 2027 program.

name: InterseXtions: Gender and Sexuality
what_you_do: Explore gender and sexuality in art with other teens. You make art, talk about representation, and plan a free, large event for LGBTQ+ teens and allies.
deadline_text: Applications closed Oct 18, 2026. Next dates are not posted.

name: Teen Night Planning Committee
what_you_do: Plan and run free, large Teen Night events at the museum. You pick activities, book young artists and performers, and promote the events on social media.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 deadline has passed. The page says to come back in June 2027 to apply for the fall 2027 program.

name: Summer PreCollege Intensive
org: Pratt Institute (School of Continuing and Professional Studies)
what_you_do: Take two college classes in art, design, architecture or writing for four weeks, build a portfolio and earn 4 college credits. Live on campus and show your work in an exhibition.
deadline_text: Not open yet: applications for Summer 2027 open in November 2026 (the page gives no day). Scholarship application deadline Feb 1, 2027. International student deadline Apr 1, 2027. Payment due May 31, 2027. The main application deadline is not stated.

name: Teen Service Series and Park Pitch In
what_you_do: Remove invasive plants, maintain woodland trails and help restore the forest in Prospect Park. All tools are provided and you need no experience. You earn service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for each event. The page lists Teen Service Series days through October and Park Pitch In weekends through November. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Bossgirls Summer Entrepreneurship Program
org: Zahn Innovation Center, City College of New York (CUNY)
city: CCNY campus, 160 Convent Ave, New York, NY
what_you_do: In teams, find a problem in daily life, build a business idea around it and pitch it at the end. You learn customer research, marketing, money basics and product building.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2026 are closed. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: Teen Volunteer Days
what_you_do: Teens spend a Saturday hour caring for the park. Jobs may include raking, weeding or mulching depending on the season.
deadline_text: Sign-ups open about four weeks before each session. No sign-up link was posted as of Oct 12, 2026.

name: Pre-College Programs: NYC Commuter Summer
org: Columbia University School of Professional Studies
what_you_do: You take a college-level course on Columbia's campus. There are 70+ courses in a dozen subject areas. Class is about 4 hours each weekday. You go home at night. You earn a certificate of participation and an evaluation letter.
grades: Entering grades 9 to 12, or freshman year of college
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open mid-November 2026. Early registration deadline Feb 1, 2027. General application deadline Apr 1, 2027 for the NYC Commuter sessions.

name: Design Hive
what_you_do: A paid, youth-led program for juniors and seniors. You study design objects and how designers work, then build your own team design project with other teens.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 are open. Apply by Sunday, Oct 25, 2026 at 11:59 PM.

name: The Saturday Program (free art and architecture classes)

name: Next Generation STEM Internship (NGSI), Spring 2027
city: Oak Ridge, TN (virtual, for East Tennessee students)
what_you_do: Work part time with ORNL researchers on a STEM project. The spring 2027 round is virtual, for about 16 to 17 weeks.
grades: High school junior or senior (class of 2027 or 2028), or a recent graduate not yet in a degree program
deadline_text: Spring 2027 applications are due October 21, 2026.

name: SAGE Camp (Science Accelerating Growth and Engagement)
what_you_do: Join a summer day camp at the laboratory with hands-on projects, job shadowing and facility tours. It runs about a week and a half.
deadline_text: SAGE 2027 is July 12 to 22, 2027. The page says summer 2027 applications are expected to open in early 2027.

name: Facilities and Operations (F&O) Trades Camp
what_you_do: Spend 4 days at the lab to explore skilled trades and tech careers. You get tours, career talks and job shadowing.
grades: Rising high school juniors and seniors
deadline_text: The page says summer 2027 applications are expected to open in spring 2027. No session dates are posted.

name: Mayor's Summer Youth Employment Program (MSYEP)
org: City of Oakland, Oakland Workforce Development Board, and partner nonprofits
what_you_do: You get paid summer work experience of up to about 100 hours, with job readiness training, through partner nonprofits. You apply to the partner group, not the City.
deadline_text: Deadlines vary by partner. For Summer 2026 one partner (ACOE) closed recruitment June 18, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; check partner sites in early 2027.

name: Oakland Workforce Development Board Youth Summer Jobs (Lao Family, YEP, Trybe)
org: Oakland Workforce Development Board (City of Oakland)
what_you_do: If you are an Oakland youth, you can get job readiness training. You can get work-based learning. You can get paid work experience. You get these through one of three partner agencies.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Contact the partners for the current cycle.

name: Oakland Parks, Recreation and Youth Development (OPRYD) Part-Time Jobs
what_you_do: You can apply for part-time and seasonal City recreation jobs. Jobs include recreation aide, recreation leader, sports official, lifeguard, water safety instructor and pool staff. There is also a recreation specialist job.
deadline_text: Deadline Oct 25, 2026 for Spring/Summer 2027 starts; Feb 7, 2027 for Summer 2027 starts; Aug 8, 2027 for Fall/Winter 2027 starts.

name: Oakland Public Library Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: You can join a monthly teen group that works with library staff on projects and programs and earns service credit. It meets at Main (TeenZone), 81st Ave, Asian, Cesar Chavez, Dimond and Rockridge branches.
deadline_text: Rolling

name: Oakland Public Library Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help at a library branch with teen programs, social media, book and film picks, and art and design projects. The hours count as community service.
deadline_text: Rolling. Not every branch has space at all times.

name: Teen Summer Internship (California Trail Interpretation)
what_you_do: You spend about 200 hours over 7 weeks teaching guests in the Habitarium and California Trail. Up to 6 interns are chosen.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Teen Wild Guides
what_you_do: Teens learn to teach visitors about animals at the Valley Children's Zoo. They run the petting yard. Later, they can help keepers on service projects.
deadline_text: Accepted year-round. Later applications are reviewed in the next enrollment period. The Sept 1, 2026 fall application date has passed. Fall 2026 info meetings Aug 15 and 16, trainings Sept 26 and Oct 4.

name: ZooCamp Teen Assistant and Teen Interns
what_you_do: Help run summer day camp at the zoo. Teen Assistants volunteer. Teacher and Administrative Interns (grades 11 and 12, with camp experience) earn a $400 weekly stipend.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Feb 1 and closed April 1, 2026 at 5pm. Summer 2027 dates not posted yet; the page says to check back.

name: Oakley Youth Advisory Council (OYAC)
what_you_do: Help plan and attend city events for youth and families. Advise the City of Oakley on policies that matter to young people.
deadline_text: No application dates are stated. The council meets on the first Wednesday of each month from August through May, 5:00 to 6:00 PM.

name: Oak Futures Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Paid part-time work at local groups and businesses. There is a nine-week summer job at 20 to 30 hours a week and a year-round job. Some spots are a one-week job shadow or an eight-week internship.
deadline_text: The page says: 'Applications for Summer 2027 will open in the Spring.' No dates posted.

name: OC Fair & Event Center Jobs (annual OC Fair)
what_you_do: Work at the annual OC Fair or at events held year-round at the fairgrounds, in indoor or outdoor jobs.
deadline_text: No hiring dates posted on the jobs page for 2027.

name: OC Public Libraries Teen Volunteer
city: Orange County, CA (any OC Public Libraries branch)
what_you_do: You help a local library branch. Tasks include organizing materials and taking part in library events. Shifts are flexible. They include weekdays and weekends.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings are limited and depend on each branch.

name: OCC Sailing Youth Leadership Program
org: Orange Coast College School of Sailing and Seamanship
what_you_do: Teens learn teamwork and job skills in the summer sailing camps. This prepares you to be a camp counselor or assistant sailing instructor. You also study weather, tides and boating laws.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the program page. Check the class schedule on the online registration site.

name: Ocean Institute Counselor-In-Training (CIT) Summer Program
what_you_do: Work with camp counselors at Ocean Institute summer camp. You help with check-in and check-out, daily activities and camper care. In week 1 you shadow, in week 2 you team teach, and in week 3 you lead.
deadline_text: The page says applications close May 1. It does not state the year, and its sessions start June 15, July 6 and July 27. Dates for next summer are not posted.

name: Ocean Institute Stan Cummings Scholars Internship
what_you_do: Do a year-long marine science project with a weekly 4-hour shift. Projects include animal care, water sampling on a research boat and exhibit design. You present your work at a poster session and a showcase.
deadline_text: Applications are closed and open again in Summer 2027. For 2026-27, applications opened July 6 and closed August 12.

name: Ocean Institute Volunteer Docents (age 14 and up roles)
what_you_do: Teach visitors about the sea and ships as a docent. On weekends, some docents run hands-on exhibits. Others talk about old ship objects.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says they reopen in January 2027.

name: O'Connor Hospital Volunteers (students 15 and up)
org: Santa Clara Valley Healthcare, O'Connor Hospital
what_you_do: You give kind and friendly service to patients, visitors and staff at a county hospital. Training for your service area happens on your first shift.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The page invites applications online with no window stated (read 2026-10-16).

name: Orange County Sheriff Explorer Program
what_you_do: Learn about police work. Help the Sheriff's Department at parades, health fairs and charity events. Explorers are volunteers. They are not police staff.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Use the Explorer Interest Form on the program page.

name: Orange County Sheriff Teen Academy
what_you_do: Spend 5 days in a summer workshop on the Sheriff's Department. You tour the police academy, crime lab and coroner's office. You see K-9, helicopter and harbor patrol shows.
deadline_text: In 2026 there were two sessions: June 8 to 12 and July 20 to 24. Sign-up closed June 2 and July 14. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: OC Workforce Development Board READY S.E.T. OC (WIOA Young Adult Program)
what_you_do: You can get help with tutoring and career exploration. You can get paid or unpaid work experience. Other help includes job skills training, mentoring and college planning. County service providers offer this help.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Start by filling out the interest form.

name: Ogden Youth Council
what_you_do: Learn how city government works. You hear from elected leaders and tour Ogden City buildings. Members also go to Local Government Day at the State Capitol.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 school year are open now. They close at the end of the school year. The page gives no exact date.

name: WSU Summer Medical Academy (Weber State University)
org: Weber State University, Pre-Medical Professional Program
what_you_do: Try out health care careers in a short summer camp. You do lab activities, hear from health workers and patients, and learn how to get ready for health school.
deadline_text: The 2026 session was July 13 to 16, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted. The page lets you sign up for notices about future sessions.

name: WeberBiz Summer Camp (Weber State University)
org: Weber State University, Goddard School of Business and Economics
what_you_do: Stay on campus for 4 days and 3 nights to try out a business major. You take classes with Weber State teachers, meet business leaders and compete in challenges for prizes.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Apr 24, 2026. The page says the deadline is typically the 3rd Friday in April. Applications open in March, and the interest form sends an email when they open.

name: Ohio 4-H clubs and projects
org: Ohio 4-H Youth Development, Ohio State University Extension
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club in your county and choose a project from more than 200 options. Teens can keep going in 4-H through the year they turn 19.
deadline_text: Each county sets an enrollment deadline. The state page does not list a date.

name: Buckeye Boys State
what_you_do: Spend eight days at Miami University running a mock state government. Delegates join caucuses and hold elections. They meet Ohio officials. They go to a college fair. It has 50+ colleges and service academies.
grades: Interview in junior year, attend before senior year
deadline_text: Session dates and deadlines are not posted on the program pages. Legion post interviews are usually held in winter or spring at high schools.

name: Ohio DECA chapters and state conference
org: Ohio DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter in a school career-technical program. You build business skills. Chapters compete at the Ohio state conference in Columbus.
deadline_text: The Ohio DECA conference is February 22 to 24, 2027 at the Greater Columbus Convention Center. No membership deadline is posted.

grades: Entering freshman year of high school through freshman year of college
name: ExploreAg (Ohio Farm Bureau career camps)
city: Ohio (one-day camps in Columbus, Wilmington, Findlay and more)
what_you_do: Hands-on one-day camps and a weeklong camp in summer. They show you jobs in food science, crops, farm tech, food making, animal care and more. Fall 2026 includes a Columbus day on Oct. 21.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 one-day camps, per the flyer and ofbf.org: Wilmington Oct. 13, Columbus Oct. 21, COLT Lineman Training (Mount Gilead) Oct. 23, Meat Processing (Yorkshire) Oct. 27, Findlay Nov. 3. Registration closes 10 days before each event or when full. By that rule Wilmington (about Oct. 3) and Columbus (about Oct. 11) have already closed. Still open by that rule: COLT (about Oct. 13), Meat Processing (about Oct. 17) and Findlay (about Oct. 24, 2026). The page does not post close dates itself.

name: Ohio FFA membership through your school chapter
org: Ohio FFA Association (Ohio Department of Education and Workforce)
what_you_do: Join FFA at a school that has an Ohio FFA chapter. Members build leadership and career skills in agriculture and take part in Career Development Events.
deadline_text: Next date: Nov 30, 2026, for all chapters. The September 30, 2026 date for students in Fall CDEs has passed. Membership opens each August through FFA.org.

grades: Rising 9th to 12th graders (for the two high school camps)
name: STEM Summer Camps (Ohio State Marion)
org: The Ohio State University at Marion
what_you_do: Week-long day camps with lab work: DNA and water testing, robot building and programming, field trips and a cardboard boat race. Two camps are for high schoolers (Science Adventurers and Horizons of Science).
deadline_text: 2026 camps ran June 22 to 26, 2026 and registration closed May 31, 2026 or earlier if full. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Ohio State Fair Junior Fair Board
org: Ohio Expo Center, Ohio State Fair
what_you_do: Serve as a welcoming host for about two weeks at the Ohio State Fair: welcome guests at fair events, and meet people for networking. Housing and meals are provided.
deadline_text: The page says the online application portal opens January 1 and the application is due March 1 ((year inferred from the next cycle)). Notices come early to mid March, interviews mid to late March, selection early April. Confirm the 2027 dates in January.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at The Wilds
what_you_do: Teens choose one or both of two paths. Restoration Ecology has more field work. Conservation Education means talking with visitors. It is at a wildlife conservation center.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates are posted on the volunteer page. The visitor season runs May through October for adult volunteers.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Ohio Wing
what_you_do: Join a year-round cadet squadron. You learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets wear uniforms and learn drill. They earn promotions and plan their own activities.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

name: Ohio Youth & Government (YMCA model government)
org: Ohio Alliance of YMCAs, Ohio Youth & Government
city: Columbus, OH (State Assembly), delegations across Ohio
what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. Prepare in the fall. Then take part in a student-run model government at the spring State Assembly in Columbus. High school roles include legislator, court, lobbyist and media.
deadline_text: Last cycle: State Assembly February 12 to 14, 2026 at the Hyatt Regency Columbus. Registration closed November 28, 2025, with late registration December 1 to 10, 2025. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.

name: GRuB Summer Youth Program
