what_you_do: Work and learn on the GRuB Farm: planting, harvesting, irrigation, composting, the market stand and bouquet CSA. Add leadership workshops, field trips and weekly group meals.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are full and closed. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Teen Connection Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in the children's hospital. They help kids and families waiting for procedures. They also staff the gift shop, work the information desk or help at special events.
deadline_text: Application form is on the site now. No deadline stated. The hospital says the most need is Monday through Friday in business hours, with few evening or weekend spots.

name: Haddix STEM Corridor Program
org: Creighton University College of Arts and Sciences
what_you_do: Do paid summer research projects for eight weeks at Creighton. You present your work at a poster session.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 application is closed. The program page does not post next year's dates.

name: Douglas-Sarpy 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and pick projects to learn by doing. A new club needs one trained adult volunteer and five youth from three different families.
deadline_text: Join any time. To show projects at the Sarpy County Fair or the Nebraska State Fair, enroll by June 15.

name: The Durham Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteers greet guests. They work the admissions desk or museum shop. Or they lead daily activities in exhibits like the log cabin and one-room schoolhouse.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline. Fill out the Volunteer Interest Form to start.

name: Jr Crew (grades 7 and 8 volunteers)
what_you_do: Junior high students can volunteer at the zoo. The page does not list the exact tasks, so read it for details.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 Jr Crew season open on January 5, 2027. Close date not stated.

name: Kent Bellows Mentoring Program (KBMP)
what_you_do: High school artists work with professional artist mentors all year. They make their own art, build a portfolio and show their work in exhibitions.
grades: Core program: mostly juniors and seniors. Foundations: freshmen and sophomores.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round. Interviews are in March, and most new mentees start in the summer session.

name: Methodist Volunteen
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital through the Volunteen program. You must commit to at least 1 year of service.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. There may be a waiting list because many teens apply.

name: Nebraska Medicine Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteers greet and guide patients and visitors. They help hospital departments. The work is office projects and errands. In some specialty care areas they offer comfort and company to patients.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply online any time.

name: Omaha Public Library Volunteer (youth ages 11 to 18)
what_you_do: Volunteers help with library programs and special events. They gain skills like teaching, teamwork and leadership.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted all year.

name: OPS Career Center Pathways
what_you_do: Take hands-on career classes in one of 11 paths. Examples are welding, CNA, EMT, IT or video production. Two paths are off campus: UNMC High School Alliance and Zoo Academy.
deadline_text: The application opens December 1 and closes March 1. Late additions are taken until April 30. The program page does not give a year.

name: Step-Up Omaha
what_you_do: Youth get a paid summer internship. You work for a local employer. Fields include health care, technology, education and construction. You also get job training and learn about careers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed March 16, 2026 (extended from an earlier date). 2027 dates not posted on the program page.

name: UNMC High School Alliance
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take hands-on health science classes, like infectious diseases and anatomy. UNMC faculty teach them on the Omaha campus. You also do job shadowing. Classes run Monday to Friday, 1 to 3 pm.
deadline_text: The application page is titled for the 2026-2027 year. An open or close date is not stated on the program pages.

name: Munroe-Meyer Institute Recreational Therapy Volunteer
what_you_do: Students help run recreation programs and Camp Munroe. These are for people with developmental disabilities. They keep activities safe and fun. Training is required.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Contact the volunteer coordinator for current openings.

name: UNO Summer Scholars
org: University of Nebraska Omaha, Student Leadership and Involvement
what_you_do: Take a UNO college course during the summer. The page says tuition, fees, books and parking permits will be covered.
deadline_text: The page does not give an application deadline or 2027 dates. The 2026 session ran May 26 to June 26, 2026.

name: Teen Tutor and Session Lead Volunteers
city: Libraries in Texas and Pennsylvania (ask which one has a chapter)
what_you_do: Tutor 4 to 5 kindergarten to 3rd grade students in math using the OneInMath lessons. The program is run with libraries. You earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Register to volunteer on the site.

name: Oneonta Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes electrical line work. It includes collision repair and cement masonry. Nurse assistant is another. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Mi4 Summer Internship at CHOC
org: Rady Children's Health (CHOC) Medical Intelligence and Innovation Institute
what_you_do: Learn how new tech is changing children's health care. You get mentors, journal clubs, hands-on workshops and field trips. Interns under 18 do morning and afternoon programs. Shadowing in hospital rotations is for ages 18 and up.
deadline_text: The 2026 round is over. The page says next year's application opens in February 2027. For 2026 it opened Feb 1 and closed Feb 28, with rolling interviews.

name: Girls Meet the Workforce Externship
what_you_do: Girls in grades 9 to 12 get up to 40 hours of job training. Then 11th grade girls do a four-week externship at a local company with a mentor.
deadline_text: Student sign-up dates are not on the page. The newest date found is old: a March 26, 2026 deadline for host companies, not for students. Ask the Girls Inc. Programs Team how and when girls sign up.

name: Golden West College Dual and Concurrent Enrollment
org: Golden West College (Coast Community College District)
what_you_do: Take college classes while in high school. Dual enrollment classes are taught at partner high schools during the school day. Concurrent classes are on the Golden West campus or online.
deadline_text: The page says it is accepting applications and consent forms for Fall 2026, and high school registration for Fall 2026 began June 4, 2026. It gives no Fall 2026 class start date or last day to register, so email dualenrollment@gwc.cccd.edu to ask if you can still join this term. Winter/Spring and Summer terms are also listed, with no 2027 dates posted yet.

name: Orange County Young Curators (OCYC)
org: UC Irvine Langson Orange County Museum of Art
what_you_do: Work with museum staff to learn about museums, art and curating. The group builds an exhibition from start to finish that opens to the public.
deadline_text: Application dates for the next group are not on the museum program pages.

name: Library volunteers, ages 14 and up (Orange County Public Library)
org: Orange County Public Library, Orange County NC
what_you_do: Help at the main library. You check shelves, get old books ready for the Friends book sale, keep displays full and set up for events.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: OC Parks Volunteer
city: Orange County, CA (regional parks, trails, beaches, nature centers)
what_you_do: Volunteer in county parks as a historic docent or in backcountry patrol. Other roles include OC Zoo chances. Training includes first aid and CPR.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page. The sign-up form is linked from the OC Parks volunteer page.

name: OC Pathways Student Ambassador Program
org: OC Pathways (Orange County Department of Education)
what_you_do: Represent your school district at the county level. Push for student voice in career classes (CTE). Meet industry mentors. Lead a year-long Impact Project to fix a real need in your school or community.
deadline_text: The page says students apply in spring. Exact dates are not posted.

name: OCFA Fire Cadet Program
city: Orange County, CA (cadet posts at fire stations)
what_you_do: Learn basic fire skills in a 10 week trainee academy. Then join cadet activities. These include hydrant care and crowd and traffic control at Fire Authority events. You also help with public information programs. Cadets can observe the ride-along program.
deadline_text: The trainee academy is held once a year. The page does not list the next start date.

name: Orangewood Foundation Independent Living Program (ILP)
what_you_do: Teens and young adults in or out of foster care get nine months of one-on-one coaching on school, careers, housing and money. Workshops can earn gift card incentives.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Santa Ana College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: High school students take college classes for free, transferable credit. Classes are at the high school, at Santa Ana College, on weekends or online.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on this page.

name: Teen Volunteer Work Experience Program (Social Services Agency)
org: County of Orange Social Services Agency
what_you_do: Teens help county Social Services staff with office tasks. These include sorting mail, filing, typing in data, copying and helping at the front desk. A couple of warehouse spots are at one site.
deadline_text: The 2026 application period has closed. The page says the next one is expected March to April 2027.

name: Santiago Canyon College Early College (Dual Enrollment)
what_you_do: High school students take college classes for free, transferable credit. Classes can be at the high school, at SCC, on weekends or online.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. See the Important Dates link on the page.

name: Ignite by 4-H Conference (Oregon delegation)
what_you_do: Join teens from across the country at a conference in Washington, DC. It has speakers and workshops on science, farming and healthy living. You make a plan for action in your community.
deadline_text: Applications close October 13, 2026 at 11:45 pm (the deadline was extended from October 1).

name: Oregon 4-H Ambassador Program
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Speak for 4-H at public events and to lawmakers. Help plan 4-H events. Volunteer at programs across the state, such as the Oregon State Fair.
deadline_text: Applications were due May 1, 2026. Finalists interview at Summer Conference in late June (2026: June 24 to 27).

name: Oregon 4-H Summer Conference
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Spend four days on the OSU campus in workshops taught by OSU faculty and 4-H volunteers. Meet teens from across Oregon and explore careers and college.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened May 15, 2026. Next year not posted.

name: Oregon 4-H Youth Development
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects like animals, robots, sewing, food saving or nature science. Clubs meet through your county Extension office.
deadline_text: The 4-H year begins October 1. Online enrollment opens the last week of September. The page was written for the 2025-26 year, so check the 2026-27 dates with your county.

name: Youth Tractor Safety Certification
city: Linn, Marion, Clackamas, Jefferson and other Oregon counties
what_you_do: Take a 22-hour course with online work, classroom time and tractor driving. It meets the Oregon Department of Agriculture rule for farm employers who hire minors.
deadline_text: Classes run in spring and summer. The 2026 classes ran March to June 2026. Next dates not posted.

name: Empowered Professionals of Tomorrow (UVU)
what_you_do: Take real college classes at UVU for seven weeks in the summer. Pick a track in science, engineering, education or business. You earn college credit and meet mentors.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full and had a waitlist. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Otis College Summer of Art
org: Otis College of Art and Design
what_you_do: A four-week summer art program on campus for high school students. Pick a specialty and a drawing studio. Earn college credit. Show your work in a final show. Housing is available.
deadline_text: Registration begins Nov 16, 2026. The scholarship application deadline is April 16, 2027 (no exceptions). The registration deadline is not posted yet.

name: OUSD Linked Learning Internships
org: Oakland Unified School District, High School Linked Learning Office
what_you_do: You can find paid summer internships and after-school internships for Oakland Unified high school students. The district lists them by employer, with dates and pay. Your pathway teachers can also connect you to internships.
deadline_text: The district updates its summer internship list weekly from January to May. The page still shows Summer 2024 forms; 2027 dates not posted.

name: OUSD Linked Learning: Pathways, Internships and Work Permits
org: Oakland Unified School District, High School Linked Learning Office
what_you_do: You can get help with career pathways, internships and job placement. You can also take dual enrollment with Peralta Colleges. Dual enrollment means college classes while in high school. The office also processes work permits for Oakland Unified students.
deadline_text: Ongoing; talk to your school's pathway or career counselor. No dates posted.

name: Lifeguard I Outdoor (seasonal)
org: City of Overland Park Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Lifeguards watch swimmers at the city's public pools. They enforce pool safety rules and rescue swimmers in trouble. You must attend required training classes.
grades: Basic education equal to 8th grade for Lifeguard I
deadline_text: Current openings are not shown on the job description page. The job is listed as seasonal.

name: Pacific Marine Mammal Center Junior Docent and Junior Outreach Assistant
what_you_do: Junior Docents greet visitors. They share how the center rescues sick sea animals. Junior Outreach Assistants set up booths and run kids activities at events.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. The page has Apply Now links.

name: Pacoima Beautiful Agua University
what_you_do: A four-week summer program for high school students in the Northeast San Fernando Valley. Students earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The next window is not posted. Follow @pbyes_ on Instagram for updates.

name: Pacoima Beautiful Junior Field Rangers (paid)
what_you_do: Six weeks of classes and field work in the community. There is one class day and one field day a week. Graduates can earn a California Naturalist Certification and 4 college units that can transfer.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The 2027 window is not posted. Follow @pbyes_ on Instagram for updates.

grades: Service projects: grades 6 to 12. Member Services: grades 9 to 12 (20 hour minimum). Book reviewers: grades 6 to 8. Teen Advisory Board: grades 9 to 12.
name: Teen Service Projects, Volunteers and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Do 2 hour summer service projects, help in Member Services or review books for credit. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It meets monthly in the school year.
deadline_text: Book review hours count for reviews submitted September 1, 2026 to May 15, 2027. Teen Advisory Board applications run August 1 to 31, and that window has passed.

name: Palo Alto Art Center Summer Camp Counselor in Training
org: City of Palo Alto Art Center
what_you_do: Help art teachers run kids' and teen summer art camps for at least one week, in a morning or afternoon session. You manage the classroom, encourage campers and prep art supplies.
deadline_text: CIT and Lead CIT registration opens Feb 4, 2027 with Enjoy! summer camp registration. No closing date stated.

name: Teen Library Advisory Board (Palo Alto City Library)
what_you_do: Teens in grades 8 to 12 volunteer with the library. They join the advisory board. Each semester you pick an activity. Examples include planning a teen program, helping at an outreach event or writing a booklist.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back in December 2026 to apply for Winter/Spring 2027.

name: Teen Advisory Board (Mitchell Park Teen Services)
org: City of Palo Alto, Mitchell Park Teen Services
what_you_do: You can join a group of 15 to 20 high school students who plan and lead events for teens in Palo Alto.
deadline_text: The page mentions a deadline but gives no date or year. The only dates found were in a 2023 city article.

name: Palo Alto Youth Council (PAYC)
org: City of Palo Alto, Mitchell Park Teen Services
what_you_do: High school students serve as youth ambassadors. The council has 15 to 20 students. They speak to the Palo Alto City Council. Topics include mental health, civic engagement and community events.
deadline_text: The page says the application opens July 2027. No closing date stated.

name: Pasadena City College Dual and Concurrent Enrollment for Middle and High School Students
what_you_do: Take college classes for credit while in school. Dual enrollment classes happen at partner schools in the school day. Students at other schools can use concurrent enrollment with a counselor and parent signature.
deadline_text: The page shows applications opened 12/01/2025 for the Summer 2026 (6/22 to 8/14/26) and Fall 2026 (8/24 to 12/13/26) terms. No later application window is posted. Forms are processed in 2 to 3 weeks.

name: Pasadena Humane Teen Volunteers (15 and up, Ambassador at 14 with a parent)
what_you_do: Help at the animal shelter. You might work with animals, foster care or community programs. You can also help with on-site support, office help and humane education. Younger teens can be Ambassadors who guide visitors around the kennels.
deadline_text: Virtual orientations are Tuesday Oct 13 and Tuesday Nov 10, 5:00 to 6:15 p.m. The page does not state the year.

name: The Rose, Pasadena's Youth Literary Magazine
what_you_do: Send in poems, short stories, book reviews, art or photos for a youth magazine for the whole city. You can also offer to help with the magazine. Use the library's teen volunteer application.
deadline_text: No submission deadline is stated on the page.

grades: Sophomore, junior or senior in fall 2026
name: Growing Strong summer internship
what_you_do: Interns work on the City Green farm and at its markets. Or they help run garden camps for kids ages 5 to 12. They also join food and fairness workshops.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. City Green says 2027 applications open in early spring 2027.

name: Pennsylvania 4-H
what_you_do: Join a local club and complete hands-on projects. Areas include health, science, agriculture and civic engagement. Older members can take on leadership roles.
deadline_text: No deadline posted; join through your county 4-H office.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, Pennsylvania Wing
what_you_do: Join a local squadron for weekly meetings. Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Wear a uniform. Move up in rank as you take on more leadership.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by visiting a squadron.

grades: High school grades 9 to 12 (middle school grades 5 to 8 has a separate group)
name: Pennsylvania FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
city: Pennsylvania (statewide, state office in Jersey Shore)
what_you_do: Join a business student group at your school. You compete in business events, go to region and state conferences and build leadership skills.
deadline_text: Join through your chapter adviser any time. Next State Leadership Conference: April 12 to 14, 2027.

name: Pennsylvania FFA Association
what_you_do: Join an FFA chapter at your school through agricultural education. Take part in leadership and career events, and do a hands-on project called a Supervised Agricultural Experience.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You join through your school's agricultural education program.

name: Pennsylvania Junior Academy of Science (PJAS)
city: Pennsylvania (12 regions; State Meet at the Penn State main campus in 2026)
what_you_do: Do your own science research project, then give a 10 minute talk to judges at a regional meet. Students who qualify go on to the State Meet in May.
deadline_text: The 2026 State Meet was May 17 to 19, 2026 at Penn State University Park. Each region sets its own deadlines. The program pages do not list 2027 dates.

name: Keystone Boys State
org: The American Legion Department of Pennsylvania
city: Pennsylvania (held at Messiah University, Mechanicsburg, in 2026)
what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend state called Keystone. You run for office and debate bills.
grades: Finished 11th grade, with at least one semester of high school left
deadline_text: The application page lists a 2025 registration date and the 2026 session dates (June 14 to June 20, 2026). No 2027 dates are posted on the program page.

name: Keystone Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Pennsylvania
what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend government. You live in a mock city and county, hold mock offices, hold meetings and learn how Pennsylvania government works.
deadline_text: The home page lists a 2027 application and the dates 20-25 June 2026. The only deadline posted is old (May 20, 2023). No 2027 deadline is stated.

name: Pennsylvania Outdoor Corps, Youth Summer Program
org: Pennsylvania Department of Conservation and Natural Resources, with the Student Conservation Association
city: Pennsylvania (crews in 18 cities, including Philadelphia and Pittsburgh)
what_you_do: Join a small crew in state parks and forests for six weeks. You build trails, protect habitats and improve park spaces, with adult mentors.
deadline_text: 2026 dates were June 29 to August 7, 2026. No 2027 dates or deadline are posted on the program page.

name: Pennsylvania School for Excellence in the Agricultural Sciences (PSEAS)
org: Penn State College of Agricultural Sciences
what_you_do: A two-week summer school at Penn State where you live on campus. It is for students who like food, farming and nature. Each student is given one of two sessions.
deadline_text: Application opens November 1 (the page does not give the year). Deadline February 26, 2027. Decisions March 26, 2027.

name: Peralta Colleges Dual Enrollment (Laney, Merritt, Berkeley City, College of Alameda)
what_you_do: Take free college classes while in high school, on a Peralta campus or through classes arranged with your school. Courses go on your permanent college transcript.
grades: High school students (the page gives no grade range)
deadline_text: No deadlines posted. Register each term.

name: Summer Youth Enrichment Program (SYEP)
org: Prince George's County Government, Office of Human Resources Management
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job for 6 weeks in Prince George's County. You might work at a nonprofit, a company, or a county office. You also learn job skills and try out careers.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications March 1 to March 31, 2026 (11:59 pm); program July 6 to August 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted, but the page says applications are accepted March 1 to March 31.

name: Youth volunteers at Summer Playtime and Summer Day Camps
org: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County
what_you_do: You can volunteer at a Summer Playtime program at age 14. Or volunteer at a Summer Day Camp at age 15. You work 12 to 15 hours a week. You earn student service learning hours.
deadline_text: Volunteer applications are accepted online from March 1-May 1. The page gives no year.

name: M-NCPPC Youth Advisory Council (YAC)
org: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County
what_you_do: You join about 20 high school youth. You advise the parks department. You plan teen events and community service projects. You join leadership conferences and field trips.
deadline_text: The page posts no application deadline or window. It says the council is taking applications.

name: Library volunteering and VolunTEEN
org: Prince George's County Memorial Library System
what_you_do: Help at a branch as a library, computer, facility or program aide. Or earn up to 6 service hours through VolunTEEN. Teens over the age of 15 can help in the Kids Achieve Club homework program.
deadline_text: No deadline. Kids Achieve Club interviews: June for September programs, November for January programs.

name: Volunteer Program, Academy of Natural Sciences
org: Academy of Natural Sciences of Drexel University
what_you_do: You can help in collections departments and the Patrick Center lab. You can help with Bird Safe Philly, a bird-collision program. You can also help with Nature at Noon walks. Roles vary. Not all are open to teens.
deadline_text: No deadline listed.

name: Teen Sketch and Teen Podcast, Philadelphia Museum of Art
what_you_do: Join the Teen Sketch art program at the museum. Or work with other teens on the museum's Teen Podcast as a writer, researcher, host or producer.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 programs are listed with Apply links. No closing date is posted on the page.

name: Outdoor and Wilderness Leadership Skills (OWLS), Awbury Arboretum
what_you_do: Train to be a camp counselor in training. You learn to lead groups, handle conflict and camp outdoors. You also practice writing a resume and job interviews. You get American Red Cross First Aid and CPR.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 session ran June 15 to 26, 2026 and was sold out. The camp FAQ says Summer 2027 registration opens Monday, Feb. 1, 2027 at 9 am; OWLS 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Paid Youth Internships, Bartram's Garden
what_you_do: Work paid, part-time shifts on one of three teams. ROOTS Tree Crew cares for trees. Earth Seeds Ecology covers gardening and nature jobs. Sankofa Community Farm grows food.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 cycle closed Sept 23, 2025 (program started Oct 6, 2025). The page says applications reopen in August for the 2026-27 school year, but still shows the 2025 dates.

name: Bloomberg Arts Internship (BAI)
what_you_do: This is a paid summer internship at an arts and culture group in Philadelphia. You get training in work skills. You get mentoring. You also go to sessions on college and career readiness.
deadline_text: The page posts no intern application dates. Its only application notice is for worksite hosts: Summer 2026 applications are officially closed.

name: Career Connected Learning PHL (C2L-PHL) Summer Program
org: City of Philadelphia Office of Children and Families, with JEVS Human Services
what_you_do: The City funds this program. It includes paid service learning, project-based learning and internships. You learn about careers and get mentoring. You build work skills and shadow workers on the job.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. FAQ: summer applications open between March and April each year.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Northeast Philadelphia Composite Squadron
org: Civil Air Patrol, Northeast Philadelphia Composite Squadron (PA-214)
what_you_do: Go to weekly squadron meetings of the Civil Air Patrol. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
deadline_text: The page posts no application deadline and does not say whether enrollment is ongoing. Contact the squadron.

grades: Rising high school juniors and seniors with a background in biology, chemistry or research
name: Neuroscience Camp for High School Students, Drexel
org: Drexel University Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences and Professional Studies
what_you_do: This is a 10-day commuter camp. It has lectures and lab experiences. The topics are current topics in neuroscience.
deadline_text: The page says information about 2027 Summer Institutes will become available this winter. No 2026 or 2027 application dates are posted on this page.

name: Teen Lounge, Fleisher Art Memorial
what_you_do: Drop in after school for free art workshops (cyanotype photography, papermaking, book arts) and free studio days. Snacks and bus passes are provided.
deadline_text: Drop in during the school year, for Teen Lounge 2026-2027. Fall workshops started Tuesday, Sept 8, 2026, and that date has passed.

name: Immersion Science Program (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
what_you_do: Take an 11 week laboratory research training course on Saturdays at Fox Chase (about 30 lab hours), then present your results on week 11. The program says it is nearly all cost free for students.
deadline_text: The application launches in mid to late October each year and stays open about 3.5 weeks. The exact 2026 dates are not posted on the program page. Interviews are in early to mid December and letters go out by email before December 31.

name: PACTS (Partnership for Achieving Careers in Technology and Science), The Franklin Institute
what_you_do: Join one of three Saturday morning workshops: Robotics, Science in the City, or Science Investigators. They have career talks, mentoring and field trips. High school Franklin Ambassadors join each workshop to help the students.
deadline_text: The page has an Apply link but no dates for the current year.

grades: Apply as a high school freshman (grade 9)
name: STEM Scholars, The Franklin Institute
what_you_do: This is a free four-year STEM program. It starts in 9th grade. Each year has STEM programming. Rising seniors are paid for a 10-week lab research experience.
deadline_text: Applications for the next freshman cohort are closed as of Oct 11; the page says check back for the 2027 class. The FAQ says applications usually open late September or early October and are due mid-December. No 2027 dates are posted yet.

name: Young Volunteers at the Free Library of Philadelphia
what_you_do: Volunteer at Parkway Central Library or a neighborhood library. Teens shelve books, help with office tasks, or review books as a Teen Book Critic.
deadline_text: Rolling. Apply any time.

name: Teen Ambassadors, Independence Seaport Museum
what_you_do: Learn about the Delaware River, caring for nature, STEM and local history. Then share what you learn with visitors on the museum floor. Ambassadors also build speaking and teamwork skills.
deadline_text: The page says apply by April 20 (priority interviews); its flyer link is dated March 2026. Next dates not posted.

name: Teen and Adult Volunteer Program, Jefferson Abington Hospital
what_you_do: Help at a hospital just north of Philadelphia. You might help staff on patient floors, show people where to go, or sit with patients. You do not need any medical training.
deadline_text: Rolling. No deadline posted.

name: Summer Student Volunteer Program, Jefferson Health Northeast
org: Jefferson Health Northeast (Torresdale, Frankford and Bucks County hospitals)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital unit one day a week for eight summer weeks. Each day is four hours. You get an orientation and on-the-job training first.
deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates and no year. The 2024 packet said applications are accepted from February until April.

name: Philadelphia Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
city: Philadelphia, PA (campus; page lists transportation and no dorms)
what_you_do: Train for a career at no cost and work toward a high school diploma or equivalent. The center provides transportation. Training includes certified nurse assistant, clinical medical assistant, culinary arts, emergency medical technician, and more.
deadline_text: The pages show Apply and Get Started links but post no enrollment window and do not say applications are ongoing. Start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Dr. Charis Eng Monell Science Apprenticeship Program (MSAP)
what_you_do: Work full time for eight weeks on a research project with a Monell scientist. The program is described as paid, and apprentices cannot work more than 35 hours a week.
grades: Currently enrolled in high school or an undergraduate school
deadline_text: The page says applications for the Summer 2027 program will open in October 2026. The deadline is not posted yet.

name: Art Education high school programs (Mural Arts Philadelphia)
what_you_do: Take part in an art program that meets twice a week at a high school site, in school or after school. The page says students can go on to apply for scholarships, internships and jobs in the creative field.
deadline_text: Rolling admission is open (page). The fall session begins in late September 2026.

name: Living History Youth Summer Institute, Museum of the American Revolution
what_you_do: Spend six weeks learning to act as a person from history, in costume. You focus on the lives of people of African descent in the time of the Revolution. You go on field trips and do museum career workshops. It ends with a public Interpretation Day.
deadline_text: The page names a 2026 session but gives no application dates. The 2026 program is finished and no 2027 dates are posted.

name: Youth Council, Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
org: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts (PAFA)
what_you_do: Meet weekly after school at PAFA to make art and talk about it. You plan events for teens at the museum, work with staff and help with a teen art magazine.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 starts Oct 21, 2026; Spring 2027 starts Jan 27, 2027. No closing date is posted.

name: Become a Lifeguard, Philadelphia Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You train for free. You earn Red Cross lifeguard certification. Then you work as a lifeguard at a city pool through the summer.
deadline_text: Free training is offered year-round; reserve a slot on Eventbrite.

name: Parks and Rec Summer Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: You can work at recreation centers, playgrounds and Playstreets. You can also work on special initiatives. You help younger children. You build communication and leadership skills.
deadline_text: The page still says registration closed for the C2L-PHL Summer 2025 program. No 2026 or 2027 dates posted.

name: Provost's Summer Mentorship Program (Penn)
what_you_do: Spend four weeks on Penn's campus. Pair up with one of five Penn graduate and professional schools to see careers up close. Get lessons on financial literacy, study skills, time management, SAT prep and personal statements. It usually ends with a college fair.
grades: Currently 9th or 10th grade (entering 10th or 11th grade in fall 2027)
deadline_text: The page says the Summer Mentorship Program for 2027 will begin taking applications in January 2027. The deadline is not posted yet.

grades: Academies and Online Seminars: current 9th to 11th grade. Pre-College: current 10th to 11th grade.
name: Penn Arts and Sciences High School Summer Programs
org: University of Pennsylvania, Penn LPS High School Programs
what_you_do: Summer Academies (2 or 3 weeks, non-credit, residential), Pre-College (residential or online, for credit) and Online Seminars on topics like biomedical research, economics, forensic science and neuroscience.
deadline_text: 2026: May 1 for Academies and Pre-College Residential/Online Session I; June 1 for Online Seminars and Pre-College Online Session II. Rolling admissions. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Junior Volunteer Program (Student Ambassador Program), Pennsylvania Hospital
what_you_do: Help at a big Philadelphia hospital in the summer and see the jobs people do there. It is meant for teens who like health care, but anyone can apply.
deadline_text: The 2026 program closed early because of high demand. Applications for Summer 2027 open February 1, 2027. No closing date is posted, so apply early.

name: Police Explorer Cadet Program (Post 991)
org: Philadelphia Police Department, with Learning for Life
what_you_do: Learn about police work. You get mentoring, classroom lessons and hands-on drills. You meet every Saturday at the Police Academy. Cadets also help at parades, runs and city events.
deadline_text: The program site says applications are open for 2026-2027. No closing date is posted.

name: AIM Afterschool, Philadelphia Youth Network
what_you_do: Go to a supervised after-school program. It has homework help and career workshops. It also has activities for leadership and life skills.
deadline_text: The page says enrollment is open all year round.

name: NextGen Career Clubs, Philadelphia Youth Network
what_you_do: Meet three days a week after school for two hour sessions. You build job skills, earn credentials that employers know, visit workplaces and meet people who work in the field. Members get first pick for paid PYN internships.
deadline_text: Now recruiting at high schools across Philadelphia for Fall and Spring 2026/27. The page posts no closing date.

grades: Rising 9th to 12th grade (Junior PYNtern rising 9th to 10th; Senior PYNtern rising 11th to 12th)
name: PYNtern Program
what_you_do: This is paid work-based learning. It includes classroom training in professional skills. You get mentoring and career coaching. Rising juniors and seniors do about 100 hours at a paid worksite in the city.
deadline_text: Now recruiting for Summer and Fall 2026 (page). Summer applications open early March, fall/winter cohort early August, winter/spring cohort November.

name: City-Wide Philly Youth Opportunity Fair
what_you_do: Meet employers, schools, training programs and workforce groups in one place. Ask about first jobs, internships, career training and college paths.
deadline_text: Friday, October 23, 2026, 3:00 to 7:00 pm. Pre-registration deadline is Oct 15. The page says registration is not required to attend.

name: Career and Technical Education (CTE), School District of Philadelphia
what_you_do: Career programs in over 43 occupational areas (healthcare, IT, culinary, construction and more), a three-year course of study with work-based learning such as internships and apprenticeships.
deadline_text: Follow the School Selection timeline for middle schoolers; high schoolers ask their counselor.

name: Counselor-in-Training Program, Camp Schuylkill
what_you_do: You volunteer as a counselor-in-training. You work with the Camp Schuylkill nature day camp. You help lead younger campers.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was March 31, 2026. Camp Schuylkill runs on a weekly schedule from June 21 to August 13, 2027.

name: Wildlife Clinic Support Volunteer, Schuylkill Center
what_you_do: You support the wildlife clinic. The clinic treats injured and orphaned wild animals. Clinic Support is for ages 16 and up. Animal Care requires age 18.
deadline_text: The page lists 2026 in-person info sessions on February 7 and February 28 and no 2027 dates. It posts no deadline and does not say applications are ongoing. Submitting the online application is how to hear about future sessions.

name: Temple Summer Academy (pre-college)
what_you_do: Take one real college course for credit and two non-credit workshops in a four-week program on Temple campus, with study hour led by Temple student mentors. You can choose to live on campus.
deadline_text: The page says registration for Summer 2027 begins in December. No closing date was readable.

name: Temple Upward Bound and Upward Bound Math & Science
org: Temple University College of Education and Human Development
what_you_do: College prep all year. There is tutoring after school on weekdays, Saturday classes, college visits and a six-week summer program on campus. One track focuses on civic work and one on STEM.
deadline_text: Rolling applications. The page says the Summer Academy deadline is May 31.

name: Pre-College Summer Academy, Villanova University
org: Villanova University College of Professional Studies
what_you_do: Take one 3 credit college course with Villanova faculty and a 1 credit College Pathways course. It is a four-week summer program on campus. You can earn four college credits.
deadline_text: The page says applications for 2027 will close in the spring; no exact closing date is posted. The page says 2027 dates are being finalized, with classes expected in July.

name: High School Program in Biomedical Research (Wistar Institute)
what_you_do: Spend four weeks at the Wistar Institute (3601 Spruce Street) learning biomedical research, with 15 students in the program. Students attend Monday to Thursday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026 program has ended. The page says to check back in January for the 2027 summer program. Last year's cycle had interviews in April and decisions in the first week of May.

name: WorkReady BOOST (year-round paid career program)
what_you_do: Do 6 to 12 weeks of career training and paid work at partner sites around the city. You get job coaching, money lessons and resume workshops. You also go on tours of workplaces.
deadline_text: No closing date posted. The page still lists 2025 summer jobs, so check PYN for new openings.

name: WorkReady VIP (violence prevention paid work program)
what_you_do: Work a paid placement of 6 to 12 weeks at a partner group. You get mentoring, career coaching and support services that help prevent violence. The program aims to serve about 400 young people.
deadline_text: No closing date posted.

name: Youth Navigators, Philadelphia Works and PA CareerLink Philadelphia
what_you_do: Talk with a Youth Navigator at a PA CareerLink center. You can find job and training programs, first-job help and career resources for Philadelphia youth. The page also links to work permit help for ages 14 to 17.
deadline_text: Year-round help. Programs have their own dates.

name: Philadelphia Youth Commission
org: Mayor's Office of Youth Engagement, City of Philadelphia
what_you_do: Advise the Mayor, City Council and schools on issues that affect young people. Review laws. Run youth-led events and public service programs. You work in committees on education, public safety, health and recreation, and jobs and economics.
deadline_text: No application dates on the current page. The 2021 announcement said applications were reviewed on a rolling basis.

name: Volun-TEENS, Philadelphia Zoo
what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about animals and conservation. You use games and hands-on activities. You build public speaking, leadership and time management skills.
deadline_text: The page says to stay tuned for details about the next recruitment period; no dates listed.

name: Volunteer Program (ages 15 and up)
what_you_do: Greet guests, help with demonstrations and hands-on activities, and prep science kits. Teens can also lead activities.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: AZYouthforce Internships
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley (BGCAZ)
what_you_do: First finish the 30 hour AZYF Academy for skills, mentors and career help. Then work a paid internship. Current listings are the AZPlays sports group internship with BGCAZ and Junior Sports Leadership Specialist.
deadline_text: Fall internships were listed as open. No deadline posted. Process takes about a month.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Do hands on volunteer work with staff and adult volunteers in different Garden teams. Roles can be short projects, seasonal or ongoing.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Use the Sign Up link on the volunteer page.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Do a paid 5-week summer internship and job readiness workshops. Each participant gets a counselor.
deadline_text: Page says the 2026 application will open soon. No dates posted.

name: Medical and Nursing Explorers Clubs
what_you_do: Join a student run club that meets each month at a HonorHealth medical center. You explore health care careers (medical or nursing).
deadline_text: 2026-27 application is closed. 2027-28 application opens mid-May 2027.

name: Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Guide visitors and school tour groups through the music museum as a guide in one of several gallery roles. Training is provided.
deadline_text: No other deadline stated. The fall 2026 Museum Guide deadline of Sept 25, 2026 has passed.

name: Summer Lifeguard and Pool Jobs
org: City of Phoenix Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Work at a city pool. Jobs include lifeguard, shallow water lifeguard, swim lesson teacher, pool cashier or Buddy Bear mascot.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Certification classes are offered year-round.

name: Police Cadet Program
what_you_do: Meet on Tuesdays at 5:00 PM. Cadets serve a three-month probation with community service.
deadline_text: Orientations are held twice a year, before the school year and after winter break. Specific dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Summer Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help library staff with the Summer Reading program. Do it at a Phoenix library branch. Help for at least 4 weeks.
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened in April 2026 (release dated April 10, 2026). No deadline posted. Positions fill fast.

name: Phoenix R.I.S.E. Summer Internship
what_you_do: Work a paid part-time summer internship with the City of Phoenix to gain real work experience.
deadline_text: Applications closed for the summer 2026 session. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Sedav Vaaki Museum Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Greet museum guests at the front desk. Share facts about the Ancestral Sonoran Desert People. Help get supplies ready for events.
deadline_text: Recruitment stays open until all positions are filled. Then a waitlist is created. Applications for the spring round closed January 10, 2026.

name: St. Mary's Food Bank Volunteering
what_you_do: Volunteer a shift at the food bank. Pick a site and activity in the online portal. Families can sign up together.
deadline_text: Sign up any time.

name: ZooTeens Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer one 5-hour weekend shift a month at the Zoo, from August to May.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications closed May 31, 2026. Join the interest list for 2027-28 dates.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Piedmont Atlanta Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer at a major Atlanta hospital over eight summer weeks. You work at least one weekday shift a week for at least six of the eight weeks and explore health careers.
deadline_text: Application period Feb 26 to Mar 12, 2027. Mandatory orientation Monday June 7, 2027. Up to 30 teens accepted.

name: Teen Volunteers at Pikes Peak Library District
what_you_do: Teens can see current volunteer chances through a link on the library teen volunteer page. The page does not list specific duties.
deadline_text: The page does not list volunteer dates. It links to current teen volunteer opportunities and gives a contact for questions.

grades: Grades 6 to 12 (high school volunteers: grades 9 to 12 and at least 14)
name: Teen Volunteer Program, Piscataway Public Library
what_you_do: Help with library programs and special projects. Middle schoolers can join Adopt-a-Shelf. They help keep teen spaces and collections neat. They also advise on new purchases.
deadline_text: Adopt-a-Shelf: the Session 1 application period has ended; Session 2 applications open November 2 (year not stated on the page). High school volunteers attend an orientation session; check the library calendar for dates.

name: Pittsburg Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: Be the voice of Pittsburg youth to the City Council. You give advice on youth issues and help the recreation department plan and promote activities for young people.
deadline_text: The city code gives no application dates. Ask Pittsburg City Hall for the next opening.

name: AHN Junior Volunteer Program
org: Allegheny Health Network (Canonsburg Hospital and Wexford Health + Wellness Pavilion)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital or health center. Canonsburg roles listed include patient activity cart rounding, helping in the Serenity Room, handwashing observation and fall purposeful rounding.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.

name: Allegheny County Parks Lifeguard
city: Pittsburgh area, PA (Boyce, Settlers Cabin, South and North Park pools)
what_you_do: Guard county wave pools and swimming pools during the summer season. Work flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Your application packet must be on file before you can take a certification class or aquatics test.

name: Audubon Naturalists-in-Training (ANTS)
city: Fox Chapel and other ASWP nature sites, PA
what_you_do: Help staff lead summer nature day camps for kids ages 5 to 12. Start with a one-day, four-hour training. Service is 30 hours during the June and July day camps.
deadline_text: 2026 training was June 11, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at Beechwood Farms Nature Reserve. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Teen Workforce Pathways (Boys & Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania
what_you_do: Get hands-on experiences, mentors and a look at real careers in several industries. Join councils and internship pathways. Get help with resumes and interview prep through the Career Works High program.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: Summer Camp Teen Volunteers (Carnegie Museums)
org: Carnegie Museums of Pittsburgh (Natural History, Art and Powdermill Nature Reserve)
what_you_do: Help museum staff and camp educators. You help with learning activities that support campers. The camps are run by three groups. They are the Carnegie Museum of Natural History, the Carnegie Museum of Art and Powdermill Nature Reserve.
deadline_text: The Natural History form says the application period has closed and to check back in early 2027 for the next cycle. Dates for the next cycle are not posted.

name: City of Pittsburgh Citiparks Lifeguard
org: City of Pittsburgh Department of Parks and Recreation (Citiparks)
what_you_do: Guard City of Pittsburgh pools as a part-time seasonal lifeguard. Shifts include evenings, weekends and holidays.
deadline_text: The 2026 posting opened Feb 7, 2026 and closed Aug 3, 2026. The 2027 posting is not up yet.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Allegheny County Composite Squadron
org: Civil Air Patrol, Allegheny County Composite Squadron
what_you_do: Go to weekly squadron meetings of the Civil Air Patrol. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The squadron page links a Request Info form, and no application window is stated.

name: CS Scholars
what_you_do: You spend four weeks living on the CMU campus. You learn computer science through classes and group projects. You hear faculty lectures and visit tech companies. All costs are covered.
deadline_text: Application deadline February 1, 2027 (decisions April 1, 2027). The page does not post the date applications open.

name: Pre-College Programs (cost to you)
what_you_do: Live on or commute to the CMU campus for 3 to 6 weeks. Study architecture, art, design, drama or music. Also study computational biology or writing. You can also study culture. Pick the National High School Game Academy or college summer courses.
grades: 10th or 11th grade at time of application
deadline_text: Basic application (rolling admission) deadline March 1, 2027. Scholarship deadline February 1, 2027 (decisions April 1, 2027). The page does not post the date applications open.

name: Summer Academy for Math and Science (SAMS)
what_you_do: Six weeks on the CMU campus taking math and science courses, doing a STEM research project, and getting college application help. Fully funded and merit based.
deadline_text: Application deadline February 1, 2027 (decisions April 1, 2027). The page does not post the date applications open.

name: Pharmacy Exploration Day
what_you_do: One-day campus visit for high school students curious about pharmacy. Try a SimMan patient simulator, pharmacy compounding and an emergency medicine scenario, then take a campus tour.
deadline_text: 2027 dates: June 14, 15, 16, 24 and 25, 2027. No registration deadline is posted.

name: SiO2 High School Glass Art Classes
what_you_do: After-school glass art classes for grades 9 to 12 in glassblowing, flameworking and kilnforming. Beginner classes meet once a week for 10 weeks. Advanced classes meet for 12 weeks.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Use Register Now for current classes.

name: Urban Farmers in Training (UFIT)
what_you_do: Work on an urban farm from seed to harvest: plant, weed, mulch and harvest. You also join food system workshops, cook with farm produce and run a farm stand.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 2 to June 5, 2026 and are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Pittsburgh Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes highway construction. It includes cement masonry. Phlebotomy is another. So is clinical medical assistant. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at Kamin Science Center
org: Kamin Science Center (formerly Carnegie Science Center)
what_you_do: Greet visitors, help with exhibit demos and support science programs. Full training is provided. No science background is needed.
deadline_text: Summer Teen Program: applications open in January, deadline March 1. School Year Teen Program: applications June 1 to August 1 only. Both were closed on the day this page was read; the posted pattern is by month, with no year.

name: Tour Your Future (career tours)
city: Pittsburgh area, PA (tours at partner workplaces)
what_you_do: Take a guided tour of a real STEM workplace, talk with STEM professionals and try a hands-on activity. 2026 stops included a manufacturing lab, a CMU materials lab, Bidwell Training Center and a power station.
deadline_text: 2026 tours ran July 8 to Sept 20, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Teen L.E.A.D. (Leadership, Education, Assistance, Development)
what_you_do: After-school program with lessons on job prep and mock interviews, public speaking, financial literacy, college and trade school planning, life skills, art and field trips.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline posted. The page does not state a current start date.

name: Summer Learn & Earn
org: Partner4Work, Allegheny County and City of Pittsburgh
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job at a local business, nonprofit or community group. You get coaching on workplace skills and career paths.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 2 to June 5, 2026 and are closed. The page says applications are accepted in the spring; 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Make-A-Wish Youth Leadership Council (Greater Pittsburgh)
org: Make-A-Wish Greater Pennsylvania and West Virginia
what_you_do: Meet with Make-A-Wish staff and learn how nonprofits work. The groups support granting wishes for children with critical illnesses. In-person members attend monthly meetings.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Meeting days are set by the group at its first meeting.

name: Teen Art Cooperative
what_you_do: Meet weekly at the museum to meet artists. You take field trips to local art spaces and learn about creative jobs. You also plan a public event made by teens for teens.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 call closed Sept 15, 2025 and the first session was Oct 9, 2025. The 2026-27 call was not found on the page.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at National Aviary
what_you_do: You help run bird shows and lorikeet feedings. You help at summer camp. You lead education cart activities. You prepare enrichment for the birds. Staff mentor you each day.
deadline_text: The 2026 application period has closed. For 2026 the group interviews were April 11 and April 18, 2026 and the orientation was May 30, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Young Naturalists
what_you_do: Five-week outdoor program in Frick Park with research and restoration work in the park. The program also has an overnight team-building retreat in the Laurel Highlands.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened March 2 and closed May 8, 2026. Interviews with the student and a parent ran April 20 to May 15. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: EcoLeader Academy
what_you_do: Take a seven-week course at Phipps. Topics are climate change, energy, pollution, food, environmental justice and green careers. It has classes, workshops and service projects. It ends with a Youth Garden Summit.
deadline_text: The 2026 group is closed. The page offers a form to be told when the next group opens. The 2026 classes ran mid June to late July.

name: Summer Camp Teen Volunteers (Phipps)
what_you_do: Help camp instructors design and prepare crafts. Work with children ages 2 to 12. Clean up after daily activities at Phipps summer camps.
deadline_text: The volunteer page says applications are due Thursday, October 22, 2026, but that line sits in a different volunteer section and the page does not say it covers teen volunteers. No teen deadline is posted, so ask Phipps. Camps run June to August.

name: Gene Team
org: University of Pittsburgh, Department of Biological Sciences
what_you_do: Spend weekdays in a Pitt lab working on a current research project with other high school students, with Pitt faculty nearby for help. Weekly sessions cover applying to college.
grades: Finished one year of high school biology
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open in spring 2027 and are due at the end of March, with interviews in April and acceptance notices by mid May. The exact due date is not posted yet.

name: Public Health Science Academy
org: University of Pittsburgh School of Public Health
what_you_do: This is a four week summer program at Pitt Public Health. It has talks and panels on public health careers. It has a team research project and a poster symposium. It also has field trips. You are matched with a Pitt faculty mentor.
deadline_text: The 2026 application ran Feb 4 to March 14, 2026, and is closed. The 2027 dates are not posted yet. Expect a similar winter to March window.

name: Accelerated Career Awareness Program (ACAP)
what_you_do: A week on campus learning about accounting jobs. You tour local firms that do accounting. You practice interviews, meeting people, public speaking and college planning.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran July 26 to 31, 2026. The page listed no application deadline. 2027 dates are not posted.
org: Point Park University (Rowland School of Business)

grades: Entering grades 9 to 12 (or a high school graduate of that year)
name: Point Park CSI Summer Camp
what_you_do: A week of crime scene work. You work a crime scene house and study fingerprints and hair clues with lab staff. You also tour the Allegheny County Medical Examiner and Jail.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran July 20 to 24 and July 27 to 31. No registration deadline was listed. 2027 dates are not posted.

grades: Entering grades 9 to 12 (or a high school graduate of that year)
name: Point SPARK Entrepreneurship Camp
what_you_do: Three days of hands-on workshops and mentoring. You come up with a startup idea, work on product design and customer research, practice public speaking and give a closing pitch.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 29 to July 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted. No registration deadline was listed.
org: Point Park University (Rowland School of Business)

grades: Entering grades 9 to 12 (or a high school graduate of that year)
name: Point Park Sports Business Camp
what_you_do: Three days of learning about jobs in sports business. People who work for local teams like the Pirates, Penguins, Steelers and Riverhounds teach you. Each day has a behind-the-scenes tour of a sports site.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 29 to July 1, 2026 and was full with a waitlist. 2027 dates are not posted.
org: Point Park University (Rowland School of Business)

name: Pittsburgh Urban Green High School Program
what_you_do: Join a 10-person crew for a summer of paid conservation work.
deadline_text: The page says there are no current openings and to check back. Past summers ran from the last week of June to the first week of August.

name: Teen Volunteer Program at UPMC Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh
what_you_do: You volunteer one shift a week. The shift is in an approved area of the children's hospital. Examples are the sibling center or therapy gym. Hospital staff supervise you.
deadline_text: The hospital is not accepting new teen applications for this calendar year and says to check back in early January for next year's process.

name: UPMC Hillman Cancer Center Academy
org: UPMC Hillman Cancer Center and University of Pittsburgh
what_you_do: Join a mentored research team in a lab. There are nine research sites at Pitt and UPMC. It runs for about seven weeks in the summer. Topics include cancer biology, computer science and biomedical informatics.
grades: High school (seniors allowed if not taking college courses that summer)
deadline_text: Application window: December 3, 2026 to February 14, 2027.

name: Teen DJ Academy
org: The Andy Warhol Museum with Tech25
what_you_do: Learn to DJ in a free 12-week workshop led by professional DJs. You use pro gear, make your own mixes and perform live at events like Youth Invasion and the LGBTQ+ Prom.
deadline_text: The Warhol page says applications are now closed. Next dates are not posted.

name: Youth Arts Council
what_you_do: Go behind the scenes at the museum. Meet professional artists. Learn silkscreen printing. Plan teen events such as Youth Invasion.
deadline_text: The application deadline was Friday, October 9, 2026. Weekly meetings start October 15, 2026.

name: Summer Zoo Teen Program
what_you_do: You volunteer one day a week at the zoo. You handle and care for ambassador animals. You guide guests at exhibits. You run touch tables and animal talks.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 program open December 15, 2026 and stay open through mid-January 2027. The exact closing date is not posted.

name: Green Teens
what_you_do: Meet about twice a month at the zoo. You talk about conservation, hear from experts, take behind-the-scenes tours and go on field trips. Teens also help with projects like pulling invasive plants in local parks.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 season were due Aug 1, 2026 and are closed. Next season is not posted.

name: Roots Rising Youth Crews
what_you_do: Teens work on farm crews and at the Pittsfield Farmers Market, with workshops. Fall and spring crews include transportation.
deadline_text: No dates posted. There are three crew seasons a year.

name: Planting Justice Youth Internships
what_you_do: You do a paid youth internship at an urban farm and nursery. You learn sustainable farming, food distribution and school gardens. You get job training. You get food safety certifications. Community mentors help you.
deadline_text: Not posted

name: Facilities Specialist Custodian
org: Pleasant Hill Recreation and Park District
what_you_do: Clean and set up community buildings for classes and events. You also help people who rent the rooms. The work is part time, at night and on weekends.
deadline_text: Open until filled.

name: Pleasant Hill Teen Council
org: Pleasant Hill Recreation and Park District
what_you_do: Help develop, plan and carry out events, classes, dances, sports and trips for teens.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated. The page says to stop by the Teen Center or email the Youth Services Manager.

grades: Junior high and senior high students are encouraged
name: Pleasant Home Volunteer Docents (students welcome)
org: Park District of Oak Park (Pleasant Home)
what_you_do: Be a volunteer docent at Pleasant Home, a National Historic Landmark. You share its history and building style with visitors. You help make their visit one to remember.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Aquatics Junior Volunteers (Junior Lifeguard and Junior Swim Instructor)
org: City of Pleasanton Library and Recreation, Dolores Bengtson Aquatic Center
what_you_do: You pick one of two pool jobs. As a Junior Lifeguard you watch small pool areas with the lifeguards. As a Junior Swim Instructor you help teach kids to swim.
deadline_text: The 2026 packet said applications were due April 15, 2026. Orientations were April 22 and 23, 2026. The next season is not posted.

name: Pleasanton Youth Commission
what_you_do: Students are appointed to a city commission. They give the City Council advice. They give feedback on community issues that affect young people.
grades: Middle school, 9th grade, or 11th grade seats (fall 2026 recruitment)
deadline_text: Fall 2026 recruitment: apply by 5:00 PM on Tuesday, August 18, 2026. That deadline has passed. The next recruitment date is not posted.

name: San Mateo Police Cadet (Explorer) Program
what_you_do: You go to training classes and monthly meetings. You finish a required 9 week Police Cadet Academy on Sundays. You do at least 10 volunteer hours a month in community service.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A recruiter contacts you after you send the application.

name: Hayward Police Explorer Program
what_you_do: You attend Wednesday night meetings and training. You go on ride-alongs. You help with traffic and crowd control at events. You join Explorer competitions.
deadline_text: Applications are taken twice a year, in January and July (page gives no exact dates). The next window is expected in January 2027.

name: Morgan Hill Police Explorer Program
what_you_do: You get practical police training, volunteer at community events, and compete in statewide Explorer competitions with police scenarios. Officers and dispatchers lead the program.
deadline_text: No deadline posted.

name: Oakland Police Explorers
what_you_do: You go to weekly meetings with law enforcement. You do physical training and go on ride-alongs. You do community service details. You also attend conferences.
deadline_text: No intake dates posted. Contact the coordinator.

name: Pomona College Academy for Youth Success (PAYS)
what_you_do: This is a free 4-week residential summer program at Pomona College. After that, there is year-round involvement for three years. It helps local students prepare for selective colleges.
deadline_text: The apply page lists the 2026-2027 dates. Application opens Nov 9, 2026. Application and transcript due Feb 22, 2027. Recommendation form due Mar 1, 2027. Decisions come Apr 16, 2027.

name: High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You volunteer one shift a week in the hospital. It helps you explore medical careers.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page says the hospital is currently only accepting adult applications, so high school applications may be closed.

name: Legacy Good Samaritan Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteers help patients, families and staff. Roles include gift shop, patient escort, greeter and office help. They also include garden and pet therapy.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The page says to wait for the application to re-open if you want a different Legacy hospital.

grades: Rising 9th to 12th grade (rising 10th to 12th for writing and art)
name: Lewis and Clark Precollege Summer Programs
what_you_do: Take a summer program on campus. Subjects include health careers, data, theatre, studio art, writing and debate.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates for five programs are not set yet on the program page. The balance is due by May 1, 2027.

name: Multnomah County Library Teen Council
what_you_do: Teen council members meet twice a month and work with library staff to improve services. Members earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Ask your branch.

name: Multnomah County Library Volunteering
what_you_do: Volunteer at a library branch. The roles vary by branch and change often. Check the volunteer page for open roles.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Allow 1 to 2 weeks for processing.

name: Multnomah Youth Commission
org: Multnomah County and City of Portland (Office of Community and Civic Life)
what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise the Multnomah County Board and Portland City Council. They advise on choices that affect young people. They push for a youth policy plan.
deadline_text: The page says applications were due April 18, 2025, and it was last reviewed February 20, 2025. The next cycle is not posted.

name: Northwest Youth Corps Portland Youth Community Crews
what_you_do: A 5 week day program. Crews of 8 to 9 teens plant trees, pull invasive plants, build trails and put up fences around Portland. They get a daily lesson, then go home.
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted; the 2027 application cycle is not posted. Dates may change.

name: OHSU Experience health careers day camp
what_you_do: A free 1 day camp at OHSU. It has hands on medical practice, talks from experts and a look at careers in medicine, nursing and research.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the OHSU Experience are now closed. It gives no reopening date. 2027 dates not posted.

name: OHSU Healthcare Volunteer Summer Program
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at OHSU. They guide patients and families to appointments. Or they help kids in a clinic waiting room as Art Cart helpers (16+). Or they play music (14+, audition).
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says the 2027 Summer Program opens in January 2027.

name: Knight Scholars Program
what_you_do: High school students explore cancer research and care careers. First comes a 1 week intro at OHSU. Then 10 week programs mix lab or shadowing time with work in their home communities.
deadline_text: The page says there is no summer program in 2026 and to check back in the fall of 2026.

name: OMSI Camp Counselor (Camp Gray and Camp Hancock)
what_you_do: Summer camp counselors look after campers. They ride the bus to camp and stay in cabins. They lead games, cabin activities and campfires at an overnight science camp in Oregon.
deadline_text: The page says "Check back for Summer 2027!" It does not say whether counselor applications are open.

name: OMSI Teen Volunteer
org: Oregon Museum of Science and Industry (OMSI)
what_you_do: Teens 14 and up volunteer in the museum. They run exhibit activities in the Featured Exhibit Hall. They usher planetarium shows. They help at The Mezz teen space.
deadline_text: The page shows an Apply Now link and gives no deadline or application window. Interviews happen once a month.

name: The Mezz teen maker space at OMSI
org: Oregon Museum of Science and Industry (OMSI)
what_you_do: A free maker space for ages 13 to 18. It has music and recording, sewing, digital design, 3D printing, and photo and video. Teens work on their own projects, and staff can help.
deadline_text: Drop in during open hours. No deadline.

name: Oregon Food Bank Volunteering
what_you_do: Sort and re-pack food at the Portland and Beaverton sites. Help with seasonal garden projects and offsite food markets.
deadline_text: Sign up any time. Everyone must register ahead of time.

name: Oregon Humane Youth Volunteers (Portland campus)
what_you_do: Youth volunteers walk dogs and play with them. They also play with cats and small animals and help keep the shelter clean and healthy.
deadline_text: Next application window opens 11 am November 30 and closes 6 pm December 4. The page does not print the year. Windows typically open in December and again in June.

name: Oregon Zoo Wildlife Leaders
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo and lead activities for guests. They do hands on nature work around the Portland area and learn about zoo careers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications have closed. Applications usually open in January and stay open about three weeks. Check the page for summer 2027.

name: Synapse: Health Career Explorations
org: Pacific University, Oregon Healthcare Workforce Institute (OHWI) AHEC
what_you_do: A week long summer camp with job shadows, practice cases, tours, workshops and panels. It helps students decide if a health care career fits.
deadline_text: 2026 registration ran March 16 to May 25, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Portland Parks lifeguard and swim instructor certification
what_you_do: Take a lifeguard, swim teacher or water fitness teacher class with the city. Then apply to work at Portland pools. The lifeguard class gives First Aid, CPR and StarGuard Lifeguard certificates.
deadline_text: Classes run year-round. Register on the page; join the waitlist if a class is full. The page lists no class dates, so use each class link to see its schedule.

name: Portland Parks and Recreation seasonal youth jobs
what_you_do: Summer jobs in programs like swimming and summer camps. The bureau hires over 1,500 people ages 14 to 24 in a typical year.
deadline_text: Summer hiring usually starts in the winter, around January and February. Spring career fairs were held March 24 and 28, 2026.

name: PDX Youth@Work and SummerWorks
org: Worksystems, Inc. (with the City of Portland, City of Gresham and David Douglas School District)
what_you_do: Paid work with local employers, with hands on skill building. Some tracks focus on fields like building, clean energy, health care and making things.
deadline_text: No application dates posted. The page does not say whether applications are open. The page links to the PDX Youth@Work Interest Form.

name: PNCA Pre-College summer art and design programs
org: Pacific Northwest College of Art (PNCA) at Willamette University, Community Education
what_you_do: 2 week Intensives and 1 week Studios. You draw, paint, animate and illustrate with PNCA teachers and artists. You build portfolio work. You meet admissions staff for a portfolio review.
deadline_text: Applications open fall 2026. 2027 dates: early application Mar 28, early registration Apr 11, application deadline May 2, registration deadline June 6 (rolling until full).

name: Providence Portland Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: Help at Providence Portland. You might greet and guide visitors or help a hospital team. You help make the stay better for patients.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Apply any time; staff match applicants to open spots.

name: Providence St. Vincent Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: Help at Providence St. Vincent. You might greet and guide visitors or help a hospital team. You help make the stay better for patients.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Apply any time; staff match applicants to open spots.

name: Portland Youth Conservation Crew
what_you_do: Teen crews work outdoors on trails, trees, community gardens or natural areas. They pull invasive plants, build trails and fences, make maps and care for trees.
deadline_text: The 2026 season ended. Next summer job applications will be posted early next year (watch the City of Portland job page).

name: YouthLine Peer Crisis Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer with a crisis line for young people. Complete 65 or more hours of training and shadowing first.
deadline_text: Orientations are held monthly. Dates are not listed on the program page.

name: Pretend City Children's Museum Volunteers and Teen Programs
what_you_do: At a children's museum, you can volunteer in administration, field trips or special events. You can also lead a short activity for kids. You can be a TeensTeach or TeensTable teen presenter.
deadline_text: No deadline. Teen program submissions are rolling and spots are limited.

name: Prince William Public Libraries Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Student volunteers help at library branches. The page says there is a wide range of activities but does not list them.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: High schoolers build leadership skills. They meet twice a month, on the first and third Tuesdays at 7 pm. They give 10 volunteer hours over the school year.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 deadline was Sept 4 at 5 pm. The page says applications for 2027-28 open in July 2027.

name: Teen Summer Volunteer (TSV)
what_you_do: Teens give at least 10 hours in one role. The roles are Literacy Advocate (online), Maker Assistant (Mondays and Wednesdays, 2 to 4 pm) and Program Intern. Teens also finish Teen Summer Reading.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 open April 15, 2027. In the usual cycle they close June 5 at 5 pm and decisions come June 15.

name: Peer-to-Peer Service Collective for Teens
what_you_do: Pitch your own workshop or activity for other teens and families. If chosen, library staff help you shape it, promote it and present it at a library branch. Builds planning and public speaking skills.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 submissions are open Sept 21 to Oct 31, 2026. The spring window is Feb 1 to Feb 28, 2027. Online info session Oct 13, 2026, 5-6 pm.

name: Queens Public Library Teen Volunteering (ages 14-17)
what_you_do: You can volunteer on library projects in Queens. Roles can be ongoing or one-day events. Hours earn community service credit. You can ask for a Service Verification Letter.
deadline_text: Minors can apply year-round. Approval and placement can take up to 30 days, longer in summer and fall.

name: Marbles Teen Play Corps
what_you_do: Play with young kids at a children's museum. You help in the exhibits, programs, camps and events, and give at least 30 service hours a year.
deadline_text: Apply December 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027 (5 PM). You must first attend an information session with a parent or guardian: Nov 14, Dec 10, 2026, or Jan 16, 2027. Decisions by early March 2027.

name: UNC Health Rex VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: Help at a hospital in Raleigh for one shift a week. You may greet people, check on patient rooms, help patients go home, stock supplies, bring flowers, or run errands for nurses.
grades: 10th to 12th grade (finished 9th grade before the program starts)
deadline_text: The 2027 Summer application is online only from March 11, 2027 to March 12, 2027. Interviews March 22 to 25, orientation April 26 to 29, and you must volunteer the first week (June 21 to 25).

name: TWIG: Teens Working in the Garden (Red Butte Garden)
org: Red Butte Garden, University of Utah
what_you_do: Work next to horticulture staff doing weeding, raking, pruning and other garden jobs. Learn about plants, build job skills and work as a team.
deadline_text: The page says dates, schedules and the application will be announced. It says to check back in the spring.

name: American Red Cross Babysitting and Child Care Training
what_you_do: You take a Red Cross course on caring for infants and children, safety and emergencies. The online option also covers starting a babysitting business.
deadline_text: Ongoing.

name: American Red Cross Lifeguard and Water Safety Instructor courses
org: American Red Cross (taught by local pools, cities and YMCAs)
what_you_do: You can take Red Cross courses for lifeguarding or swim instruction. Lifeguard students must be 15 by the last day of class and pass a swimming skills test.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Class dates depend on the provider.

name: Red River Zoo Wildlife League
