what_you_do: Teens volunteer on weekends in zoo departments such as Guest Services, Zookeeping, Grounds and Education. They also work two zoo events each trimester. Examples are Chalkfest, Boo at the Zoo and Lunch with Santa Claus.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline or trimester dates.

name: Teen Volunteer Program (A.K. Smiley Public Library)
org: A.K. Smiley Public Library, City of Redlands
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library in fall, winter/spring or summer sessions, or at one-day community events. You can earn community service hours.
deadline_text: No specific dates posted. Email to ask what is open now.

name: Junior (Student) Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital in a placement, at least one 2-hour shift a week. Some assignments have after-school, early evening or weekend shifts.
deadline_text: The page says junior recruitment opens from time to time during the year. No dates posted.

name: Red Rock Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes human services and collision repair. It includes carpentry and electrical. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Redwood City Leaders in Training (L.I.T.)
org: City of Redwood City Parks, Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Teens ages 13 to 15 get training. Then they help camp staff with kids at Redwood City summer camps. Activities include group games, sports, arts and crafts and field trips.
deadline_text: 2026: applications opened April 20 and were due May 8, 2026; interviews May 18 to 21; training June 13. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF)
what_you_do: It is the world's largest pre-college science fair. You first win a spot at a local fair affiliated with the Society for Science, then compete at ISEF in 22 categories.
deadline_text: ISEF is in Los Angeles in May 2027 (exact dates not posted on the program pages). Affiliated fairs end by mid-April, and each fair sets its own deadline, so find yours now.

name: Regeneron Science Talent Search
what_you_do: High school seniors submit an independent research project. The top 300 get recognition. The top 40 compete in Washington for awards.
deadline_text: Applications close Nov 5, 2026 at 8 p.m. ET (opened June 1, 2026). Top 300 announced Jan 7, 2027; Top 40 announced Jan 21, 2027; finals week Mar 11 to 17, 2027.

name: Regional Medical Center Junior Volunteer Program
org: Santa Clara Valley Healthcare, Regional Medical Center
what_you_do: For your first 100 hours, you work at the front desks or the volunteer office. Later tasks include helping patients go home, bringing food, answering phones and handing out clothes.
deadline_text: Closed now. The junior application window opens January 1, 2027 and closes January 7, 2027. Applications sent at other times are not considered.

name: City of Reno Junior Lifeguards

name: Future Civic Leaders
org: City of San Diego (Internship and Work Readiness Program)
what_you_do: Learn about local government and build leadership skills. You meet in person once a month and online every week. You do volunteer projects, go on City job shadows and join skill workshops.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed on the application page.

name: Recreation Aide and Pool Guard (City of San Diego Aquatics)
org: City of San Diego Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: You work at city pools. Recreation Aides give customer service to the aquatics community. They train to be lifeguards. Pool Guards need no certification.
deadline_text: Year-round hiring. Pool Guard hiring events are monthly; Recreation Aide interviews are quarterly.

name: San Diego Youth Commission
org: City of San Diego (Office of Child and Youth Success)
what_you_do: Advise the Mayor and City Council about youth issues. Examples are school, jobs, housing and mental health. You learn about city life, public policy and leadership. You also practice networking.
deadline_text: The page invites youth to apply now. No deadline, application window or open-seat count is listed.

name: Teen Service Learner
what_you_do: You help branch staff organize library materials. You take part in library events. You earn community service hours and work experience.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Ask your branch.

name: Cuyamaca College Dual and Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes for credit while still in high school. Classes can count for both high school and college. You can take up to 11 units (4 classes) on campus or online.
deadline_text: Start at least one month before the semester or session. No set deadline on the page.

name: Feeding San Diego Volunteer
what_you_do: Help pack and hand out food. In the Distribution Center, volunteers are 6 and up. At food distributions out in the community, volunteers are 14 and up.
deadline_text: No deadline.

name: San Diego Fire-Rescue Cadet Program
org: San Diego Fire-Rescue Department (City of San Diego)
what_you_do: Learn fire and rescue skills in training taught by SDFD staff, such as vehicle extrication, search and rescue, rope rescue, CPR and advanced first aid. Certified cadets can do ride-alongs with fire crews. A one week Cadet Academy runs each summer.
deadline_text: New cadets are accepted quarterly. No dates are posted.

name: San Diego Food Bank Volunteer Shifts
what_you_do: Sort and bag produce, pack food boxes and bags, and help at community food distributions. No training needed. A short orientation starts each shift.
deadline_text: No deadline. All volunteer visits must be scheduled in advance.

name: JA Fellows and Summer Youth Employment Program
org: Junior Achievement of San Diego County
what_you_do: JA Fellows is a daily class for juniors and seniors on money, the local economy and work skills. It has mentors and job shadows. Fellows ages 16 to 18 can join the summer program. The page calls it paid learning that links to careers.
deadline_text: No student application dates posted. The 2026 summer timeline listed student recruitment in April and the program start in June.

name: JA Stock Market Challenge
org: Junior Achievement of San Diego County
what_you_do: Finish the JA Take Stock in Your Future lessons. Then practice investing in a stock market contest and build a long-term plan.
deadline_text: Event date: Mar 18, 2027. More details will be shared later.

name: La Jolla Playhouse Summer Conservatory
what_you_do: Take an acting intensive with Playhouse artists. Rising 8th and 9th graders do a 9 day program. Rising 10th to 12th graders do a 3 week program with advanced training.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed Apr 6, 2026. Summer 2027 applications are expected to open on or around Feb 1, 2027. 2027 dates are not set.

name: Playhouse Teen Council
what_you_do: Join a group of high schoolers who learn how a pro theater works. You see shows and meet artists. You plan events that bring young people to the Playhouse.
deadline_text: 2026/27 applications ran Aug 3 to Sept 4, 2026. Next year is not posted yet; expect a similar late summer window.

name: Camp Aides (Youth Volunteers)
org: San Diego Natural History Museum (The Nat)
what_you_do: Help professional educators run summer camps at the museum. The camps are for Pre-K through 8th grade.
deadline_text: Page says recruitment for camp aides begins in May. No 2027 dates posted.

name: Palomar College Concurrent Enrollment for High Schoolers
city: San Marcos, Escondido, Fallbrook and Rancho Bernardo, CA
what_you_do: Take real college classes at Palomar on campus or online while you are in high school. Dual enrollment classes can also be taught at some high schools. The classes count toward a college certificate or degree.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Check the Palomar calendar for each term.

name: Palomar UC San Diego Health Junior Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Poway or Escondido hospital. The page lists general roles such as lobby ambassador, escort, desk, book cart and rehab, but does not say which are open to juniors. You complete at least 100 service hours.
deadline_text: Applications are taken all year.

name: San Diego Parks and Recreation Volunteer Program
org: City of San Diego Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Help with park clean-ups, tree planting, youth sports and recreation programs. You can also help at community events. There are roles at Tecolote Nature Center, aquatics, golf and AgeWell Services.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: San Diego Police Cadet Program
org: San Diego Police Department (City of San Diego)
what_you_do: A volunteer role with no police powers. Cadets train twice a month and go on ride-alongs. They help with traffic control and security at community events.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Recruiting meetings are held on the second Tuesday of each month at 5 p.m.

name: Teen Team Program Assistant
org: San Diego Public Library (City of San Diego)
what_you_do: Join a branch Teen Team. Help library staff plan and lead programs, support teen outreach at community events, and work on special projects.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time through the City volunteer system.

grades: Grades 8 to 11 (College Apps Academy is for grade 12)
name: Reality Changers College Town
what_you_do: A free after-school and summer program. You get tutoring, mentoring and college workshops and tours. You also go on service trips, try career experiences and practice public speaking. The page says partners offer access to internships and college courses.
deadline_text: Applications are taken all year. All applicants are added to a waitlist, and staff follow up with next steps.

name: Research Experience for High School Students (REHS)
org: San Diego Supercomputer Center, UC San Diego
what_you_do: Work for 8 weeks on a real computing research project with a UC San Diego mentor and grad students. You learn to test ideas with code and finish with a scientific poster.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 15 to Mar 15, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Sharp Grossmont Hospital Junior Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer at Sharp Grossmont Hospital for at least one year, with one shift a week or two shifts a month.
deadline_text: As of Oct 9, 2026 the page says it is no longer accepting applicants from the high school class of 2028. That means current 9th and 10th graders (classes of 2029 and 2030) may still apply. No deadline is posted.

name: Sharp Memorial and Mary Birch High School Volunteers
org: Sharp Memorial Hospital and Sharp Mary Birch Hospital (Sharp HealthCare)
what_you_do: Greet and guide patients and families, help on nursing units with phones and errands, work in a gift shop, or join Arts for Healing programs. Shifts are 3 to 4 hours a week.
deadline_text: The high school application is closed, and the page does not say when it will reopen. The adult and college applications reopen Oct 19.

name: UC San Diego Bioengineering Research Scholars
org: UC San Diego Department of Bioengineering and Division of Extended Studies
city: La Jolla, San Diego, CA (live online)
what_you_do: Take live online bioengineering courses with a loaner lab kit. Start with an intro course, then a research workshop, then plan and carry out your own project with a university lab.
deadline_text: Winter 2027 application deadline Dec 18, 2026, with a last call through Jan 3, 2027. Space is limited and may fill sooner.

name: UC San Diego Health Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help patients and staff in hospitals and clinics. Tasks include moving patients, running errands, stocking and lab deliveries. You also greet visitors and visit with patients.
deadline_text: No general deadline is listed, and the page does not confirm 2026 intake dates. Summer-only applicants must apply between Mar 1 and Apr 15, and say so on the application.

name: UC San Diego Marine Science Research Scholars
org: UC San Diego Division of Extended Studies (with Scripps Institution of Oceanography mentors)
city: La Jolla, San Diego, CA (live online)
what_you_do: Take live online ocean science courses in three levels. Level 1 teaches marine biology. Level 2 is hands-on research with Scripps graduate students. Level 3 builds science writing and a chance to publish.
deadline_text: Winter 2027 applications are listed as coming soon. The Fall 2026 deadline (Sept 17, 2026) has passed.

name: San Diego Workforce Partnership youth career services
what_you_do: You can sign up for free career centers. They offer training and one-on-one coaching. Some people get paid on-the-job work experience.
deadline_text: No deadline. The online application takes about 10 to 15 minutes, then staff contact you about next steps.

name: San Jose Middle College (San Jose City College)
org: San Jose Unified School District with San Jose City College
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take 2 to 3 free college classes. Those are 6 to 9 college credits. They also take 4 high school classes. This is on the San Jose City College campus. You earn a high school diploma and transferable college credit.
deadline_text: Not stated on the San Jose City College page. Ask the Middle College office for the application timeline.

name: San Jose Public Library Teen Volunteers (Teens Reach, Teen Book Reviewer)
what_you_do: Join Teens Reach, the library youth council, to help with kids crafts and Summer Learning sign-ups and to speak up as a library advisor. Or earn service hours by writing book reviews as a Teen Book Reviewer.
deadline_text: Rolling. Each branch has its own Teens Reach sign-up. No single deadline.

name: San Jose Works
org: City of San Jose (work2future and Mayor's Gang Prevention Task Force)
what_you_do: You can get paid work experience and job help in San Jose. If you are 14 to 18 and face barriers to work, you can be placed in paid jobs and training. Job services are open to ages 16 to 29.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the city pages. Apply any time with the online youth application.

name: San Jose Youth Commission and Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Teens advise the San Jose Mayor and City Council on youth issues. The Youth Commission is closed. The Youth Advisory Council (YAC) has an apply page, but it says some districts are paused.
deadline_text: Youth Commission: recruitment is closed, no reopening date posted. Youth Advisory Council: the page has an apply button but does not say if it is open, and says some districts are unavailable or paused. No deadline posted.

name: San Leandro Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: You help library staff run programs for younger kids, or help with kit assembly, shelving and displays. You work one shift of 2 to 3 hours a week.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back in November 2026. Summer applications open in mid March, per the summer page.

name: San Leandro Youth Advisory Commission
org: City of San Leandro Recreation and Parks
what_you_do: You give the City Council feedback. The feedback is on issues that affect young people. You help run city events like Pumpkin Splash and the Egg Hunt.
deadline_text: The page does not say when applications open.

name: Jobs for Youth (County of San Mateo)
org: County of San Mateo Human Resources
what_you_do: You can take free job-skills workshops. You can use a members-only job and internship board. There are twenty $2,000 scholarships a year for San Mateo County youth. The county summer internship is for ages 18 to 21.
deadline_text: Membership: the page has an online student registration form but gives no dates or ongoing-intake statement. Workshop dates: email jobsforyouth@smcgov.org. Summer internship: 2026 applications are closed; applications for next summer open early 2027. Scholarship deadline not stated.

name: San Mateo County Libraries Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens shelve books, help with kids' crafts and STEM programs, join outreach events or support the makerspace.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Openings vary by branch and there may be a waiting period.

name: San Pablo Summer Internship Program
org: City of San Pablo Youth, School, and Community Partnerships
what_you_do: Work a paid summer internship in a city department. You get hands-on experience in local government and build job skills. In 2025 the city hosted nine interns.
deadline_text: The page says applications open every January and are due in March. The exact dates for next year are not posted.

name: San Pablo Youth Commission (SPYC)
org: City of San Pablo Youth, School, and Community Partnerships
what_you_do: Speak up for youth in San Pablo and learn how local government works. The commission builds youth leaders and works to improve chances for young people in the city.
deadline_text: The page says the city is taking online applications now. It gives no closing date.

name: Leaders in Training (LIT)
org: City of San Ramon Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Learn leadership and job skills in class. Then volunteer for a week at a time at city summer camps. You work with kids and learn from staff.
deadline_text: The 2026 program is full and closed. The page says to check back in March for next year.

name: Teen Service and Leadership (TSL)
org: City of San Ramon Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Take 8 classes on teamwork, resumes, interviews and local government. Then do at least 3 volunteer shifts. Your class also helps host an event for people with special needs.
deadline_text: The fall 2026 class runs Thursdays, Oct 1 to Nov 19, 2026. The page gives no sign-up deadline. Call to ask if spots are left.

name: SPARK High School Internship
org: Sanford Burnham Prebys Medical Discovery Institute
what_you_do: Spend six summer weeks as a fully paid intern in a biomedical research lab.
deadline_text: Next application dates not posted on the page. Use the Request Info form or email the program director.

name: Sanford Health Sioux Falls Volunteer Program (Ages 16 and Up)
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital and clinics. Jobs include escort, greeter, gift shop helper and aide. Units include rehab and cardiology. One is the Children's Hospital.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.

name: City of Santa Ana Student Intern
org: City of Santa Ana Human Resources
what_you_do: Work in a city department. Go to quarterly workshops to build job skills. Build mentor ties with department leaders. The city lists a Student Intern level for people enrolled in high school.
deadline_text: The city recruits interns about once a year or as needed. No dates are listed on the page.

name: City of Santa Ana Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in City of Santa Ana departments. Fill out the volunteer handbook forms and apply through the city volunteer page. Some roles involve working with children.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Santa Ana Youth (SAY) Employment Program
org: Santa Ana WORK Center (City of Santa Ana)
what_you_do: Get a paid work placement with the city, a public agency or a local group. Selected participants work 15 to 20 hours a week.
deadline_text: The main program page says the city takes applications now, with no end date given. A separate interest page says the program is closed to new applications. The pages disagree, so we cannot say if it is open. Call (714) 565-2600 to confirm before applying.

name: Santa Ana Zoo Volunteers (including Zoo Buddies)
org: Santa Ana Zoo (City of Santa Ana)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the zoo, either as a short-term Zoo Greeter or in a long-term role. Younger teens can join as a Zoo Buddies pair with a parent or guardian.
deadline_text: No deadline. Long-term volunteers do an online and an in-person orientation offered every other month.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Santa Barbara Composite Squadron 131
org: Civil Air Patrol, Santa Barbara Composite Squadron 131
what_you_do: Join weekly squadron meetings. You get hands-on flight time, STEM projects and leadership milestones. Cadets can serve on search and rescue missions as a Ground Team Member or Mission Radio Operator. They can also help at community events.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact the squadron to schedule a visit.

name: Volunteer Program (Santa Barbara Humane Society)
what_you_do: Volunteer with dogs, cats, the clinic or outreach. You go through a virtual meeting, orientation and role training, then start solo shifts.
deadline_text: No deadline. The page says dog volunteer opportunities are full at the Santa Barbara campus, and says its animal volunteer positions are full at this time. If a role is full, the page offers a waitlist form.

name: Teaching Assistant Program (Santa Barbara Museum of Art)
what_you_do: Assist a Teaching Artist in art classes and camps for kids. You prepare materials. You help with hands-on art-making. You act as a role model. It includes an orientation and mentoring.
deadline_text: Winter After-School Class: apply by Dec 29, 2026 (confirmations Jan 5, 2027). Spring Camp: apply by Mar 15, 2027 (confirmations Mar 22, 2027).

name: Counselors in Training (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: You help run Nature Adventures summer camps for young children. The camps are at the Museum and Sea Center. You do crafts, exhibit visits and activities. You earn community service hours. You also learn to teach.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened April 1 and were due April 30, 2026. CIT training was June 12, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.

grades: Must be in 8th or 9th grade (or that age) to apply
name: Quasars to Sea Stars (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: This is a three-to-four year program for high school teens. It has museum studies classes and learning from scientists. It includes camping, field trips and volunteering. After 60 community service hours, you become a paid Museum employee.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications were due April 3, 2026, with in-person interviews in April and orientation week June 21-27, 2026. The page says applications for 2026 opened Feb 1, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.

name: VolunTEENS (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: You help guests at interpretive tables and science games. You work in the Museum's Backyard, Butterfly Pavilion or Observatory. Shifts are on summer weekends. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened April 1 and were due April 30, 2026. Training was May 16-17, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.

name: Junior Counselor Program (Parks and Recreation)
org: City of Santa Barbara Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You help summer camp counselors with daily activities. You earn volunteer service hours. You build leadership skills.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page. Use the Register link or call Parks and Recreation at 805-564-5418.

name: Parks and Recreation Seasonal Jobs (lifeguard, camp staff)
org: City of Santa Barbara Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: These are seasonal and part-time jobs. They help build workplace skills and experience. Titles include Lifeguard, Camp Counselor, Recreation Leader and Seasonal Program Staff.
deadline_text: No application window or 2026 hiring dates are posted on the program page. Current openings are on an external job board linked from the page.

name: Teen Job and Volunteer Fair (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: Meet local employers and nonprofits face to face. Look for summer jobs, internships and volunteer roles. A teen interview skills workshop is held the following week.
deadline_text: 2026 fair: Wednesday, April 15, 2026, 4:00 to 6:00 PM at Central Library (workshop April 22). The 2027 date is not posted; the library calls it annual.

grades: Book reviews: grades 7-12. Teen Advisory Board: high school students.
name: Teen Volunteering and Teen Advisory Board (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: You earn community service hours at the library. You can join Teen Volunteer Time. You can join the Teen Advisory Board to plan teen programs and shape the collection. You can also write book reviews.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board applications are taken at the start of each school term. Teen Volunteer Time and book reviews are ongoing.

name: Teens Teach Tech (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: You learn robotics and coding. Then you work in pairs. You plan and lead one robotics program for children. You plan and lead one for teens at the library. There are six programs in all.
deadline_text: Apply by Saturday, October 24, 2026.

name: Dual Enrollment (Santa Barbara City College)
what_you_do: You take real college courses while in high school. Santa Barbara and Carpinteria Unified students can take them at their high school. All high school and home school students can take them on the SBCC campus or online.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 dual enrollment registration began July 1. Deadlines for each term are on the Dual Enrollment calendar on the SBCC page.

name: Sea Center Volunteers (Ty Warner Sea Center)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History, Ty Warner Sea Center
what_you_do: Help guests at the Stearns Wharf aquarium meet live animals, from sea anemones to small sharks. You do hands-on demos and live animal talks. Teens 14 and up can earn service hours as exhibit interpreters.
deadline_text: The Museum's teen page says the Sea Center accepts volunteer applications year-round.

grades: 10th or 11th grade (outstanding 9th graders considered case by case)
name: Research Mentorship Program (UCSB Summer Sessions)
what_you_do: You do a college-level research project. A mentor helps you. The mentor can be a grad student, a postdoc or a faculty member. You go to a research talk series. You take part in university life for about seven weeks.
deadline_text: Application window Dec 15, 2026 to Mar 8, 2027. Reviews start in January and decisions are rolling.

name: Summer Research Academies (UCSB Summer Sessions)
what_you_do: You pick a research track in STEM, humanities or social sciences. You take a 4-unit university course. You build a research topic with an instructor. At the end, you present your findings at a capstone seminar.
deadline_text: Application window Dec 15, 2026 to Mar 22, 2027. Reviews start in January and decisions are rolling.

name: Volunteering with a Guardian (ages 13 to 17)
what_you_do: Help care for injured and orphaned wildlife at a rescue center, usually one 4-hour shift a week. A parent or guardian volunteers with you.
deadline_text: No dates posted. A mandatory orientation is required.

name: Santa Barbara Youth Council
what_you_do: Speak for teens to City Council and city departments, recommend youth programs and policies, and plan teen events. Meets twice a month.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 City advisory group recruitment: applications due Monday, October 19, 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applications are accepted year-round for future rounds.

name: Santa Barbara Zoo Jobs for Teens (Guest Experience Specialist and seasonal)
what_you_do: These are entry-level seasonal jobs. Examples are Guest Experience Specialist and Zoo Camp positions. The Zoo says most openings are for applicants 14 and older. It welcomes first-time workers for entry-level roles.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The Zoo says the busiest hiring is a month before spring and summer school breaks.

name: Zoo Teen Volunteers (Junior Camp Counselor, Leader in Training, Teen Conservation Club)
what_you_do: You help run Zoo Camp. You can be a Junior Camp Counselor or a Leader in Training. Or join the Teen Conservation Club. It has monthly meetings and conservation projects.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted. The Zoo volunteer page says it is not taking new volunteer recruitment applications at this time (that line sits in the adult sign-up steps), yet the teen sections still show application links. The Leader in Training dates (June 17 to Aug 23) have no year.

name: Santa Clara County Teen CERT Academy
what_you_do: You take a weekend emergency response course. It covers fire safety, search and rescue, stop the bleed and disaster psychology. After it, you can help your community in disasters. You can earn 20+ volunteer hours.
deadline_text: The newest date on the site is old or unclear. It shows an academy on January 8 to 10 with no year printed, and says the most recent academy was in March 2026. Join the waitlist to hear about the next one.

name: Santa Clara Youth Commission
what_you_do: You advise the City Council on issues that affect teens and help plan events like a 5K run. Fifteen teens serve, and the group meets monthly during the school year.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 recruitment is closed. The page does not give 2027-28 dates.

name: Santa Clarita Public Library Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: Teens give input to the library, meet other teens and can earn service hours. Meetings run September through May.
deadline_text: New members are always welcome. No deadline.

name: Young Curators
what_you_do: A free after school program. High school students write about art, learn about jobs in art and museums, and work together to put on an exhibit.
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the page.

name: Santa Fe YouthWorks Youth Corps and Job Training
what_you_do: Get paid job training in Santa Fe. Youth crews do work like fire danger reduction, river and watershed care, farming, construction and cooking. You build job skills and good work habits.
deadline_text: No dates on the program pages. The page says to connect with YouthWorks to learn about current offerings.

name: County Superintendent Student Advisory Council
what_you_do: Share your views on schools with the County Superintendent at meetings through the school year. You can present at County Board of Education meetings and go on school visits.
deadline_text: The page links a sign-up form but lists no dates or deadline.

name: Job Readiness Training and Paid Internships (Partners in Education)
org: Santa Barbara County Education Office, Partners in Education
what_you_do: Take a weekly job readiness class on resumes, money, networking and interviews, with a career coach. Finish it and you can apply for a paid internship.
deadline_text: Training sessions run Fall (Sept to Nov), Spring (Feb to Apr) and Summer (May to June). The page says the internship application is closed right now.

name: SBIFF 10-10-10 Student Filmmaking Program
what_you_do: For about five months you write or direct a short film with a college partner. The 10 films premiere at the historic Arlington Theatre during the festival. You study script writing, casting, cinematography, lighting, sound and editing.
deadline_text: Applications are closed now. The page says the 2027-28 round opens in spring. No deadline posted.

name: County of Santa Clara Intern and Earn
org: County of Santa Clara Employment Connection
what_you_do: You get an eight week paid county internship, plus job-readiness workshops, hiring events and coaching from an Employment Counselor. You work up to 30 hours a week.
deadline_text: Posted 2026 cohorts: Summer deadline May 20, program June 29 to Aug 7. Fall deadline Sept 19, program Oct 19 to Dec 11. The page also says it is accepting applications now; call to ask about the next cohort. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Santa Clara County Library District Teen Volunteers (tutor a K-6 student)
what_you_do: Teens 14 and older can volunteer at the Santa Clara County Library District. One job is tutoring a student after school. The student is in kindergarten through grade 6.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadline posted.

name: County of Santa Clara Student Internship Program (Level I, high school)
org: County of Santa Clara Employee Services Agency
what_you_do: High school students can work as paid student interns in county departments. They help professional staff. They work under close supervision. Tasks depend on the department.
grades: High school (regular, vocational or working toward equivalency)
deadline_text: No current posting for Level I. Subscribe to email alerts on the Student Intern, Level I job title or contact county departments. Applications are reviewed as departments ask and expire after 6 months.

name: Santa Clara County Library District Teen Volunteer Tutor
city: Campbell, Cupertino, Gilroy, Los Altos, Milpitas, Morgan Hill and Saratoga, CA
what_you_do: Teens tutor students in kindergarten to grade 6. They help with homework after school at a library. You can earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadline posted.

name: Student Advisory Trustee, Schaumburg Township District Library
what_you_do: This is a non-voting seat on the Library Board. You give feedback on teen programs. You speak for teens at Schaumburg, Conant and Hoffman Estates High Schools. You attend monthly Board meetings. You help with at least two library events.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application period ended August 9, 2026. The page gives no 2027 application dates.

name: Volunteer Squad (summer teen volunteers)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library over the summer. High school students can earn service hours. The library also keeps a list of volunteer options in the community.
deadline_text: The page says opportunities are posted in the spring and take place over the summer. No dates are given for 2027.

name: Aquatics and Seasonal Park Jobs
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at district pools and The Water Works as a lifeguard, swim instructor or concession worker. Paid lifeguard CPR and AED training is provided. Other seasonal park and recreation jobs are on the district job board.
deadline_text: The newest date on the page is old. The latest job fair post is dated February 18, 2025, and lists fairs on March 19, April 16 and May 8, 2025 at the Community Recreation Center, 505 N. Springinsguth Road. No newer fair dates are posted. Ask the district or check its job board for current openings.

name: Science Center of Iowa Junior Camp Counselor and Volunteers
what_you_do: Junior Camp Counselors volunteer with the Science Center's science camps. They are ages 14 to 18. General volunteers are also welcome.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. Summer 2027 applications open in February 2027. No closing date is posted.

name: Sacramento County Office of Education Career Technical Education
what_you_do: Through the Sacramento County Office of Education, you can take career technical education courses in 15 industry sectors. The courses mix technical training with academics. The course catalog is posted online.
deadline_text: Course catalog online; no student deadline posted on the page.

name: Teen Volunteers at Scottsdale Public Library
what_you_do: Help at the library and earn documented volunteer hours. Some teens are Reading Buddies who work closely with school-age children over the summer.
deadline_text: School year: fill out the interest form on the program page. Summer applications are open April 1 to 30 (Civic Center and Mustang libraries only). Summer 2026 applications have ended.

name: Scottsdale Teen Employment Program (STEP)
org: City of Scottsdale, Vista Career Center
what_you_do: Get one-on-one job help from a teen employment specialist. They help with your resume, practice interviews, and job search. They give job referrals when they can.
deadline_text: No deadline. Make an appointment any time. The fall and spring job skills events are postponed.

name: Volunteer Program (ages 15 and up)
city: San Diego County, CA (La Jolla, Encinitas, San Diego, Chula Vista)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Scripps hospital in a regular weekly shift. You help patients and visitors. Open to teens 15 and older.
deadline_text: South region (Scripps Mercy San Diego and Chula Vista): reviewed on an ongoing basis. North region (Scripps Memorial La Jolla and Encinitas, Scripps Green): applications open the first business day of April (May orientation) and of October (November orientation); applications sent outside those periods are not reviewed.

name: Santa Clara Valley Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: You staff the hospital information desks or the volunteer office for your first 100 hours. Then you move to an area you like. After 6 months and 100 hours you can ask about shadowing.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Applications are accepted online year-round, and the office is looking for weekday morning or afternoon shifts.

name: Teen Council
what_you_do: Work with museum staff and other teens to share ideas, shape community programs and plan a hands-on art-making workshop. Meets monthly.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 application closed Oct 1, 2026 and the first meeting is Oct 14, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted; expect a similar fall cycle.

name: ANEW Construction Trades Training (teens with disabilities)
city: Washington (site not stated on the page)
what_you_do: A 40 hour paid training in building jobs for students with disabilities. ANEW runs it with a state job help office. Students earn a certificate.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The 2026 application deadline was April 30, with notice in early June. No 2027 dates are posted.

grades: 9 to 12 (high school, Running Start, GED or homeschool)
name: Youth Ocean Advocates
what_you_do: Teen volunteers teach visitors about marine life and ocean protection. They join projects like beach cleanups and community science. They get behind-the-scenes tours. They get about 20 hours of training.
deadline_text: School Year 2026-27 Currents interest form is closed. The page says to check back in February 2027 for the Summer 2027 interest form (its general timeline says January; confirm with the Aquarium). Info sessions run over Zoom in March (summer) and September (school year).

name: Teen Arts Group (TAG)
what_you_do: Learn how an art museum works, from planning shows to caring for art. Lead tours, post on social media, plan Teen Night Out and other events, and make your own art.
deadline_text: The page says the application deadline is typically in May. No 2027 date is posted.

name: YouthForce Teen Jobs
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of King County
what_you_do: Teens get job skills workshops on resumes, interviews and money. Then they get paid internships with local employers. TeamWork Internships are paid game day jobs at Mariners, Kraken and Seahawks games.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page has an Apply button for TeamWork internships and a resume help form.

name: Voices in Science: Burke-ology (high school)
what_you_do: Free sessions where high school students study one science, such as ancient plants or fish. Teens tour behind the scenes at the Burke collections. They speak at a public STEAM Spotlight Symposium.
deadline_text: Applications for the spring 2026 session are closed. Future dates are not posted; the Burke asks teens to join its Youth and Family Programs e-newsletter.

name: Seattle Children's Hospital Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Weekly volunteer shifts at the hospital and regional clinics. Roles vary; see the position summaries on the volunteer site.
deadline_text: The volunteer portal says applications open each March, July and November and stay open until positions are filled. None of those windows is open as of Oct 11; the next one is November.

name: Research Training Program for High School Students
what_you_do: Four weeks of hands-on biology lab training in downtown Seattle. Teens learn lab skills like PCR and gene editing. They join workshops on college and careers. They present a project of their own.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed March 8, 2026 (letters due March 29). The page says to check back in late 2026 for summer 2027.

name: Youth Voice Research Liaison Program
what_you_do: Paid training in how research works, then teens consult with Seattle Children's research teams. They give feedback on study plans and outreach and help share results in youth-friendly ways.
deadline_text: No application cycle for 2026-27. The next cycle is 2027-28 and dates are not posted. (The 2025-26 deadline was Sept 1, 2025.)

name: Clean Water Ambassadors Internship
org: Mountains to Sound Greenway Trust with King County Wastewater Treatment Division
what_you_do: Learn about clean water, teach students, interview people who work in environmental jobs, and give a final presentation. Field trips and workshops are part of it.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran April 1 to 22, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Seattle Fire Cadet Program (Company 511)
what_you_do: Train on Saturdays at the fire department training facility to learn what firefighting is like. You get a helmet, coat, pants, boots and gloves for training.
deadline_text: Applications accepted all year. Apply Feb 1 to July 31 and hear back in August. Apply Aug 1 to Jan 31 and hear back in February.

grades: Entering senior year (the page also says 'between 11th and 12th grade')
name: Fred Hutch Summer High School Internship Program (SHIP)
what_you_do: This is eight weeks of paid, full-time lab work. The first two weeks teach lab safety and technique. Then you spend six weeks in a Fred Hutch research group. You go to seminars and college and career workshops. You end with a presentation.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says information on the 2027 program will be posted in November 2026.

name: YESS Restoration Ecology Internship (Riverview and WANIC)
org: Mountains to Sound Greenway Trust, Riverview School District and WANIC Skill Center
city: Carnation, WA and field sites in King County
what_you_do: Work outdoors on projects that heal land across King County. Take a summer Restoration Ecology course. Build skills in plant ID and public speaking. Give a talk on your final project.
grades: Rising 9th to 12th graders (rising 12th graders get first priority)
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 24 to April 23, 2026 on the WANIC summer course site. Next year not posted.

name: Harborview Volunteer Services
what_you_do: Teens 16 and 17 help at the front desk and in the room where patients wait to go home. Adults 18 and up can also help in patient units and clinics.
deadline_text: The 2026 volunteer application is closed. The page gives no reopening date; you can sign up to be told when it reopens.

name: Henry Teen Art Collective
what_you_do: A weekly group of teens. They go behind the scenes at the museum and meet artists and creative workers. They make projects like zines, art shows and videos.
deadline_text: The newest date on the page is old. The only call for applications listed is for 2023-24, with a deadline of October 10, 2023. No newer call is posted. Ask the museum if a new call is open.

name: History Lab
what_you_do: A two week summer program at the history museum. Teens learn how to research and tell local history. Then they publish their own project on the Rainy Day History website.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was May 22, 2026 and has passed. The page says to check back in spring 2027.

name: MOPOP Youth Advisory Board (YAB)
what_you_do: Help shape the museum's teen programs. Work with local musicians, artists and curators, screen Sound Off! music showcase entries, help run events like the Science Fiction + Fantasy Short Film Festival, and make social media posts.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page gives no date for the next call.

name: Seattle Counselor In Training (CIT) Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a summer day camp. All-Time Belayers belay and coach campers on climbing walls. Junior Counselors work with a mentor counselor, help keep a camp group safe and co-lead games and activities.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 open in March 2027 (no exact day posted). Summer 2026 applications are closed.

name: Youth Volunteer (ages 16 to 17)
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help visitors at the air and space museum. Roles include guiding tours, helping with school trips, and acting out history with costumes and props. Open roles are listed on the page.
deadline_text: Roles are recruited by season. No single deadline. Browse current roles and apply online.

name: Career Explorations (Mentorship and Internship)
what_you_do: Teens do a 4 Saturday job training and mentor program. Then they can apply for a paid summer internship with Seattle Parks. Interns work 20 hours a week for 8 weeks, for example on summer meals and playgrounds.
deadline_text: Page says mentorship applications opened in August 2026. Mentorship starts the first Saturday of October, November, February, March and April. No close date stated.

name: Seattle Parks and Recreation Lifeguard
what_you_do: You watch swimmers. You respond to emergencies. You help teach swim skills. This is at city swim beaches and indoor and outdoor pools.
deadline_text: The last posting closed June 16, 2026. The Aquatics page says Temporary/Intermittent Lifeguards are hired year-round, even when no posting is active.

name: Seattle Parks Summer Temporary Jobs
what_you_do: Work a city summer job such as wading pool attendant, aquatics customer service, boat ramp ranger or lifeguard. Some jobs are mostly weekends and some include first aid training.
deadline_text: 2026 postings closed between May 12 and June 16, 2026 (page updated April 14, 2026). 2027 postings not posted.

name: Teen Late Night Internship
what_you_do: Interns help run Late Night teen events at Seattle teen life centers and community centers. They check teens in. They help with games, contests, community dinners and service projects.
deadline_text: Applications for the January to June cohort open in December. Applications for the June to December cohort open in May. Exact close dates are not stated.

name: Teen Summer Musical
what_you_do: A summer theater program where youth rehearse and perform a full musical (Peter Pan in 2026). The program is aimed at youth of color. Rehearsals ran June 29 to Aug 27 in 2026, with shows Aug 28 to 30.
deadline_text: 2026 auditions were April 17 and 18. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Seattle Parks Youth Employment and Service Learning: Pre-Employment Training
what_you_do: A 7-week, 14-hour after-school job readiness class (resume writing, time management, professional communication) at Teen Life Centers or community centers. Finishing it unlocks Parks paid internships.
deadline_text: Offered each Fall, Winter and Spring quarter. The page does not list current dates, so email to ask.

name: Seattle Police Explorers
what_you_do: Learn how police work through monthly meetings and visits to units like K-9 and Harbor Patrol. Volunteer at community events, such as directing traffic and security work. Uniforms are provided.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Explorers meet monthly.

name: PV Events Fellowship
what_you_do: Lead the planning of Girlvolution, a youth arts and social justice event, with training, a mentor and a $5,000 event budget. Also help run 3 other community events.
deadline_text: Applications closed for 2026. The page says to check back next year. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Healing Justice Fellowship
what_you_do: Support peers, help build a healing justice curriculum and help plan the Healing Justice Summit. You work with a team of staff, mental health providers and community partners.
deadline_text: Applications closed for 2026. The page says to check back next year. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital with training for your role. You do about 48 hours over roughly 3 months with at least one 3 to 4 hour shift a week.
deadline_text: No application dates are listed. The page says to apply through the online form.

name: Puget Sound Skills Center
org: Puget Sound Skills Center (Highline Public Schools)
what_you_do: Spend half your school day in a hands-on career class such as aerospace manufacturing, dental assisting, certified nursing assistant, video game programming, auto, construction or cyber security. 21 programs.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 lottery has run and all offers have been made. The admissions page asks students still interested in 2026-27 to complete the PSSC Application interest form. The 2027-28 window is not posted.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program
city: Seattle, WA (serves SW and SE Seattle and South King County)
what_you_do: A 6-week paid summer internship for 20 teens. Interns explore career paths, take field trips, hear guest speakers and work on personal growth.
grades: Entering 9th grade (fall 2026) through high school seniors (Class of 2030)
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened in April 2026. Close date not stated. 2027 dates not posted.

name: SCA Seattle High School Conservation Crews (Urban Green)
what_you_do: Work on a crew led by two adult Crew Leaders. You do parks and nature projects. There are field trips to learn about the earth across western Washington.
deadline_text: Not posted; the page is about a past season, call to ask.

name: SDOT Youth Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Visit transportation sites, meet people in planning, engineering and communications, job shadow, and build resume and interview skills. Learn about advocacy for fair transportation.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed June 16, 2026. Program ran Aug 4 to 27, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Enrolled in high school (classes of 2027 to 2030)

what_you_do: Work part time at a local nonprofit for the summer. TIPS hires you and places you based on your interests, such as a camp, an arts group or a food bank.

deadline_text: TeenTix's Program Applications page says: Applications for 2026/27 programs are now closed! Applications for the 2027-2028 program year will open in Spring 2027.

name: Rainier Beach Youth Stewards
what_you_do: Work at the Rainier Beach Urban Farm and Wetlands. You help heal the wetland and teach about the farm. You also do team building, field trips and workshops.
deadline_text: Dates and deadline not posted on the page. Applicants are encouraged to apply for all seasons.

grades: Washington high school students in 10th or 11th grade when applying (rising juniors and seniors)

name: Engineering Academy

what_you_do: A summer-only volunteer program for high school students. You serve the hospital community and see health care careers up close. New UWMC volunteers start as patient escorts who greet and guide patients and visitors.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. For the 2027 program, the page says to check back in early spring (March) 2027.

grades: Grades 11 and 12 for full-year classes. Summer semester: students entering grades 9 to 12.

deadline_text: No dates posted. The page says registration typically opens in the spring and is first come, first served. Email the museum to ask about info sessions.

grades: Entering 10th to 12th grade in the fall of the program year (2026 page)
name: Woodland Park Zoo Teen Ambassador Volunteer Program

deadline_text: 2026 cohort: application deadline Friday, March 27, 2026, 5:00 pm; Q&A sessions in March; interviews mid-April; decisions early May. 2027 dates are not posted.

grades: Grades 6 to 12 for monthly service projects

what_you_do: Be a role model and lead campers in grades 1 to 8 through crafts, STEM, archery, hikes and outdoor games at a local YMCA summer day camp.

name: WAGES Ten Week Internship Program

deadline_text: No dates posted. The page appears out of date (it mentions a 2025 event), so ask about the next cohort.

A free open house is Wednesday, Oct 14, 6:00 to 7:30 pm at the East Madison YMCA, no RSVP. The Oct 8 open house has passed. No sign-up deadline is stated.

name: Job Training Program (Photography)

deadline_text: No deadline. Take a class first, then ask about jobs.

grades: Programs for ages 6 to 18; stipended roles for grades 8 to 12
deadline_text: No dates posted. Check the 826 Valencia program calendar.

deadline_text: The summer 2026 application is closed. The page says the summer 2027 application launches in early 2027; exact dates not posted.

name: Careers in Science (CiS) Intern Program
what_you_do: You do a paid, year-round internship that lasts 2 to 3 years. You do fieldwork, teach visitors and join research projects after school and on Saturdays.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says to check back in February 2027; closing date not posted.

name: CCSF Dual Enrollment (free college classes)

what_you_do: Take free City College classes while in high school and earn both high school and college credit.

deadline_text: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, 12:00 to 4:00 p.m. at Stonestown Galleria.

name: High School Elections Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Learn how to plan and run pre-registration events that help 16 and 17 year olds sign up to vote. Includes an in-person training and a mentor from the Department of Elections.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed (the round ran Sept 14 to 27, 2026). The program runs twice a year, in April and September. Spring 2027 dates are not posted.

deadline_text: School-year applications are typically posted in July and summer applications in March. Closing dates are not stated.

name: San Francisco Fire Youth Academy

deadline_text: The academy's site shows no class dates or deadline. The newest deadline found is old: a news article from 2025 reported an Aug 11, 2025 deadline for the fall class. Ask the academy if applications are open.

name: Girls on the Run Bay Area Junior Coach

what_you_do: You coach elementary and middle school girls. The program covers running and life skills. You are a junior coach. You work 1.5 to 3 hours a week for 8 to 10 weeks.
deadline_text: The fall Junior Coach application was due Aug 26 (season started early September; 5K on Nov 14, 2026). The page lists no spring Junior Coach dates. A banner about Spring 2027 is for site registration, not Junior Coach applications.

name: Mission Bit Free Coding Classes
what_you_do: You can take free semester-long coding classes. You can take computer science classes too. Classes are in person or remote. There are also workshops, self-paced courses and events.

name: California Pre-Register to Vote (ages 16 and 17)
what_you_do: Sign up early so you are on the voter list the day you turn 18. Pairs well with the SF elections ambassador program.

name: YEP! Youth Employment Program

It gives only the month each window opens, not exact dates, and does not say whether Session 2 applications are open today. Check SchooLinks.

name: Jobs 253 Summer Credential Programs
what_you_do: Free summer training from experts. The 2026 page lists courses in cars, cooking, digital drawing, business starts, plumbing, building, drones and wildland fire. Students earn credentials.
deadline_text: The auto course priority deadline was April 30. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Youth Coalition Member (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps)
org: Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico
what_you_do: Join the Youth Coalition Member job in Taos, NM. It is part of the Prevention Program.
deadline_text: The job runs from Oct 9, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027. The apply page does not give a last day to apply.

name: Dual Enrollment at Technical College System of Georgia colleges
org: Technical College System of Georgia (including Atlanta Technical College)
what_you_do: Take college and career courses at a technical college while in high school and earn high school and college credit at the same time. Funding covers tuition, fees and books for the first 30 hours.
deadline_text: Each college sets deadlines. Atlanta Technical College lists June 1 for fall, Nov 1 for spring and April 1 for summer (no year stated).

name: The Tech Interactive Teen Volunteer Program (Holiday Helper)
what_you_do: Teen volunteers lead hands-on science, tech and art activities for museum visitors. This is during the holiday season. Volunteers complete six shifts. Each shift is 3 to 4 hours.
deadline_text: The official page gives no application dates as of Oct 9, 2026.

name: Teen Line Volunteer Listener (peer hotline)
org: Teen Line, a program of Didi Hirsch Mental Health Services
what_you_do: Teens train to give peer support to other teens by hotline, text and email. Adult mental health pros guide the work.
deadline_text: The page says applications are due "Monday September 8, 2026 by 5pm" (that date is a Tuesday, so confirm the day), which has now passed. Training runs three times a year (Fall, Spring, Summer). Next dates are not posted; the page has an email interest list for future applications.

name: Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help shape what the library offers for teens and earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due no later than August 21, 2026. Next year's date is not posted.

name: High School Internship in Cybersecurity Research
org: ASU Center for Cybersecurity and Trusted Foundations
what_you_do: Do about 8 weeks of cybersecurity research on the ASU Tempe campus. You work 15 to 20 hours a week and meet in person each week.
deadline_text: Not offered in summer 2026 (paused). Planned to relaunch in summer 2027. No dates or opening posted.

name: Tennessee 4-H Roundup and All Star Conference
what_you_do: High school 4-H members compete in project judging. They go to workshops and a career fair. They do service and leadership tasks. They also vote in 4-H state council elections.
deadline_text: Registration day is Monday, July 19, 2027. Roundup ends Thursday evening, July 22, 2027.

name: Tennessee 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or project through your county Extension office. Teens can do projects and camps. They can lead and serve their community. They can also run for state leader jobs.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Sign up through your county Extension office.

name: Tennessee FFA
what_you_do: FFA is part of your farm and food class. Members build leadership and job skills. They do chapter events, contests, camps and a state convention.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join through your school's agricultural education class.

grades: Next year's high school juniors and seniors
name: Tennessee Forestry Camp
org: Tennessee Forestry Association with the Tennessee Department of Agriculture and Tennessee FFA
city: Pikeville, TN (Fall Creek Falls State Park)
what_you_do: Spend a week outdoors with pro foresters. Learn to name trees, measure them, use a compass and count steps. Learn about wildlife, fire safety, water quality and GPS maps.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was May 31 to June 5, 2026 with applications due May 8. 60 campers are accepted first come, first served by postmark. 2027 dates were not posted on the program page.

name: Tennessee Leadership Summit
org: Tennessee Farm Bureau Federation and UT Herbert College of Agriculture
what_you_do: Spend a week in UT dorms. You meet student leaders from across Tennessee. You learn about leading, teamwork, service and Tennessee farming. The week ends with a banquet on Friday.
deadline_text: Summit is May 31 to June 4, 2027. The page says the application is coming soon. No deadline is posted.

name: WIOA Youth Program (Workforce Essentials)
org: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Workforce Essentials
what_you_do: Get help with career ideas. The program can also help you find work experience. It can help with job training. It can help with a Registered Apprenticeship.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.

name: Model United Nations (YMCA of Middle Tennessee)
org: YMCA of Middle Tennessee, Center for Civic Engagement
what_you_do: Play a delegate for a United Nations member country. Write and debate world resolutions. High school students can also join the Security Council. They can lead teams. They can argue cases in the International Court of Justice.
deadline_text: High school conferences in Murfreesboro: Nov 6 to 8, Nov 13 to 15 and Nov 20 to 22, 2026. Middle school one-day events: Chattanooga Oct 22, Murfreesboro Nov 16, Memphis Dec 2, 2026. No registration deadline is posted.

name: Youth in Government (YMCA of Middle Tennessee)
org: YMCA of Middle Tennessee, Center for Civic Engagement
what_you_do: Act as a state senator or representative. Write mock bills and debate in committees at the State Capitol. High school students can also serve as lobbyists, Supreme Court lawyers or judges, press corps or heads of state offices.
deadline_text: 2027 high school conferences: Capitol Conference Feb 25 to 28, Tristar Conference Apr 8 to 11, Volunteer Conference Apr 15 to 18. Middle school: Chattanooga Mar 11 and 12 (other dates not posted yet). No registration deadline is posted.

name: Texas 4-H
what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club and pick at least one project. Take part in club meetings, events and contests. The program offers hands-on leadership, community service and career discovery.
deadline_text: Enroll by October 31 for the lower fee ($25). After that the fee is $30 until the end of the 4-H year. Memberships reset every August 15.

name: Texas 4-H Ambassador Teams
what_you_do: High school 4-H members can join a state ambassador team. There are teams for livestock, horses, poultry, water, science, photos, fashion and room design, shooting sports, and healthy living.
deadline_text: Each team posts its own dates. Examples on the page: Fashion and Interior Design March 1 to 31, 2026. STEM July 1 to 31. Shooting Sports opens June 1. Photography opens in spring.

name: Texas 4-H Council
what_you_do: Speak for the Texas 4-H program across the state. Work with Extension staff to plan and run events. Seats go to district delegates from the twelve AgriLife Extension districts. There are also six At-Large Delegates.
deadline_text: 2026 Council training was July 27 to 30, 2026 in College Station. Ask your District 4-H Specialist for the district application deadline. The page does not list an At-Large deadline.

name: Texas Boys State
org: The American Legion, Department of Texas
what_you_do: Spend a week running a pretend city, county and state government. You join one of two practice political parties, run for office, hear speakers and debate.
grades: Just finished 11th grade, with at least one semester of high school left
deadline_text: 2027 dates and the application deadline are not posted on the program pages. The 2026 session ran June 7 to 12, 2026. The site shows an Applications Now Open banner, but it posts no deadline or 2027 dates, so ask your school and local Post.

name: American Legion Auxiliary Texas Bluebonnet Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Texas
what_you_do: Spend a week at Texas Lutheran University in a pretend 51st state. You set up your own city, county and state governments and take a trip to the State Capitol.
grades: Junior year (11th grade) of high school
deadline_text: 2027 dates are not posted. In 2026, units could reserve spots Feb 1 to May 1 and schools Feb 15 to May 1. The page says spots fill fast, so act quickly.

name: Texas Brigades Camps (Cadet)
city: Camps across Texas (Rising Star, La Pryor, McCoy, Freer, Santa Anna, Garwood, Anahuac)
what_you_do: Spend five days at a wildlife and land stewardship leadership camp. Past camps covered bobwhite quail, deer, bass, ranching, waterfowl and coastal wildlife.
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Nov 1, 2026 and close March 15, 2027. The 2026 camps ran June 7 to Aug 1, 2026.

name: Texas ChalleNGe Academy
what_you_do: Live on the Eagle Lake campus in a free residential program for teens who are disengaged from school. After the on-campus phase there is a follow-up phase with a mentor.
deadline_text: Recruitment is open now for the January 2027 cohort. Classes start in January and July. The application cutoff is normally no later than 30 days before class starts (so about early December 2026 for January 2027).

name: Summer Junior Volunteer Program (North Austin)
what_you_do: This is four weeks of full-day volunteering at a children's hospital. You take three to four assignments a day. Examples are a tea cart, craft cart, library, physical therapy and supply chain. You also get a lunch and learn.
grades: Enrolled in high school for the following school year
deadline_text: The 2026 application opened Monday Feb 9 and closed Friday Feb 13, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Texas DECA (high school)
org: Texas DECA, chartered association of DECA Inc.
what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter to build business and marketing skills. Take part in DECA programs and contests. Texas DECA runs a yearly state career development conference.
deadline_text: Membership deadlines come from your chapter advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 25 to 27, 2027 at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston.

name: Texas Envirothon
org: Environmental Institute of Houston, University of Houston-Clear Lake
city: Statewide, TX (state event in Nacogdoches in 2026)
what_you_do: Teams of five high school students study soils, water life, wildlife, forestry and a current issue. They take field tests and give an oral presentation at the state contest.
deadline_text: 2026 state event: March 28 to 30, 2026 in Nacogdoches. Page says registration opens in 2026 with the deadline to be announced.

name: Texas FFA Association
what_you_do: Take an agricultural science class at school and join your local FFA chapter. FFA is a student-led leadership group. Members earn degrees and can join contests, speaking events and leadership programs.
grades: Agricultural science classes start no earlier than 7th grade. Junior FFA starts at 3rd grade.
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.

name: Texas HOSA Future Health Professionals
what_you_do: Join a HOSA chapter at your school to explore health careers. Texas HOSA runs a state leadership conference each year. Membership comes through school chapters.
grades: Middle school grades 6 to 8, and high school (secondary) students
deadline_text: No membership deadlines or conference dates are on the program pages. Ask your advisor for dates.

name: Texas State Parks Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Texas state park. Jobs include special events, gift shop and office help, trail and grounds work, plant restoration, and leading tours and nature programs.
deadline_text: Apply any time. Openings are listed in the online portal.

name: REACT @ TAMU Chemistry (summer research training)
org: Texas A&M University, Department of Chemistry
what_you_do: Spend part of the summer on campus in a hands-on chemistry research training program. Up to 20 students learn lab skills, see research demos and prepare for chemistry research in high school.
grades: High school students (the 2026 page says as of Fall 2026)
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens Jan 19, 2027. No closing date is posted. In 2026, students were notified April 24, 2026.

name: Summer Earn and Learn (SEAL) for students with disabilities
org: Texas Workforce Commission, Vocational Rehabilitation, with local workforce boards
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job placement of at least five weeks. You earn a paycheck while learning new skills and gaining work experience.
deadline_text: No dates for summer 2027 are posted on the program pages. It is a summer program. Ask your local office in the fall or winter.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, Texas Wing
what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aerospace and STEM, fitness and character. Cadets can go to summer and winter encampments. They can take part in real Civil Air Patrol missions.
deadline_text: Join any time. Attend three squadron meetings first.

name: Texas Youth Range Workshop
org: Texas Section, Society for Range Management
what_you_do: High school students spend a week at the Texas Tech University Center in Junction. They learn about grassland, plants, soil and wildlife on Texas ranches.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop was June 21 to 26, 2026. The 2026 deadline and 2027 dates were not posted on the program page.

name: Growing Leaders (Thanksgiving Point)
what_you_do: Teens help with learning activities, help with events and learn leadership. They gain experience in teaching, event planning and customer service. They work with staff and volunteers.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: SheTech Internship (Thanksgiving Point)
what_you_do: High school girls do real STEM projects. Topics include insects, exhibit design, wetland repair, growing plants in water, coding lessons and school programs.
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not posted on the page.

what_you_do: This Evanston group links students to local firms and to job training. You learn skilled trades. Trades include plumbing, HVAC and automotive. Others are electrical, aviation and manufacturing. Students meet business owners. The owners can help start careers.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Library Volunteer and Teen Volunteer
org: Topeka and Shawnee County Public Library
what_you_do: Volunteers help at library events. They help with crafts or storytelling for kids. They also do clerical work, help in the Friends Booktique and book sale, and greet visitors. The page also lists a Teen Volunteer path for learning job skills.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The library keeps an application on file for 30 days; apply again if you have not heard back.

name: EcoClub (grades 5 to 12)
what_you_do: EcoClub is for students in grades 5 to 12. The club meets on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of the month at the zoo.

what_you_do: Volunteer at Tracy Aviary. Help with ongoing jobs at the aviary, and meet people who share an interest in birds. Group projects are mostly outdoors.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: TreePeople Volunteer Events (all ages with parent consent)

deadline_text: 2026 cycle: opened Nov 15, 2025, closed Feb 2, 2026, job ran June 1 to July 17, 2026. The page says 2027 details are coming later.

org: City of Dublin, with San Ramon, Pleasanton, Danville and the Dublin/San Ramon Women's Club

what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about animals, nature and the earth on Zoo grounds. Teens manage their own schedules.

what_you_do: Do a 7 week research project in a University of Arizona science lab. A scientist is your mentor. Earn 3 units of college credit.

name: Disadvantaged High School Student Summer Research Program
org: University of Arizona College of Medicine, Tucson
what_you_do: Work as a paid summer research helper. It is at the University of Arizona College of Medicine in Tucson. The research is medical.

org: Tucson Village Farm, Pima County Cooperative Extension, University of Arizona
what_you_do: Be a teen leader who promotes healthy habits and caring for the earth. Do hands-on projects. Go to monthly meetings at the farm. Do community service.
deadline_text: Registration closed October 1, 2026. The required info meeting was September 24, 2026. Next year not posted.

name: Tustin Counselor in Training (C.I.T.) Program
org: City of Tustin Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Help staff at the city summer day camps. You supervise kids, lead games and crafts, and enforce camp rules. You work in the sun and walk and run with the kids.

name: Tustin Police Explorer Post 615
what_you_do: Get an inside look at police work. You can ride along with officers, see K-9 work and get firearms training.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Meetings are held every Wednesday at 6 p.m.

org: City of Tustin Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Volunteer to help supervise kids and run games and crafts. You also help at city events like Tustin Tiller Days, Halloween Howl and the Holiday Tree Lighting. You build leadership skills.
deadline_text: In the 2026 cycle, applications opened April 1, 2026 and closed May 1, 2026. The interview day was May 23, 2026. The next dates are not posted.

name: Summer Speech and Debate Camps (high school)
what_you_do: Debate and speech camps at Augsburg. They cover policy, Lincoln-Douglas, Congress, Public Forum and speech. There is also a workshop on speaking up for a community issue.
deadline_text: 2026 early bird ended March 29; scholarship priority deadline March 1 and last call May 10, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Minnesota Business Venture (MBV)
what_you_do: Teams build a made-up product and business plan, then pitch it Shark Tank style at the end of the week. Includes speakers, mock interviews and breakouts.
deadline_text: MBV 2027 dates are not posted yet. The site says to check back.

name: Production Job Shadowing
what_you_do: Shadow a team that helps put on a show, such as stage management, lights or sound. You learn how a show is made.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.

name: Nature Walk Summer Teen Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help visitors connect with Como's animals and plants and learn to care about nature. The program also builds work experience and job skills.
deadline_text: The page says applications are no longer being accepted for this summer. Next dates are not posted.

name: Conservation Corps Youth Education: Youth Interns
what_you_do: Learn about nature and caring for natural areas. Build outdoor skills. Finish community projects with a crew led by young adults. You are based at a nature center or park in the Twin Cities area.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted for summer 2027. The page lists 2026 home bases only.

name: Cookie Cart Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Teens start with a 90 day work readiness internship, then can interview for the paid Bakery Program, where you earn while you learn. Cart Captains get a raise.
deadline_text: The page says applications are always accepted. Session dates are not posted.

name: Design Camp
what_you_do: A four day summer design camp at Dunwoody for high school students. It includes lunch, supplies and a field trip.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed July 13, 2026. The page says summer 2027 details are expected in January or February 2027.

name: Pathways to Careers (youth chapter)
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors join monthly workshops and a 3 week summer experience. It has job site visits, hands-on projects and mentoring. Students who enroll at Dunwoody can get a scholarship.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed (the deadline was April 19). The page says Fall 2027 applications open in early fall; no date posted yet. Online info sessions Nov 5, Dec 3, 2026 and Jan 7, Feb 4, Mar 4, Apr 8, 2027 (RSVP required).

name: Genesys Works Twin Cities (training and paid internship)
what_you_do: Students finish 8 weeks of summer training in IT, business and work skills. Then they work a paid, year-long internship at a partner company. They get college and career coaching.
grades: Junior year per the FAQ (apply in fall or winter of junior year). The application page says rising senior. Ask which grade.
deadline_text: No date is posted. Students apply in fall or winter of junior year and the process finishes in the spring.

name: Student Summer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teen volunteers work one weekday shift a week at the children's hospital in downtown Saint Paul. They work on their own. They are at ease around patients with disabilities and complex medical needs.
deadline_text: The page says applications for summer 2026 are closed. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.

name: Girls Inc. Eureka! STEM program (YWCA Minneapolis)
org: Girls Inc. at YWCA Minneapolis, with University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering
what_you_do: Join a five year STEM program. It has summer camp at the University of Minnesota and YWCA Midtown, plus school year support. You explore STEM careers and meet mentors. In high school you can do a stipend internship.
grades: Grades 8 to 12 (the University of Minnesota page says students entering grades 8 and 9 can apply)
deadline_text: The 2026 summer dates were June 29 to July 24, 2026 (no camp July 4). The page says registration is currently closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Microscope Adventure Summer Camp
what_you_do: A weeklong day camp. You use light microscopes and Hamline's scanning electron microscope. Then you make microscope images in teams and show them.
deadline_text: Registration opens Monday, Oct 26, 2026. Scholarship application due March 30, 2027 (supporting documents due April 15, 2027).

name: HealthPartners volunteer program for high school students
what_you_do: High school volunteers work weekly shifts of two to four hours in HealthPartners hospitals and clinics. You get training in your department first.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The process takes about 3 to 4 weeks.

city: Minneapolis, Saint Paul and Bloomington, MN
what_you_do: One on one career coaching, job and resume help, and help applying for partner employers' internships and jobs. Hired does not run internships itself. Also help with a diploma or GED, skills training and life skills.
deadline_text: The page does not state an application deadline. Staff aim to follow up quickly after you send the referral form.

name: JXTALabs Paid Apprenticeships
what_you_do: Young artists work on paid projects for clients in studios. The studios are for graphic design, modern art or environmental design. Working artists, designers and architects train you.
deadline_text: No deadlines are posted.

what_you_do: A 10 week drawing and design course taught by working artists. Finishing one session lets you interview for paid JXTALabs apprenticeships, which start at age 14.
deadline_text: Sessions: fall Sept 16 to Nov 20, 2026 (Tue and Thu, 4:00 to 6:30 pm) and winter Jan 6 to Mar 12, 2027. Summer 2026 ran June 23 to Aug 27. The page does not post an application deadline or registration dates.

name: High school volunteer program

deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.

name: Minneapolis Parks Teen Teamworks
what_you_do: Do work experiences with the Park Board. They teach work skills, decision making, communication and a good work ethic. Photo captions on the page show crews doing garden, painting and sign install projects.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 season are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Minneapolis Park Board Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Serve on a youth council. It gives feedback on Park Board programs and processes. Members plan community events and build leadership and research skills. They explore careers. They help guide anti-violence outreach.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the council page.

name: Minnesota ACE Camp (Aviation Career Education)
what_you_do: A one week aviation career camp for high school students in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul area. Each of two sessions is limited to 30 students.
deadline_text: The page says the window is open each year from Feb 1 to April 1. 2027 is not posted yet. Aid decisions come in April.

grades: Entering 9 to 12 (page also says current 8th to 11th)
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 1, 2027 and are reviewed as they arrive. Aid offers start May 1.

name: Open Arms youth volunteering
what_you_do: Teens help in the kitchen, on the farms, or on meal deliveries. You work with Open Arms staff after an orientation.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for an orientation.

deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

name: Ecosystems of STEM Careers High School Internship
